hook.name: BunniHook

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: GlueHook

Spend is sized by fee and liquidity depth, paced by a time-bucketed rate limit, and gated on a time-weighted reference tick. An optional auto-compounding LP program can split harvested fees into compound, burn (via Glue Protocol), and recipient delivery legs.

hook.name: VTSwapHook

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buyback-and-burn hook with auto-compounding LP fee programs. On sells of the configured "main" token it absorbs the sell at pool execution price from a secondary-token pot (shield, via beforeSwap delta). On buys it spends the pot to buy more main (pump, via nested swap in afterSwap). LP programs auto-harvest fees inside swaps, splitting into compound, buyback, burn, and recipient shares.

hook.name: Portorium
hook.description: Single-pool hook that charges an exact-input swap fee (1–2%, read from an external Forum oracle with a 1% fallback) in the input currency. When ROME is the input, the fee is burned immediately; when ETH is the input, it accumulates as ERC-6909 claims until anyone calls tribute(), which sends half to a fixed treasury (aerarium) and uses the rest to buy and burn ROME.

hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market pools that requires a backend-signed VALS sigma parameter on every swap. Computes a dynamic exponential fee from trade size, liquidity, and toxic velocity, extracting it from the collateral token and forwarding it to a YieldDistributor. Tracks LP virtual balances and updates YES/NO outcome prices after each swap.

hook.name: OrketHook

Swaps and liquidity additions are blocked when the prediction market is resolved or disputed.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as an on-chain aggregator. On each swap, it performs real-time price discovery (RFQ) across six configured V3 and V4 pools, routes through the best-priced liquidity sources using a BeforeSwapDelta return, and charges a small service fee via donate. Liquidity addition and pool initialization are restricted to an admin address.

hook.name: LBPStrategy

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook implementing a custom constant-sum curve: it takes the full input, wraps or unwraps ETH via the phiEth contract, settles the full output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the concentrated liquidity engine. Liquidity additions to the pool are blocked.

hook.name: Arcmind
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that creates ETH-only paired pools, adds initial liquidity, and collects a configurable BPS fee on ETH-side swaps using beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Fees are split between the token creator and the platform owner; deployed as a transparent upgradeable proxy.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiEth custom swap curve, bypassing concentrated liquidity via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. On each swap it takes the input from the PoolManager, wraps or unwraps ETH via the phiEth contract, and settles the output — effectively an on-chain ETH wrapper as a v4 hook. Direct liquidity addition to the pool is blocked.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook implementing 1:1 ETH/phiEth swaps. On each swap, it takes the input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert between ETH and phiEth, then settles the output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity addition is blocked.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: Shared hook for all Forge V4 pools that enforces factory-only pool initialization and applies a time-decaying MEV fee: starts at 80% and decays parabolically to a 1.5% base fee over a 30-second window after pool creation.

hook.name: PVTWethTaxHook
hook.description: Imposes a hardcoded 3% WETH tax on all exact-input swaps in a single canonical PVT/WETH pool, diverting the tax to an immutable fee recipient via beforeSwapReturnsDelta (buys) and afterSwapReturnsDelta (sells). Exact-output swaps are permanently disabled.

hook.name: MineSwapHookV2
hook.description: A universal fee-capture hook that deducts 0.15% of output tokens on every exact-input swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating tokens in the contract. Anyone can trigger fee processing, which swaps accumulated tokens to BG via Uniswap V3, then splits the result: 50% burned to 0xdead, 49% sent to a rebate tracker for volume-based rewards, and 1% paid to the caller as a mining reward.

hook.name: CustomFeesHook
hook.description: Stub hook with afterSwap permission enabled but all fee-collection logic commented out. The contract stores an immutable fee recipient and swap fee in BIPS, but afterSwap returns a zero delta without executing any fee or token transfer logic.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad hook for ERC-20 tokens on Uniswap v4. Manages token pools through a bonding curve phase, automatically graduating to a standard AMM pool when the bonding curve supply is exhausted. Takes a 5% swap fee (1% creator, 1% platform, 3% protocol) via afterSwapReturnsDelta. External liquidity additions, removals, and pool initializations are blocked to this hook only.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) plus an optional 7 bps tribute on every swap's unspecified currency when hookData encodes a player address, routing both directly to a fixed treasury. Tracks cumulative per-pool swap volume per player and maintains an on-chain leaderboard of the highest-volume trader (the 'champion').

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a 1:1 custom swap curve between ETH and phiEth (an ETH liquid wrapper). Swaps are fulfilled directly via phiEth deposit/withdraw, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity addition is blocked; only ETH/phiEth pool pairs with zero fee are accepted.

hook.name: HaberdasheryHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that charges a configurable percentage fee (default 1%, max 10%) on each swap by taking the fee amount via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating fees per pool by currency. The owner can withdraw accumulated fees, automatically converting non-Habs token balances to the Habs token via an internal pool swap.

hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Corners protocol hook that manages Uniswap v4 pools with two configurable static LP fees (one for buying the "corners" token, one for selling it), collects a 20% protocol cut of each swap fee, and runs an optional MEV-protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that powers a token launch platform ("publiphi"), implementing a fair launch mechanism with optional Merkle-based whitelisting, temporal release scheduling (tokens cannot be swapped before a configurable timestamp), and custom fee distribution that splits swap fees among protocol, token creator, and "inspired" recipients.

hook.name: NGUHook
hook.description: Attempts to enforce a 30-minute initial buy limit of 0.5 ETH after pool deployment and a 20% fee on sell swaps transferred to a fixed fee recipient. The temporal buy limit is never enforced (poolDeploymentTime is never set), and the sell fee transfer is likely non-functional (no afterSwapReturnsDelta claimed).

hook.name: PhiEthHooks

Blocks all direct liquidity additions and only accepts ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook

hook.name: Aquinas Hook (Base)

hook.name: ContentCoinHook

On pool initialization it mints multiple Doppler-curve liquidity positions.

Implements an internal swap pool that fills swaps against fee inventory before they reach the AMM, a BidWall for liquidity support, creator fee distribution with optional referrer payouts via hookData, and temporal launch gating (pools revert until a configurable flaunchesAt timestamp passes).

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers only the afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a pure no-op stub; pool initialization and liquidity bootstrapping is coordinated externally via an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract called through initializePools().

hook.name: RehypHook
hook.description: A custom bonding-curve AMM hook that owns all pool liquidity internally, blocking external LP deposits and donations. Swaps exchange WETH/USDC/GHO for REHYP tokens using reserve-based pricing; excess assets are deposited into Aave V3 to earn yield, which can be harvested to increase reserves and burn REHYP supply.

hook.name: TrinityHookV6
hook.description: Manages concentrated liquidity across price bands for a token, automatically rebalancing LP positions after each swap. Extracts a 1% fee on all swaps: buy fees go to a community treasury, sell fees are burned. Blocks external LP additions so only the hook controls liquidity. Only exactInput swaps are supported.

hook.name: FeeCollectHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that tracks per-LP-token trade counts for authorized pools, designed to trigger fee collection on an external LeveragedLPManager contract after each swap. The actual fee processing call is currently commented out, making the hook effectively a trade counter and event emitter only.

hook.name: UpHook
hook.description: A fee-charging hook for ETH/token pools that pre-charges buy fees in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta and post-charges sell fees in afterSwap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, splitting revenue among protocol, referral, and token creator. Only owner-configured trusted routers and quoters may swap; exact-output swaps are disabled.

hook.name: ClawclickHook
hook.description: A two-phase token launch hook that imposes a decaying tax (up to 50%, floor 1%) and per-user position limits in Phase 1, graduating to a 1% LP fee model after 16x market cap growth. Fees are split 70/30 between the token beneficiary and the platform, with configurable multi-wallet fee distribution.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that enables 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth (a wrapped ETH token). It intercepts beforeSwap, takes the input token, calls phiEth.deposit()/phiEth.withdraw() to convert, and settles the output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity. Liquidity addition is permanently blocked.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launch hook that operates a bonding curve for newly deployed tokens, blocking external initialization and liquidity modifications. Swaps drive the bonding curve until the supply cap is reached, at which point liquidity migrates to a full-range AMM pool; a 1% fee on each swap is split evenly between the token creator and the platform.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: A shared hook for all Forge V4 pools that enforces factory-authorized pool initialization and applies a parabolic time-decaying MEV fee: starting at 80% and decaying to a 1.5% base fee over a 30-second window after pool creation.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for a phiEth/ETH pool that swaps ETH and phiEth 1:1 by depositing or withdrawing via the phiEth contract and returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Adding liquidity directly to the pool is blocked; only the ETH/phiEth pair with zero fee is permitted.

hook.name: LiquidLaunchHook
hook.description: A liquid launch hook that restricts pool initialization to authorized strategies via a factory registry, and automatically converts accumulated fees to a preferred token currency during swaps using nested pool swaps.

hook.name: Liquid Launch Hook
hook.description: Access-controlled initialization hook for a liquid launch system. Only strategies authorized via a factory may initialize pools. In beforeSwap, automatically converts accumulated protocol fees to the pool's preferred token (token0 or token1) via nested swaps on the same pool; fee claiming is permissionless but always routes to the strategy's designated fee recipient.

hook.name: Politiswap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 2% fee on ETH/token swaps across owner-registered pools, tracks daily net ETH inflows per pool via delta returns, and allows users to claim minted rewards based on participation in the pool with the highest daily ETH inflow.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that deploys new ERC20 tokens on a Uniswap v4 bonding curve pool; once the bonding curve supply is exhausted, it graduates the token to a full AMM pool with two-sided liquidity. Takes a hardcoded 1% fee on every swap, split equally between the token creator and platform fee recipient.

hook.name: ExactInGate
hook.description: Blocks exact-output swaps by reverting when `amountSpecified > 0`. Inherits `AeonFee`, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via `afterSwapReturnsDelta`, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address.

hook.name: RetardV111DelayedHookProxy
hook.description: Upgradeable proxy for the retard.market v111 AMM hook, delegating all calls to an implementation via delegatecall with a time-delayed upgrade path (minimum 1-day delay). Implements beforeSwap with delta returns for custom pricing based on virtual depth and fixed entry fees.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: Manages NFT-backed strategy pools with gated initialization and liquidity (only callable via a factory), and applies time-decaying buy fees that start at 99% and decrease every 5 blocks. Fees are taken from swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributed to a vault, collection owner, and protocol address; if the fee is in a non-ETH token, it is first swapped back to ETH internally.

hook.name: TokenLaunchpad
hook.description: A permissionless fixed-supply token launchpad hook for Uniswap v4. The beforeInitialize callback always reverts for external callers, ensuring only the launchpad itself can initialize launch pools via its createToken function, which atomically deploys a token, sets up a pool, and seeds permanent liquidity positions.

hook.name: TWAMM Hook (Base)
hook.description: Implements the Time-Weighted Average Market Maker (TWAMM) strategy, allowing users to place long-horizon token swap orders that are executed gradually over time against the AMM. Before each swap, liquidity add, or liquidity remove, the hook executes any pending TWAMM orders up to the current timestamp.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiEth custom-curve swap by minting or burning phiEth (an ETH wrapper) directly in beforeSwap, bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity additions are permanently blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Custom-curve hook for a 1:1 ETH/phiETH pool that intercepts all swaps to mint or burn phiETH via the wrapper contract, blocks direct liquidity provision, and restricts pool initialization to zero-fee ETH/phiETH pairs only.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom curve swap between ETH and phiEth (a wrapped ETH token) by intercepting beforeSwap, minting or burning phiEth directly, and returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions are blocked; only ETH/phiEth zero-fee pools may use this hook.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 constant-price swap between ETH and phiEth via a custom curve using beforeSwap delta returns. On each swap, the hook takes the input from the pool manager, mints or burns phiEth accordingly, and settles the output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity addition is blocked.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swap as a custom curve via beforeSwap. Takes the full input amount, converts between ETH and phiEth using deposit/withdraw, settles the output directly, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta that fully no-ops the concentrated liquidity swap. Liquidity addition is permanently blocked.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom-curve hook that intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, takes the input currency, converts it using phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw(), and settles the output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity additions to the pool are blocked via beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements 1:1 ETH/phiEth swaps by taking input from the PoolManager, calling phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, and settling output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity additions are blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only the afterInitialize flag enabled; the afterInitialize callback is a no-op that simply returns the selector. Pool liquidity bootstrapping is coordinated externally via a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract called through initializePools().

hook.name: StableSwapHooks
hook.description: Curve-style (StableSwap) AMM hook for Uniswap v4 supporting multi-currency stable pools (2–4 tokens). Executes full StableSwap invariant math in beforeSwap with optional rate oracle support, and blocks direct PoolManager liquidity operations in favor of its own add/remove liquidity flow.

hook.name: UnifiedFeeHook
hook.description: A shared fee hook for Direct and Bond token launches. On buys, it deducts platform and creator fees in native currency via beforeSwap delta. On sells, it burns a token fee before the swap and deducts a platform fee from native output via afterSwap delta. Only pools pre-authorized by admin-controlled lockers can use this hook.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH-to-phiEth custom swap curve: beforeSwap takes the full input, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, then settles the equivalent output. Direct liquidity additions are permanently blocked via beforeAddLiquidity revert.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom swap curve using beforeSwap delta returns, wrapping/unwrapping ETH via the phiEth contract. Blocks direct liquidity addition to the pool and enforces a zero fee with an ETH/phiEth-only pair constraint.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Bonding curve token launchpad hook. New ERC20 tokens launch on a concentrated bonding curve pool; once the curve supply is exhausted, the hook automatically transitions liquidity to a standard AMM pool split into base-only and token-only legs. A fixed 1% fee on each swap is split 50/50 between the token creator and the platform.

hook.name: RetardV111DelayedHookProxy
hook.description: A time-delayed upgradeable proxy for a Uniswap v4 hook using EIP-1967 storage slots and delegatecall. The proxied implementation handles beforeSwap (with delta return), beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeInitialize. Upgrades require a minimum 1-day delay, must be scheduled then executed by an authority address, and are validated for storage-version and config compatibility.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that only sets the afterInitialize flag (as a no-op selector return). Holds pool configuration constants and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools().

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook with a custom curve, bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Swaps mint or burn phiEth via deposit/withdraw on the phiEth contract; liquidity additions are permanently blocked.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for ETH/phiETH pools that enforces a 1:1 exchange rate: beforeSwap takes the input, calls phiETH deposit or withdraw to convert it, then settles the output, bypassing the concentrated liquidity mechanism entirely. Liquidity addition is blocked.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that enables 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiEth (a wrapped ETH token) by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the full input from the PoolManager, calling phiEth.deposit/withdraw to convert, and settling the output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Direct liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked.

hook.name: FlashPerpsHook
hook.description: Custom-curve perpetuals issuance hook where each registered PERP/USDG pool mints or unwinds leveraged perp exposure through Morpho-backed vaults. All swaps are fully intercepted via BeforeSwapDelta (no passive liquidity); a fixed 0.30% USDG fee routes to a buyback module.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that enforces asymmetric static LP fees — separate rates for buying vs. selling the clanker token — updated each swap via updateDynamicLPFee. Includes a time-limited MEV protection module (active for up to 2 minutes post-launch), automatic protocol fee collection (20% of LP fee), and LP locker fee claiming on every swap.

hook.name: KnightV4TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that levies a fixed 5% trade tax on every swap by taking the fee from the output currency in afterSwap via afterSwapReturnDelta. Accrued fees are held by the hook contract and can be withdrawn by the owner via claimFees().

hook.name: HowdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TOKEN/HOWDY pools implementing phased launches with optional Merkle-based allowlist access control and MEV protection. During the MEV window, LP fees decay linearly from a high initial rate to 0.5%. Liquidity additions are blocked during the active MEV window, and allowlist-phase swaps require a Merkle proof in hookData.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: A hook for Zora Coin v4 pools that initializes multi-curve LP positions on pool creation, then after each swap collects LP fees and distributes them as market rewards to creators, platform referrers, optional trade referrers (passed via hookData), the protocol, and Doppler. Also emits detailed swap events.

hook.name: ApexYieldHookV4
hook.description: Oracle-based swap hook that prices trades using Pyth and Chainlink feeds and executes them against an external vault (IApexVault) by returning a BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap. Applies zone-based dynamic fees, enforces vault liquidity checks, and includes an owner-triggered circuit breaker that halts swaps when oracle prices move too rapidly.

hook.name: NomadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM with configurable liquidity density functions (LDFs), an auction-managed AMM (am-AMM) to recapture LVR and MEV by auctioning swap fee rights, automatic pool rebalancing via FloodPlain fill orders, a TWAP oracle, and dynamic surge fees.

hook.name: AvillHook
hook.description: Enforces a dynamic price floor for the Avill token in USDC/USDT pools. beforeSwap reverts sell orders when the current pool price falls below a floor derived from cumulative stable inflows and Avill sold; afterSwap updates those accumulators after each trade.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Manages Uniswap v4 pools for Clanker-deployed tokens with asymmetric static fees (separate clankerFee and pairedFee per direction), collecting a protocol cut via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta on each swap. Supports an optional time-limited MEV protection module that can temporarily raise fees, and LP locker fee auto-claiming.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom curve by intercepting swaps, converting ETH↔phiEth via a wrapper contract, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta that no-ops the concentrated liquidity math. Liquidity additions are blocked via a revert in beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: TokenFab

It deploys new ERC-20 tokens into bonding curve pools, charges a 1% swap fee split between creator and platform, and automatically migrates to a standard AMM pool once the bonding curve supply target is reached.

hook.name: FeeCollectHook
hook.description: Tracks swap activity per registered LP token position on authorized pools by incrementing trade counters in afterSwap. Designed to trigger fee processing via an external LeveragedLPManager contract, though the actual fee collection call is currently commented out.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Collects a platform swap fee on every Mixpad-launched token trade, splitting proceeds between the token creator and treasury with optional buyback-and-burn. Applies a block-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-decaying dump surcharge on sells by the original deployer.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiEth custom swap curve via beforeSwap: takes the full input amount, converts using phiEth.deposit()/withdraw(), and settles the equivalent output directly to PoolManager via BeforeSwapDelta, bypassing concentrated liquidity. All direct liquidity additions to the pool are blocked.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Powers the Zora Coins protocol by managing per-coin Uniswap v4 pools with automated multi-curve liquidity provisioning, a decaying launch fee (99% to 1% over 10 seconds), and post-swap reward distribution to creators, referrers, and LPs.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that applies a dynamic launch fee (decaying linearly from 99% to 1% over 10 seconds post-creation) on every swap, then in afterSwap collects accrued LP fees from all positions, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop paths, and distributes them as market rewards. Also fills limit orders based on tick movement and supports liquidity migration to successor hook versions.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy

Hook behavior (beforeSwap, afterSwap, afterInitialize) cannot be analyzed because the implementation source is not verified on-chain.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Juicebox-integrated Uniswap v4 hook that routes exact-input swaps through either the V4 AMM or a Juicebox terminal (buy or sell side), choosing whichever path offers better output. It also maintains a TWAP oracle by recording price observations after each swap, add-liquidity, and remove-liquidity event.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook

Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set an initial tick and mark the pool as initialized; no swap-path logic is present.

hook.name: Flaunch POSM v2 (Base)

hook.name: B20Hook

hook.name: LexifiHook

Each pool can be assigned a configurable policy contract that determines user access levels; non-compliant users are denied via revert. Resolves user identity through trusted routers' msgSender(), falling back to the caller address.

hook.name: IpStrategyHook
