hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook managing token launches ("publiphi") with a timed fair launch period, scheduled pool opening, optional Merkle whitelist, and fee distribution across creators, protocol, referrers, and swappers. During the fair launch window, sells are blocked and buys are filled from a hook-managed position; after it closes, standard AMM swaps apply with hook-captured fees.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom-curve swap between ETH and phiEth, a wrapped ETH token. In beforeSwap, the hook takes the input from the pool manager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert, and settles the output, returning a delta that fully bypasses the standard AMM curve. Liquidity additions to the pool are permanently blocked.

hook.name: BpegHook
hook.description: An afterSwap and afterAddLiquidity hook for the BPEG DN-404 token on Base mainnet. afterAddLiquidity sets the pool address on the token contract on first liquidity add. afterSwap syncs NFT metadata count with the user BPEG balance using tx.origin: buying BPEG mints NFT metadata proportional to integer balance, selling burns accordingly. Wallet-to-wallet transfers move NFT metadata alongside tokens. vanillaSwap: false

hook.name: StockTokenHook
hook.description: A hook for stock token pools that enforces configurable trading-hours windows and charges time-decaying buy/sell fees (decaying from a start rate to an end rate over 48 hours from the first trade), redistributing collected fees between a developer wallet and the StockToken vault contract.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook enabling 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swaps with no liquidity. In beforeSwap, it takes the full input from the PoolManager, converts via the phiEth contract (deposit/withdraw), and settles the output with a delta that no-ops the concentrated liquidity swap. Adding liquidity to the pool is permanently blocked.

hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH-to-phiEth swap hook that implements a custom curve via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, minting phiEth on ETH deposit or burning phiEth on ETH withdrawal. Liquidity addition is blocked; only phiEth/ETH pools with a zero fee are accepted.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v2.2 (Base)
hook.description: A Zora hook that initializes multi-position Doppler curve liquidity when a Zora coin pool is created, then automatically collects LP fees on every swap, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards to creators, trade referrers, and liquidity providers.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that captures the current tick before each swap via transient storage, then executes limit orders in afterSwap when the tick crosses order boundaries. Supports role-based dynamic LP fee management via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for Saturn Omnichain that records pool initialization state via a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub; no swap or liquidity logic is modified.

hook.name: CreatorCoinHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Zora creator coins that collects LP fees after each swap, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop swaps, and distributes rewards to creators and trade referrers. On pool initialization, it creates multiple Doppler-curve liquidity positions for the coin's pool.

hook.name: HookNewEvents
hook.description: A hook that emits custom events (HookSwap, HookModifyLiquidity) with additional amount and fee data decoded from hookData. Requires ABI-encoded AdditionalSwapData in swap hookData and AdditionalModifyData in liquidity hookData; calls with empty hookData will revert.

hook.name: HookNewEvents
hook.description: Emits custom events (HookSwap, HookModifyLiquidity) during beforeSwap and beforeAddLiquidity by unconditionally ABI-decoding caller-supplied hookData into AdditionalSwapData/AdditionalModifyData structs. Both hooks require non-empty encoded hookData or they revert on decoding.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn hook that absorbs main-token sells at the pool's own execution price using a BeforeSwapDelta (SHIELD), and executes a capped buy of the main token on every secondary-to-main swap using pot reserves (PUMP). Optionally supports auto-compounding LP fee programs per pool, with configurable compound, buyback, and burn share splits.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee (base + surge) computed by a DynamicFeeManager, charges a protocol share of swap fees as BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and mints them to a FullRangeLiquidityManager, maintains a truncated geometric mean oracle, and auto-tunes oracle parameters based on tick-movement capping.

hook.name: HookNewEvents
hook.description: A hook that emits custom events (HookSwap, HookModifyLiquidity, HookFee, HookBonus) on swap and liquidity operations. It requires non-empty hookData in both beforeSwap and beforeAddLiquidity, which it ABI-decodes into structs containing additional amount fields; empty hookData will revert.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that handles swaps on Bunni using a custom AMM mechanism with dynamic and surge fee computation. Implements auto-rebalancing via FloodPlain and uses am-AMM to recapture LVR and MEV. Includes an on-chain TWAP oracle and supports hooklets for per-pool customization.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: A fully custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that replaces standard pool swap math with its own concentrated liquidity model using configurable Liquidity Density Functions (LDFs). Features a dynamic surge-based fee system, TWAP oracle, am-AMM fee auction mechanism, vault reserve integrations, and an optional per-pool hooklet plugin interface.

hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker's v2 dynamic fee hook that adjusts LP fees based on a tick-difference volatility accumulator, collecting a 20% protocol fee on each swap. Supports optional MEV protection and pool extension modules.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers the afterInitialize flag but implements it as a pure no-op. The contract exposes a separate initializePools() function that calls a LiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting initial pool tick in contract state.

hook.name: StablecoinHook
hook.description: Collects a 0.01% fee on exact-input swaps by diverting the fee amount via BeforeSwapDelta and minting ERC6909 claims to itself; only the designated FEE_RECEIVER can withdraw accumulated fees via the pool manager's unlock-burn-take pattern.

hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad for ERC20-quote-denominated token launches on Uniswap v4. Each coin is 1B fixed supply, trading through a concentrated hook-owned curve position until 800M tokens sell, at which point the hook auto-graduates by converting to a permanently locked full-range position. Enforces 1% fees (70/30 creator/platform split), anti-snipe decay, a permanent 2% per-wallet buy cap, and a block+1 trading delay.

hook.name: JurassicPlatformV4Hook
hook.description: Routes swaps through Jurassic Protocol's external core pools instead of standard Uniswap v4 AMM liquidity, using beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fully handle token settlement. Supports only exact-input swaps; direct liquidity provision via Uniswap v4 is disabled.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that runs a permissionless per-pool buyback pot: after each swap, the pot uses donated secondary-token funds to buy the pool's main asset and deliver it to a configured recipient (default: burn). Also supports an optional auto-compounding LP fee program with configurable splits between compounding, pot refuel, burn, and a custom recipient.

hook.name: UCrossHookV4
hook.description: On each exact-input swap, deducts a configurable fee (up to 3%) from the input currency by minting ERC-6909 claims to itself and returning a BeforeSwapDelta that reduces the effective swap amount. Accrued fees can be collected permissionlessly to a treasury address. Exact-output swaps and zero-fee cases pass through unchanged.

hook.name: EqtInrUsdtTreasuryHook
hook.description: Intercepts EQT→USDT swaps on BNB Chain and redirects the entire EQT input amount to a configurable treasury address via poolManager.take(). Targets the EQT/USDT pair only; other pools are ignored. An owner-controlled pause mechanism exists in storage but the enforcement check is commented out and non-functional.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A liquidity management hook with dynamic fees, a truncated geometric oracle, and full-range liquidity reinvestment. It is also malicious: a hardcoded wallet address (0x7c743F590bC9565bd9E2ff839BE77Fc4c375d509) receives minted tokens on every swap via a 0.10% hidden fee extracted before/after each swap. Swaps too small to generate the minimum fee are forcibly reverted.

hook.name: DualCurveHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable fee (hookFeeBps) on the ETH leg of exactIn swaps. On ETH-input buys, it skims the fee in beforeSwap via a delta return; on ETH-output sells, it skims the fee in afterSwap. Collected fees are forwarded to a configurable FeeRouter address.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/FWAToken pool that charges a flat 1% fee on both buys and sells (routed to an owner-set fee wallet). Pool initialization and seed liquidity are gated to the token's one-shot `launching()` flag. Buys are restricted to registered protocol addresses until the owner enables external trading via `externalBuysEnabled`.

hook.name: UpegHook
hook.description: Calls `start` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to that token's pool, and updates an internal random seed on every swap involving that token.

hook.name: HumansHook
hook.description: A minimal hook that calls `xpegToken.start(poolManager)` in `afterInitialize` to register the PoolManager address with the HumansToken (XPEG) contract on first pool initialization. Contains no swap logic; all token transfer restrictions are enforced ERC-20-side in HumansToken._update.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain V4 hook that sets the afterInitialize flag but performs no logic in that callback. Provides an initializePools() function (callable by anyone) that invokes an external liquidity bootstrapper and records the initial tick and poolInitialized state. No swap logic is implemented.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A swap fee-splitting hook that levies configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode) on each swap and distributes them to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via a claim vault. Pool initialization and the initial liquidity deposit are gated by a central launch manager authorization system; liquidity removal is permanently disabled.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in that callback. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial liquidity and record the initial pool tick.

hook.name: StarbaseHookV1
hook.description: Applies a 4% buy tax on FLT/WBNB swaps, routing portions to a burn address (1%), an operations wallet (1%), and a space fund (2%), collected via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Tracks Blueprint NFT mint credits and burn obligations per user on each swap. Requires hookData with the swap user address (≥32 bytes); reverts for senders not in the trusted-router allowlist.

hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook that replaces the Uniswap v4 AMM for an ETH/MiniBTC pool. Buys mint MiniBTC via a forward curve; sells burn MiniBTC and pay ETH from the hook's accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden. Requires a swapper address ABI-encoded in hookData; enforces a 1-block cooldown between a wallet's last buy and any sell.

hook.name: LumoriaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Lumoria token/BNB pools on BNB Chain that collects platform fees and per-token buy/sell taxes on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapDelta, gates pool initialization and liquidity additions to the LumoriaLiquidityVault, and permanently locks all liquidity (remove liquidity always reverts).

hook.name: MultiPoolPrincipalProtectionHook
hook.description: A hook for multiple native-BNB/ERC20 pools that restricts liquidity management to a designated principal owner and compounder contract, and dynamically adjusts LP fees across three tiers (375, 750, 1500 bps) based on the tick range observed within 15-minute windows.

hook.name: BucketHook
hook.description: A single-pool Uniswap v4 hook for the Bucket Protocol that collects a configurable USDT fee on each swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, depositing fees into an epoch-based escrow. Restricts liquidity additions and removals to a designated LP lock contract, blocks all donations, and gates trading on both a governance bootstrap flag and an epoch start timestamp.

hook.name: DynamicFeePrincipalProtectionHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook for a single native-BNB/BTCB pool that adjusts LP fees across three tiers based on the observed tick range within 15-minute windows. Liquidity additions and removals are restricted to an immutable principal owner and a designated compounder contract.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another vault, enforcing a concentration-based bonding curve invariant. It blocks standard concentrated liquidity positions and donations, acting as a fully custom-curve pool.

hook.name: GridHook
hook.description: Grid trading hook for Uniswap v4 that deploys weighted concentrated liquidity positions (grid orders) across configurable tick ranges. Supports manual and keeper-authorized rebalancing to recenter the grid when price moves, with slippage protection and Permit2-based token settlement.

hook.name: MultiPoolPrincipalProtectionHook
hook.description: Manages multiple native-BNB/ERC20 pools where liquidity operations are restricted to an immutable principalOwner and a registered compounder contract. Applies a dynamic 3-tier LP fee (0.0375%, 0.075%, or 0.15%) based on observed tick range volatility over 15-minute windows.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn Uniswap v4 hook that absorbs main-token sells from an on-hook pot at the pool's own execution price (shield), and buys back the main token on detected buy swaps up to a sandwich-proof fee cap (pump). Optionally supports auto-compounding concentrated-liquidity LP fee programs with configurable split allocations.

hook.name: ConstantSumCurve
hook.description: A constant-sum (1:1) custom curve hook that fully intercepts swaps via beforeSwap with return delta, trading tokens at a fixed 1:1 ratio without using Uniswap v4's native AMM pricing. It manages its own liquidity pool and blocks native v4 liquidity modifications via a revert in beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker V4 hook v2 for autonomous token deployment with fixed LP fee rates, MEV modules, pool extensions, protocol fee, and LP locker fee collection.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that collects swap fees and splits them between creators and a platform treasury, with optional buyback-and-burn and dividend distribution. Enforces a snipe-protection window and a per-token max-buy cap during a fair launch period, both gated by block.timestamp.

hook.name: AlphaHook3Pct
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for BSC token/stablecoin pools that adjusts LP fees (0.30%–3.00%) based on volatility and volume EMAs, seeding new pools at the fee ceiling as a launch premium that decays over ~10–15 minutes. Collects a 20% protocol share on top of LP fees via the afterSwap delta, swept to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Stores the initial tick and a pool-initialized flag when `initializePools()` delegates to an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract; the `afterInitialize` callback itself is a no-op that only returns its selector.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick and pool initialization state in its public initializePool() function; the afterInitialize callback is a no-op. All other hook callbacks are no-ops; the hook has no swap logic or access control.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick in its initializePool() function; the afterInitialize callback is a no-op. Has no swap, liquidity, or fee logic — it is purely a pool initialization helper with no effect on swap execution.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the `afterInitialize` permission enabled (as a no-op callback). Pool initialization and the initial tick are managed externally via `initializePools()`, which delegates to a `LIQUIDITY_BOOTSTRAPPER` contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only afterInitialize is enabled (as a no-op callback). Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with an afterInitialize no-op callback. Pool initialization (including storing initialTick and poolInitialized) is performed via the initializePool() external function. All hook callbacks are no-op stubs with no swap, liquidity, or fee customization logic.

hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook that gates pool creation to an internal factory, enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap with automatic surplus refund, and a decaying anti-snipe fee premium on buys. Upon reaching the graduation raise target, the hook executes an inner swap, locks full-range liquidity, and updates the dynamic LP fee to a flat 1%.

hook.name: StableQuoteDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for BSC token/stablecoin (USDT, USDC, USD1) pairs that computes LP fees from price-tick volatility and swap-volume EMAs, capped at 3%, and charges a 20% protocol share on top via afterSwap delta to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: Bonding curve hook that acts as the sole counterparty for ETH/SATO swaps: buys mint SATO via a forward curve and sells burn SATO via an inverse curve, paying ETH from accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; hookData must encode the swapper address or the swap reverts.

hook.name: StablecoinHook
hook.description: Collects a 0.01% fee on exact-input swaps for stablecoin pairs by returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims to the hook contract and can be withdrawn to a designated fee receiver via the PoolManager unlock pattern.

hook.name: BSC_FeeCaptureHook
hook.description: A hook that applies a dynamic LP fee (0.5% base, 2.0% when the current tick drops ≥300 ticks below the last stable tick) and, after each swap, extracts fee amounts from the pool via poolManager.take() and transfers them directly to a hardcoded owner address.

hook.name: BucketHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook for the Bucket Protocol that charges a configurable USDT swap fee (1–5% BPS) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing fees to an epoch-based fee escrow. Liquidity provision is restricted to a designated LP lock contract; trading requires governance bootstrap finalization and an epoch start timestamp.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: Arrakis Finance private vault hook that restricts liquidity additions to the authorized vault module and overrides LP fees per swap direction (zero-for-one vs one-for-zero) as configured by the vault executor.

hook.name: PrincipalProtectionHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to the fixed `principalOwner` or `compounder`, and liquidity removals to `principalOwner` (or `compounder` for fee collection only), on a native-BNB/BTCB pool. The hook admin can rotate the `owner` and `collector` addresses. Swaps are permissionless.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A DEX aggregator hook that intercepts Uniswap v4 swaps in beforeSwap, queries up to 6 V3/V4 liquidity pools hardcoded in bytecode, sorts them by effective price, and routes the trade across pools using BeforeSwapDelta. Liquidity additions and pool initialization are gated to a hardcoded admin address via tx.origin check.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook for token launches on Uniswap v4 that collects swap fees and splits them between creators, platform treasury, and referral tiers. Features anti-snipe and fair-launch temporal windows, optional buyback-and-burn of creator fees, and optional dividend tax routing to a DividendPool.

hook.name: EqtInrUsdtTreasuryHook
hook.description: Intercepts EQT→USDT swaps on BNB Chain and redirects the full EQT input amount to a treasury address via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. Only operates on EQT/USDT pools; passes through all other pairs. hookData optionally encodes a recipient and deadline for validation.

hook.name: OmniPriceHook
hook.description: A cross-chain oracle-priced hook that prices every swap against a coordinator-signed global reference price using JIT one-tick liquidity bands and a dynamic LP fee override. External liquidity is blocked; the hook exclusively manages a straddle book position in the pool.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpads that collects a configurable swap fee (default 1%) on every trade, splits it between the token creator and platform treasury with a referral tier system, and tracks quote volume per token for graduation tracking.

hook.name: VoraxHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Vorax launchpad hook that applies asymmetric static LP fees based on swap direction (vorax token vs. paired token), collects a 20% protocol fee via BeforeSwap/AfterSwap delta manipulation, optionally runs a MEV protection module active for 2 minutes post-creation, and auto-claims LP locker fees on each swap.

hook.name: IQFAntiBotHook
hook.description: Launch-protection hook for IQF/USDT pools with three time-based phases: an anti-snipe window (allowlist-only swaps, per-tx size caps, per-address block cooldowns, and IQF token locks on buys), a cooldown window (open access with higher caps and shorter cooldowns), and a normal phase with no restrictions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A passive hook for Saturn Omnichain pools that enables only afterInitialize (as a no-op). Exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to record the initial tick.

hook.name: PokpegHook
hook.description: A hook that calls `start()` on a configurable token when the first liquidity is added to its pool, and updates an on-chain random seed after each swap involving that token.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects a percentage fee on every swap in registered launchpad token pools, then splits the fee between the token creator and a platform treasury, with optional referral cuts distributed via a configurable registry. Tracks net quote volume per token for graduation tracking via the factory contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only afterInitialize enabled (a no-op pass-through). The contract exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper to set up liquidity positions and records the initial tick after pool creation.

hook.name: OmniHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 10 bps fee on every swap, taken from the specified input amount (exact-in) or output amount (exact-out) via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Fees are pooled to the hook contract and booked in a per-currency pull-payment ledger split among five hardcoded recipients, claimable by anyone via claim() or claimAll().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain project hook that registers only afterInitialize, returning the selector without modification. Includes an external initializePools() function that delegates pool liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: StarbaseHookV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 4% swap tax on STAR token trades in the official STAR/WBNB pool, routing a burn portion to the dead address and the remainder to a tax accumulator contract. Swaps initiated by the configured taxAccumulatorProcessor address bypass tax collection.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that registers the afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in the callback. A separate initializePools() function delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap and liquidity hook callbacks are no-ops returning their selectors with no side effects.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission as a stub. It exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity across multiple pools and records the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag active (which performs no logic). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and stores the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: GravityHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable fee on ETH/token swaps (buy and sell), splitting proceeds between token holders and a treasury address via BeforeSwap and AfterSwapDelta returns. Also calls a token-specific `onSwap` callback after each swap.

hook.name: V4PermissionedSwaps
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts swaps to an owner-managed allowlist of approved sender addresses, reverting any swap from an unapproved sender with `SenderNotAllowed`.

hook.name: BVCCDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook with a configurable base fee (default 0.01%) and a 1.5% anti-bot penalty applied when a user swaps within 300 seconds of their last swap. Also charges a 0.005% admin fee taken directly from swap output amounts via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: ConstantSumCurve
hook.description: A constant-sum AMM curve hook that implements 1:1 token swaps using hook-managed liquidity. Disables standard v4 liquidity provision via a revert in beforeAddLiquidity, and routes all swaps through a custom beforeSwap handler that returns a delta, bypassing the pool's internal pricing.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Protocol vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully handles swap execution: takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate always revert to protect users from non-productive positions.

hook.name: BoobHook
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for a token launchpad that charges a configurable fee (default 1%) on each swap in the quote currency, credited to the token creator. Applies an elevated anti-snipe tax (default 13%) on buys within the first 30 blocks after token launch.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad launchpad that collects swap fees on launched tokens and splits them between the token creator and treasury. Applies anti-snipe surcharges on early buys and deployer-dump penalties on sells within a time window, with a portion of creator fees automatically used for buyback-and-burn via nested swaps.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic LP fees (base + surge pricing via a volatility oracle), a truncated geometric TWAP oracle, and protocol-owned liquidity auto-reinvestment. Charges a configurable protocol fee on each swap.

hook.name: StarbaseHookV2
hook.description: Tax collection hook for the STARBASE V2 STAR/WBNB pool on BNB Chain that collects a 4% STAR tax on every swap: 1% is sent directly to a burn address and 3% (operations + space fund portions) is sent to a tax accumulator contract for distribution, implemented via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns.

hook.name: BnbableHook
hook.description: Fee hook for BNBable token launches on BNB chain. Takes direction-specific fees on the BNB side of every swap in registered BNB/token pools, splitting fees between a protocol recipient and up to 5 configured reward wallets as claimable BNB.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: Implements a signed-quote (RFQ) swap mechanism where each swap requires an off-chain signature from a designated quote signer authorizing specific trade parameters (sender, amounts, exchange rate, nonce, expiry). Any output exceeding the quoted exchange rate is captured as ERC-6909 tokens claimable by authorized accounts.

hook.name: PmavHookBnb
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook for BNB Smart Chain that sells tokens along an AMM curve with block+1 anti-snipe protection, per-wallet 2% permanent caps, and dynamic fees. When the curve fills, it graduates the pool to a standard Uniswap v4 AMM with a permanently locked full-range liquidity position and a flat 1% LP fee set via updateDynamicLPFee.

hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: Bonding-curve token launch hook for a pump-style platform. Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe rule, a permanent 2% wallet buy cap with auto-refund, and a 1% trading fee (70% creator / 30% platform) with a decaying anti-snipe premium on buys. Graduates pools from the bonding curve to open liquidity once the curve completes, then passes swaps through unchanged.

hook.name: PokpegHook
hook.description: Calls `start` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to the token's pool, and updates an on-chain pseudo-random seed after each swap involving that token.

hook.name: StablecoinHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for stablecoin pairs that collects a 0.01% (1 bps) fee on exact-input swaps by returning a BeforeSwapDelta and minting ERC6909 claims to a designated fee receiver. The fee receiver can withdraw accumulated fees via `withdrawFees` or `emergencyWithdraw`.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op callback). Exposes a separate initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the resulting initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: StonkHookV4
hook.description: Access-control and fee hook for a single token pool that enforces exact-output-only swaps, blocks all liquidity removal, gates external buys behind a token-controlled boolean flag, and takes a 1% fee on each swap's output accrued to the creator.

hook.name: TimedDecayFeeHook
hook.description: Overrides the LP fee for pools containing a configured token using a time-decaying schedule, stepping from 3% down to 1% in 0.5% increments every 30 seconds over 120 seconds. The owner sets per-token decay start times via setTokenStartTime().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op). It integrates with an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial liquidity via initializePools(), storing the initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: StockTaxHook
hook.description: A per-pool, creator-adjustable Uniswap v4 tax hook for TOKEN/USDG pools that skims buy and sell taxes (2–5%, hard-capped at 5%) in USDG across all four swap shapes, splitting proceeds among the pool creator, platform treasury, and a stock-reward vault. Features a per-pool launch-window sniper guard and is UUPS-upgradeable.

hook.name: PandaPegHook
hook.description: Updates an on-chain random seed on every swap involving the configured token, using block entropy (timestamp, prevrandao, block number). On first liquidity addition, calls token.start() to initialize the token. The random seed is exposed for use by the paired NFT collection (PandaCollection).

hook.name: OmniPriceHook
hook.description: A JIT AMM hook that anchors swap prices to a threshold-signature-based cross-chain oracle. Before each swap it mints a one-tick liquidity band at the oracle-derived price and harvests it after, applying dynamic fees and routing proceeds to configured recipients. External liquidity is blocked; only the hook's own positions are allowed.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects a percentage fee on every swap in registered launchpad token pools, splitting proceeds between the token creator and a platform treasury with an optional referral chain deducted from the platform share. Tracks net quote volume per swap for token graduation accounting.

hook.name: BNB20Hook
hook.description: Implements a BRC-20-style inscription system on Uniswap v4 on BNB Chain. When swaps include ABI-encoded Inscription data in hookData, the hook handles deploy, mint, and transfer operations for ERC1155 inscription tokens, collecting BNB fees from the swap's currency0 via poolManager.take().

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that manages fair launches by providing one-sided liquidity and charging a configurable fee (1–10%) on buy swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Applies a decaying anti-snipe fee (starting at 99%) during the first 20 seconds after launch. Fee proceeds are split between a platform and a tracker address via a FeeEscrow contract.

hook.name: StarbaseHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Starbase STAR/WBNB pool on BNB Chain that collects a 4% tax on each swap, splitting it into burn (1% to dead address), operations (1%), and space fund (2%) portions. Uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to capture tax from both the specified and unspecified sides of each swap.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that uses Euler lending vaults as its liquidity source. It fully handles swaps in beforeSwap using its own invariant curve, taking input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity entirely. Swaps revert if the configured expiration timestamp has passed.

hook.name: MarginHook
hook.description: Custom-curve hook that routes all swaps through an external IPairPoolManager, bypassing Uniswap v4's native AMM entirely. Standard v4 liquidity addition is disabled (reverts). Fees are computed per-swap by the external manager and returned as an lpFeeOverride; token transfers are handled outside v4's pool liquidity.

hook.name: BucketHook
hook.description: A single-pool hook for a BucketToken/USDT pair that levies a configurable fee (1–5%) on swaps denominated in USDT, accumulates fees into an epoch-based escrow contract, and restricts LP operations to a designated lock contract. Trading is gated by an admin-finalized bootstrap phase and a configurable epoch start timestamp.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker protocol hook that configures asymmetric static LP fees per pool (separate rates for clanker-token and paired-token swap directions), collects a 20% protocol fee on paired-token flows via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta manipulation, and includes a temporary MEV protection module active for 2 minutes post-deployment that can increase fees to deter sandwich attacks.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission bit set. All hook callbacks are pure no-ops. Pool initialization and tick recording are handled by a separate initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that only registers the afterInitialize permission. It integrates with a LiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools() to set up initial liquidity and record the initial tick; the afterInitialize callback itself performs no logic beyond returning its selector.

hook.name: MarginHook
hook.description: Implements a custom AMM curve via beforeSwap with delta return, routing all swap execution through an external IPairPoolManager that handles margin trading liquidity. Disables native v4 liquidity management by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol lending vaults. The beforeSwap hook fully handles each swap by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, enforcing a configurable bonding curve invariant in place of standard Uniswap concentrated liquidity.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that registers an afterInitialize permission but performs no action in that callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(); no swap behavior is modified.

hook.name: GmgnAdminTransparentProxy
hook.description: A transparent upgradeable proxy (ERC1967) for the GMGN hook, delegating all hook calls to an underlying implementation contract. The proxy admin can upgrade the implementation via upgradeToAndCall. Hook flags include beforeSwap with returnsDelta, beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeRemoveLiquidity.

hook.name: KnotV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for launch token markets that applies configurable per-token buy/sell taxes via hook deltas in beforeSwap/afterSwap, and collects a 1% protocol fee on swaps routed to a FeeVault. Pool initialization and liquidity operations are restricted to an authorized adapter; trading is permissionless but taxes and fees are deducted atomically through the hook delta mechanism.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with an afterInitialize permission whose callback is a no-op. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are handled by the separate initializePools() function, which delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an immutable external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: BnbableHook
hook.description: A fee hook for BNB/token pools that takes direction-specific fees on the BNB side of each swap (buy fee and sell fee, both in BPS) and distributes them as claimable BNB rewards to up to 5 configured recipient wallets; a fixed 0.10% protocol cut is deducted first. Only pools pre-registered by the immutable launcher address can use this hook.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An ERC-1967 upgradeable proxy contract whose hook implementation is not verified on-chain. All hook logic is delegated to an unverified implementation address; the actual swap behavior, fee mechanism, and access control cannot be determined from the available source.

hook.name: PairHook
hook.description: A launchpad-companion hook that restricts pool initialization to a designated launchpad, prevents liquidity removal (except zero-delta fee collection), limits new liquidity additions to the currently active minting pool, and enforces a per-swap token buy cap during the token's protection window.

hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that fully replaces AMM pricing via BeforeSwapDelta. Buys (ETH→MiniBTC) mint tokens through a forward curve; sells (MiniBTC→ETH) burn tokens through an inverse curve priced against accumulated ETH reserves held by the hook. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; swaps require the swapper address encoded in hookData.

hook.name: VerifierHook
hook.description: A KYC/AML compliance hook using PureFi protocol that requires senders to provide PureFi-formatted compliance payloads (with token identity and amount validation) on swaps, liquidity modifications, and donations — unless the sender is pre-approved as a market maker or router via an on-chain whitelist.

hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFee
hook.description: Clanker V4 hook for autonomous token deployment with dynamic fees that adjust based on trading volume.

hook.name: ZA_Hook
hook.description: An owner-controlled liquidity management hook that allows authorized callers to rebalance token holdings via swaps, mint LP positions, add liquidity to existing positions, and withdraw funds. The afterSwap, afterAddLiquidity, and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are no-ops that do not modify swap or liquidity behavior.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook that deducts a configurable fee (in basis points, max 2%) from each swap's input amount via custom accounting (BeforeSwapDelta), accumulating proceeds in the contract. An immutable owner address set at deployment can withdraw collected fees. Liquidity hooks are no-ops.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain hook with only afterInitialize permission (a no-op). Provides a separate initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: BucketHook
hook.description: A single-pool Uniswap v4 hook for the Bucket Protocol that charges a configurable BPS fee on USDT-denominated swaps, routes collected fees to an epoch-based escrow, and restricts liquidity operations to a designated LP lock contract. Trading is gated by a one-time bootstrap finalization and a future epoch start timestamp.

hook.name: LaunchSatoHook
hook.description: A launchpad bonding-curve hook for the LaunchSato platform that routes all buys and sells through a custom exponential curve, minting tokens on buys and burning on sells. Buys require a swapper address in hookData, are capped per transaction, and are permanently closed once 99% of the fair token supply is minted; sells remain enabled with a 1-block cooldown after a buy.

hook.name: HavenHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for the Haven protocol that extracts a configurable fee (basis points, capped at 5%) from swaps involving registered ("moored") tokens, routing the collected fees to a yield pool that token skippers (owners) can claim.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that activates only afterInitialize (as a no-op selector return); all swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are stubs. Provides an external initializePools() that delegates to a LiquidityBootstrapper and records the initial tick.

hook.name: BSC_FeeCaptureHook
hook.description: Applies a dynamic LP fee (0.5% base, 2.0% when price drops ≥300 ticks) and after each swap extracts fee amounts from the pool via poolManager.take(), forwarding them to a hardcoded owner address.

hook.name: MegaHook
hook.description: A fee-taking launchpad hook that collects configurable BPS fees on token swaps, taking fees directly from the pool via delta returns. Applies an elevated anti-snipe tax during the first N blocks after token launch, with fees accumulating as claimable balances for token creators.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Dynamic-fee AMM hook that charges protocol-owned liquidity (POL) fees on swaps and auto-reinvests them as full-range liquidity. Uses a truncated geometric oracle to track tick movement per swap or per block, feeding a dynamic fee manager that applies base + surge fees overridden on every swap via lpFeeOverride.

hook.name: ConstantSumCurve
hook.description: A custom-curve hook implementing a constant-sum (1:1) AMM with hook-owned liquidity. It disables native Uniswap v4 liquidity via a revert in beforeAddLiquidity, and handles all swaps directly using beforeSwapReturnsDelta — taking the input token and settling the output token at a 1:1 ratio.

hook.name: ZA_Hook
hook.description: An owner-controlled liquidity management hook that holds tokens and manages Uniswap v4 positions on behalf of authorized operators. Hook callbacks (afterSwap, afterAddLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity) are pure no-ops returning zero deltas; active management is performed via privileged ZA_* functions for minting positions, adding/removing liquidity, and executing swaps through a configured v4 router.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission bit set, but the afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub. Initial pool tick data is recorded by a separate initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-op stubs; the hook does not alter swap behavior.

hook.name: GazzFeeHook
hook.description: A fee hook for gazz.fun V4 pools that charges a flat platform fee (up to 5% cap, deployed at 2%) plus an optional per-coin community fee (up to 2%) on every swap, always taken in native ETH and forwarded to GazzFeeSplitter. Restricted to native ETH pools; handles all four swap directions via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Dynamic fee Uniswap v4 hook with a truncated geometric oracle for volatility measurement, policy-driven fee adjustment via DynamicFeeManager, and full-range liquidity reinvestment. Covertly extracts 0.10% (1000 PPM) of every swap's input amount by minting ERC-6909 pool manager claims directly to a hardcoded wallet address, in both exactIn (beforeSwap) and exactOut (afterSwap) paths.

hook.name: LaunchlyBNBHook
hook.description: The hook is used to get the fixed percent fee on every swap to launchaly app admin wallet and send the fee to ClaimRevenue contract (A custom contract for split the fee to creator )

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook using a truncated geometric mean oracle for volatility-based fee computation. Applies an additional configurable hook fee (default 0.10%, up to 50%) on top of the LP fee. A hardcoded wallet address can unilaterally adjust the hook fee and drain all ERC20 and native tokens held by the hook contract.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee computed from base and surge components via a DynamicFeeManager, records price observations in a truncated geometric oracle, and routes a protocol-owned-liquidity share of each swap fee to a FullRangeLiquidityManager for automatic reinvestment.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 oracle hook that records TWAP observations and executes automatic backrun swaps to reduce price impact. Requires full-range liquidity positions, exactInput-only swaps, and routers implementing IMsgSender to credit backrun proceeds to the original sender.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that maintains price observations for Uniswap v4 pools and automatically executes backrun swaps to mitigate price impact, returning profits in ERC6909 tokens to the original swapper.

hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad (pmav.fun v2.2) for launching ERC20 meme coins paired with an immutable quote ERC20 (e.g. USDG). Manages a concentrated liquidity curve position, charges 1% fees split 70/30 creator/platform, enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap refund logic, applies a decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, and graduates in-place to a full-range locked position upon reaching the raise target.

hook.name: ZA_Hook
hook.description: Owner-managed liquidity management hook that allows authorized callers to mint positions, increase liquidity, and withdraw funds from Uniswap v4 positions. The afterSwap, afterAddLiquidity, and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are all no-ops that do not alter swap or liquidity behavior.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a pure no-op; a separate initializePools() function calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to set up initial liquidity and records the resulting tick. No swap-time logic is present.

hook.name: VoidHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that charges 0% fees on buys but drains 100% of sell proceeds (quote token) to the token creator by default, with no owner-callable setter to change the sell drain rate. Registered tokens are tracked via an external factory contract; collected fees are credited to creators as claimable yield.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization. It integrates with a liquidity bootstrapper contract to set up initial liquidity positions across multiple pools. No swap-time logic is implemented.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that collects fees on every swap, splitting them between token creators, a platform treasury, and referral tiers. Features anti-snipe and fair-launch windows with max-buy limits, optional buyback-and-burn of creator fees, optional dividend tax routing to a DividendPool, and configurable per-token creator fee recipients.

hook.name: BSCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that fully replaces Uniswap v4 swap execution by minting and burning BSCToken against a single canonical ETH reserve state. Buys are capped at 5 ETH per swap and a 1-block cooldown is enforced between a wallet's last buy and first sell; all swaps require an encoded swapper address in hookData.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission. It tracks pool initialization state and delegates initial liquidity setup to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. It does not modify swap behavior in any way.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op (returns selector only). Pool initialization is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain protocol hook with only afterInitialize active (a no-op returning the selector). Initial liquidity is bootstrapped externally via an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract called through initializePools(), which records the initial tick and marks the pool as initialized.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers only afterInitialize (implemented as a no-op). All hook callbacks return their selectors without modifying swap or liquidity behavior. An external initializePools() function delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper to seed initial pool positions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only afterInitialize active (a no-op stub). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick and poolInitialized state on-chain.

hook.name: PokpegHook
hook.description: Calls `start()` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to its pool, and updates an on-chain random seed (derived from block data) on each swap involving that token.

hook.name: BStonkHook
hook.description: A gamified Uniswap v4 hook that collects ETH-denominated taxes on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, pooling fees into per-round prize pots. Traders are scored by realized ETH volume on buy swaps and assigned to teams; at the end of each round the winning team's players claim the accumulated pot.

hook.name: EquityHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equities quoted in a USD stablecoin (USDT, USDC, or USD1) on BSC. Computes LP fees (0.03%–0.20%) from volatility and volume EMAs, then charges an additional 20% protocol fee on top via the afterSwap delta.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/FWAToken pool that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps, routing proceeds to an owner-set fee address. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated to the token's one-shot launch period; buy swaps are restricted to registered protocol buyers until the owner enables external trading.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/FWAToken pool that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps: buy fees are taken in FWAToken and swapped back to ETH via a nested pool swap, sell fees are taken in ETH, both routed to an owner-set address. Pool initialization and seed liquidity are gated to the token's one-shot launch flag, and external buys are restricted to an owner-managed allowlist until external trading is explicitly enabled.

hook.name: BVCC Dynamic Fee Hook (BNB)
hook.description: Dynamically adjusts LP fees per swap based on gas price levels, price volatility, and 24-hour trading volume, with an anti-bot cooldown penalty for frequent swappers. Also collects a small hook fee from swap output amounts via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: JurassicPlatformV4Hook
hook.description: Routes all exact-input swaps through the Jurassic Platform's external AMM (IJurassicV4Core) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, fully bypassing Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity logic and handling token settlement directly. Liquidity addition is permanently disabled; only pools registered and marked V4Active in the JurassicV4Registry can be used.

hook.name: SparkHookV4
hook.description: A token-launch hook that enforces anti-bot protections for the first 20,000 blocks after launch: one swap per block per sender, and a max buy limit per wallet. On sells, it collects a 2% fee (via afterSwapReturnsDelta) split between a platform wallet and the pool creator.

hook.name: MomoHook
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for meme token launches that charges a configurable fee on quote-token swap amounts, with an elevated anti-snipe tax applied during the first N blocks after launch. Fees are taken via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, credited to token creators, and claimable on demand.

hook.name: PairHook
hook.description: A launchpad pair hook that restricts pool initialization to the launchpad address, enforces that liquidity can only be added during active minting, permanently locks liquidity removal (except zero-delta fee collection), and enforces a per-swap buy cap on launch token output during the token's protection window.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual bootstrapping is triggered externally via initializePools().

hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that takes over all ETH/MiniBTC swaps via BeforeSwapDelta: buys mint MiniBTC via a forward curve and sells burn MiniBTC via an inverse curve priced against accumulated ETH reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently disabled. Requires hookData encoding the swapper address; enforces a block-number cooldown between a wallet's last buy and its first sell.

hook.name: NakaHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for the NAKA token on BNB Chain. Buys mint NAKA via a forward curve; sells burn NAKA via an inverse curve. The hook is the sole liquidity source, blocks external LP additions, requires the swapper address in hookData, enforces a per-wallet block cooldown between buys and sells, and auto-forwards fees to a hardcoded donation address. Self-deprecates (disables buys) at 99% of the 21M supply cap.

hook.name: BNB20Hook
hook.description: A BRC-20-style inscription protocol hook that intercepts zeroForOne exact-input swaps to process DEPLOY, MINT, and TRANSFER operations encoded in hookData. Mints ERC-1155 inscription tokens (BNB20) and collects BNB fees by redirecting swap input amounts via BeforeSwapDelta.

hook.name: BscpegHook
hook.description: After each swap, this hook calls an associated BscpegToken contract to generate and distribute token (peg) rewards to the swap sender, or to an alternate address encoded in hookData. Reward generation uses on-chain entropy. Only a single owner-configured pool is supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds pool configuration constants (fee, tick spacing, initial price). Pool liquidity setup is delegated to an external bootstrapper via a separate `initializePools()` call; the `afterInitialize` hook callback itself is a no-op.

hook.name: IndexHook
hook.description: A hook for IndexToken pools that gates swaps and liquidity additions/removals to owner-approved pools, supports dynamic LP fees with zero-fee overrides for index token self-swaps and custom hook fees for other swappers, and tracks index token reserves in pools for burn coefficient accounting.

hook.name: EqtInrUsdtTreasuryHook
hook.description: After EQT→USDT swaps on BSC, routes EQT proceeds to a configurable treasury address and distributes USDT output to a recipient (defaulting to the swap sender). Supports optional hookData to specify a custom recipient, minimum USDT output, and deadline; only active for the hardcoded EQT/USDT pair, and can be paused by the owner.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook that deducts a configurable fee (capped at 2% each side) on each swap using Uniswap v4 custom accounting: pulls the fee via poolManager.take() and returns a BeforeSwapDelta so pool accounting nets to zero. Collected fees accumulate in the contract and can be withdrawn only to the immutable owner address.

hook.name: StablecoinHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 0.01% fee on exact-input swaps by intercepting beforeSwap and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to collect the fee as ERC-6909 claims for a designated fee receiver address. The fee receiver can withdraw accumulated fees via withdrawFees() or an emergency unlock pattern.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with an afterInitialize permission that is registered but performs no action in the callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are handled by the separate initializePools() function, which calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract.

hook.name: DooV4BuyHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook for a Doo token pool that records buy events to an external DooPowerRegistry. When hookData containing (buyer address, USDT principal, Doo amount) is provided, it logs the purchase via the registry; swaps with empty or invalid hookData emit an ambiguity event and complete normally without reverting.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM curve hook for Uniswap v4 that integrates with Euler Protocol. Swap execution is handled entirely in beforeSwap using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), routing assets through EVC-managed Euler vaults instead of standard concentrated liquidity. Each hook instance is a delegatecall proxy to a shared EulerSwap implementation.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Dynamic-fee AMM hook that computes LP fees via a TruncatedGeoOracle and DynamicFeeManager, collecting protocol fees and an undisclosed 0.10% surcharge on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, and reinvesting accumulated fees into full-range liquidity positions through a FullRangeLiquidityManager.

hook.name: HookHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that mints a HOOK token on buys (BNB in, HOOK out) via a forward curve and burns HOOK on sells (HOOK in, BNB out) via the inverse curve. It fully intercepts all swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, replacing Uniswap AMM mechanics entirely. Liquidity additions are forbidden; sells require a block-number cooldown after the last buy.

hook.name: SatHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that intercepts all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta. Buys (ETH→SAT) mint SAT tokens through a forward curve; sells (SAT→ETH) burn SAT and pay ETH from accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; the hook acts as the sole counterparty.

hook.name: AlphaHook2Pct
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for BSC token/stablecoin pairs that sets the LP fee between 0.30% and 2.00% based on volatility and volume EMAs, seeding the maximum fee at pool launch. Also charges a 20% protocol surcharge on top of the LP fee, collected via afterSwap delta and swept to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that activates only on afterInitialize. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and records the starting tick; the hook itself performs no swap-time logic.

hook.name: OmniPriceHook
hook.description: A cross-chain hook that prices every swap against a coordinator-signed global USD reference price, converted to local native via Chainlink. Uses JIT one-tick liquidity bands for fills, blocks external LPs, and applies a dynamic fee that widens when the signed price is stale or intra-version drift exceeds a threshold.

hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for an ETH/MiniBTC pool. Buys mint MiniBTC via a forward curve (with a randomized entropy multiplier during early blocks); sells burn MiniBTC and pay ETH from accumulated reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; all swap execution is fully taken over by the hook via BeforeSwapDelta. Requires a swapper address ABI-encoded in hookData on every swap.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes token swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults, depositing received tokens and withdrawing sent tokens from vault positions. Uses a configurable bonding curve (CurveLib) to validate each trade, entirely replacing standard Uniswap v4 swap mechanics via beforeSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: VoraxHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies direction-dependent static LP fees per pool (a "vorax" fee and a "paired" fee) by calling updateDynamicLPFee on every swap, and deducts a configurable protocol fee from swap amounts via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta adjustments. Supports an optional time-limited MEV module that can temporarily raise fees during pool launch, and prevents liquidity additions while the MEV module is active.

hook.name: HumansHook
hook.description: A minimal hook that, on first pool initialization, registers the PoolManager address with an external HumansToken contract via `xpegToken.start()`. No swap or liquidity hook logic is implemented; all token mechanics are handled ERC-20-side in HumansToken.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op selector return). Pool and liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(). No swap logic is modified.

hook.name: IndexFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on all swaps, always collected in native ETH (currency0), sent directly to an immutable treasury address. The fee is applied via return deltas: in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency, and in afterSwap when ETH is the unspecified currency. Pools where currency0 is not native ETH pass through untaxed.

hook.name: ZA_Hook
hook.description: A hook with no-op afterSwap, afterAddLiquidity, and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks. Includes owner/authorized-caller controlled functions for minting, adding liquidity to, and withdrawing from Uniswap v4 positions held by the hook contract.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the pool's initial tick after initialization. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity, storing the resulting tick. All other hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with the afterInitialize flag set but a no-op callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are performed via the separate `initializePools()` function, which calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap logic is implemented; all swap callbacks are no-op stubs.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy

hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX

Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, 1% trading fee split 70/30 creator/platform, a permanent 2% wallet cap with automatic refund, and auto-graduates the pool to a full-range position when the raise target is reached.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description: Records the pre-swap tick in transient storage during beforeSwap, then in afterSwap calls an external LimitOrderManager to execute limit orders based on tick movement. Also exposes an admin-controlled updateDynamicLPFee function to adjust the pool's LP fee.

hook.name: BucketHook

Trading is gated by an admin-controlled bootstrap finalization flag and a configurable epoch start timestamp.

hook.name: OmniPriceHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a cross-chain virtual order book that prices swaps using a threshold-signed global USD reference price converted to local quote via Chainlink oracle. Between swaps, all inventory sits in a visible straddle position; each swap removes the book, JIT-mints a one-tick fill band at the coordinator price, executes, then distributes fees to four recipients and rebuilds the straddle.

hook.name: BscpegHook
hook.description: After each swap on the owner-configured pool, generates entropy from block data (chainid, number, prevrandao) and calls BscpegToken.recordSwap() to potentially mint peg tokens to the swapper. An optional hookData address argument overrides the token recipient; without hookData the swapper address is used.

hook.name: NLSTRHook
hook.description: A single-pool hook for native BNB/NLSTR that restricts liquidity provision to a treasury address and applies a dynamic LP fee decaying linearly from 95% to 10% over a configurable period after launch. Includes a temporal single-transaction buy-size cap during the decay window to limit large buys at launch.

hook.name: V4AlphaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization, liquidity additions, and swaps behind a configurable per-pool start timestamp set by an owner. Designated pool owners may initialize pools and add liquidity before the public start time; general swaps are blocked until the timestamp is reached via block.timestamp comparison.

hook.name: V4AlphaHook
hook.description: Owner-controlled hook that gates pool initialization (requires owner tx.origin), liquidity addition (gated by pool owner allowlist until launch), and swaps (blocked until a configurable start timestamp) to support permissioned token launches on Uniswap v4.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook

hook.name: GlueHook

hook.name: SatoHook

Includes per-wallet cooldown by block number, entropy-based multipliers in the first 100 blocks, and automatic self-deprecation when fair-curve supply nears the 21M cap.
