Instead of charging a flat fee on every swap, it uses that reference to set fees dynamically, capturing more value for LPs while keeping execution tight and predictable around the reference.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Core hook for Bunni v2, a concentrated liquidity protocol on Uniswap v4. Implements a virtual AMM with dynamic fees (TWAP-based + surge detection), am-AMM bidding for LVR/MEV recapture, auto-rebalancing via FloodPlain, and an on-chain price oracle.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Bunni v2 concentrated liquidity hook that handles swap execution entirely via BeforeSwapDelta using a Liquidity Density Function (LDF). Supports surge fees, am-AMM fee management for MEV/LVR recapture, a TWAP oracle, and automated pool rebalancing via Flood Protocol.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: DualPool is a Uniswap v4 hook where capital rests in ERC-4626 vaults between swaps and is deployed as concentrated liquidity just-in-time, so LPs earn swap fees and vault yield on the same token.

hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: SatoHook is an immutable Uniswap v4 custom-accounting hook for SATO on Ethereum. It implements an ETH-denominated bonding curve, permissionless mint and burn settlement, and transparent on-chain reserve accounting.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Implements the Bunni v2 AMM protocol as a Uniswap v4 hook. Handles swaps entirely in-hook via a configurable Liquidity Density Function (LDF), with dynamic fees (surge fees and optional am-AMM managed fees), a TWAP oracle, and automated rebalancing via the Flood protocol.

hook.name: Nuclear Man's Pool Trader Hook
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that adjusts LP fees based on volatility by comparing spot price from a Uniswap V2 pair against an exponential moving average filter — keeping fees low during calm markets and raising them up to 25% during high-volatility periods. It also collects a configurable developer fee on each swap.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Bunni v2 hook that implements a custom AMM in Uniswap v4, handling swaps entirely in `beforeSwap` via custom liquidity density functions (LDF), TWAP oracles, surge fees, and am-AMM for MEV recapture. Supports auto-rebalancing via FloodPlain and optional per-pool hooklet extensions.

hook.name: Complex64WaveHook
hook.description: Implements a 64-phase buy/sell tax and dynamic LP fee system for pools containing the Complex64 (C64) token. Each swap deducts a phase-dependent tax from the C64 side of the trade, splits it between token burns and a treasury address, and advances or reverses the phase index based on swap direction (buy=forward, sell=backward).

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Applies a fixed 5% buy and 5% sell tax on swaps involving a registered token. Tax is collected in the base asset via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and minted as ERC-6909 claims to the token contract for dividend distribution.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: An on-chain smart order router that intercepts swaps via `beforeSwap` and fans them out across multiple hardcoded Uniswap v3 and v4 liquidity pools. It reads real-time prices via an RFQ mechanism, sorts pools by effective price, routes the swap through the best-priced venues using `BeforeSwapDelta`, and collects a service fee via `donate`. Liquidity addition and pool initialization are restricted to a single admin address (enforced via `tx.origin`).

hook.name: 0XPAIN HOOK
hook.description:
PokemonPegHook is a Uniswap v4 hook that powers PokemonPeg ($pPEG), an art-coin where every buy mints a unique          on-chain pixel-art NFT fragment to the trader.
                                                                                                                          Hook permissions: afterAddLiquidity + afterSwap.

  Mechanism: on each ETH→pPEG swap, the hook resolves the real recipient (via hookData 20b/32b, with tx.origin fallback
  for EOAs) and mints a deterministic ...

hook.name: Action Hook
hook.description: Captures a configurable basis-point fee from BUX/ETH pool swaps, splitting proceeds between an action funding contract (for hourly and daily rewards) and a dev fee splitter via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas.

hook.name: DynopegHook
hook.description: Applies a flat 3% ETH tax on every swap involving native ETH: on the buy side, reduces the swap input via BeforeSwapDelta and mints ERC-6909 claims; on the sell side, extracts ETH via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. Also advances a rolling per-swap entropy seed each call. Anyone can call normalize() to convert accumulated claims to physical ETH and push them to the DynopegToken reward distributor.

hook.name: GroveHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that charges a configurable levy (up to 5%) on swaps for registered tokens, extracting fees via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta and accumulating them in a per-planter sap mapping claimable via tap or tapAll.

hook.name: UHook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook that only implements beforeInitialize, returning the selector without performing any additional logic. Stores an immutable token address set at deployment.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that integrates with Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it handles full swap execution: taking input tokens into Euler vaults via a custom curve invariant (CurveLib), withdrawing output tokens from vaults, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Designed as a delegatecall proxy implementation; beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate always revert.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that fully replaces Uniswap v4's CLAMM with its own bonding curve (CurveLib). In beforeSwap, it computes quotes, deposits input tokens into Euler lending vaults (via EVC), withdraws output tokens from vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to settle the swap entirely outside the pool's tick-based engine. Reverts on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate to prevent unproductive positions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. No swap behavior is modified; all swap-related hook functions are no-ops.

hook.name: AnyPositionManager
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Flaunch protocol that manages memecoin launches, routes fees through an internal swap pool and bid wall, and records price observations via an oracle. Supports pools backed by externally approved paired tokens beyond native ETH.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements EulerSwap's bonding curve, routing swap liquidity through Euler vaults. The hook handles all swap accounting directly via beforeSwap with a delta return, enforcing a custom reserve curve. Standard liquidity additions and donations are intentionally blocked.

hook.name: DarwinHook
hook.description: Collects a variable ETH tax (in basis points, sourced from the DARWIN token contract's currentTaxBps()) on DARWIN/ETH swaps: buy taxes are deducted from the ETH input via BeforeSwapDelta, sell taxes from the ETH output via AfterSwapDelta. Accumulated taxes are withdrawable by the owner. Only exact-input swaps in the DARWIN/ETH pool are supported.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV2
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook that applies a configurable ETH-denominated swap fee (1%–10%, fixed at pool registration) on native ETH/token pools. The total fee is split between the token creator and an immutable Launcher treasury (fixed 0.10% share), accruing as ERC-6909 claims redeemable by creator or Launcher. LP fee is zero; no token transfer tax.

hook.name: UnigenHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that queues NFT mints for qualifying ETH-to-UGEN buyers in afterSwap and applies a reduced 1 bps fee override in beforeSwap for Tier-S wallet-age holders. Includes an admin-controlled whitelist gate for launch-window anti-sniper protection.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Registers the `afterInitialize` permission but the callback is a no-op. Pool state (initial tick, initialized flag) is recorded by the separate `initializePools()` function which delegates to a `LiquidityBootstrapper` contract.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. The beforeSwap hook computes quotes using a proprietary curve, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, and pays output tokens from an Euler vault via BeforeSwapDelta. Swaps are subject to a configurable expiration timestamp.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A general-purpose hook that maintains a per-pool buyback pot funded by swap fees. On every afterSwap, it auto-harvests fee splits, observes the current tick against a 10-minute time-weighted reference, and executes a nested buy of the pool's designated main asset from the secondary token. A spend bucket paced by fee accrual limits pump size per swap. Supports configurable LP programs with autocompound, burn, and fee-split options.

hook.name: WHATHook
hook.description: A single ETH/WHAT pool hook that collects a 3% tax on every swap (buys and sells) and distributes all fees to WHAT token holders. Enforces a per-transaction buy size cap of 500 WHAT for the first 70 buys.

hook.name: PaydayHook
hook.description: Captures 3% of every swap's output side (buys in PAYDAY tokens, sells in ETH) via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributes fees to token holders through seniority-weighted payroll and bonus pools, claimable directly from the contract.

hook.name: Oddity
hook.description: Oddity is an ERC-20 token ($ODD) and Uniswap v4 hook that imposes a dynamic LP fee per swap: buys are free during a 24-hour prime window if the oracle-submitted Genesis Number is prime, otherwise all trades pay 1%. A Merkle-based prediction reward distributes 3% of supply to winners who guessed the number's last digit.

hook.name: Ring Few ETH Hook
hook.description: A hook that enables 1:1 wrapping and unwrapping between ETH and fwWETH (Few Wrapped ETH) in Uniswap v4 pools, intercepting swaps via beforeSwap and using delta returns to handle token conversions entirely within the hook.

hook.name: RestakeHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook with a trading gate (swaps revert until the owner calls enableTrading), a 3% buy/sell tax taken in the pool's reHOOK token and held as a restaking reward reserve, and a 0.5%-of-supply max-transaction limit. Liquidity providers earn layered restaking rewards: each additional deposit increments a layer and increases the provider's share of collected tax rewards.

hook.name: ETIMTaxHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook for ETIM/ETH pools that deducts configurable tax rates from swap input amounts using return deltas, holding collected ETH and ETIM fees in the contract for owner withdrawal or burn.

hook.name: ETIMTaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook for ETIM/ETH swaps that deducts a configurable tax (up to 10%) on buys and sells via beforeSwap. Buy taxes (in ETH) and sell taxes (in ETIM) are held in this contract, with sell taxes split among S6, Foundation, Official, and a burn address. Buys are gated by a governance flag from an external main contract.

hook.name: MetalHook
hook.description: Protocol-owned liquidity hook for an ETH/METAL pool that restricts LP provision to the hook itself and levies a symmetric 2% protocol fee on every swap, routing it to a treasury address. All trading is gated on the METAL token's `tradingEnabled` boolean flag set by the token owner.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with an afterInitialize permission flag, though the afterInitialize callback is a no-op. The contract exposes a separate `initializePools()` function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to record the initial tick in storage. All hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: Fuse
hook.description: A last-buyer-wins game hook on Uniswap v4: every ETH→FUSE swap pays a 2% fee into a round pot and extends a countdown timer. When the timer expires, the five most-recent buyers split 80% of the pot weighted by recency, with the remainder seeding the next round. Fees are skimmed via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: EgyptHook
hook.description: Fairlaunch hook that atomically creates and funds an ETH/token pool in a single transaction, applying a block-decaying swap fee (from a configurable high rate down to a 5% floor) on ETH volume to deter launch sniping. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and are paid out to a developer address on demand.

hook.name: HookLifeHook
hook.description: Tracks buy and sell token flow using an EWMA decay model to compute a dynamic LP fee that rises with directional imbalance (calm: 0.30%, max: 3.00%). Emits vitals (pulse BPM, imbalance, fee, sqrtPrice) on every swap; never reverts or modifies token transfers.

hook.name: TideHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements stepped directional dynamic fees for a paired TIDE ERC-20 token. Buy fees range from 50–500 bps and sell fees are 2× the buy rate, with the tier determined by the token's current total supply relative to a fixed 21M cap.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for tokens graduated via the Livo launchpad that collects a 0.5% LP fee (split 50/50 between creator and treasury) on all swaps, plus an optional time-limited buy/sell tax configurable per token. Swaps are blocked before token graduation.

hook.name: VortexHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a VRTX/USDC pool that organizes liquidity into tick-based bands; out-of-range bands have their USDC removed and deposited to Aave to earn yield, which is periodically used to buy and burn VRTX. Charges a 1% fee on USDC-side swaps, restricts liquidity management to the hook itself, and gates public swaps behind an owner-controlled started flag.

hook.name: BlacklistHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that blocks token sells by default; wallets self-unlock by sending any ETH amount to the hook (immediately refunded). Applies a 3% ETH buy tax and a volume-tiered sell tax (3–10% over a 2-hour window) to an authorized ETH/token pool, with an on-chain lottery for buys ≥ 0.05 ETH.

hook.name: ZeroRWAHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable BPS fee on each swap in RWA token pools; fees are taken from currency0 via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta and forwarded to the factory contract for distribution. Swaps revert if the pool's currency1 token has not been registered by the factory.

hook.name: GrandpaHook
hook.description: Applies a 2% buy tax (taken in WETH input, sent to a fixed engine address) and a 4% sell tax (2% of token input burned to address(0xdead), remainder collected in WETH to engine) on swaps. Restricted to a single pre-configured pool matching stored currency pair, fee, and tick spacing.

hook.name: ShardHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that owns permanently-locked single-sided SHARD token liquidity across full-range and concentrated band positions. It enables NFT minting and burning via pool buys and sells, charges a 1% fee on all swaps (via hook callbacks for third-party swaps and explicitly for hook-initiated swaps), and distributes fees proportionally to NFT holders.

hook.name: MeridianHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Meridian launchpad that manages single-sided concentrated liquidity positions for token launches. It collects custom fees on buys (via beforeSwapReturnsDelta) and sells (via afterSwapReturnsDelta), with a time-decaying anti-snipe fee at launch, and locks the liquidity position so only the hook itself can add or remove it.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT collection trading pools that takes dynamic buy fees (starting at 95% and decaying ~100 bps per 5 blocks down to 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Fees are split 80% to the NFT collection contract and 20% to a configured fee address. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the NFTStrategyFactory.

hook.name: Vitalik0Hook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook acting as the sole swap counterparty for an ETH/VITALIK0 pair. Buys mint tokens via a forward curve; sells burn tokens and pay ETH from accumulated reserves. Liquidity addition is permanently disabled. A 20% tax on each swap routes to dev, liquidity, and public reward wallets.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: Charges tiered ETH fees on swaps in ETH/token pools, with fee rates scaled by the token's market cap queried from an external factory contract. Fees are split between a platform treasury and the token creator address; no fees are charged on the pool's deployment block.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap: input tokens are deposited into Euler vaults and output tokens are withdrawn, with pricing enforced by a configurable bonding curve (CurveLib). Standard concentrated liquidity operations are blocked; a single LP provides liquidity exclusively through Euler vaults.

hook.name: MiladyStrategyHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 20% fee on all swaps in the MLDYSTR/ETH pool via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing 80% to a MiladyStrategy contract (for NFT purchases) and 20% to a protocol fee address. Exact-output swaps are blocked, and token-denominated fees are internally swapped to ETH before distribution.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as an on-chain aggregator, routing swaps across up to 6 hardcoded V3 and V4 pools using a price-sorted RFQ algorithm. Returns a BeforeSwapDelta to settle the aggregated output atomically. Liquidity additions and pool initialization are restricted to an admin address (ADMIN constant).

hook.name: RebelProtocol
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/USDT/USDC↔REBEL pools that charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap (always denominated in non-REBEL currency) using beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Fees fund a round-based PvP game where buyers compete to become "King" and earn from a leaderboard-weighted stake pool; no admin, no upgrade, no owner.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize. It provides an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to set the initial tick; swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops with no access control or fee logic.

hook.name: UsdcWstGbpHook
hook.description: Oracle-aware dynamic-fee hook for a wstGBP/USDC v4 pool that sets LP fees per swap based on directional flow and pool deviation from a Chainlink GBP/USD feed combined with wstGBP NAV price. Swaps are never blocked; an owner pause or oracle failure degrades to a flat fallback fee.

hook.name: LFWAHook
hook.description: A single-pool ETH/LFWA hook that charges a configurable percentage fee (up to 30%) on both buys and sells. Buy fees are deducted from the input ETH in beforeSwap; sell fees are deducted from the output ETH in afterSwap. Fees are routed to a fixed fee recipient address set at construction.

hook.name: MUGENHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the MUGEN/ETH pool that collects fees on every swap and burns MUGEN tokens. On buys (ETH→MUGEN), 1% of the MUGEN output is taken and burned directly. On sells (MUGEN→ETH), 5% of the ETH output triggers a nested buyback swap (ETH→MUGEN) inside afterSwap, and the purchased MUGEN is burned. Only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial pool tick after initialization. An external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract handles liquidity bootstrapping; the hook stores the resulting tick and a poolInitialized flag for on-chain state tracking.

hook.name: Sivo UniswapHook
hook.description: Oracle-priced Uniswap v4 hook for the Sivo SLP token. Absorbs stablecoin-to-SLP swaps at the Chainlink NAV price using BeforeSwapDelta custom accounting, bypassing the AMM curve entirely. SLP exits are handled via an async FIFO redemption queue filled by inbound deposits and operator replenishment. Third-party liquidity and donations are blocked.

hook.name: ProofOfTimeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that rewards liquidity providers with time-weighted POT token emissions, enforces anti-whale buy caps during a 10-minute launch window, and applies a decaying buy/sell tax (35% to 2% over the first hour) collected in the non-protected currency and sent to a configurable treasury.

hook.name: YinYangHook
hook.description: A hook for a twin ERC-20 token pair (Yin/Yang) that mints or empties token "pieces" on each swap based on the swap direction (buy vs. sell), takes a per-swap skim fee forwarded to a configurable destination (with a 20% sniper tax for the first 10 seconds after pool launch), and bootstraps pool state on first liquidity addition.

hook.name: TokenLaunchHook
hook.description: Shared fair-launch hook serving multiple pools, each bootstrapped via hookData on the first mint. Supports per-pool optional modules: whitelist phase, anti-snipe protection, dynamic buy/sell LP-fee tax (returned as an lpFeeOverride), and liquidity lock. Governance is captured by the first LP NFT; the NFT owner controls module parameters during the launch window.

hook.name: EthereumWordsHook
hook.description: EthereumWordsHook is a non-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook for Ethereum Words protocol-registered pools. It enforces immutable liquidity rules, charges fixed protocol fees using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas (2% on the ETH/WORDS pool and 1% on WORDS/child-token pools), tracks WORDS reserves as NFT reward weights, burns child-market WORDS fees, and distributes main-pool ETH fees between the treasury and NFT owners.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed-rate fee on every swap for registered launchpad tokens, splitting proceeds between the token creator, platform treasury, and up to three referral tiers. Fees are extracted via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and accumulated in pull-based claimable balances for ETH and ERC-20 quote tokens.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token Uniswap v4 positions on behalf of token creators. Creators initialize a pool, add liquidity (held by the hook), and later remove it. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are no-ops returning zero deltas; no swap hooks are active.

hook.name: YinYangHook
hook.description: A twin-token hook for the YinYang project that bootstraps ETH/Yin and ETH/Yang pools on first liquidity add, then on each swap mints or burns token "piece" state based on the buy/sell direction. Takes a per-swap skim fee (up to 20% sniper tax during the first 10 seconds after pool launch, then a configurable base rate) forwarded to a owner-controlled destination via `afterSwapReturnsDelta`.

hook.name: Coven
hook.description: A hook and ERC20 token (COVEP) that collects a 10% tax (1000 bps) on ETH-paired buys and sells, taking the tax from the pool and forwarding it to a hardcoded treasury address. It also tracks "ritual chains" — consecutive sequences of 13 unique buyers each spending ≥0.5 ETH — sealing a coven on completion; a sell by a chain member resets the chain.

hook.name: FeeHookV3
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for token launch pools that charges ETH-denominated fees on each swap, splitting proceeds among a registered token creator, an optional partner, an optional hot-swappable extension module, and a protocol wallet. Fee rates are determined by a configurable market-cap-tiered table or per-token custom fees with automatic decay.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled as a no-op stub. Liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract called via initializePools(), which records the initial tick. Has no swap-related logic.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize. All swap and liquidity callbacks are pure no-ops. Pool initialization is bootstrapped via an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract that sets the initial tick.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered tax hook for ETH/token pools that deducts a fee on every buy and sell swap, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token creator. Fees step down from 1.25% to 0.35% as market cap increases (queried from an external factory); no fee is taken on the pool's deployment block.

hook.name: UniForge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 10% ETH tax on buys and sells in an ETH/uniFOR pool, forwarding proceeds to a fixed treasury address. Swappers who spend ≥0.0001 ETH earn non-transferable Bronze shard counters, which can be forged 2-for-1 into Silver, Gold, or Diamond tiers via a separate forge() function.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with a single afterInitialize permission flag; the callback is a no-op. Includes a permissionless initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to record the initial tick after pool creation.

hook.name: LendingHookV2
hook.description: A V4-native lending AMM that seeds LOOP/ETH liquidity across 100 discrete price bands and skims a 1% swap fee via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta delta accounting. Enables borrowing ETH against LOOP collateral with band-aware liquidation that replenishes the same liquidity band.

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHookEth
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee override in `beforeSwap` for pools registered by an owner-controlled factory. Each pool's fee tier is set at registration time from a fixed set of allowed values; unregistered pools receive no override.

hook.name: OTYHook
hook.description: Gates swaps on the OTY pool by querying tradingEnabled() on the token contract; swaps revert until trading is enabled by the token owner/admin.

hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook integrated with a CryptoPunks strategy contract. Takes fees on every swap (10% for sells, starting at 95% for buys and decreasing by 1% per 5 blocks), converts token fees to ETH via nested swaps inside afterSwap, and restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the linked strategy contract.

hook.name: Ring Few WBTC Hook
hook.description: Enables 1:1 wrapping and unwrapping between a token and its Ring Protocol fewToken wrapper during Uniswap v4 swaps. Validates that pools are formed exclusively between the underlying token and its fewToken counterpart with zero fees.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook
hook.description: A singleton, ownerless Uniswap v4 hook for tokens graduated via LivoGraduatorUniswapV4 that collects LP fees and time-limited buy/sell taxes on ETH/token swaps. Fees are split between a configurable LP fee router (treasury + creator) and the token's master fee handler, with fee amounts determined per-token via ILivoToken.getSwapFees().

hook.name: Upeg
hook.description: Allows the deployer to define SVG data and read it using a specified seed. Stores metadata for collectible ERC-20 tokens. Calls start on the configured token when first liquidity is added, and updates randomSeed on swaps.

hook.name: ReHookHook
hook.description: A tax hook that collects buy and sell fees (up to 3%) on swaps in currency1, routing them to a ReHookLedger that tracks liquidity provider weights for proportional reward distribution. Swaps are gated behind an owner-controlled tradingEnabled flag.

hook.name: UpegHook
hook.description: Calls `start()` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to the token's pool, and updates an internal random seed after each swap involving that token. The random seed is derived from block data and is readable by external contracts.

hook.name: HookFee
hook.description: Charges a configurable basis-point fee on token1-to-token0 swaps by intercepting the output amount in afterSwap and redirecting the fee portion to an immutable feeRecipient via afterSwapReturnsDelta. The fee rate is owner-adjustable up to 10,000 bps.

hook.name: KilobitHook
hook.description: Buy/sell tax hook for the Kilobit protocol that charges ETH fees on every swap and distributes them to patient holders and protocol rewards. Manages a "rot" decay mechanism that progressively breaks token bits over ~4-day cycles, with mode-based inventory selection (cursor, clean-only, broken-only, patient-only) for buys and sells.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that only uses afterInitialize (as a no-op stub) to satisfy the interface. Provides an initializePool() helper that deploys an ETH/token pool with fixed parameters (0.3% fee, tick spacing 60). Does not alter swap or liquidity behavior.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. The afterInitialize callback is a pure no-op (returns selector only). Pool initialization is triggered externally via initializePools(), which delegates to a LIQUIDITY_BOOTSTRAPPER contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The afterInitialize callback is a pure no-op (just returns the selector). An external initializePools() function calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed liquidity and stores the resulting initial tick. Has no swap, liquidity modification, or donation logic.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with afterInitialize permission (no-op callback) and a convenience initializePool() function that deploys a fixed ETH/TOKEN pool at 0.3% fee and 1:1 initial price. Records initial tick and pool state in contract storage. No swap, liquidity, or donation logic is active.

hook.name: VitaHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that gates trading on official VITA pools until the token is started, applies a time-based tiered dynamic LP fee (decreasing from 5% to 1% over 7 hours), and refreshes a random seed after each swap to support token launch mechanics.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. It uses `beforeSwapReturnsDelta` to handle all swap accounting, depositing input tokens into Euler vaults and withdrawing output tokens from them, with configurable per-direction fees and optional pool expiration.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records pool initialization state. Only the `afterInitialize` flag is active; the callback is a no-op returning only the selector. Pool setup is delegated to an external liquidity bootstrapper via `initializePools()`.

hook.name: HooksensorHook
hook.description: Reads stress and price-volatility data from a threshold-quorum Bittensor oracle bridge and uses it to set a dynamic LP fee (1%–5%) via lpFeeOverride on every swap. Higher stress or volatility raises the fee to protect LPs; calm markets lower it. Emits telemetry in afterSwap for off-chain scoring.

hook.name: GweiTaxHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that charges a time-decaying ETH swap tax on every pool launched by GweiFunLaunchpad, forwarding the tax to the token deployer. Buy and sell tax rates decay linearly from a configured start rate to a floor, and can only ever be lowered by the tax recipient. Includes an optional per-transaction buy cap that lapses after a configurable deadline.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes swap funds through Euler lending vaults. The beforeSwap handler takes input tokens from the pool manager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and verifies the result against a custom concentrated-liquidity curve. Liquidity provision and donations are blocked by design.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes liquidity through Euler lending vaults instead of standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. Intercepts all swaps in `beforeSwap`, computes quotes via a proprietary curve invariant, and deposits/withdraws assets to/from Euler vaults, fully replacing the pool's AMM logic via `BeforeSwapDelta`.

hook.name: SatXHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for an ETH/satX pool that fully replaces AMM pricing via BeforeSwapDelta. Buys mint satX via a forward curve; sells burn satX and return ETH from accumulated hook reserves. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; sells have a 1-block cooldown from the swapper's last buy.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad fee hook that collects a configurable fee (default 1%) on every swap in registered token pools, splits fees between the token creator (≥50%) and a platform treasury, distributes referral cuts through a 3-tier referral chain, and records quote volume to a factory contract for graduation tracking.

hook.name: FugaziV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Fugazi token pools that collects a fixed 1% swap fee denominated in the reserve token and distributes it among a burn address, the token creator, and a protocol treasury. Only works with pools pairing a FugaziToken against a designated reserve token with zero LP fee.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook serving tokens graduated via LivoGraduatorUniswapV4. Blocks swaps before a token's graduation, then collects time-limited sell taxes on token sales by taking ETH from the pool, wrapping it to WETH, and forwarding it to each token's configured tax recipient.

hook.name: CaSFProtocol
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single official CSF/native ETH pool that charges a direction-dependent ETH fee (1% on buys, 3% on sells) per swap, taking fees via delta mechanics and distributing 100% of collected ETH to CSF token holders proportionally.

hook.name: DaemonsHook
hook.description: Claims a single canonical ETH/DAEMON v4 pool by enforcing initialization parameters (fee, tick spacing, starting price) in beforeInitialize. After each swap, folds the direction, token deltas, block number, and swap count into a rolling keccak256 hash stored on-chain as "corruption" state, emitted via Mutation events for use by external ERC20/ERC721 NFT renderers.

hook.name: InuPegHook
hook.description: A swap-tax hook that deducts 2.5% on buys (2% to a rewards vault, 0.5% to a deployer address) and 2% on sells (ETH forwarded to vault), using afterSwapReturnsDelta. On buys, INU NFTs are minted to the buyer; on sells, NFTs are burned LIFO from the seller's inventory.

hook.name: LaunchTokenV4
hook.description: ERC20 token with a built-in Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable buy and sell taxes in ETH. On buys (ETH→token), a percentage of the input ETH is taken before the swap via beforeSwap; on sells (token→ETH), a percentage of the ETH output is taken after the swap via afterSwap. Both taxes are forwarded immediately to an immutable tax wallet.

hook.name: GweiFeeHook
hook.description: The shared Uniswap v4 hook for the gwei.fun token launchpad. On every swap it takes a fee in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta — composed of a platform fee plus a per-pool creator tax with an optional linearly-decaying anti-snipe rate — and splits the proceeds between the pool creator and a protocol buyback vault, accumulating them as ERC-6909 claims redeemable lazily.

hook.name: WojakToken
hook.description: ERC20 token combined with a Uniswap v4 hook. Implements tiered buy/sell fees in ETH based on the swapper's WOJAK token balance, taking fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and distributing all collected ETH to token holders weighted by balance and hold duration (Trust Multiplier).

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Euler Finance that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults, depositing input tokens and withdrawing output tokens while enforcing a proprietary bonding curve invariant. Prevents standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity positions and donations to protect users from non-productive positions.

hook.name: TokenpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1.25% fee on ETH-in buys (via beforeSwap delta) and ETH-out sells (via afterSwap delta) for registered token pools, forwarding collected ETH to each token's LaunchToken contract for reward distribution, with buffering and rescue mechanisms for failed forwards.

hook.name: SpectraBlocklistHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that blocks swaps from addresses on a configurable blocklist, checking both the immediate swap caller (sender) and tx.origin. The immutable owner can update the blocklist but cannot affect fees, liquidity, or swap amounts.

hook.name: ERCV4AWeatherHook
hook.description: After each swap on the designated ERCV4A token pool, records buy/sell volume by calling V4AWeatherEngine.recordTrade(), which updates an epoch-based market-sentiment state (Cold/Warm/Hot/Storm). Emits a SwapWeatherPulse event on success or SwapWeatherPulseSkipped if the engine call reverts.

hook.name: VoltageHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that captures a 3% fee on every ETH/VOLT swap: sell fees are taken in ETH and immediately distributed (70% to VOLT holders weighted by balance × time-held multiplier, 30% to a capacitor reserve for holders with ≥100 VOLT); buy fees are collected as VOLT tokens and converted to ETH via a permissionless convertVoltageFee() call.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap by taking input tokens into Euler vaults and withdrawing output tokens from vaults, with configurable fees and optional expiration-based deactivation of the pool.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, enforces a custom curve invariant, and returns BeforeSwapDelta to fully replace pool manager swap accounting.

hook.name: TotalizerTrap
hook.description: Tracks a per-pool cumulative swap volume and reverts any swap whose amount would bring the running total to a multiple of 11. Inherits a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) taken on every swap's output currency via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: AggHook intercepts swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta to route liquidity across multiple registered V3 and V4 pools (including Uniswap V3 and PancakeSwap V3 via swap callbacks), performing multi-hop execution and charging a protocol fee via the pool manager's donate function. Routing data and pool addresses are baked into the contract bytecode; add-liquidity and initialization are restricted to an admin address (tx.origin check).

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: Arrakis private vault hook that restricts liquidity additions to the authorized module and overrides LP fees per swap direction, configurable by the vault executor.

hook.name: SimpleBurnRewardHook
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook. On buy swaps (ETH→token), burns a configurable percentage of the token output from the user's proceeds, reducing total supply. On sell swaps (token→ETH), collects a configurable portion of ETH output into a reward pool distributed proportionally to token holders via a MasterChef-style accumulator; holders claim ETH rewards via claimReward().

hook.name: InuPegHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that imposes a trade tax on each swap — 2.5% on buys (2% to a rewards vault, 0.5% to a deployer address) and 2% on sells (ETH forwarded to the vault) — via afterSwapReturnsDelta. On buys it mints NFTs for the recipient per whole INU token unit received (capped at 3 per swap); on sells it burns NFTs LIFO from the seller's inventory.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in that callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are handled externally via the initializePools() function, which delegates to an immutable LiquidityBootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are passive no-ops.

hook.name: SatoshiYield
hook.description: A hook for a project token/ETH pool that applies epoch-based swap fees via afterSwap delta returns. ETH-side fees are forwarded to a marketing wallet; token-side fees are split between the marketing wallet and a dead-address burn, with both the fee rate and the marketing/burn split decreasing across epochs. Trading is gated by a guardian-controlled enableTrading() call.

hook.name: TTTStrategyHook
hook.description: After-swap hook that collects a 5% fee on token-to-ETH sells: 4% is forwarded to the token contract for buyback and burn, 1% is sent to a dev wallet. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to the factory contract while its loadingLiquidity flag is active.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that integrates with Euler lending vaults. Uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to handle the full swap lifecycle — depositing input tokens into Euler vaults and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults — enforcing a custom invariant curve instead of standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 token launchpad hook that manages creator-controlled, one-sided liquidity positions for new ERC20/ETH pool launches. Token owners initialize pools and add single-sided token-only liquidity; the hook holds LP positions on their behalf and settles proceeds to the creator on removal.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Has no swap-time logic.

hook.name: BrahHook
hook.description: Hook for launching ETH/token pools that restricts initialization and liquidity provision to a designated wall address, gates external buys behind an owner-controlled flag, calls an external pokePrint() function on each non-wall swap, and emits Trade events with price data after every swap.

hook.name: HystrategyHook
hook.description: Skims a fee on the output token of every swap, split 80/20 between a treasury and team address. Buy-side fee decays from 15% to 10% (1% per 5 blocks from deployment); sell-side fee is a flat 10%. Fees are accrued in-contract and withdrawn by recipients separately.

hook.name: SpectrumHook
hook.description: Charges a 3% (300 bps) tax on all non-excluded swaps by taking the fee from the input currency in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta and routing it to a vault. The owner can exclude addresses from the tax and has an emergency kill switch via a config bit.

hook.name: Sa1tHook
hook.description: A multi-phase token launch hook managing CURVE (bonding curve with custom pricing via ERC-6909 claims), REFUND_WINDOW (sell-only with refunds at entry price), and AMM (full-range Uniswap v4 pool with 1% fee skim) phases. Supports mechanic plugins for customizable fee structures and behaviors (e.g., HALVING token burns, MONEYBACK refunds).

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Accumulates swap fees from a Uniswap v4 pool and distributes collected ETH to vMooney token holders who perform weekly check-ins, proportional to their vMooney balance. After each swap, non-native tokens collected as fees are burned to the dead address.

hook.name: flETHHooks
hook.description: A constant-sum 1:1 custom-curve hook for ETH/flETH pools. In beforeSwap, it takes the full input amount, converts it via flETH deposit or withdraw (1:1), and settles the output back to the PoolManager — completely bypassing concentrated liquidity. Direct liquidity addition is blocked; only the ETH/flETH pair with zero fee is accepted.

hook.name: Hyf1Hook
hook.description: A swap tax hook that collects a 4% fee on all non-excluded swaps by intercepting the input token via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and forwarding it to a configurable fee sink. The owner can pause trading globally and exclude specific addresses from taxation.

hook.name: DEPHIHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token pools implementing a block-decaying buy tax (starts at 99%, decays to 10% over ~445 blocks) and a constant 10% sell tax; collected fees are converted to ETH and distributed 40/40/20 between the token contract, a charity address, and a protocol address. Exact-output swaps and post-deployment liquidity additions are blocked.

hook.name: Ring FewV2 Direct Routing Hook
hook.description: Ownerless Uniswap v4 hook that exposes Ring FewV2 direct-pair liquidity through v4 swaps. The hook wraps the input token into its canonical FewToken, swaps through the corresponding FewV2 pair, unwraps the output token, and settles back through PoolManager. It does not require or decode custom hookData, does not allow liquidity in the v4 pool, and has no hook owner, pause, upgrade path, or route-control admin.

hook.name: PoolMetrics
hook.description: Oracle-gated hook that blocks token0-output swaps (token1-input; zeroForOne=false) when an external price oracle reports a price below a configured minimum. In afterSwap, if token0 flows out of the pool to the swapper and the oracle price is below minPrice, the hook returns an invalid selector causing the PoolManager to revert the swap. Always returns a zero delta.

hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Klik.finance that implements market-cap-tiered swap fees for token launch pools. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims during beforeSwap/afterSwap and distributed to a platform treasury and token creator. Includes anti-sniping protection that locks trades on the deployment block and caps buy amounts in USD during the first few blocks.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Collects configurable basis-point fees on both the input token (via BeforeSwapDelta) and output token (via afterSwapReturnsDelta) of each swap, routing the collected fees to a designated recipient address. Fee rates can be configured globally or per-pool by an admin role.

hook.name: Mirror
hook.description: A tax hook for ETH-paired pools that deducts a 10% fee (1000 BPS) on both buys and sells, forwarding proceeds to a hardcoded treasury address. Also maintains a bonding registry that links consecutive swappers via a reflection/echo system, emitting events when bonded wallets trade.

hook.name: DiamondHandsHook
hook.description: Anti-dump hook for a single DMND/WETH pool that charges 0% on buys and a dynamic 0.5–10% fee on sells, scaling with 1h rolling sell pressure via integral pricing. Captured fees are split 50/30/20 between a MerkleDistributor jackpot for DMND holders, WETH→DMND buyback-and-burn, and direct LP donations via poolManager.donate().

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buy-and-burn hook: buys collect 1% of ETH input into a burn pot; sells queue 1% of tokens for burning. Every 20 swaps a buyback-and-burn can be triggered. Sells revert in the same block as a buyback and can be gated by a per-token tx.origin allowlist: any address can permissionlessly enable the sell gate via compress(), while adding addresses and disabling the gate are deployer-only.

hook.name: DopplerHookMigrator
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that migrates Doppler/Airlock token launch liquidity into a fresh v4 pool, splitting it across two single-sided positions, and optionally delegates beforeSwap/afterSwap logic to a configurable Doppler hook with dynamic LP fee support.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom curve AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. It implements a custom bonding curve to verify reserve invariants, handles swaps via beforeSwap with delta returns, and intentionally reverts on standard concentrated liquidity additions and donations.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. On each swap, it computes amounts via a parameterized curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another vault, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the pool's native liquidity.

hook.name: DeltaHook
hook.description: A wave-tax hook that applies zone-aware swap taxes: buys always pay a 3% baseline ETH tax in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta, with ETH rebates paid in afterSwap to buyers in peak (net −3%) or dip (net −6%) price zones relative to the running ATH. Sells are taxed 3% normally or 12% during deep dips, funding the rebate vault.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Arrakis private vault system that applies directional dynamic LP fee overrides per pool (separate rates for zeroForOne and oneForZero swaps), and restricts liquidity additions to the authorized module for each pool.

hook.name: RealmHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that takes a 1% fee on every swap in the pool's REALM token, routing fees into a masterchef-style reward accumulator distributed to NFT heroes weighted by their Power attribute. Includes a commit/reveal NFT recruitment system with burn-on-commit, a genesis delay for fair early-holder distribution, and a guaranteed token-floor redemption for NFT holders.

hook.name: PriceFloorHook
hook.description: Enforces a dynamic price floor on registered memecoin/stablecoin pools by adjusting the LP fee in beforeSwap. Compares the pool's current sqrtPrice against a TWAP reference composed from UniswapV2 price accumulator snapshots along a project-configured route; the fee is raised to prevent swappers from receiving better execution than the external reference minus a configured margin. Curators and LP managers are exempt from the fee adjustment.

hook.name: MEI Swap Hook
hook.description: A 0.5% fee hook for the MEI/ETH Uniswap v4 pool. On each buy or sell, it skims a 0.5% fee in $MEI tokens using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, then forwards collected fees to the meiToken contract via notifySwap() for distribution to token holders.

hook.name: VibeHook
hook.description: A sell-tax hook for an ETH/VIBE pool that charges a time-decaying sell tax (20% during cooldown, decaying to 5%) on exact-input token sells, retaining the tax as reward inventory. Qualified buys (≥0.01 ETH) trigger a 5% reward paid to the previous qualified buyer from the hook's token inventory.

hook.name: EthTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable ETH-side tax (default 5%, max 5%, only decreasable) on every swap in an ETH/token pool. The fee is taken via return deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap and deposited into a RewardsDistributor contract. Trading is gated behind a flag controlled by a launch controller address.

hook.name: ZeroHook
hook.description: Hook for $ZERO that gates all swaps behind a launcher-controlled trading-enable flag, enforces an NFT holder allowlist with a per-address buy cap during an initial time window, and captures a 200 bps fee on every swap by taking output tokens to a fee router via afterSwap delta return.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-gated, one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are no-ops (return zero delta); actual LP seeding and withdrawal occur through separate creator-only entry points (initializePool, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity).

hook.name: HHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a reserve-backed floor price for the H token. On exact-input sells below RFV, beforeSwap intercepts the swap, burns the H, and pays ETH from the treasury at RFV. A 5% swap tax is applied via afterSwap (burning H on buys, routing ETH to treasury on sells). Also mints epoch-based staking rewards on each swap.

hook.name: MoonCatsStrategyHookV2
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook that takes configurable buy/sell fees (up to 10%, or 50% for the first hour post-launch) after each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converts token fees to ETH through a nested pool swap, and distributes proceeds 80% to a strategy contract and 20% to a marketing wallet. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the strategy contract.

hook.name: PegomonHook
hook.description: A tax hook for a PEGOMON token pool that extracts a 3% tax on every swap (2.5% to a prize vault, 0.5% to a platform wallet) using beforeSwap delta returns. In afterSwap, qualifying ETH buys trigger tiered Pokeball awards via an external catcher contract, with bonus flags for whale buys, sell-streak resets, price dip timing, and daily buy count milestones.

hook.name: X3DHook
hook.description: Captures fees on X3D/ETH swaps in beforeSwap using BeforeSwapDelta: 20% flat for the first 5 minutes post-launch, then up to 1.25% (owner-configurable). Fees split 45/45/10 to a pot vault, dividend tracker, and treasury. Triggers round settlement on each swap and stores ETH input in transient storage for automatic key grants by the X3D token contract.

hook.name: 0BL1V10N BuybackAndBurn Hook
hook.description: A hook for the 0BL1V10N token that collects a 1.2% fee on each swap—ETH on buys, tokens on sells—and pools the ETH for periodic buyback-and-burn operations executed via POOL_MANAGER.swap(). Only one liquidity addition per token is permitted, and exact-output swaps always revert.

hook.name: pERC20Hook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that collects a dynamic tax (0.05–0.20%) on buy-side (zeroForOne) swaps and stores the proceeds in an on-hook reserve. The tax rate adjusts each epoch based on buy count; the reserve funds shield bonuses distributed via a linked wrapper contract.

hook.name: LotoHook
hook.description: A lottery hook that skims a 0.5% fee from each swap's output side into an epoch-based pot. At the end of each epoch (~7200 blocks), a winner is selected via sqrt-weighted lottery based on fee contributions, receiving 80% of the ETH pot; 10% rolls over and 10% is donated to LPs. Accumulated LOTO tokens collected as fees are burned at draw time.

hook.name: TombHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the canonical TOMB/ETH pool that permanently burns TOMB on every swap via an asymmetric fee: 1% on buys (withheld directly from TOMB output) and 5% on sells (used to fund a nested ETH→TOMB buyback, with the purchased TOMB then burned). Only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: NFTEngineHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the NFTEngine platform that gates pool initialization and liquidity additions to factory-authorized callers. In afterSwap, it takes a graduated fee (starting at 95% for buys, decaying ~1% per 5 blocks to a 10% floor; flat 10% for sells), swaps token fees to ETH, and distributes 80% to the NFT collection engine and 20% to a configurable fee recipient.

hook.name: uStakeHook
hook.description: A native-ETH Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable flat fee (default 1%, hard-capped at 3%) on the ETH side of every swap using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Collected ETH accumulates in the hook and can be forwarded permissionlessly to a PlantVault via pour() as yield for stakers.

hook.name: PoolMetrics
hook.description: Oracle-guarded hook that blocks token0-to-token1 swaps when a configured oracle reports a price below a minimum threshold. In afterSwap, if amount0 > 0 and the oracle check fails, the hook returns an invalid selector to force a revert; otherwise returns a zero delta and valid selector.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swaps to only allow selling the token the pool currently holds more of, based on virtual reserves derived from slot0 price and active liquidity. Past a 10% skew cap the gate inverts so only the rebalancing direction is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return-delta, routed to a fixed recipient address.

hook.name: OraclePricingHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that prices swaps entirely from Chainlink oracle feeds, bypassing the AMM curve. Operates as an on-chain RFQ venue for tokenized equities, with configurable markets, bid-ask spreads, market hours, and inventory held as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager.

hook.name: GlyphHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that skims a configurable fee (in basis points, hard-capped at 3%) from the input currency on exact-input swaps, accruing it as ERC-6909 claims in the pool manager. Fees can be collected permissionlessly to a treasury address; the fee can only be lowered by the deployer, never raised.

hook.name: SwapFeeHook
hook.description: The single Uniswap v4 hook for the gwei.fun launchpad. In beforeSwap, it charges a configurable fee (platform fee plus optional per-pool creator tax with linear anti-snipe decay) on the specified currency, holding collected amounts as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager for lazy redemption by creators and a buyback vault. Pools must be pre-registered before initialization.

hook.name: SeasonsHook
hook.description: Applies seasonal dynamic LP fees (Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter) that rotate on a fixed time clock. Gates public trading via an owner-controlled boolean switch; skims a configurable protocol fee (up to 1%) from each exact-input swap's output into a treasury, which an owner can use to execute ETH→SZN buybacks routed to a rewards vault.

hook.name: FroundsHookV2
hook.description: A timed game hook for the ETH/FRND pool that takes fees on each swap (burning FRND and funding an ETH prize pot), enforces EIP-712 signed swap authorization, and runs competitive rounds where qualifying buys extend the timer; prizes are split among the top time-holder, last buyer, and comeback leader.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A pass-through Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only afterInitialize is enabled, but the callback performs no logic. A separate initializePools() function bootstraps liquidity via an external contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: HookFee
hook.description: A hook that charges an owner-configurable fee (in basis points) on one-for-zero swaps (token1→token0), diverting a portion of the output amount to a fixed fee recipient via afterSwap delta return. The fee rate can be updated by the owner up to 100% of the output.

hook.name: STRMOGHook
hook.description: Accrues a 10% fee on all swaps in a designated ETH/STRMOG pool, routing collected fees to an immutable treasury address. Fees are captured inline via swap delta returns in beforeSwap and afterSwap, and can be swept to treasury by any caller, with an optional 0.3% bounty to the sweep initiator.

hook.name: StockpairHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for bonding-curve-style token pools that applies a 2% sell-side fee via afterSwap return delta, splitting proceeds 60/40 between the pool creator and platform. Liquidity additions are restricted to the factory before seeding, and liquidity removals are permanently locked.

hook.name: ErcStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/ERC20 pools that applies a 3% buy fee and a dynamic sell tax (5–95% based on time since last sell and trade size), routing collected fees to a vault for periodic token buybacks and burns triggered by the founder.

hook.name: Anchor
hook.description: Combined ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook for the official ANCHOR/native ETH pool. Collects a flat 1% fee on both buys and sells (charged on the ANCHOR leg via delta returns), distributing 100% of collected fees to ANCHOR holders through an O(1) accumulator-based reward mechanism with no staking or lockup required.

hook.name: AlphaHook
hook.description: A floor-backed bonding curve hook that replaces standard Uniswap v4 swaps with a custom buy/sell mechanism using an ETH reserve. Buys mint ALPHA tokens against the curve; sells burn them with a ratcheting ETH floor price guarantee. The team can migrate all liquidity to a Uniswap v3 pool upon graduation.

hook.name: QuasarHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that burns 1% of its own QUASAR/PRISM token on every swap (taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas) and distributes 4% LP fees to rank-weighted NFT holders. Each whole QUASAR token unit held automatically mints a corresponding facet NFT, with earlier-minted facets assigned higher rank-based weights for proportionally greater fee shares.

hook.name: Uni20Hook
hook.description: A beforeSwap-only Uniswap v4 hook that automatically triggers LP fee harvesting via an immutable IUni20FeeLocker contract before each registered pool swap. Harvesting failures are caught with try/catch so they cannot block user trades. No hookData is required and no swap deltas are modified.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that seeds a single-range liquidity position and charges a high anti-snipe fee (99%) that linearly decays to 1% over 20 seconds post-launch. Only the hook itself can add/remove liquidity. Buy fees are collected via beforeSwap; sell fees via afterSwap. Fees are split between the token creator and a protocol fee escrow.

hook.name: TokenHook
hook.description: An ERC20 token that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook. Mints a fixed supply to a specified address on deployment. All hook callbacks are no-ops returning the required selectors without modifying swap behavior.

hook.name: TetrisHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable reflection fee on ETH-denominated buy and sell swaps, distributing collected ETH to token holders via an external IReflectionToken.distributeRewards() call. Also overrides the LP fee dynamically on every swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize flag is active; the callback is a no-op returning only the selector. The contract also exposes an `initializePools()` function (separate from the hook callback) that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record an initial tick.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Applies dynamic LP fee overrides on every swap, delegating buy/sell tax calculations to a configurable external IAntiBotModule contract. Records each user's first buy block to support anti-bot fee tiers; hookData optionally overrides the caller address for fee computation.

hook.name: YieldHook
hook.description: YieldHook is an ERC-20 token (YIELD) and Uniswap v4 hook implementing yield farming: buying into the pool activates a user's stake, selling deactivates it, with token emissions distributed to active stakers. Contains a critical backdoor: an unguarded `setHook(address)` function that permanently locks all sells via division-by-zero once called with the pool token address. Liquidity removal is also permanently disabled.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vaults. Each pool is a delegatecall proxy instance; beforeSwap fully replaces standard concentrated liquidity by taking input tokens into an Euler vault, withdrawing output tokens from another Euler vault, and verifying a custom curve invariant — returning a full delta override to the pool manager.

hook.name: CumHook
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook that adjusts fees based on cumulative price impact (CPI) across swaps. Fees scale with directional market imbalance and time-decay between swaps; each pool must be explicitly configured with fee bounds, decay parameters, and illiquidity scale before trading is permitted.

hook.name: Vitalik0Hook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that acts as sole counterparty for all ETH/Vitalik0 swaps, bypassing AMM liquidity entirely. Buys mint Vitalik0 via a forward curve; sells burn it via an inverse curve, with taxes routed to dev and public reward wallets. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A launch hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a single occurrence per token. In afterSwap, when enabled via the permissionless zero() function, reverts non-zeroForOne (buy) swaps if tx.origin is not in a deployer-managed allowlist, creating asymmetric swap access control.

hook.name: SubframeSwapHookV2
hook.description: Tracks per-wallet token purchase amounts in afterSwap, enforcing a 69-token maximum buy limit (MAX_BUY_AMOUNT). Permanently locks liquidity removal by reverting all beforeRemoveLiquidity calls.

hook.name: StratHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for the $STRAT/wETH pool that levies a 2% fee on all swaps, routing wETH fees to a reserve and burning STRAT fees to maintain a monotone-increasing price floor (N = reserve/supply). Includes a permissionless `defend()` function that uses reserve wETH to market-buy and burn STRAT when TWAP price falls below the floor, and blocks LP additions below the floor price.

hook.name: KingOfTheHillHook
hook.description: A gamified hook where the largest ETH buyer earns the "King" title and collects 2% fees on all buys. Sells incur a 1% KOTH token burn. Dethroned kings have ~12 hours to claim earnings before a keeper can forfeit them into a buyback-and-burn of KOTH. Scroll NFT discounts can reduce the ETH threshold required to dethrone the current king.

hook.name: SimpHook
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that computes LP fees using a VPIN-based model. It tracks order imbalance across fixed-size volume buckets and estimates price impact via an illiquidity measure, then sets a per-swap fee override in beforeSwap. afterSwap records actual price impact and updates volume trackers for subsequent fee calculations.

hook.name: UspegHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that activates the Uspeg ERC-20 token mechanism on pool initialization and enforces a per-buy amount limit during swaps, with a one-way price-triggered phase transition that permanently disables an early-phase mint discount when the pool's sqrtPriceX96 falls below a configured threshold.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that holds afterInitialize permission but implements all callbacks as no-ops. Coordinates multi-chain pool setup via a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract, recording the initial tick on-chain when initializePools() is called.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token LP positions on behalf of token creators. Creators initialize a pool, seed token liquidity into a one-sided range, and can later withdraw their position plus accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta and perform no additional logic.

hook.name: PrismReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: Collects a 1.2% fee on buys (ETH into a reflection pot) and sells (tokens sent to the token contract). Every 20 swaps a buyback is queued; execution needs a manual buyAndReflectPrism() call that buys back and distributes the token. Same-block-as-buyback sells revert; exact-output unsupported. afterSwap also gates sells: when reflectionBase[token] is set, non-canReflect addresses cannot sell - anyone can enable it via excludeReflections(), only genesisAddress disables it.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: ETH/FWAToken pool hook that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps, routing proceeds to an owner-set fee wallet (buys: fee taken in FWAToken and swapped to ETH; sells: fee taken in ETH). Pool initialization is gated on the token's `launching()` flag; buy-side swaps revert for unauthorized callers until the owner enables external trading via `externalBuysEnabled`.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker platform hook that enforces per-pool static LP fees with separate buy/sell rates for the Clanker token, collects a protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, and supports an optional MEV-protection module that temporarily raises fees on newly created pools.

hook.name: StockpairHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 2% fee on token sells (0% on buys), split 60/40 between the pool creator and a platform address. Liquidity additions are restricted to the factory contract and removals always revert, locking LP positions permanently.

hook.name: ImpactHook
hook.description: Computes a dynamic LP fee based on estimated price impact and an illiquidity metric (price impact divided by swap volume), overriding the fee before each swap via OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG. Tracks actual post-swap price impact and updates the illiquidity state used to estimate fees for future swaps.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Collects configurable swap fees in ETH from factory-registered pools, routing portions to a creator wallet, buyback/burn contract, rewards distributor, and platform address. Features an anti-sniper mode that charges a 30% fee during a 60-second post-launch window. LP additions are restricted to an authorized seeder; LP removal is permanently disabled.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the hook exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial liquidity positions across pools.

hook.name: SPCXReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single SPCX/TOKEN pool that collects a 2% SPCX fee on buys (0.25% to dev, 1.75% distributed as reflections to eligible TOKEN holders) and burns 0.5% of TOKEN on sells, using beforeSwap delta returns to intercept fees before the underlying pool swap executes.

hook.name: GweiFeeHook
hook.description: The single Uniswap v4 hook used by all gwei.fun launchpad pools. In `beforeSwap`, it deducts a configurable fee (platform fee plus optional per-pool creator tax with separate buy/sell rates and a linearly-decaying anti-snipe tax) from the specified currency via BeforeSwapDelta, routing proceeds to the creator's fee recipient and a GWEI buyback vault as ERC-6909 claims.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for controlled token launches that enforces launchManager authorization for pool initialization and liquidity provision. Collects configurable buy/sell fees via swap deltas and distributes fee shares across platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Remove liquidity and donations are permanently disabled.

hook.name: Hive
hook.description: ERC-20 token (HIVE) fused with its own Uniswap v4 hook. Takes a 0.5% ETH tax on buys via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and 1% on sells via afterSwapReturnsDelta into a shared jar. Net sell pressure depletes a strength buffer; when it reaches zero, the jar is split among non-selling holders proportional to their time-weighted balance (honey), then a fresh round begins.

hook.name: AuroraHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a loyalty-based dynamic fee system. Traders accrue a "lumi" score based on time (blocks) elapsed since their last swap, scaled by global trading activity, unlocking lower swap fees (1.00% down to 0.10% across four tiers). Sellers who exit within 24 hours of their last buy pay a 15% impatient tax on ETH output, which is redistributed to registered Stellar-tier Archiver holders.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps between the V4 pool and Juicebox project terminals, selecting whichever venue gives the user more output tokens. Uses a 30-minute TWAP oracle to compare routes for buy-side (pay into project for tokens) and sell-side (cash out project tokens) swaps. Also serves as a TWAP oracle for external contracts via an IGeomeanOracle-compatible interface.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. The beforeSwap hook intercepts all swaps, computes exchange amounts via a custom pricing curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity entirely.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. All hook callbacks are pure no-ops returning the selector. An external initializePools() function delegates to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in the callback. Pool initialization and initial tick recording are handled separately via the `initializePools()` function, which calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract. All other hook callbacks (swap, liquidity, donate) are no-ops.

hook.name: TokenpadHook
hook.description: Applies tiered ETH fees on all swaps (buys and sells) based on the token's current market cap, splitting fees among platform, creator, and stakers via a registered LaunchToken contract. Optionally applies an additional creator-controlled tax (up to 5%) on top of the platform fee.

hook.name: BonniHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for the BONNI token ETH pool. Charges a time-decaying fee on ETH (10% buy / 15% sell during a ~17-minute launch window, then 2% flat), distributing fees equally between a treasury and protocol address via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Trading can be enabled or disabled by the owner.

hook.name: ArkHook
hook.description: Charges configurable buy and sell fees on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, taking the fee from the pool manager and routing it to an external fee router. Optionally triggers on-chain maintenance calls (buyback or harbor reinforcement) after each swap.

hook.name: PredicateHook
hook.description: A compliance hook that gates swaps via an external Predicate policy service, requiring a signed authorization message in hookData for non-allowlisted users. Liquidity addition is restricted to an owner-managed allowlist of authorized LPs.

hook.name: Infect
hook.description: ERC-20 memecoin and Uniswap v4 hook that runs a PvP infection game: every buy/sell charges an ETH-denominated tax (2% on buys and clean sells, 7% on infected-wallet sells), distributed to all holders by balance. Users lock tokens to infect wallets and earn a share of those wallets' sell taxes; the hook skims fees via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta overrides with the LP fee forced to zero.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A combined ETH/TOKEN AMM and on-chain lending protocol that self-manages a full-range liquidity position. Takes a 0.5% protocol swap fee via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta returns and blocks swaps in the same block as a liquidation to prevent sandwich attacks.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that enables creators to initialize ETH/token pools and seed one-sided liquidity from a configurable percentage of the token's total supply. Creators can later withdraw their full position (principal and accrued fees) via creator-gated entry points.

hook.name: BossHook
hook.description: A gamified Uniswap v4 hook that turns swaps into a boss-fight: buys deal USD-denominated damage and roll for collectible item drops, sells heal the boss. Active curses apply additional fees (taken via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta) on sellers or buyers; LP fee is fixed at 1% via a beforeSwap fee override.

hook.name: BtcPegHook
hook.description:
Mints $bPEG fragments to swap recipients on the ETH/bPEG v4 pool. Calls token.start when first liquidity is added (afterAddLiquidity). Resolves the real EOA recipient on each swap (afterSwap) via hookData (20-byte address override) or tx.origin fallback for routers, then calls BtcPeg.mintFragmentsFor to give the buyer one on-chain fragment per whole bPEG bought. Read-only on the swap path otherwise (no fee, no delta).

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 0.7% fee on every swap — ETH on buys, tokens on sells — accumulating ETH into a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn operations. Sell transactions can be selectively blocked via a tx.origin allowlist when enabled, and only one liquidity addition per token is permitted.

hook.name: WhitelistTaxHook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that applies dynamic LP fee overrides based on buy/sell direction and a whitelist. Whitelisted addresses swap fee-free; non-whitelisted buyers pay a configurable buyTaxRate, and sellers pay a configurable sellTaxRate (reduced after 10 blocks since the user's first buy).

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a single occurrence per token (currency1). When a per-token timeBased flag is enabled, afterSwap reverts non-zeroForOne swaps for tx.origin addresses not in the owner-controlled hasValue allowlist, blocking non-allowlisted addresses from executing sell-direction swaps.

hook.name: GeodeMiningHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that tracks WETH buy volume per round to allocate mining rewards to buyers, accrues a 3% fee on all WETH swaps (split between burns and protocol), and automatically executes token buybacks triggered by sell pressure.

hook.name: RockTestHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for the PETROCK token that takes configurable buy/sell fees in native ETH and routes them to a fee wallet via pool delta mechanisms. Emits a randomized on-chain RockSignal message on every swap and triggers rock token pool initialization on first liquidity add.

hook.name: LiquidGuard
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that skims a configurable fee (in RARE tokens) from every swap in RARE-paired pools, routing the fee to a distributor contract. When RARE is the specified currency, fees are deducted in beforeSwap; when unspecified, in afterSwap. Pool initialization is restricted to owner-approved initializer addresses.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that locks liquidity to the hook itself and charges time-decaying anti-snipe fees on swaps (starting near 99% and decaying to the configured fee over 20 seconds). Fees are split between a creator fee recipient and a platform escrow. Optional 96-byte hookData enables referral address and trade comment tracking via emitted Trade events.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements only the afterInitialize permission, recording an initial tick from a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-ops; swap behavior is identical to a standard pool.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A smart-routing hook that intercepts swaps in beforeSwap and fills them by routing across multiple hardcoded V3 and V4 pools at the best available price, collecting a small service fee via donate. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to a single admin address enforced via tx.origin check.

hook.name: ETHIHook
