hook.description: A swap-tax hook for the ETHI token that charges a configurable buy/sell fee (default 5%) on every swap, always denominated in ETH, and forwards it directly to a treasury address. The hook also holds the pool's initial liquidity position, which the owner can later remove.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize to support pool setup. It stores the initial tick and a poolInitialized flag when called via initializePools(), which delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper. No swap-side logic is present.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: An on-chain DEX aggregator hook for the USDC/USDT pair that intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, fetches real-time quotes from 4 Uniswap v4 pools and 2 Uniswap v3 pools, sorts them by effective price, and routes swaps through the best venues. Returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully satisfy the swap amount without touching the hook's own v4 pool liquidity.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only `afterInitialize` is enabled (as a no-op). Exposes an `initializePools()` function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to record the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized.

hook.name: Process
hook.description: A self-contained ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook for the PROCESS/native ETH pool. Charges a fixed 1% fee on both buys and sells (always in PROCESS), distributes 100% of fees to eligible token holders via an O(1) accumulator-based reward index, and tracks a gamified "Skull Process" integrity counter that advances or retreats with qualifying swaps.

hook.name: PAMHook
hook.description: ETH-side fee collector for the Perpetual Asteroid Machine token; converts fees to ASTEROID and distributes to PAM holders

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements a concentrated liquidity alternative using Euler Finance vaults, routing swap inputs through vault deposits and outputs from vault withdrawals, verified against a custom bonding curve formula.

hook.name: PepeHook
hook.description: Calls `start` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to a pool involving that token. On each swap involving that token, updates an internal random seed using block entropy (timestamp, prevrandao, block number).

hook.name: ForestHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects 1% of each swap's output as "sap" via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributes it to registered FOREST token holders in a tier-weighted reward pool. Holders earn proportional to their tier (Seedling to Wolf, weights 1–5) based on FOREST balance. Also custodies the launch LP NFT with an owner-callable burn function.

hook.name: LaunchTokenV4
hook.description: An ERC20 token contract with a built-in Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable buy and sell taxes in ETH on every swap (up to 10% each), routing the tax directly to a designated wallet via poolManager.take() before or after the swap executes.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 5% buy and sell tax on swaps in registered pools. Taxes are minted as ERC-6909 claims to an ITaxedDividendToken contract, which redistributes them to token holders.

hook.name: AgentOrchestrationHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the ORCH/WETH pool that skims a 3% WETH tax on every swap, routing fees to an AgentStaking contract, while enforcing a per-transaction ORCH sell cap configurable by a governor address.

hook.name: HookpotHook
hook.description: A jackpot lottery hook for a native ETH / Hookpot token pool that charges a 1.7% fee on every buy and sell to accumulate a jackpot. Each eligible swap earns weighted tickets proportional to trade size (with per-wallet caps and penalties), and at round end a weighted-random winner is drawn who must hold a minimum Hookpot token balance.

hook.name: AscendiumHook
hook.description: A custom step-function AMM hook for a single ASC/WETH pool that fully overrides Uniswap v4 swap math via beforeSwap and BeforeSwapDelta, implementing a geometric pricing curve. Liquidity additions, removals, and donations are blocked; the hook custodies the ASC token supply and accumulates fees for a treasury address.

hook.name: Uniliquid
hook.description: A minimal observation-only hook that listens to afterSwap events for pools pairing ETH (currency0) with a single bound token. It increments a global swap counter and emits a Swapped event; it never modifies swap amounts, charges fees, or alters pool state.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn omnichain token project. Only the afterInitialize flag is set; the callback is a pure no-op returning the selector. Includes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial pool liquidity and records the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: FullRangeLBPStrategy (Strato)
hook.description: The dedicated hook for the STRATO pool, from Strato's June 2026 auction. It uses a full-range position to seed the pool across the whole tick range rather than a concentrated band.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that automatically routes swaps across multiple registered liquidity uniswapV3like pools from Uniswap, Pancakeswap, Sushiswap, Aerodrome, etc. By discovering and executing the most efficient path at transaction time, it allows traders to access deeper aggregated liquidity, improve price execution, and reduce the effects of liquidity fragmentation.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: Charges immutable, configurable buy and sell fees on native ETH/token pools, split between a registered creator reward vault (authenticated via a factory) and an immutable launcher fee recipient. Fees are deducted directly from swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values; ERC-20 transfers are not taxed.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for the MultiPools platform that charges a 1% swap fee on every ETH-token swap (0.7% to pool creator, 0.3% to platform), accumulated in a separate FeeVault. LP is permanently locked after a single initial seed, and pools must be registered by the owner before swaps or liquidity operations are permitted.

hook.name: AvaHook
hook.description: Tracks sell-side tax accrual (default 3%, owner-adjustable up to 10%) on an ETH/AVA Uniswap v4 pool via afterSwap; increments a cumulative counter and emits an event per AVA-sell, but does not transfer or collect any tokens.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided (token-only) liquidity positions for ERC20 token creators. Creators can initialize a Uniswap v4 pool, seed liquidity from a percentage of the token supply, and later withdraw principal plus accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it intercepts all swaps, computes quotes using a configurable price curve (CurveLib), and routes funds through Euler vaults — returning a custom BeforeSwapDelta to replace standard CLAMM execution. Liquidity addition and direct donations are intentionally blocked.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 custom-curve hook that routes all swap liquidity through Euler Finance lending vaults. It replaces standard concentrated liquidity with a proprietary bonding curve, depositing swap inputs into and withdrawing outputs from Euler vaults, with beforeSwapReturnsDelta fully handling token accounting.

hook.name: UniPerps
hook.description: A gamified ERC20 token hook that applies a 10% ETH tax on both buys and sells via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, forwarding taxes to a fixed treasury. Sellers become a "corpse" for 100 blocks; the next buyer within that window "raises" the corpse, otherwise it expires.

hook.name: PactHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on each swap output (2% to a game contract, 1% to a dev wallet) via afterSwap, using poolManager.take() and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Fee destination addresses are configurable by an owner.

hook.name: STRPNKHook
hook.description: Charges a 10% fee on every swap by intercepting beforeSwap and afterSwap, accumulating ETH and token fees as ERC-6909 claims held by the PoolManager. Fees can be swept by anyone and distributed to a treasury and dev wallet (80/20 split for ETH, all to treasury for tokens), with a 0.25% bounty paid to the caller who triggers the sweep.

hook.name: Vesta
hook.description: ERC20 vesting token (VESTA/ETH) that enforces per-seller vesting schedules: sell caps ramp from 0.1% to 100% of a user's bag over 21 days, and swaps exceeding the cap revert. A 5% ETH sell tax is deducted in afterSwap and redistributed proportionally to patient holders (by vesting weight) and a dev treasury.

hook.name: SimHookMVP
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that sets LP fees based on simulated price impact and a time-decaying cumulative price imbalance score. Includes an owner-configurable JIT liquidity lock that prevents LPs from removing liquidity within a configurable block window after adding it.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: Enforces one-time pool initialization and initial liquidity per token (currency1). When the buy gate is activated via the unprotected `bigInt()` function (callable by anyone), non-zeroForOne (buy) swaps revert unless `tx.origin` is in a deployer-managed allowlist.

hook.name: BrickHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 2% WETH fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, accumulates fees in a pot, and periodically deploys the pot to add permanent floor liquidity (35%), buy-and-burn BRICK tokens (27%), fund operations (36.8%), and reward the triggering keeper (1.2%). Liquidity removal is blocked for all addresses except the designated seeder.

hook.name: VirtualLiquidityHook
hook.description: A hook that implements a virtual constant-product AMM (x*y=k) using configurable virtual reserves, handling all swaps entirely in `beforeSwap` via `BeforeSwapDelta` without consuming pool liquidity. Only exact-input swaps are supported, and only a single authorized swap router may initiate swaps.

hook.name: MRPHook
hook.description: Collects a 3% tax on ETH-denominated exact-input swaps by intercepting both beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas, accumulating the tax as ERC-6909 native-ETH claims, and distributing the collected ETH to a token mine distributor. Also advances a rolling per-swap entropy seed using block randomness to support downstream randomized minting.

hook.name: BoredStrategyHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable trade tax (default 10%) on the token0 (ETH) leg of every swap via afterSwap returnDelta, splitting proceeds between a strategy contract (80%), a team wallet, and a spotlight wallet. The tax rate and allocation percentages are adjustable by the owner.

hook.name: FreeholdHook
hook.description: Intercepts all swaps in creator-registered sDAI/SyntheticFiatToken pools and routes them through the token's mint() and redeem() functions via BeforeSwapReturnsDelta, providing oracle-priced, zero-slippage virtual liquidity with no real liquidity held in the pool.

hook.name: PaperHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for a single ETH/token pool that levies a time-decaying swap duty — opening at a configured rate (e.g. 5%) and decaying smoothly to a resting rate (e.g. 1%) over a fixed window from the first swap — routing collected ETH directly to an immutable Pyx address via poolManager.take(), and emitting a daily record to a Foil contract after every swap.

hook.name: StopHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that imposes a flat 3% ETH buy fee and a dynamic sell tax (3–20%, based on time since last sell and trade size) directed to a vault, which uses collected ETH for periodic automated token buybacks and burns.

hook.name: Unilaunch Fee Hook
hook.description: Singleton v4 hook for Unilaunch pools that skims a configurable per-pool fee (50–1000 bps) from each swap and splits it 60% to the pool creator and 40% to a fixed platform wallet. Only pools registered by the factory can initialize with this hook.

hook.name: CustomHook
hook.description: Hook for applying a dynamic (changeable) fee for any pool the hook works with. On each swap, it calls poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee() with an admin-configurable fee rate, and is deployed behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy.

hook.name: Tetris Custom Dynamic Fee Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable proxy hook that calls poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee() on every swap to enforce a configurable LP fee percentage. The fee and admin address are set at initialization and can be updated by the admin.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Implements a usage-grounded dynamic LP fee. The fee starts at 2.00% (cold ceiling), decreases by 0.05% per swap toward a resting floor, and drifts back up 0.005% per block of inactivity. Every 100 swaps, the floor permanently drops by 0.025% down to an absolute minimum of 0.25%. No owner or admin controls; all parameters are immutable constants.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: ETH/FWAToken pool hook that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps, routing collected fees to an owner-set address (buys: fee in FWAToken swapped to ETH via internal pool swap; sells: fee in ETH). Pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated on the token's transient launching() flag; buy access is governance-controlled via an owner-toggled externalBuysEnabled flag.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. Each hook instance is a delegatecall proxy. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, enforces a custom curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully handle swap accounting — replacing standard CLAMM liquidity with vault-backed liquidity.

hook.name: PriceImpactDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A 2-state dynamic fee hook pinned to a single pool. In the DOWN state, non-owner swaps pay a base LP fee (default 2%); if a swap moves the sqrtPrice beyond a configurable threshold, the crank flips ON and subsequent non-owner swaps pay a fee cap (default 10%). Fee is applied as a beforeSwap LP fee override; the owner (tx.origin) pays 0% and can reset the crank via hookData.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces one-time pool initialization and allows only one liquidity addition per token (subsequent additions revert); LP funds are not trapped, as liquidity removal proceeds through standard Uniswap v4 mechanics and LPs can remove their positions freely. In afterSwap, once the permissionless robot() function has been called for a token, non-zeroForOne (sell-side) swaps revert for any address not in the deployer-controlled allowlist, while buys remain unrestricted.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only `afterInitialize` is enabled (as a no-op returning the selector). Liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract via the `initializePools()` function. All swap and liquidity callbacks are pure no-ops.

hook.name: HTOHook
hook.description: Integrated presale and Uniswap v4 hook for the HTO token. Manages an ETH presale (100 ETH hard cap), adds launch liquidity with the LP NFT minted to the deployer address, and collects a fixed 1% trade tax on every swap that is automatically used to buy back and burn HTO tokens when price moves 30% from the last buyback price.

hook.name: Ritual
hook.description: A leveraged liquidity hook where users stake ETH to create recursive LP positions (Disciples), represented as soulbound ERC-6909 tokens. Enforces a 20% launch tax and per-swap size caps on external swaps (liftable by an admin); includes buy-and-burn and permissionless liquidation mechanics.

hook.name: Meme Strategy Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the MEMS meme token that collects dynamic asymmetric swap fees (Phase 1: 50%, Phase 2: 10–90%) on ETH↔MEMS swaps, splitting proceeds 80/20 between a strategy contract and treasury. Includes anti-snipe protection that blocks public swaps until trading is activated by the strategy.

hook.name: SummerHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Summer protocol that gates pool initialization to the Launchpad, enforces full-range LP positions, and charges a 0.25% protocol fee on each swap's unspecified-currency side via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Also runs a 4-week SUMMER token farming program with vesting for LP stakers and a Founders Pool for Genesis Badge holders.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults that implements a proprietary curve invariant. Swaps are executed by depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another, with a full BeforeSwapDelta returned to override standard Uniswap v4 pricing. Standard concentrated liquidity positions and donations are blocked.

hook.name: PMUReactorHook
hook.description: Fee hook for an ETH/PMU pool that applies a time-decaying launch fee on ETH-in (zeroForOne exact-input) swaps. The fee starts at a configurable high rate and decays block-by-block to a 2% base fee, with proceeds split between a buy-and-exile receiver and a team address. Exact-output swaps are blocked. Sell swaps (PMU→ETH) incur a flat 2% fee collected in afterSwap.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that initializes ETH/token Uniswap v4 pools and manages one-sided liquidity positions on behalf of token creators. Exposes no-op afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks; all pool and liquidity operations are creator-gated.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission enabled (implemented as a no-op stub returning the selector). Pool initialization is bootstrapped via an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract through a separate initializePools() call; the hook does not modify swap or liquidity behavior.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM curve hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. Intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler lending vaults while enforcing a custom price curve invariant. Blocks standard concentrated liquidity additions and donations; each deployed instance is a minimal proxy to the shared implementation.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A launch hook that restricts pool initialization and initial liquidity addition to once per token. In afterSwap, it tracks buy-direction swap recipients and can revert sell-direction swaps for addresses not on a deployer-managed allowlist. Makes non-standard calls (msgSender, msgTarget, msgData) on the token contract that will revert on standard ERC-20 tokens.

hook.name: SqueezeCurveMainnetTaxHook
hook.description: An ERC-20 token ("squeeze curve" / "sc") combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 2% swap tax on every trade. In afterSwap, the hook takes the tax from the unspecified-token side of the swap via poolManager.take() and sends it to an immutable taxRecipient address, returning the fee amount as an afterSwap delta.

hook.name: LendingHookV3
hook.description: A lending AMM hook that manages a full-range ETH/ERC20 V4 LP position as a shared vault. LPs deposit and earn swap fees; borrowers draw ETH against TOKEN collateral at 40% LTV; a 0.5% protocol fee is skimmed from each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta hooks, and swaps are blocked in any block where a liquidation occurred.

hook.name: LpGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to a single whitelisted launcher address, reverting any attempt by an unauthorized sender to initialize a Uniswap v4 pool using this hook.

hook.name: Fomo4DHook
hook.description: A FoMo3D-inspired jackpot game hook for Uniswap v4. Buyers of KEY4D tokens earn round credit and extend a countdown timer; when the timer expires, Chainlink VRF selects a weighted winner from the last 128 qualifying buys. The hook applies a dynamic buy tax that steepens as the round nears expiry, with ETH-side fees funding the jackpot and KEY-side fees burned.

hook.name: Ring FewV2 Aggregator Hook
hook.description: Ownerless router-compatible Uniswap v4 hook that exposes Ring FewV2 AMM liquidity through v4 swaps. The hook uses empty hookData, registers aggregator pools, exposes quote and pseudoTotalValueLocked for routing discovery, and has no hook owner, pause, upgrade path, or route-control admin.

hook.name: OFAOrderFlowAuctionHook
hook.description: An order-flow auction hook for ETH/OFA pools that routes exact-in buy swaps to bonded fillers at the spot price when a qualifying filler is available, distributing the filler's surplus bid to OFA token holders. Falls back to a 2% baseline fee on unmatched buys and all sells, also forwarded to holders.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only afterInitialize is active; no swap or liquidity callbacks modify swap behavior.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that only holds the afterInitialize permission, recording the initial pool tick after initialization. An external initializePools() function invokes a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract to bootstrap token liquidity positions.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using its own bonding curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap v4 pool math, and enforces a reserve invariant. Standard LP positions and donations are intentionally blocked.

hook.name: SoulHook
hook.description: A pump.fun-style bonding-curve hook for Uniswap V4. ETH buys mint SOUL tokens along a constant-product curve; sells burn them. The hook intercepts all swaps via beforeSwap (requiring an encoded swapper address in hookData), handles token minting and burning directly, and graduates to a locked Uniswap V3 LP position once the bonding curve fills.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick on pool initialization via a liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only the afterInitialize flag is active (as a no-op selector return); there are no active swap, liquidity, or donate hooks.

hook.name: ToshisHook
hook.description: On first liquidity add, calls token.start() on the bound IStartableToken to lift a pre-start trading cap. On each swap, re-rolls an internal random seed by mixing swap count, prevrandao, block number, and timestamp; the seed is publicly readable via randomSeed().

hook.name: RipeHook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 observer hook for the RIPE project that records the pool key on first initialization and tracks the last swap block number in afterSwap. It performs no fee modifications, token transfers, or access control on swaps.

hook.name: SidechainHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 ETH/BPM pool hook that functions as an on-chain music sequencer, mapping each swap to a rhythmic note on a 16-measure grid. It applies dynamic protocol fees based on beat position, accumulates fees per track, and tracks player groove scores; at track close the score leader is crowned winner and fees are handed to an immutable fee vault for a BPM buyback.

hook.name: Pyre
hook.description: Pyre is a Uniswap v4 hook bundled with an ERC20 token (v4PYRE) that levies a 15% ETH tax on both buys and sells. On buys (ETH→v4PYRE), it skims 15% of the ETH input via beforeSwap delta; on sells (v4PYRE→ETH), it skims 15% of ETH output via afterSwap delta. All tax proceeds are forwarded to a hardcoded treasury address.

hook.name: FlywheelV4Hook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn hook that collects a 1.2% fee on every swap — ETH on buys into a burn pot, tokens on sells queued for burning — and periodically executes autonomous buybacks by swapping accumulated ETH for the pool token and burning the proceeds.

hook.name: NoncePoolHookV1
hook.description: A launchpad hook for nonce.fun pools that restricts pool initialization and liquidity provision to a designated launchpad contract. It enforces a fixed opening price, tick range, and fee, allows only one initial liquidity mint per token, locks principal removal, and permanently disables donations.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: A swap tax hook for a FORGE token pool that skims a flat 1% sell tax and a 90% cliff launch buy tax (active for 5 minutes post-launch) to a treasury address on every swap. Also overrides the LP fee to a flat 0.30% on all swaps. Pool is locked until a configured launch timestamp.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that lets a creator initialize a Uniswap v4 ETH/token pool and seed a one-sided (token-only) liquidity position. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero deltas; actual pool mutations are performed via an unlockCallback driven by creator-gated addLiquidity/removeLiquidity entry points.

hook.name: StakerHook
hook.description: ERC20 token (STAK3) that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook. Buying through the official ETH/STAK3 pool activates staking for the buyer; selling deactivates it. Token emissions follow a daily decay schedule and are settled to active stakers on each swap interaction.

hook.name: PredicateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces transaction compliance by validating swaps against off-chain Predicate policies. Authorized users bypass policy checks; others must supply signed authorization data in hookData. Liquidity additions are restricted to an owner-managed allowlist.

hook.name: ETIM Tax Hook
hook.description: Applies a configurable buy/sell tax (up to 10%) on ETIM swaps via BeforeSwapDelta; buy tax is collected in ETH (currency0), sell tax is split among a burn address, S6 rewards, a foundation wallet, and an official wallet. Buys are blocked until a governance flag (isGrowthPoolDepleted on the main contract) is set; exempt addresses bypass taxation. afterSwap currently returns a zero delta.

hook.name: ETIMTaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook for the ETIM token that deducts configurable buy and sell taxes from each swap via BeforeSwapDelta, distributing sell-side taxes to foundation, S6, official, and burn allocations. Buys are gated behind a growth-pool depletion check and only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables only afterInitialize (which performs no action beyond returning the selector). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial pool liquidity and record the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: LiquidityGenHook
hook.description: Collects configurable buy and sell taxes in WETH (up to 15% each) via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns, then automatically adds full-range liquidity to the pool when accumulated fees reach a configured threshold, distributing a platform fee cut to a collector address.

hook.name: TransparentHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements phased buy and sell fees (higher opening rates, then baseline rates), routing buy-fee tokens into a seller inventory that is automatically sold via nested swaps into the pool before each user sell, with ETH proceeds forwarded to a collector address.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions on behalf of token creators. Creators initialize a pool, seed liquidity as a percentage of token supply, and can later withdraw their position plus any accrued fees. The hook only intercepts add/remove liquidity callbacks and does not modify swap behavior.

hook.name: BunnyToken
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 meme token and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 0.5% fee on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, taking the fee in the output token (BUNNY on buys, ETH on sells) and accumulating it in the contract for periodic transfer to a treasury address.

hook.name: BlockAddLiquidityHook
hook.description: Records tx.origin as the pool creator on initialization, then reverts any liquidity addition where tx.origin differs from the stored creator. Only the EOA that initialized the pool can add liquidity, regardless of which router they use.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A lending AMM hook that manages a single full-range ETH/TOKEN LP position as an ERC4626-style vault, allowing LPs to deposit and borrowers to take ETH loans against TOKEN collateral at 40% LTV. Skims a 0.5% protocol swap fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and blocks swaps in the same block as a liquidation.

hook.name: CombustionBurnHook
hook.description: Burns 0.1% of COMBUSTION tokens on every swap. On buys (ETH→COMBUSTION), immediately burns 0.1% of COMBUSTION output via afterSwap delta. On sells (COMBUSTION→ETH), collects 0.1% of ETH output into the contract; anyone can call executeSellBurn() to swap that ETH back for COMBUSTION and burn it.

hook.name: SharesHook
hook.description: Collects protocol fees (2.5% each) on buy and sell swaps for a designated native/token pool, updates an on-chain random seed on each swap, and notifies an external launch controller of swap activity. Triggers a token start on first liquidity addition once config is finalized.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults that implements a concentrated bonding curve. In beforeSwap, it handles all token accounting directly—depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another vault—returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap v4 CLAMM liquidity. Standard liquidity addition and donation are blocked via hook reverts.

hook.name: IncineratorHook
hook.description: Applies a 1.2% fee on all swaps: buy fees collect as ETH in a burn pot; sell fees queue as tokens for burning. Every 20 swaps a buyback is queued (BuybackQueued event); the ETH buyback-and-burn is executed by a later buyAndBurn() call (a nested pool swap). Sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Sells can also be gated to a deployer-managed allowlist (via tx.origin) in afterSwap: any address can permissionlessly trigger this per token, after which only allowlisted addresses can sell.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A one-time launch hook that restricts each token's pool initialization and initial liquidity addition to a single occurrence. In afterSwap, when enabled for a token, limits non-zeroForOne swaps to addresses in an owner-managed allowlist, checked via tx.origin rather than msg.sender.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: Validates signed quotes from a designated signer before each exact-input swap, enforcing nonce-based replay protection, a max amount-in, and an expiry time. In afterSwap, any output exceeding the quoted max exchange rate is captured as ERC-6909 tokens for a configured recipient.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only `afterInitialize` is active (as a no-op selector return); no swap, liquidity, or donate hooks are enabled.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A configurable swap-fee hook for ETH-paired pools that collects fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and routes them to a fee vault, buyback burner, and rewards distributor. Includes an optional antisniper window with elevated fees at launch and restricts liquidity provision to an authorized auto-LP seeder only.

hook.name: StableStableHook
hook.description: Dynamic fee hook for stable/stable pools that adjusts LP fees based on price deviation from a configurable reference price. Fees decay exponentially when the pool price is outside the optimal range, incentivizing arbitrage back to peg while charging reduced fees for stabilizing swaps.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable swap fees (30–500 bps) by intercepting swap amounts via before/after swap deltas, routing proceeds to creator, buyback/burn, rewards distributor, and platform wallets. Features a 60-second antisniper window (30% fee) at launch and locks LP so only a designated auto-LP seeder can add liquidity; removals are permanently blocked.

hook.name: HookLaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the HookLaunch token launch platform that gates pool initialization to a factory contract, enforces a pre-registered opening price, and records per-swap statistics (swap counts and native/token volumes) for launched token markets.

hook.name: GBYV4Hook
hook.description: A gamified tax hook that applies dynamic randomized buy (1–8%) and sell (3–12%) taxes on each swap. Tax proceeds fund a round reward pool and a buyback reserve. Large buys above a USD threshold qualify for reward rounds; eligible holders receive token distributions when rounds finalize. A separate mechanism swaps reserve tokens for WETH and burns repurchased tokens.

hook.name: HystrategyHook
hook.description: Fee-skimming hook for ETH/WETH ↔ HYSTR pools that deducts a fee from swap output on every trade. Sell-side fee is flat 10%; buy-side decays from 15% to 10% (1% per 5 blocks after deployment). Collected fees are split 80% to treasury and 20% to team via poolManager.take().

hook.name: EthTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that skims configurable buy and sell taxes (in basis points) from the ETH side of ETH/token pools. Fees are taken via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and forwarded to a rewards distributor contract, with optional per-swap account settlement via hookData. Trading is gated by a launch controller.

hook.name: ZCHFSavingsRouterHook
hook.description: A zero-fee ZCHF/svZCHF pool hook that provides just-in-time liquidity for each swap from protocol-owned reserves, blocks all external liquidity providers, and reverts swaps when the spot price deviates from the savings vault's fair price beyond a configurable threshold.

hook.name: RuneHook
hook.description: An afterSwap-only hook that advances a 16-joint inverse-kinematics (CCD) animation on each swap. Joint angles are packed into two storage slots; targets track the pool tick; 1–4 solver passes run per swap scaled by swap size. Emits Step events and seals the rig after 12 stalled improvement steps.

hook.name: TTTHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TTT/ETH pools launched by the TenThousandTokens factory. Applies a flat 1% fee on every swap; on buys, fee tokens are swapped back to ETH and forwarded to a FeeSplitter. During the first 15 minutes after launch, if the pool has nftOnlyPeriod enabled, only holders of the original TenThousandTokens NFT collection may buy.

hook.name: GhostProtocol
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that mints on-chain "ghost" game entities for each ETH-in swap, implementing a PvP yield lifecycle: ghosts are created on swap, activated (haunted) to accrue yield, claimable by first movers (possessed), and expire with yield redistribution (vanish).

hook.name: Doppler
hook.description: A time-bounded token launch hook implementing a Dutch auction-style mechanism via rebalancing liquidity slugs. It enforces a trading window (startingTime to endingTime), dynamically adjusts LP fees, tracks total proceeds against a minimum threshold, and supports a migration function to transfer assets after a successful or failed sale.

hook.name: FALLaunchHook
hook.description: Charges a 4% fee (0.5% to a fee collector, 3.5% to a harvester contract) on exact-input swaps involving ETH (currency0) — deducting from ETH input on ETH→token swaps via BeforeSwapDelta, and from ETH output on token→ETH swaps via AfterSwapDelta. Fee recipients and governor address are configurable by the current governor.

hook.name: BallisticFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges immutable directional buy/sell fees on registered native ETH/token pools, splitting collected fees 90/10 between a per-pool creator reward vault and an immutable treasury. Supports optional launch-period fee schedules with linear time-decay from a higher opening rate to a settled base rate.

hook.name: PokemonPegHook
hook.description: Pokémon Peg ($pPEG) v4 hook. Mints NFT fragment metadata (one Pokémon per fragment) on every buy, proportional to pPEG received. Resolves the recipient address from hookData (20- or 32-byte) or falls back to tx.origin for contract callers. Calls start() on the token on first liquidity addition and randomises the RNG seed on each afterSwap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables afterInitialize but performs no logic in any hook callback. Pool initialization tick is recorded externally via a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract called through initializePools().

hook.name: UniLandHook
hook.description:
UniLand is a 10,000-plot lottery meme coin powered by a Uniswap v4 hook. Each whole $ULand token (1e18) maps 1:1 to a numbered plot in [1..10000] via a lazy Fisher-Yates shuffle inside the ERC20. On every sell, the hook's afterSwap takes 3% of the output ETH, draws a random plot id, and forwards the ETH directly to that plot's owner. Free plots fall back to the treasury. Buys are tax-free. Hook permissions: afterSwap | afterSwapReturnDelta (bottom-14 = 0x44).

Site: https://unilandhooks.fun
X...

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled (as a no-op). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap or liquidity-modification logic is active.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-controlled, one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions on Uniswap v4. Creators initialize a pool, seed token-only liquidity at the launch price boundary, and can later withdraw both principal and accrued fees.

hook.name: UCards
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single ETH/token pool that collects configurable buy and sell fees in ETH via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, accumulating them in the hook for a designated tax wallet to withdraw. Includes an optional per-swap token cap (as a % of supply) that auto-lifts after a configured block window, with manual override by the tax wallet.

hook.name: LiquidityGrowthFeeOracleHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges directional native-token swap fees (configurable buy/sell rates, 1%–10%) distributed between a creator and a launcher fee recipient, while maintaining an on-chain tick observation oracle per pool using a truncated Panoptic-style observation history.

hook.name: LBPStrategy
hook.description: LBPStrategy (v3.1.0) bootstraps a Uniswap v4 pool from a price discovery auction. It creates the auction through a factory, then opens the pool at the auction's clearing price, seeded with the tokens reserved for liquidity plus a scheduled share of the currency raised.

hook.name: Coven
hook.description: A combined ERC20 token (COV4) and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 10% tax on ETH/token swaps via delta returns, forwarding tax to a fixed treasury address. Tracks a "ritual chain" of 13 consecutive unique buyers (each ≥0.5 ETH), emitting a RitualSealed event when a coven of 13 unique buyers is formed.

hook.name: Permissioned Pools
hook.description: Permissioned Pools are a Uniswap V4 hook system that allows trading of tokenized and regulated assets onchain. The hook checks an issuer-managed allowlist on every swap and liquidity addition, while a verified wrapper contract keeps the permissioned token compatible with the standard PoolManager.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn omnichain protocol. Only afterInitialize is flagged but its callback is a no-op (returns selector only). The actual pool bootstrapping is performed by a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract invoked via the initializePools() function, which records the initial tick and sets a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: JrnyHook
hook.description: A protocol-fee hook for ETH-paired Uniswap v4 pools that intercepts swaps to collect a configurable fee on each trade, including a time-decaying "shock fee" window that ramps down from a maximum to a base rate. Collected ETH fees accumulate and are automatically distributed to owner-configured receiver addresses when a minimum threshold is reached.

hook.name: AtomicLimitOrderHook
hook.description: AtomicLimitOrderHook atomically combines a swap and a limit-order placement in a single transaction, extending OpenZeppelin's LimitOrderHook. It prevents front-running between the two steps and adds guards that keep order accounting consistent under aggregator-style multi-hop swaps. Uses the AFTER_INITIALIZE and AFTER_SWAP flags; ordinary swaps through the pool require no custom hook data.

hook.name: FomoHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a FOMO-style token launch platform. It gates initial liquidity bootstrapping to the designated launcher via tagged hookData, calls an external fee vault on every swap to trigger game-round settlement, and records qualifying buy events from the designated fomoRouter for prize pool accounting.

hook.name: PercentProfitHarvestOnZeroHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces dynamic LP fee overrides per swap direction (configurable fee for zeroForOne swaps, zero fee for oneForZero) and collects an additional owner-configurable hook swap fee (up to 0.01%) from the output token for exact-input swaps and from the input token for exact-output swaps. Accrued fees are held in the hook contract and claimable by the owner.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A hook that applies dynamic LP fee overrides based on buy/sell direction via a pluggable external IAntiBotModule. In beforeSwap it queries the module for a fee (falling back to tx.origin if no hookData is provided), and in afterSwap it records the trade in the module. The owner can update the anti-bot module address at any time.

hook.name: Ring Few USDC Hook
hook.description: A hook that facilitates seamless 1:1 wrapping and unwrapping of an ERC20 token and its Ring Few-wrapped counterpart (fewToken) within a Uniswap v4 pool, intercepting swaps in beforeSwap to perform the wrap or unwrap operation and returning a delta to settle the exchange.

hook.name: Ring Few UNI Hook
hook.description: A hook that enables atomic wrapping and unwrapping of Few Protocol wrapper tokens within Uniswap v4 swaps, enforcing a 1:1 exchange rate between an ERC20 token and its fewToken equivalent.

hook.name: LaunchGuardHook
hook.description: A launch guard hook for a single token/ETH pool that enforces strict pool initialization parameters (price, fee, tick spacing) and restricts initialization to a designated locker address. On buy swaps it records transient buy credits; on sell swaps it triggers fee collection from the locker contract via an external call.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts using a configurable concentrated-liquidity curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting directly, bypassing standard Uniswap pool liquidity.

hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a time-decaying fee on swaps (starting at 95% for buys, declining 100 bips per 5 blocks to a 10% floor), collecting fees in ETH via nested pool swaps when needed, routing 80% to a companion StrategyPunk contract and 20% to a fee address. Liquidity operations are gated to the companion StrategyPunk contract.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Applies a fixed 5% buy and 5% sell tax on swaps in registered pools. Tax is collected in the base asset via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas, minted to the token address, and recorded as dividends through the token's recordTaxFromHook function.

hook.name: MiladyStrategyHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 20% fee on all exact-input ETH/MLDYSTR swaps via afterSwap delta; 80% of collected fees are forwarded to the MiladyStrategy contract (for NFT purchases) and 20% go to a protocol fee address. Exact-output swaps revert. Token fees are converted to ETH via a nested pool swap before distribution.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% buy and sell tax on registered token pools using BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapDelta to deduct the tax from swap amounts. Collected taxes are minted as ERC-6909 claims to the token contract and reported via `recordTaxFromHook`.

hook.name: PosHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1% ETH fee on every swap in ETH/TOKEN pools. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to collect the fee from the ETH side of each swap, covering all four swap directions (exactIn/exactOut × ETH-input/ETH-output). Accumulated fees are held in the hook contract and withdrawable by an immutable fee recipient.

hook.name: RigHook
hook.description: Proof-of-liquidity mining hook for a single ETH/RIG pool. Applies buy (2%) and sell (5%) swap taxes via BeforeSwapDelta; buy tax funds ETH rewards, sell tax is 50% burned and 50% swapped back to ETH via an internal poolManager.swap() call. Rewards are distributed per 720-second epoch to LPs weighted by capital depth, range tightness, and position age.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% buy and sell tax on swaps involving a designated token in registered Uniswap v4 pools. Tax amounts are minted from the pool manager via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and recorded on an ITaxedDividendToken contract for dividend distribution.

hook.name: SXSHook
hook.description: A buyback hook that collects a configurable fee (default 4%) on ETH/token swaps and routes those fees through a two-hop ETH→USDC→SPCX swap on Uniswap v4, delivering purchased SPCX tokens to the associated token contract as staking rewards.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-controlled, one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions. Creators call initializePool to create a pool, addLiquidity to seed a percentage of token supply, and removeLiquidity to withdraw principal plus accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta and perform no custom logic.

hook.name: DestinyHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook for DESTINY/ETH pools. Charges a fixed 1% buy tax (deducted from input before the swap via BeforeSwapDelta) and a 1% sell tax (deducted from ETH output after the swap via AfterSwapDelta). Exact-output swaps are disabled. Collected fees accumulate in the hook contract and can be withdrawn by the owner.

hook.name: Psyche
hook.description: An ERC20 token (ECHO) combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that applies variable swap surcharges (5–50 bps) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, scaled by each swapper's contribution coefficient — a weighted product of token tenure, balance weight, and swap witness count. Higher-coefficient holders pay lower surcharges; the surcharge differential routes back to liquidity providers.

hook.name: MiladyStrategyHook
hook.description: A fixed 20% fee hook for the MLDYSTR/ETH pool that intercepts swaps in afterSwap, takes the fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converts token-denominated fees to ETH via a nested poolManager.swap() call, and distributes proceeds 80% to MiladyStrategy and 20% to a protocol fee address. Exact-output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: OfficialFloorHook
hook.description: A custom bonding-curve swap hook for the FLOOP token. It completely replaces pool swap mechanics: ETH-in buys mint FLOOP (routing funds through an ETH treasury vault), and FLOOP-in sells burn the tokens and return ETH. Liquidity additions are forbidden; the hook enforces a coverage invariant to maintain an ETH-backed floor price.

hook.name: FaunaHook
hook.description: UUPS-upgradeable hook for the FAUNA NFT pool that notifies a renderer contract after each swap to trigger butterfly reveal mechanics. No access control on swaps; only afterSwap is active and solely performs an external notification call.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-owned one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions in Uniswap v4. Creators initialize a pool, seed a token-only position sized as a percentage of supply, and may later withdraw principal and accrued fees back to themselves.

hook.name: SanctumHook
hook.description: Fee-skimming hook for a SANCTUM/USDC pool. Takes a 2% buy fee and a tiered sell fee (1–6% based on how long the seller has held SANCTUM, via an on-chain clock), routing proceeds 90% to a vault and 10% to a team wallet. Both buy and sell skims are implemented via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapReturnDelta.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 token launchpad hook that manages one-sided token liquidity in an ETH/token pool. Token creators initialize a pool, seed a percentage of the token's total supply as a one-sided range position [minUsableTick, currentTick], and later withdraw the full position (principal + accrued fees) back to themselves. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta.

hook.name: UniChainHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a deflationary ERC-20 (CHAIN) that burns 1% of token output on buys and uses 5% of ETH output to execute a nested buyback-and-burn on sells, reducing CHAIN total supply on every trade in a single canonical CHAIN/ETH pool.

hook.name: VolcanoHook
hook.description: Tracks buy/sell swaps on a designated volcano token pool: buys increment "volcano energy" (+1% per transaction) and sells mark the seller as "ashed" (ineligible for rewards). When energy reaches 100% an "eruption" occurs, distributing the accumulated ETH reward pool proportionally to non-ashed token holders, then resetting energy and the round.

hook.name: TailTwins
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's absolute low byte to be within 16 of the current pool's sqrtPriceX96 low byte; reverts otherwise. Also charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwap return delta, routed to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: GridHook
hook.description: GridHook imposes a 3% sell tax on GRID→ETH swaps by claiming a portion of the ETH output via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accumulated ETH is held in the contract and can be used by any caller to trigger a buyback-and-burn of GRID tokens through the same pool.

hook.name: MiladyStrategyHook
hook.description: A hook for the MLDYSTR/ETH pool that takes a time-decaying custom fee (starting at 99%, decaying 10pp/hour to 20% over 8 hours) on each ExactIn swap via afterSwap. Token fees are converted to ETH through a nested poolManager.swap(), then distributed 80% to MiladyStrategy and 20% to a protocol fee address. ExactOutput swaps are unconditionally rejected.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that implements a constant-product bonding curve priced in IMD tokens. Swaps on launched token pools (ETH/coin) are fully consumed in beforeSwap: the ETH leg routes through a canonical ETH/IMD pool, and the IMD proceeds price the coin against a per-coin virtual reserve curve. Creator fees (ETH) and burn fees (IMD) are applied on each trade.

hook.name: TitanumHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $Ti (Titanum) token that skims a 3% WETH tax on swaps into a treasury, advances a positive token supply rebase every 30 minutes triggered by swaps or a permissionless poke, and executes buyback-and-burn of $Ti using accumulated treasury WETH.

hook.name: StockMemeV4FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% swap fee on the pool's registered quote token, splitting it between the pool creator (1%) and protocol treasury (0.5%); fees are accumulated as ERC-6909 claims redeemable by the creator directly or via EIP-712 X-account signature.

hook.name: PrismCombinedTokenHook
hook.description: A self-contained ERC20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1.2% fee on buys (in native ETH, stored for external reflection token buybacks) and burns 1.2% of the token on sells. Periodically triggers a buyback of an external reflection token that is distributed to holders.

hook.name: Cork AMM (Ethereum)
hook.description: Cork AMM is a custom Uniswap v4 hook for the Cork Protocol that implements a specialized AMM for depeg-swap token pairs (RA and CT). It replaces the standard Uniswap price curve with its own pricing logic, gates all native liquidity modifications through the hook's own interface, and supports optional flash swaps via a CorkSwapCallback pattern.

hook.name: DeployerTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable per-direction buy/sell tax (up to a 15% hardcap) on exact-input swaps for a single token pool by returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Fees are accrued as ERC6909 claim tokens on the PoolManager and drainable by anyone to a configurable dev wallet.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Charges a 1.2% fee on all swaps: buy-side (ETH->token) fees accumulate in a native burn pot and are periodically used to buyback and burn tokens; sell-side (token->ETH) fees are taken and burned directly. Blocks all liquidity additions after the first and reverts exact-output swaps. An afterSwap allowlist (hasValue) can gate sells; the restriction is enabled permissionlessly by anyone via burner(), while allowlist membership is owner-controlled.

hook.name: Luck
hook.description: A combined ERC20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a tiered ETH tax on buys and sells. Tax starts at 20% for the first 10 minutes post-launch, drops to 10% for the next 10 minutes, then settles at 3%. Collected ETH is forwarded to a hardcoded treasury address. A separate admin can adjust the rate downward within the scheduled tier cap.

hook.name: BloomHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing queue-based sell access control for its native BLOOM token. Buyers are automatically enqueued and only the queue head (or Bloom Pass NFT holders) may sell; idle heads suffer linear token decay. LP fees are distributed to Bloom Pass holders proportionally by weight.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description:
A deployment of OpenZeppelin's LimitOrderHook — a Uniswap v4 hook implementing single-tick limit orders. Users place orders by providing concentrated liquidity at a specific tick; when the pool price crosses that tick, the position is automatically filled and can be withdrawn at any time.

Original implementation by OpenZeppelin (github.com/OpenZeppelin/uniswap-hooks). Deployed to Ethereum mainnet to make this functionality publicly accessible.

hook.name: ChronaHook
hook.description: Charges a flat 1% ETH fee on every swap in ETH/TOKEN pools by intercepting both beforeSwap and afterSwap with return deltas. Collected ETH fees accumulate in the hook contract and are withdrawable by a designated fee recipient.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: DualPool is a Uniswap v4 hook where capital rests in ERC-4626 vaults between swaps and is deployed as concentrated liquidity just-in-time, so LPs earn swap fees and vault yield on the same token.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that initializes ETH/token pools and manages one-sided LP positions on behalf of token creators. Liquidity is seeded at launch (token-only, below current tick) and withdrawn to the creator on demand. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are pass-through (ZERO_DELTA).

hook.name: TideHook
hook.description: A fee-skimming hook that collects a configurable levy (default 1%, max 5%) on each swap's quote-side amount. Fees are captured via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and held in the hook contract, where they can be claimed by designated "sailors" registered in the paired factory.

hook.name: Auto Liquidity Generator Hook
hook.description: LiquidityGenHook collects configurable buy and sell WETH taxes on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, accumulates them, and automatically re-invests into the pool as full-range liquidity once a threshold is reached. A platform fee is taken before the liquidity add.

hook.name: Auto Liquidity Generator
hook.description: Collects configurable buy and sell taxes (in WETH) on every swap. Once accumulated fees reach a configurable threshold, deducts a platform fee (20–50% of the accumulated amount) sent to a designated collector, then uses the remainder to buy the paired token and add full-range protocol-owned liquidity. Residual tokens after liquidity addition are burned.

hook.name: WETHHook
hook.description: WETHHook turns a v4 pool into an ETH / WETH wrapper. Swaps mint or burn WETH 1:1 against native ETH via the WETH9 contract. Deposits take ETH from the PoolManager and settle the minted WETH back; withdrawals unwrap and return native ETH. Direct liquidity provision is disabled.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook for Uniswap v4 that allows token creators to initialize ETH/token pools and seed one-sided (token-only) liquidity positions. The hook gates add/remove liquidity through a creator-only entry point backed by a pending-op pattern, while swaps execute as standard Uniswap v4 pool swaps with no hook intervention.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: MixpadHook collects a configurable platform fee on every swap for factory-registered tokens, splitting revenue between the token creator and treasury. It applies anti-snipe surcharges in blocks immediately after launch, a time-decaying deployer dump surcharge, optional buyback-and-burn of the creator's fee share, and optional dividend routing to a yield vault.

hook.name: NestHook
hook.description: A liquidity mining hook that distributes EGG token rewards to LPs proportional to their contributed liquidity in a single canonical pool. Reward accrual is triggered on each swap and liquidity modification, with per-position tracking and support for excluding burned (dead-address) liquidity from reward distributions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. A separate initializePools() function delegates to a linked ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap pool liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: DeployerTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable buy/sell tax (up to a 15% hardcap) on exact-input swaps for a specific token's ETH pool by returning a BeforeSwapDelta, accruing fees as ERC6909 claim tokens on the PoolManager drainable to a designated dev wallet.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A burn-and-buyback hook that charges a 2.2% fee on buys (ETH routed to a reserve for periodic buybacks) and burns 2.2% of tokens on sells. Liquidity additions are restricted to one initial deposit. Contains a hidden allowlist mechanism in afterSwap that can selectively block sells from non-allowlisted addresses when activated by any caller via superposition() (allowlist membership itself is controlled by the deployer).

hook.name: BracketHook
hook.description: BracketHook is the central contract for the TheCup protocol, managing 48 country-token pools across two AMM regimes: a bonding curve phase (hook handles all swap math via custom virtual-reserve AMM and a 1% protocol fee) and a graduated phase (standard v4 AMM with 1% protocol fee plus an optional 9% elimination tax on sells of knocked-out country tokens). A per-block price-impact cap (5%) is enforced as a sandwich protection mechanism.

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_WETH
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization to factory-pre-registered pools and sets an immutable per-pool dynamic LP fee (from a fixed allowlist of five tiers) via updateDynamicLPFee() in afterInitialize. Has no swap callbacks — the fee is written once at pool creation and cannot be changed afterwards.

hook.name: Echo Hook
hook.description: Fixed-fee hook for native ETH/token pools that takes a 2% buy fee and 2% sell fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, forwards collected ETH to an external token contract via poolManager.take(), and calls token.processSwap(tx.origin, isBuy, feeAmount) on every swap to advance an external round-chain state machine.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial pool tick after initialization via a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only afterInitialize is enabled; all swap hooks are no-op stubs, making swap behavior entirely vanilla.

hook.name: FableHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook that deducts a 1% fee from token output on buys and ETH output on sells via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating fees in an on-contract conviction pool. An owner-set oracle address can draw from the pool to settle on-chain predictions.

hook.name: LatentSpaceHookV4
hook.description: A token/ETH pool hook that burns a configurable percentage (up to 10%) of token amounts on each swap. Sells (token→ETH) are additionally gated: a designated gatekeeper EOA can block specific addresses from selling (warded mapping) or globally pause all sells (gateSealed flag).

hook.name: BlockNodeHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that automatically mints tiered "node" NFTs via an external nodeManager when BLOCK tokens are bought, and burns nodes proportionally when BLOCK tokens are sold. Owner-configurable per-tier node limits, max nodes per swap, and a global auto-node toggle.

hook.name: TrinityHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable flat fee (up to 3%) on every swap via afterSwap, skimming the unspecified-currency output and splitting it into three buckets (TRI token burn, WETH rewards distribution, and protocol-owned liquidity reinvestment), each processed asynchronously by keeper-callable transactions with slippage protection.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in its callback. Liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(), which records the initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: Skims a flat 5% protocol fee on every exact-input swap, taking the fee from the output token (ETH or SPCXSTR) via afterSwapReturnsDelta, and accrues it until anyone calls sweep() to push funds to a configurable treasury address.

hook.name: NyxoraTaxHookV2
hook.description: Takes a 1% fee from the output side of every swap (buy or sell) and transfers it to a configurable treasury address using afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: StockLaunchEthHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired token launch pools that charges a mandatory 1% platform fee plus a configurable creator fee on every swap. Fees are taken from the stock/ETH currency via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta and held as claimable balances. Only factory-registered pools may use this hook.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token pool launches on Uniswap v4. Creators initialize a pool, seed token-only liquidity over a range from MIN_TICK to the current tick, and later withdraw principal and accrued fees. The hook imposes no swap restrictions or fee overrides.

hook.name: SpectrumHook
hook.description: ERC20/NFT hybrid token (7,777 supply) that deploys single-sided liquidity across multiple owner-managed Uniswap v4 pools and distributes LP fees proportionally to NFT holders. The afterSwap hook is a pure no-op; fees are collected lazily via pokeFees().

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Deducts a configurable percentage (up to 10%) of input currency from each swap as a tax, routing 99% to a project treasury and 1% to a factory protocol fee recipient. Supports per-direction buy/sell tax decay schedules anchored on trading activation, a ramping max-buy cap enforced in afterSwap, and governance-gated trading. Exact-output swaps are not supported.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-only, one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions. The creator initializes a pool, seeds token-only liquidity across [MIN_TICK, currentTick], and can later withdraw the full position (principal and accrued fees) back to themselves. afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks are no-ops returning ZERO_DELTA.

hook.name: UoreHook
hook.description: A token-incentive hook for UORE/ETH pools that applies a 1% swap tax: buys trigger UORE token burns; sells accumulate ETH into a buyback bucket. Qualifying buys record a pending lottery roll. Accumulated ETH can be used to buy back UORE from the pool and burn it. Also triggers UORE token start on first liquidity add.

hook.name: STRCLaunchHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/STRC pool that collects a dynamic fee (5% base, up to 10% with MEV surcharges) from every swap's ETH leg, routing proceeds to a dividend vault. Applies a decaying anti-snipe buy fee and a per-wallet 2%-of-supply cap during the post-migration window, governed by an owner-controlled flag.

hook.name: DragonHook
hook.description: A v4 hook for an ETH/Dragon token pool that charges a 3% swap tax on every swap (2.5% routed to a hoard vault, 0.5% to a platform wallet) via BeforeSwapDelta, and forwards buy/sell events to an external arena contract tracking sell streaks, whale buys, dip buys, and daily crit intervals.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Flaunch token-launch platform that manages memecoin pool creation, an internal swap pool that fills fee inventory against incoming swaps, fee distribution to creators/protocol/BidWall/referrers, and TWAP oracle recording. Swaps on newly scheduled pools are time-gated until the configured launch timestamp.

hook.name: UnimonHook
hook.description: An afterSwap-only hook that tracks on-chain XP and evolution for each trader's "Unimon" character. After every swap, it awards XP proportional to the ETH-side trade size plus a flat bonus, then evolves the trainer's mon through up to 5 stages as cumulative XP crosses thresholds. No swap behavior is altered.

hook.name: Hive
hook.description: ERC-20 token (HIVE) that is its own Uniswap v4 hook. Collects a 0.5% ETH tax on buys via beforeSwap delta and 1% on sells via afterSwap delta into a shared jar. Tracks a time-weighted "honey" score per holder; net sell pressure drains a strength buffer. When strength hits zero, a permissionless settle() distributes the ETH jar to non-selling holders proportional to their honey, then opens a new round.

hook.name: PredicateHook
hook.description: A compliance-gating hook that validates swaps against a configurable off-chain Predicate policy via operator signatures. Owner-managed allowlists let approved users and LPs bypass the check; all other swappers must supply Predicate-signed hookData encoding the authorization message, or the transaction reverts. Liquidity additions are restricted to an owner-managed LP allowlist.

hook.name: PosHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% ETH fee on every swap in ETH/TOKEN pools by using beforeSwap and afterSwap with delta returns to intercept ETH on both the specified and unspecified sides of a swap. Accumulated fees are held by the hook and withdrawable by an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v5
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT-backed range liquidity pools that validates pool initialization with an NFT collection, restricts liquidity additions to the NFTStrategyFactory, and takes a dynamic swap fee on behalf of NFT strategy holders via afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements a concentrated liquidity curve backed by Euler lending vaults. It routes swap input tokens into and output tokens out of Euler vaults, enforcing a custom curve invariant while bypassing standard Uniswap concentrated liquidity positions.

hook.name: AGIFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that taxes swaps involving the AGI token, collecting a configurable sell fee (via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap) and buy fee (via afterSwapReturnsDelta in afterSwap), both denominated in AGI and forwarded to a configurable fee recipient. Fees are capped at 10% per side and adjustable by an owner.

hook.name: RecursiveStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT strategy pools (by TokenWorks) that collects fees on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta: buy fees start at 99% at deployment and decrease 100 bps per minute to a 10% floor; sell fees are a constant 10%. Collected fees are distributed 80% to the NFT strategy collection, ~8% to PunkStrategy for buy-and-burn, ~2% to TokenWorks, and the remainder to a deployer-specified address.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote against a configurable bonding curve, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all accounting—bypassing Uniswap concentrated liquidity entirely. Standard LP positions are blocked.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that activates only on pool initialization. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op (returns selector only); external liquidity bootstrapping is handled by a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. Has no swap hooks.

hook.name: JackpotLootboxHook
hook.description: Collects a 3% tax on every swap (2.5% to a prize vault, 0.5% to a platform wallet) and awards tiered lootbox tickets to qualifying buyers, with bonus flags for whale buys, dip buys, sell-streak reversals, and periodic guaranteed jackpots.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the hook's main entry point is initializePools(), which delegates liquidity setup to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper. No swap logic is implemented.

hook.name: NoncePoolHookV1
hook.description: A launchpad hook for nonce.fun that restricts pool initialization and liquidity operations to an authorized launchpad and position manager. Enforces fixed tick ranges and pool parameters for token launches, disables donations, and imposes no restrictions on swaps.

hook.name: NRC20Hook
hook.description: A hook that collects a 0.2% cognition tax on every buy-side swap (ETH → NRC20) via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating intercepted tokens in a reserve that is distributed to registered AI agents by a privileged registry address at epoch end.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A one-time launch hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a single event per token. In afterSwap, non-zeroForOne swaps (buys) revert if tx.origin is not in a deployer-controlled allowlist, while sells are always permitted.

hook.name: Engine
hook.description: A protocol hook managing a SOUL/ETH pool with a built-in leverage protocol. Applies 10% buy and sell taxes routed to an operator while a `limited` flag is active, enforces a per-transaction buy cap of 10k SOUL, and blocks direct LP modifications — restricting all liquidity management to internal protocol operations.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a combined AMM and lending market for ETH/TOKEN pairs. LPs provide full-range liquidity and earn auto-compounded swap fees; borrowers lock TOKEN collateral at 40% LTV to borrow ETH, with on-chain interest accrual, utilization-curve rates, and permissionless liquidations.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and initial liquidity addition to a single occurrence per token. In afterSwap, when activated via mix(), selectively reverts buy-side swaps (non-zeroForOne direction) for addresses not in an owner-controlled allowlist, checked via tx.origin.

hook.name: UHook
hook.description: Minimal hook that implements only `beforeInitialize`, returning the selector without performing any logic. Stores an immutable token address set at deployment. Has no swap, liquidity, or donate callbacks.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. On each swap, it deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a custom BeforeSwapDelta to settle accounting, and verifies a parameterized curve invariant after every trade.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A swap tax hook that levies a 10% fee on exact-input swaps in WETH-paired pools, reducing the swapped amount via BeforeSwapDelta and distributing 8% to a protocol wallet and 2% to a team wallet via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. Reverts on exact-output swaps and non-WETH pools.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook
hook.description:
# LivoSwapHook

A singleton Uniswap V4 hook that intercepts swaps on graduated Livo token pools to collect two types of fees:

1. **LP fee (1%)** — hardcoded as `LP_FEE_BPS = 100`. Charged on every swap, split 50/50 between token creator and protocol treasury.
2. **Sell/buy tax** — read dynamically per-token from `ILivoToken(tokenAddress).getTaxConfig()`, which returns a `TaxConfig` struct with `buyTaxBps`, `sellTaxBps`, `taxDurationSeconds`, and `graduationTimestamp`. Tax is time-limited (on...

hook.name: HookPadHook
hook.description: Launch-pad hook enforcing a 5-second anti-snipe window (60% tax on non-whitelisted buys) and cycling dynamic buy/sell tax tiers (1–30%) on ETH-denominated trades, routing fees to the token creator or protocol treasury via HookPadFeeLocker.

hook.name: UMiner
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token (uLEGIT) and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable ETH tax (initially 20%, capped at 30%) on both buys and sells, forwarding proceeds to a hardcoded treasury address. Buy swaps that include a recipient address in hookData mint pseudo-NFT "Miner" badges with hashpower proportional to ETH spent; each swap's volume bleeds virtual fees distributed to miners proportionally.

hook.name: ViperHook
hook.description: A VIPER/ETH pool hook that harvests fees on every swap and routes most to a fee splitter while burning a configurable portion, gates additional liquidity behind NFT burns (granting permanent reward shares to burners), tracks price milestone persistence to unlock NFT reveal batches, and executes automatic buyback-and-burn swaps from accumulated ETH fees when a threshold or interval is met.

hook.name: FairTradeHook
hook.description: Anti-MEV hook that blocks swaps from owner-blocklisted addresses, reverts same-block swaps from the same sender (sandwich detection), and enforces a configurable per-address timestamp cooldown between swaps.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A one-time launch hook that restricts pool initialization and initial liquidity addition to occur only once per token (currency1). In afterSwap, gates one-direction swaps (non-zeroForOne) to an allowlist of addresses checked via tx.origin when the restriction is enabled per token.

hook.name: ArtCoinsHookSkimFee
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for ArtCoins token launches that skims a per-swap fee from swap volume and splits it three ways: a bounty leg, a protocol leg, and an optional referral leg. Implements a dynamic LP fee and an anti-sniper decay window that blocks public LP additions while the skim rate is elevated above its baseline.

hook.name: NimbusHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for registered token/quote pairs. On each eligible swap, takes a configurable toll (up to 5%) from the quote amount via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwap return delta, and accumulates the fees for a designated seeker address to withdraw via siphon().

hook.name: ShowtimeBurnHook
hook.description: On every swap in the ETH/SHOWTIME pool, collects 0.1% of the output as a burn fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Buys (ETH→SHOWTIME) burn the SHOWTIME directly; sells (SHOWTIME→ETH) accumulate ETH which anyone can trigger via executeSellBurn() to swap back for SHOWTIME and burn it.

hook.name: SockMarketHook
hook.description: Triggers liquidity collection from a registered locker contract after each non-zeroForOne swap. Pools must be registered by a factory-authorized locker before swaps can proceed; unregistered pools revert. Protocol-initiated swaps (identified by hookData marker from the locker) skip collection to avoid recursion.

hook.name: TesseraHook
hook.description: A time-decaying toll hook that charges a fee on the ETH leg of swaps in a designated pool. The fee starts at 25% at pool launch (triggered by a named seeder's first liquidity add) and decays linearly to 2% over 180 seconds. Tolls accrue as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and are paid to a fixed mosaic address via a permissionless collect function.

hook.name: PegScapeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the PegScape protocol that mints Runes to buyers based on swap size and market conditions, computing four boost flags (WHALE, DIP, REVENGE, LATE) from pre-swap state captured in transient storage. On sells, it updates a ring buffer tracking recent sellers for the REVENGE flag and drags the DIP price anchor downward as an anti-MEV measure.

hook.name: Sa1tHookV2
hook.description: Multi-phase bonding curve hook for SA1T token pools. Phases: CURVE (custom constant-product AMM with ERC-6909 claims), REFUND_WINDOW (money-back sells at average entry price), and AMM (full-range locked LP). Fees split between protocol, creator, and configurable mechanics; exact-input swaps only.

hook.name: HooksensorHook
hook.description: Dynamically adjusts LP fees and applies asymmetric fee skewing based on stake-weighted Bittensor subnet oracle consensus signals. Includes an owner-configurable circuit breaker that halts swaps when the oracle's toxicity score exceeds a threshold; falls back to a base fee when oracle data is stale.

hook.name: Unigen Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/UGEN pool that queues NFT mints for qualifying buyers via commit-reveal entropy in afterSwap. Applies a dynamic LP fee override (1 bps) for Tier-S wallet-age holders in beforeSwap, and includes a governance-controlled whitelist gate for the launch window.

hook.name: TaxHook
