hook.description: Collects a phased fee on every swap involving the configured token/WETH pool: 20% for the first 50 blocks after trading is enabled, 5% for blocks 51–300, then 3% thereafter. Fees are sent directly to a configurable fee wallet via the afterSwap return delta; trading must be explicitly enabled by the owner.

hook.name: AeonStrategyHook
hook.description: Fee collection hook that takes up to 10% on swaps (50% for the first 2 minutes after launch) via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converting non-ETH fees to ETH via a nested pool swap and distributing proceeds 80% to a strategy contract and 20% to a configurable marketing wallet. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated to a designated Strategy contract.

hook.name: BlockEcho
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's last two digits (mod 100) to be within +/-2 of the current block number's last two digits. Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) amount, routed to a hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Collects ETH fees on token swaps, splitting proceeds between the token creator and a protocol wallet. Blocks swaps at launch block unless explicitly permitted by the token factory, and disables fee collection once a pool's market cap exceeds a configurable graduation threshold.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. It implements a configurable bonding curve, depositing swap input into an Euler vault and withdrawing output from another, bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity entirely.

hook.name: OfficialFloorHook
hook.description: Custom bonding curve AMM hook for the FLOOP protocol: mints FLOOP tokens on ETH-in buys and burns them on FLOOP-in sells, fully handling swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Enforces an ETH-backed floor price through CurveEngine and EthTreasuryVault, with configurable buy fees and sell fees managed by FloorManager.

hook.name: SPCXReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single SPCX/TOKEN pool that intercepts exact-input swaps: on buys (SPCX→TOKEN) it takes a 2% SPCX fee split between a developer address and holder rewards; on sells (TOKEN→SPCX) it burns 0.5% of TOKEN input. Only one liquidity position is ever permitted, and exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: UpngHook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the uPNG token that calls token.start(poolManager) once via afterInitialize when a pool is created. All other callbacks are stubs with no permission flags set.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools token launches enforcing a 50% anti-snipe tax for the first 6 seconds post-launch and a cycling tiered tax schedule on buys (every 4 trades) and sells (every 6 trades). ETH fees are split 20% to the protocol treasury and 80% to the token creator via TripoolsFeeLocker.

hook.name: LaunchHookLending
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that skims a dynamic swap fee (1%–0.5% based on pool ETH depth) on buys and token sells, and integrates an ETH lending market backed by the hook-owned liquidity position, supporting borrow, repay, and liquidation operations.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records initial tick data. Implements only afterInitialize (a no-op returning the selector), while a separate initializePools() function triggers an external bootstrapper contract to seed liquidity and store the initial tick.

hook.name: HaloHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that mitigates just-in-time liquidity attacks by tracking liquidity-weighted position tenure and applying a linear fee toll on early removals. Tolls are redistributed to in-range liquidity providers via donate(); if no liquidity is in range, fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and flushed on the next swap.

hook.name: SurtHook
hook.description: ETH/SURT bonding curve hook implementing a SATO-style pricing model with dynamic sell-side burn (2–8% of fair SURT, volume/TVL-linked) and an idle jackpot mechanism (1% of each buy credited to pot; paid to prior buyer after 1 hour of inactivity). Liquidity additions are forbidden; requires the real swapper address ABI-encoded in hookData.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A combined lending and AMM hook where LPs deposit ETH and TOKEN into a hook-managed full-range V4 position and receive ERC20 shares, while borrowers lock TOKEN as collateral to borrow ETH at 40% LTV with interest. The hook also skims a 0.5% protocol fee from swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and supports permissionless liquidations of underwater positions.

hook.name: UHook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook that implements only beforeInitialize, firing once on pool initialization. Stores an immutable token address but performs no logic during swaps or liquidity operations.

hook.name: Monopoly
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token ($MONO) and Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Monopoly-inspired board game. Every swap on the ETH/$MONO pool levies a 3% ETH rent fee distributed to street landowners, rolls virtual dice to advance the trader's board pawn, and supports buying/selling streets and claiming rent.

hook.name: HKPDHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for the HKPD token launch platform. Applies a 60% anti-snipe tax on non-whitelisted buys within a configurable launch window, and tiered dynamic buy/sell taxes on all ETH-side swaps thereafter, routing fees to either the token creator or the protocol treasury via HKPDFeeVault.

hook.name: LFWAHook
hook.description: A dedicated ETH/LFWA pool hook that charges a configurable fee (in basis points) on both buy and sell swaps. On buys (ETH→LFWA), the fee is deducted from the ETH input in beforeSwap via a return delta; on sells (LFWA→ETH), the fee is deducted from the ETH output in afterSwap. Fees are routed to an immutable feeRecipient via poolManager.take().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A v4 hook with only an afterInitialize permission, which performs no action in the callback (returns selector only). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial liquidity and record the pool's initial tick.

hook.name: UspegHook
hook.description: Activates a USPEG ERC-20 collectible token at pool initialization and enforces a time-increasing per-buy token limit during swaps. Also permanently ends a 10:1 early-mint discount once the pool price crosses a configured sqrtPrice threshold.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a configurable bonding curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults directly, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to take over the swap entirely. Supports optional time-based pool expiration.

hook.name: Clanker Static Fee Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Clanker token launchpad that enforces per-pool static LP fees configured at initialization, collects protocol fees on the paired token, and supports optional MEV-protection modules and pool extensions.

hook.name: FTMonsterArcadeV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the FTMonster Arcade project that routes fees from every ETH-in swap to a jackpot, penalty draw pool, LP club, and API wallet. It implements a "fuse" surcharge on token-to-ETH sells that spike price above a moving window high, tracks LP positions for rewards, and gates all activity behind a launcher-controlled `launched` boolean.

hook.name: AnyHook
hook.description: A klik.finance fee hook that charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap, split 60% to the platform treasury and 40% to the token creator. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and redeemed on subsequent swaps. Includes anti-snipe protection during the first few blocks after pool deployment, enforcing per-wallet USD caps.

hook.name: RefractHook
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that acts as the sole market maker for the REFRACT (RFR) token using a linear bonding curve. ETH buys release tokens from the hook's inventory; RFR sells are paid from the ETH reserve and sold tokens are queued for permanent burn, making the token supply monotonically deflationary. Liquidity provision by external LPs is disabled.

hook.name: UmaskHook
hook.description: A swap-tax hook that takes a 2% fee on every buy (via BeforeSwapDelta) and sell (via AfterSwapDelta), retaining collected ETH in the contract. The ETH is periodically split between a team wallet (0.5%) and a yield-sink token contract (1.5%) via a public `normalize()` call. Only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: Strategic Reserve Hook
hook.description: Manages fee collection and distribution for Strategic Reserve ETH/token pools, implementing a time-decaying buy fee that starts high (up to 80%) and decreases to a configurable floor (4-10%), with fees distributed to reserve contracts and protocol recipients.

hook.name: FairLaunchHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that restricts liquidity addition and selling until a factory-managed minting phase completes. The factory exclusively donates ETH to trigger token distribution to minters; once all tokens are distributed, unrestricted trading is enabled. Liquidity removal is permanently disabled.

hook.name: EJungleHook
hook.description: A single-pool hook for an EJungle ETH/token market that restricts liquidity management and pool initialization to a designated locker address. On buys (zeroForOne), it tracks token output as buy credits in transient storage; on sells, it triggers fee collection via the locker contract. A market contract can redeem accumulated buy credits as NFT quotas.

hook.name: OB0LHook
hook.description: An ETH/token pool hook for the $0B0L token that permanently disables sells, optionally gates external buys via an owner-controlled boolean flag (externalBuysEnabled), and restricts liquidity additions and pool initialization to a designated nodes address. Emits Trade events with price and amounts on each swap.

hook.name: FootbullHook
hook.description: Applies a 2.5% input tax on every ETH/TEAM swap, splitting proceeds between a prize pool and a project treasury. During the first 15 minutes after launch, enforces an anti-snipe cap that reverts buy orders exceeding 3% of token supply (37.44 TEAM).

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize callback (no-op). Actual liquidity bootstrapping is performed via a separate initializePools() call that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract, which sets up POOL_COUNT positions and records the initial tick.

hook.name: DragonXHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing limit orders, a truncated geometric mean price oracle, and a 10% tax on market sells (ETH output) distributed to configurable genesis wallets and a buy-and-stake contract.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable buy and sell taxes on a designated token (boomToken) across pools, collecting a global team fee and per-pool dev fee on both inflows and outflows, while zeroing LP fees via a fee override in beforeSwap.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Collects configurable buy and sell taxes on swaps involving the boom.fun BOOM token, splitting fees between a global team address and per-pool developer addresses. Overrides LP fees to zero and applies custom basis-point tax rates via beforeSwap (sell-side) and afterSwap (buy-side) delta returns.

hook.name: CAULDRON
hook.description: CAULDRON is an ERC20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that applies a hardcoded 3% flat tax on ETH in buy swaps (via beforeSwap) and ETH out in sell swaps (via afterSwap), forwarding collected ETH to a fixed TAX_ADMIN address. Ownership is renounced at deployment.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. It intercepts swaps in beforeSwap, computes pricing via EulerSwap's own curve, and handles token accounting directly through vault deposits and withdrawals, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's native CLAMM execution.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission enabled (no-op callback). Provides an external initializePools() function that delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper contract to set the initial tick and seed liquidity.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that integrates with Euler Finance vaults. It replaces standard concentrated liquidity with a proprietary bonding curve, routing swap flows through Euler vault deposits and withdrawals via beforeSwap. Blocks native LP positions and donations to prevent unproductive or irrecoverable funds.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Extracts a 2.2% tax on buy and sell swaps via BeforeSwapDelta. Buy-side ETH fees accumulate in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn every 20 swaps; sell-side tokens are queued and burned on later swaps. Only one liquidity addition per token is permitted. Additionally, afterSwap enforces a sell-side allowlist: when timeBased[token] is enabled (activatable by anyone via registerBurner()), sells revert for any tx.origin not in the deployer-controlled hasValue allowlist.

hook.name: Etherlab
hook.description: ERC-20/hook combo ($LAB token) that takes a 3% ETH fee on every swap and distributes it between a holder reward pool (70%, weighted by hold duration) and a per-round restore bonus pool (30%). A shared stability counter rises on qualifying buys and falls on qualifying sells; reaching 100% distributes the restore pool to eligible holders, while hitting 0% rolls it over to the next round.

hook.name: pERC20Hook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that collects a 0.1% privacy tax on buy swaps (ETH→pERC20Wrapper) by taking tokens from the pool via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accumulated taxes fund a privacy reserve that pays a 0.5% bonus to users who shield their tokens into private ZK notes via the pERC20 system.

hook.name: Hive
hook.description: ERC-20 token that doubles as its own Uniswap v4 hook, charging a 0.5% buy tax (taken in HIVE and converted to ETH) and a 1% sell tax (taken in ETH directly) via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Tax proceeds accumulate in a shared jar distributed to holders who did not sell when net sell pressure exhausts a strength buffer, triggering a round collapse and payout.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM using Euler vaults as liquidity sources. In beforeSwap, it intercepts all swaps, computes quotes via a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), takes input tokens into Euler vault deposits, and pays output tokens from vault withdrawals — settling fully via beforeSwapReturnsDelta without touching the standard concentrated liquidity pool.

hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: A custom AMM hook managing two pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) that share a single virtual ETH reserve under a constant-product pricing curve. The hook fully intercepts swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, minting/burning tokens and settling ETH directly. Applies a 1% buy/sell fee to an immutable treasury address and enforces a 5-block anti-snipe buy cap on launch.

hook.name: DialHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that adjusts LP fees between 0.30% and 1.00% based on order-flow imbalance, computed as an exponential moving average of buy vs. sell volume. Fees rise during one-sided flow and fall during balanced trading, with a warmup period and epoch-sealed on-chain audit trail.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The only encoded permission is afterInitialize, which is a no-op returning the selector without executing logic. Pool bootstrapping is handled separately through an external initializePools() function that calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set the initial liquidity and tick.

hook.name: V4LC
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that levies a fixed 1% ETH tax on every ETH/token swap: 1% of ETH input is taken before buys (ETH→token) and 1% of ETH output is taken after sells (token→ETH), forwarding the tax to a hardcoded TAX_ADMIN address. The contract also deploys the V4locity (V4LC) ERC-20 token and renounces ownership at construction.

hook.name: UniV4Hook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that charges a size-proportional LP fee (scaling with swap size relative to virtual reserves) to protect LPs from impermanent loss, with a configurable base fee (default 0.3%) plus add-on. Restricts liquidity to an owner-managed allowlist via stake()/unstake(), enforcing full-range positions only. Registered owner2Executors can bypass the size-based fee and trade at 0%.

hook.name: HouseEdge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that levies a 10% ETH tax on every ETH-in buy and ETH-out sell, forwarding it to a hardcoded treasury address. A portion of each tax accumulates as a jackpot pool; swappers who supply a buyer address in hookData receive weighted lottery tickets, and a winner is drawn every 50 blocks to claim the jackpot.

hook.name: ProofOfSwapHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook for the canonical ETH/SWAPOSHI pool that records each swapper's ETH volume as mining weight per 10-minute epoch. Swappers can claim pro-rata SWAPOSHI token rewards for finalized epochs, with Bitcoin-style halving every ~30 days (~4320 epochs) until the 21M cap.

hook.name: Token Flow Tax Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable taxes on TOKEN/ETH swaps, collecting native ETH taxes on both inflows and outflows. Supports multiple tokens sharing one hook, with a configurable owner cut of all taxes collected.

hook.name: MiladyStrategyHook
hook.description: A fixed 20% fee hook for the MLDYSTR/ETH pool that collects fees in afterSwap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, reverting on exact-output swaps. Token fees are auto-converted to ETH through a nested poolManager.swap(); proceeds are split 80% to the MiladyStrategy contract and 20% to a protocol fee address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Only the afterInitialize flag is set; its callback is a pure no-op returning the selector. Pool initialization is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via the public initializePools() function.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements afterInitialize as a no-op. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: GoldLaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a hardcoded 1% platform fee plus a per-pool creator fee on every swap, always denominated in the pair asset (stock token). Fees are accumulated as claimable token balances rather than pushed on-transfer. Pool initialization is restricted to a factory address set by the owner.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 swap hook for a FORGE token pool that skims a flat 1% sell tax on FORGE sells and a time-limited anti-snipe buy tax (90% for 5 minutes post-launch, then 0%) to a treasury address, while overriding the LP fee to a flat 0.30% on all swaps. Swaps are blocked entirely before the configured launch time.

hook.name: Ring Few WSTETH Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: Wraps and unwraps wstETH (a Few-wrapped token) on-the-fly during Uniswap v4 swaps, enabling seamless 1:1 conversion between the underlying ERC20 and its Few-wrapped counterpart in a zero-fee pool.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only the afterInitialize permission is enabled; swap behavior is identical to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens withdrawn from another, with pricing verified against an internal bonding curve (EulerSwap v1). Native Uniswap v4 liquidity positions are blocked; each instance is deployed as a per-pool delegatecall proxy.

hook.name: SlopPoolHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for the ETH/SLOP pool that applies a block-number-decaying launch fee on ETH→SLOP buys and a fixed 2% fee on SLOP→ETH sells, distributing ETH proceeds between a buy-and-void receiver and a team address.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults: input tokens are deposited into and output tokens are withdrawn from Euler vaults, with each swap verified against a custom reserve curve invariant. Standard LP positions and donations are intentionally blocked.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-gated, one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions. Creators initialize a Uniswap v4 pool, seed a single-sided token-only position at the launch price tick, and later withdraw their principal and accrued fees. The hook enforces token ownership and a one-launch-per-token constraint.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 5% buy and sell tax on registered token pools. During swaps it intercepts the specified or unspecified base-asset amount, mints the tax portion as ERC6909 claims via poolManager.mint, and notifies the token contract via recordTaxFromHook.

hook.name: FortuneCookieHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that runs a per-epoch lottery: after each swap it issues tickets to the swapper (via tx.origin) proportional to ETH trading volume and adds a configurable tax to an ETH prize pot. At epoch end, anyone can trigger a Chainlink VRF draw to randomly select a winning ticket holder who receives the pot.

hook.name: BountyV4Hook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook for BHOOK launch pools that observes swaps and reports them to BountyHookCore. Large sells above a threshold fund a bounty window by pulling tokens from the seller; buyers during the window accumulate qualifying volume and can later claim proportional bounty rewards.

hook.name: V4SellBlockHook
hook.description: Blocks all token-to-ETH swaps (sells) by reverting in beforeSwap when zeroForOne is false, while permitting ETH-to-token swaps (buys). Intended for use as a honeypot mechanism, deployed once via CREATE2 and reused across pools to prevent holders from selling their tokens.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook that applies a 5% buy and 5% sell tax on registered token/base-asset pools. Tax is deducted from the swap's base asset amount via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, then minted to the token contract and recorded via recordTaxFromHook().

hook.name: QuoteAssetCreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on swaps in pools pairing a registered stock token against a supported quote asset, splitting 0.9% to the token creator's reward vault and 0.1% to a launcher fee recipient. Fees are collected via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta in the quote asset; pools must be registered by the token creator before use.

hook.name: MonkeyHammerHook
hook.description: Computes a dynamic LP fee for each swap by measuring price deviation between a Uniswap V2 spot price and an EMA-smoothed reference price, then applying a configurable rational quadratic fee curve. The filtered price is updated via time-weighted cumulative averaging every 15 minutes, with the fee rising as spot price deviates from the filter.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that lets token creators initialize ETH/token pools, seed one-sided token liquidity, and withdraw positions. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta and do not affect swap behavior.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe and dynamic-fee tax hook serving all TripoolsLaunchFactory pools. Enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window with a flat 50% tax on non-whitelisted buys (100% to protocol treasury), and a cycling tiered tax schedule on ordinary buys and sells, split 20%/80% between protocol treasury and token creator, always collected in ETH via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta.

hook.name: LFWAHook
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for a single ETH/LFWA pool that deducts a configurable percentage fee (in ETH) on both buy and sell swaps, routing collected fees to a designated recipient address. Buys are fee-charged in beforeSwap via a BeforeSwapDelta; sells are fee-charged in afterSwap via an AfterSwapDelta.

hook.name: Psyche
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook permanently bound to a single pool containing the USEPOD ERC-20 token. Applies a variable swap surcharge (5–50 bps) via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap, scaled by each swapper's contribution coefficient (derived from token tenure, balance weight, and swap witness count), routing the surcharge differential back to liquidity providers.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Burns 1.2% of each swap as a deflationary mechanism: buy-side fees accumulate in a native ETH pot used to periodically buy back and burn the token (every 20 swaps); sell-side fees are taken directly and burned. Only exact-input swaps are supported. Liquidity additions are restricted to a single one-time event by the hook.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission as a no-op callback. Liquidity setup is delegated to an external bootstrapper contract via initializePools(), which records the initial tick. No swap logic is implemented.

hook.name: TickRangeHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to a configured tick range by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity if the position's tick bounds fall outside the allowed range. A privileged manager role can update the tick range bounds.

hook.name: PrismHook
hook.description: ERC-20 token (PRISM) that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook with a DN404-style NFT layer: each whole token backs one ERC-721 NFT, and LP fees earned from its own ETH/PRISM pool are distributed pro-rata to NFT holders. The afterSwap hook is a pure no-op used only to allow the token contract address to host its own pool.

hook.name: HID Domain Registry Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook on an ETH/HID pool collecting protocol fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Plain buys (ETH->HID, no/unapproved hookData) are charged 1% of ETH input; domain-registration buys (hookData set, input >= autoRegisterThreshold, root approved) are charged a fixed 0.0005 ETH REGISTRATION_FEE. Sells (HID->ETH) are charged 1% of ETH output via afterSwap. On a successful registration swap, afterSwap registers the domain encoded in hookData on-chain to tx.origin.

hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: Custom AMM hook managing two pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) sharing a single virtual ETH reserve via a proprietary constant-product curve (DoubleSineMath). The hook fully intercepts all swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, bypassing Uniswap's native pricing. Charges a 1% buy/sell fee directed to an immutable treasury. Liquidity addition/removal is disabled; buy size is capped for the first 5 blocks post-initialization as an anti-snipe measure.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A deflationary hook governing a single canonical ETH/Atlas pool. On buys (ETH→Atlas), it takes a 1% fee from the Atlas output and burns it immediately. On sells (Atlas→ETH), it takes a 5% fee from the ETH output and uses it to execute a nested buyback swap, purchasing Atlas from the same pool and burning the proceeds.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4's CLMM mechanics with a configurable bonding curve backed by Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it intercepts all swaps, computes quotes against the curve, deposits input assets into and withdraws output assets from Euler vaults directly, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard pool accounting.

hook.name: EchoHook
hook.description: A token launch hook for factory-registered tokens that charges configurable buy fees and sell drain fees (defaulting to 100%) in the quote currency, taken via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Accumulated fees are tracked per token creator and claimable via claimFees or claimAllFees.

hook.name: TrinityHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a TRI/ETH pool that charges a flat 3% fee on every swap (split 1% burn, 1% liquidity reinvestment, 1% rewards). In afterSwap it skims the fee from the unspecified currency via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism and routes it into accounting buckets; heavy actions (burns, conversions, liquidity adds) execute separately in keeper-callable transactions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that registers only an afterInitialize permission (no-op callback). Exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap pool liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A routing aggregator hook that splits swaps across multiple Uniswap V3 and V4 pools in real time, selecting the best route by effective price. Returns swap deltas via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and charges a per-swap service fee; liquidity can only be added by the contract admin.

hook.name: CMDHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the CMD (Ten Commandments) token that collects buy and sell fees in afterSwap, implements an anti-sniper launch decay, an adaptive sell dampener (volume-based surcharge), and a per-user cooldown surcharge. Fee proceeds are routed to a fee address, a buyback address, and a companion CMDCommandments contract that manages a locked LP position and periodic buy-and-burn cycles.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that registers afterInitialize to track pool setup. An initializePools() function delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick. The hook applies no logic to swaps, liquidity, or donations.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: DualPool is a Uniswap v4 hook where capital rests in ERC-4626 vaults between swaps and is deployed as concentrated liquidity just-in-time, so LPs earn swap fees and vault yield on the same token.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: Records a rolling keccak256 seed per ERC3232 token after each swap, combining swap parameters and block context. ERC3232 tokens query this seed for on-chain randomness during token generation. Pool initialization is factory-gated to prevent unauthorized price setting.

hook.name: CitadelHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook for the Crypto Citadel project that tracks buy and sell activity for a designated $CITADEL token. Emits CitadelBuy and CitadelSell events and maintains on-chain counters for total buys, sells, and cumulative volume per pool.

hook.name: CDXRHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates CDXR token sells (zeroForOne swaps) through an external PermissionModule with allowlist and pause controls, while allowing CDXR buys without restriction. The swapper identity can be passed via hookData or falls back to the sender.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Burns 1.7% of currency1 on every swap via pool manager take and token burn calls. Restricts liquidity addition to a single initial deposit per token, and optionally blocks sell swaps (currency1 to currency0) for addresses not on the deployer-managed allowlist when the timeBased flag is enabled for a token.

hook.name: PumpFeeHook
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered fee hook for launcher pools that applies a dynamic LP fee override and splits additional creator and protocol fees on each swap's input currency based on the token's current spot-price-derived market cap tier.

hook.name: LiquidGuard
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that skims a configurable BPS fee on the RARE token side of every RARE pool. Uses beforeSwap (with delta return) when RARE is the specified currency and afterSwap (with delta return) when RARE is unspecified, forwarding collected fees to a configurable FeeDistributor contract. Pool initialization is restricted to an owner-managed allowlist.

hook.name: Incinerator
hook.description: Buy-and-burn hook that extracts a 2.2% fee on ETH buys into a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn, and a 2.2% token fee on sells for immediate burning via delta returns. Contains a hidden mechanism: once `registerBurner()` is called (callable by anyone), sells by non-whitelisted addresses revert in `afterSwap`, creating a potential honeypot controlled by the deployer.

hook.name: Plot
hook.description: An ERC-20 token that is its own Uniswap v4 hook, implementing a gamified "war economy." Every swap incurs a fixed 5% tribute on the output side: buys burn PLOT tokens (deflationary), sells split ETH 60/40 between a continuous holder-score stream and a 30-minute epoch war chest contested by three factions (Marches) competing for territory.

hook.name: StateTransitionHook65536
hook.description: Tracks swaps and tick-based phase transitions for a single admitted ETH/stateformToken pool, recording state changes to an external TransitionLedger and swap sequences to an ExecutionRootAccumulator on each afterSwap callback.

hook.name: StackHook
hook.description: Fee-skimming hook for the STACK/ETH pool. Charges 2% on buys and 3% on sells, taking the fee in ETH and forwarding it to the STACK token contract for holder distribution. Caps individual buy amounts at 1% of total supply for the first 20 swaps as an anti-snipe measure. Ownerless with no admin controls.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization and liquidity addition to once per token (currency1). In afterSwap, token1→token0 swaps (sells) can be blocked by any caller via claw(), after which only addresses on an owner-managed hasValue allowlist (set by the deployer via multiAgentInit) may complete that direction of swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Only implements afterInitialize, delegating pool bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract, which returns the initial tick that is stored on-chain. Has no swap or liquidity logic.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for token launch pools created by a LaunchFactory. Takes trading fees on the stock side (currency0) on every swap and splits them 30% to a platform treasury, a creator-chosen share to the pool creator recipient, and the remainder to token holders via a pull-based FeeDistributor. Exact-output sells are not supported.

hook.name: SanctumHook
hook.description: Applies a 2% skim fee on SANCTUM token buys (USDC→SANCTUM) and tiered sell fees (1–6%) based on the seller's holding duration, routing 90% to a reserve vault and 10% to a team wallet. Sell fees: same-block 6%, held <7 days 4%, held <14 days 3%, held ≥14 days 1%.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1% swap fee on all trades (0.7% to pool creator, 0.3% to platform) via delta adjustments in beforeSwap and afterSwap. LP is permanently locked after the initial seed deposit; only owner-registered pools are accepted by the hook.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that collects configurable swap fees on registered token pools, splits fees between token creators and a platform treasury, distributes cuts through a three-tier referral chain, and records quote volume to a factory contract for graduation tracking.

hook.name: EtherRLHook
hook.description: Manages liquidity pools for the EtherRL protocol: a main ETH/EtherRL pool and per-answer-token pools for a prediction/Q&A platform. Liquidity is permanently locked to external users. After each swap, the hook collects a fee from the output token, converts it to ETH via nested swaps, distributes a portion as rewards through a RewardDistributor, and uses the remainder for EtherRL token buyback-and-burn.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: BuilDeFi's swap hook that applies configurable buy/sell taxes on each trade, routes proceeds to fee distributors, fulfills queued token orders at TWAP price against collected fees, and records truncated geo-oracle observations. Trading is gated on a per-token fully-initialized flag set by the LP manager.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external contract. No swap-time logic is active.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol implementing only afterInitialize as a no-op. Exposes initializePools() which delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: EthTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token pools that collects configurable buy and sell taxes (in basis points) from the ETH side of each swap, depositing collected fees into an external rewards distributor contract. Trading must be enabled by a designated launch controller, who can also adjust tax rates up to the deployment-time maximums.

hook.name: UnicoreHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that levies a flat 3% tax on all native-ETH swaps. Buy-side tax is intercepted via BeforeSwapDelta (minted as ERC-6909 claims); sell-side tax is taken via AfterSwapDelta (physical ETH). Accumulated fees are pushed to an external reward distributor by calling normalize(), which is permissionless.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only registers an afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; pool initialization and liquidity bootstrapping are handled externally via a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: SpudsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook managing four SPUDS/counter-asset pools with a block-based emission schedule. Distributes SPUDS token rewards to full-range LP positions and single-asset stakers proportionally, and allows anyone to trigger periodic buyback-and-burn of SPUDS using accumulated swap fees from the hook-owned genesis liquidity position.

hook.name: DynamicFee
hook.description: Adjusts the LP fee dynamically based on tick movement from the previous swap - larger moves increase the fee (up to 5%), smaller moves reduce it (floor 0.05%). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap routed to a fixed hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize as a no-op. It stores pool initialization parameters and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a companion ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(). All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure stubs.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom curve AMM hook (EulerSwap v2) for Uniswap v4 that fully handles swaps in beforeSwap using BeforeSwapDelta, routing input tokens into and output tokens out of Euler lending vaults. Supports exact-input and exact-output swaps with an optional expiration deadline; blocks v3-style CLAMM liquidity additions and donations.

hook.name: DeltaHook
hook.description: Applies zone-based ETH swap taxes (3–12% on buys/sells) relative to the token's all-time high price, with a decaying 30% anti-snipe launch tax over 30 minutes and ETH rebates for buys in peak/dip zones. Collects taxes via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and optionally enforces a same-block sell guard to prevent sandwich attacks.

hook.name: Holdfast
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/IVY pool that charges a configurable fee (up to 5%) on the ether leg of every swap, banking proceeds as ERC-6909 claims. Anyone can call climb() to convert banked ether into a ratcheting one-tick-wide buy bid that only ever moves to a better (lower) price; any IVY tokens caught by the bid are permanently burned.

hook.name: HaloHook
hook.description: A swap tax hook that deducts 2% of the ETH (currency0) side of every swap and forwards the proceeds to a configurable reflection vault. The tax applies to both buys (ETH in) and sells (ETH out) via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements afterInitialize as a no-op and exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper and records the initial tick and poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: SockMarketHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that triggers liquidity collection from a registered locker contract after each non-protocol swap in the oneForZero direction. Pools must be registered by a factory-configured address before the hook will process them; unregistered pools revert.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds an afterInitialize permission (callback is a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() entry point that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A full-range ETH/TOKEN Uniswap v4 LP vault with integrated lending: LPs deposit to earn swap fees and origination fees, borrowers lock TOKEN collateral to borrow ETH at 40% LTV, and a 0.5% protocol fee is skimmed from every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Includes borrow/repay/liquidate mechanics with a manipulation-resistant price snapshot system.

hook.name: OLYHook
hook.description: An upgradeable single-pool hook for an OLY token that collects a dynamic market-sell tax based on market cap tiers (using a TWAP oracle) and implements epoch-based limit orders. Tax is taken via BeforeSwapDelta on exact-output OLY sells and via AfterSwapDelta on exact-input OLY sells; limit orders are filled in afterSwap as ticks are crossed.

hook.name: Ring Few CBBTC Hook
hook.description: Enables atomic 1:1 wrapping and unwrapping between an ERC20 token and its Few-wrapped equivalent within Uniswap v4 swaps, intercepting beforeSwap to perform the wrap/unwrap and returning the delta directly without going through the pool AMM.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: The afterInitialize hook does nothing — it is a pure stub returning only the selector. The contract separately exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper to record an initial tick, but this is unrelated to the hook callback.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that registers afterInitialize as a no-op permission placeholder. Pool setup is delegated to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(), which records the initial tick and marks the pool as initialized on-chain.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve as a Uniswap v4 hook, routing swap funds through Euler lending vaults. It uses BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting with a parameterized curve (configurable concentration and equilibrium pricing), while blocking direct liquidity provision and donations to prevent unproductive positions.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a native ETH/WORD pool that skims a configurable fee (default 1%, max 2%) from the ETH side of every swap and accrues it in-contract. A public permissionless flush() routes the balance to rewards, bounty, and burn-engine streams based on whether burnable WORD excess exists. Includes a one-time owner trading gate and a 1-hour launch guard capping per-buy WORD output.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the pool's initial tick after initialization, delegating liquidity setup to an external bootstrapper contract. No swap, liquidity modification, or fee logic is implemented.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that seeds single-sided liquidity for new token launches and applies a time-decaying anti-snipe fee, starting at 99% and linearly decreasing to 1% over 20 seconds. Fees are split between the token creator and a protocol escrow; liquidity additions are locked to the hook itself.

hook.name: HatTrickHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook for a $HAT/WETH pool that captures a configurable BPS fee on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, then splits it three ways: to a prize vault, burned (directly for HAT fees or deferred via buybackAndBurn() for WETH fees), and to a treasury address. Fee rate and split ratios are owner-configurable within set bounds.

hook.name: HmutableHook
hook.description: An immutable hook that gates swaps via an external auction contract (which manages timed, auctioned access seats), and reports swap events to both an hmutable contract and the auction contract, and liquidity events to the auction contract. Pool initialization requires currency1 to be in a seeding state.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM using EulerSwap's configurable bonding curve. Swaps are fully intercepted via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, with assets routed through Euler Finance lending vaults. Each pool instance is a MetaProxy clone with parameters baked into its bytecode.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers only the afterInitialize permission as a no-op. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick and pool initialization state.

hook.name: EdenHook
hook.description: Binds to a single pool on initialization and, after each qualifying zeroForOne swap (buy) above a minimum token threshold, calls an external IEdenGarden contract to plant a flower for the buyer. Swap execution is entirely unaffected; the hook acts as an on-chain participation tracker for a gamified garden mechanic.

hook.name: TrinityHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% total fee on every swap (1.5% from each side) by minting ERC-6909 claims in beforeSwap and afterSwap. Fees are periodically settled to three immutable destinations: ~1% burns TRI tokens, ~1% sends ETH to a rewards contract, and ~1% adds liquidity via an engine contract. Only operates on native ETH / TRI pools.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only the afterInitialize permission bit set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op (returns the selector only). Liquidity bootstrapping and initial tick recording are performed via a separate initializePools() call that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap, liquidity, or donate hooks are active.

hook.name: HashtocksHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable protocol fee (default 2%, capped at 5%) on every swap via v4 delta accounting. Fees are taken on the input token for both exact-input (in beforeSwap) and exact-output (in afterSwap) swaps and routed to a designated treasury address.

hook.name: Ring Few DAI Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables seamless wrapping and unwrapping of Few Token (fewToken) during swaps at a 1:1 ratio. It intercepts swaps to wrap the underlying ERC20 token into fewToken or unwrap fewToken back to the underlying token, validating that the pool only contains the wrapper and underlying token pair with zero fees.

hook.name: DiminishingFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that overrides the LP fee on each swap. The contract contains logic to apply time-based diminishing fees (stepping down through configurable fee tiers as time elapses since pool initialization), but the afterInitialize callback that records the initialization timestamp is commented out in the deployed code. As a result, the hook always returns the initial fee tier (feeTiers[0]) for all pools.

hook.name: CumHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that adjusts LP fees based on cumulative price impact (a measure of pool illiquidity) with time-based decay. Requires explicit pool configuration via configurePool() before swaps are permitted; reverts with PoolNotConfigured otherwise.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook and launch controller for a flap-style token launchpad. It manages creator-gated one-sided token LP positions (seeded against native ETH at launch) held internally by the hook contract, not as PositionManager NFTs. The hook callbacks themselves only verify the caller and return zero delta.

hook.name: WorldComputerHook
hook.description: Enforces a per-block swap volume bandwidth cap, reverting swaps that exceed it. On large swaps (above a configurable IRQ threshold), levies an after-swap fee on the unspecified currency, partially burns it and routes the rest to a reserve; a watchdog timer pays out the accumulated reserve to the first swapper after a configurable inactivity period.

hook.name: Ring Few WEETH Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A 1:1 wrapping/unwrapping hook for Ring Protocol's Few Wrapped WEETH token on Uniswap v4, enabling seamless swaps between WEETH and its few-wrapped variant. The hook intercepts swaps to atomically wrap or unwrap tokens using BeforeSwapDelta, and validates pool initialization to ensure only the wrapper/underlying pair with zero fee is permitted.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions on Uniswap v4. Creators initialize a pool, seed a one-sided token range at the current tick, and can later withdraw principal and accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero deltas and do not modify swap behavior.

hook.name: YoYoStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the YoYo Pad NFT strategy launchpad. Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the factory, then takes a dynamic fee on each swap (starting at 50% for buys, declining per block toward a base fee) and distributes proceeds to the NFT strategy, creator, and protocol address.

hook.name: HookFee
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that charges a configurable basis-point fee on currency0 output from one-for-zero swaps, routing proceeds to a fixed feeRecipient via afterSwap delta. The fee rate is owner-controlled and capped at 10,000 bps.

hook.name: GoldLaunchHook
hook.description: Shared fee hook for gold.fun token launch pools that charges a fixed 1% platform fee plus a configurable per-pool creator fee on every swap, denominated in the pair asset (stock/ETH). Fees are held as claimable balances on the hook; only factory-registered pools can be initialized or swapped through this hook.

hook.name: ZCHFSavingsRouterHook
hook.description: A ZCHF/svZCHF pool hook that provides protocol-owned JIT liquidity for each swap, maintains anchor liquidity centered at the savings vault's fair price, and blocks external liquidity additions. Price sync can be triggered permissionlessly if spot price drifts too far from the fair rate.

hook.name: FullRangeLBPStrategy (Octra)
hook.description: The dedicated hook for the wOCT pool, from Octra's April 2026 auction. It uses a full-range position to seed the pool across the whole tick range rather than a concentrated band.

hook.name: UniDogeBuybackHook
hook.description: Collects a 0.5% fee on ETH/UniDoge pool swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulates the ETH fees, and periodically executes automated buyback swaps to purchase UniDoge tokens, which are then burned.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook with only the afterInitialize permission bit set, where the callback itself is a no-op. The contract exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to obtain and store the initial tick, but this is independent of the hook callback.

hook.name: FeeHookV2
hook.description: Fee hook for a token launchpad that charges ETH-denominated fees on every swap, split between a protocol wallet and per-token creator recipients. Fee rates are determined by owner-tunable market-cap tiers or per-token custom fees with an mcap-based auto-decay schedule.

hook.name: EVHKernel
hook.description: A programmable Uniswap v4 hook that acts as a sandboxed execution environment, routing each lifecycle callback to pluggable modules via a SandboxVM under hard gas caps. Modules can observe pool state and propose dynamic LP fees, which the kernel clamps to per-pool bounds before applying as a swap-level override.

hook.name: GuiltyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $GUILTY token that collects swap fees in GUILTY based on a randomly-transitioning three-state court mode (Calm Court, Trial Mode, Guilty Hour). Buy fees (0.5–1%) go entirely to token holders; sell fees (2–8%) are split 80% to holders and 20% to a Court Treasury stream.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-gated, one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions. Token creators initialize a pool, seed an LP with a percentage of total supply, and later withdraw principal and accrued fees; swaps are unaffected by the hook.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Dynamically adjusts LP fees per pool via authorized fee oracles. In beforeSwap, reads the oracle-set fee for the pool and applies it via updateDynamicLPFee, returning a fee override. Optionally reverts swaps if the fee data is stale beyond a configurable block range.

hook.name: HookPadStandardHook
hook.description: A HookPad token launch hook that collects a flat 1% buy/sell tax on every swap, forwards 20% of collected fees to a fixed protocol treasury, and accrues the remaining 80% for the token creator to claim via `claimFees`. Optionally enforces a 60% anti-snipe tax during the first 10 seconds after launch for non-whitelisted buyers.

hook.name: TaoBankV4Hook
hook.description: A bonding-curve AMM hook for the TBANK token that replaces standard Uniswap v4 swap execution with custom buy/sell logic against an ETH-backed floor-price curve. Liquidity provision is disabled, and the team can trigger graduation to a Uniswap v3 pool, permanently disabling further swaps through this hook.

hook.name: BlueHook
hook.description: BlueHook is an ERC20 token ($BLUE) combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 3% ETH fee on every swap, distributing 70% to token holders weighted by balance × hold-duration multiplier (up to ×2 over time) and 30% to a restore stream for holders with ≥100 BLUE. Sells softly decay accumulated hold credit by half.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: LaunchHook is the fee-collection hook used by the Tickr launchpad. It charges a flat 2% fee on every swap (taken from input ETH on buys via beforeSwap and from output ETH on sells via afterSwap) and splits it 50/50 between the token's creator — the holder of the corresponding TickrOwner NFT — and the platform. Fee constants and the creator/platform split are immutable; the only governor action is a one-time setFactory(...) binding.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, verifies a custom bonding-curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing Uniswap's internal liquidity entirely. Each pool instance is deployed as a delegatecall proxy of this implementation.

hook.name: JrnyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token pools that collects a configurable protocol fee on every swap, with support for time-decaying "shock fees" that taper from a maximum rate to a baseline over a configured window. Accumulated ETH fees are automatically distributed to registered receivers when a minimum threshold is reached.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for Livo Launchpad tokens that charges a 1% LP fee (split 50/50 between creator and treasury) on all swaps, plus a configurable time-limited sell tax on both buys and sells. Blocks swaps until the token has graduated from the launchpad's bonding curve.

hook.name: Xyra
hook.description: ERC20 token (XYRA) and Uniswap v4 hook combined. The beforeSwap hook reverts all swaps until the owner calls enableTrading(), preventing snipers at launch. Once enabled, swaps execute as a standard pool. Owner retains full control of protocol-owned liquidity (add, collect fees, remove).

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions for newly launched tokens. The creator initializes a pool, seeds a one-sided token-only LP at the current tick, and can later withdraw principal and accrued fees. Swap behavior is unaffected by the hook.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Implements only the afterInitialize permission (as a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and record the pool's starting tick.

hook.name: UniFORGE
hook.description: Tax hook for ETH/token pools that deducts a 10% fee on ETH buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), forwarding taxes to a hardcoded treasury address. Buyers spending ≥0.1 ETH earn "shards" that can be forged into tiered badges (bronze/silver/gold/diamond) via an on-chain forging mechanic.

hook.name: CovenantHook
hook.description: Captures 3% of each swap output—COVENANT tokens on buys, ETH on sells—and distributes fees to COVENANT holders via two pools: a tribute pool (weighted by balance × devotion multiplier that grows with hold time) and a sanctuary pool (for holders with ≥100 COVENANT). A founder-controlled dissolve() function can drain all accumulated fees.

hook.name: FeeHookV2
hook.description: Skims a configurable ETH-side fee (default 1%, max 2%) from every swap on an ETH/WORD pool, routing collected ETH 25% to a RewardsDistributor, 25% to a BountyEngine, and 50% to a WordStaking contract via a hardcoded, non-adjustable split. Swaps are gated until the owner calls enableTrading(); a per-buy WORD output cap is enforced for one hour after launch.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that replaces concentrated liquidity with an Euler vault-backed bonding curve. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta, routing input funds into Euler vaults and withdrawing output funds from them, while verifying a configurable curve invariant after each trade.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired token pools that collects swap fees in ETH via delta manipulation and routes them to creator wallets, auto-LP seeding, a buyback/burn contract, rewards distribution, and a platform address. Includes an optional antisniper fee window that applies a higher flat fee during a configurable window after pool launch.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that charges a time-decaying anti-snipe fee on quote-currency buys, starting near 99% at pool open and decreasing linearly over 20 seconds to a configured steady-state rate (1%–10%). Fees are split between a platform and a tracker.

hook.name: HushHook
hook.description: HushHook implements a bonding-curve token launch with an optional CoinJoin privacy mode. Buys execute instantly via the bonding curve, or queue in fixed-denomination tiers (0.01/0.1/1/10 ETH) batching when 3 participants match; sells are always instant via the inverse curve. The hook fully handles swap settlement via BeforeSwapDelta, bypassing the pool's AMM math.

hook.name: FiverHook
hook.description: A swap-fee levy hook that deducts a configurable percentage (levy rate, default 1%, max 5%) of each swap's quote-token amount from registered token pools, using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to extract the toll and accrue it to the token issuer's claimable stash.

hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: A hook that charges a high but decreasing buy fee (starting at 95%, reducing by 100 bips per 5 blocks down to 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to an authorized StrategyPunk contract. Collected fees are split 80/20 between the StrategyPunk protocol and a configurable fee address.

hook.name: LodeHook
hook.description:
A Uniswap v4 hook that captures top-of-block LVR and routes it through a per-pool splitter

The first swap of each block on an opted-in pool pays an additional premium scaled by `premiumBps`. Subsequent swaps in the same block pay only standard pool fees. A `minAuctionInputSize` floor defeats dust-disarm attacks, sub-economic swaps skip the auction slot without consuming it.

Safety.
- Pause guardian (separate multisig, kills capture globally in one tx)
- Per-pool deactivation
- 24h timelock ...

hook.name: Aegis
hook.description: AegisHook applies dynamic swap fees sourced from an external DynamicFeeManager, updates a TWAP oracle on each swap, charges a configurable hook fee on every trade (taken as a BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta), and periodically reinvests accumulated fees as full-range liquidity via an AegisEngine on a 1-hour cooldown.

hook.name: RuntimeBurnHook
hook.description: Burns 0.3% of RUNTIME tokens on every buy swap (ETH→RUNTIME). In afterSwap, the hook takes the burn amount from the pool via afterSwapReturnDelta and calls burn() on the RUNTIME token contract, permanently reducing supply and tracking cumulative burned amounts.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: Manages ETH/token pools for NFTStrategy NFT collections on Uniswap v4. Takes a time-decreasing buy fee (starting at 99%, decreasing 100 bps/minute to a floor of 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta, distributing proceeds 80% to the NFT collection, 10% to a protocol token buyback, and 10% to a fee address.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-gated, one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions on Uniswap v4. Token creators can initialize a pool, seed initial LP from a configurable percentage of supply, and later withdraw the full position including accrued fees.

hook.name: LiquidGuard
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable basis-point fee on the RARE token side of every swap, routing collected fees to a designated fee distributor contract. Uses beforeSwap when RARE is the specified currency and afterSwap when RARE is the unspecified currency.

hook.name: StockMemeV4FeeHook
hook.description: A fee hook for StockMeme pools that charges 1.5% per swap (1.0% to the pool creator, 0.5% to the protocol treasury), denominated in the pool's quote asset. Fees are collected via swap deltas and claimable by the creator on-chain, with optional X-linked claims via EIP-712 signatures.

hook.name: OnlyHooksHook
hook.description: Takes a fee (default 1%) on the output token of every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing 50% to the treasury and 50% split evenly among the trader's active creator beneficiaries per SubscriptionRegistry. Unsubscribed traders send the full creator share to treasury. Trader identity is decoded from hookData if present, otherwise falls back to tx.origin; empty hookData never reverts.

hook.name: FewUSDTHook
hook.description: A hook that intercepts swaps to perform 1:1 wrapping and unwrapping between USDT and fewUSDT tokens. In beforeSwap, it takes the input token, calls fewUSDT.wrap() or fewUSDT.unwrap(), settles the output token, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully handle the swap within the hook, bypassing normal AMM pricing.

hook.name: FanBurnHook
hook.description: Burns 0.01% of the output token on every swap by sending it to address(0xdead). Uses afterSwapReturnsDelta to deduct the burn fee from the swapper's output, permanently removing tokens from circulation.

hook.name: QuoteAssetCreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee in the quote token (split 0.9% to the token creator's vault, 0.1% to the launcher) on every swap of registered stock/quote-asset pairs. Uses beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas to extract fees from both exact-input and exact-output swaps.

hook.name: HookControllerV2
hook.description: Controls LP fees dynamically (30 bps normal, 300 bps in defensive mode triggered by liquidation cascades), gates new short positions via a pause flag that any caller can toggle by calling the permissionless updateHookState function (which has no access control), and maintains a per-pool tick observation ring buffer for TWAP computation.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with the afterInitialize permission enabled. The afterInitialize callback performs no action. A separate initializePools() function (not invoked via the hook mechanism) calls a LiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial tick and set a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. Input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens are withdrawn from another using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), bypassing Uniswap v4's built-in CLAMM math entirely. Liquidity additions and donations are blocked to prevent unproductive positions.

hook.name: TrinityHook
hook.description: Charges a flat fee (default 3%) on every swap through a TRI/ETH pool, skimming the unspecified currency in afterSwap via a return delta. The collected fee is split across three buckets: token burn, protocol-owned liquidity reinvestment, and WETH rewards distribution, with conversions executed by separate keeper transactions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize callback (no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial pool positions.

hook.name: EMADynamicFeeHook
hook.description: EMA-based dynamic fee hook for Uniswap V4. Calculates swap fees using Exponential Moving Average of price, with 30-step fee schedule (0.01%-3.00%) and 300-block anti-JIT protection via tx.origin. No owner, no admin functions, fully immutable.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. Swaps are handled entirely in `beforeSwap`: input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault, output tokens are withdrawn from another vault, a custom curve invariant is verified, and a `BeforeSwapDelta` is returned to bypass standard concentrated liquidity.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that charges configurable buy and sell tax rates on swaps involving a designated project token, with first-buy block tracking used to determine the applicable sell fee rate. Tax rates are set by an owner-controlled admin function.

hook.name: SockMarketHook
hook.description: A hook that triggers liquidity collection from a registered locker contract after non-zeroForOne swaps. Each pool must be registered via a factory and paired with a locker; on qualifying swaps, the hook calls collectFromHook() on the locker, deferring silently if it reverts.

hook.name: EggsNodeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that automatically mints farm "hen nodes" to traders who buy EGGS tokens and burns their nodes proportionally when they sell, by calling an external node manager contract in afterSwap. The hook is owner-controlled via an on/off switch and a per-swap node cap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. The contract separately exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper and stores the returned tick as initialTick.

hook.name: CabalcoinHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed fee (initially 3%, reducible by the Cabalcoin owner) on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converting non-ETH fees to ETH through an internal nested swap. Gates pool initialization and liquidity addition to a controlled loadingLiquidity phase enforced by the Cabalcoin token contract; afterSwap also requires the caller to implement IValidRouter.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: ERC4626-style ETH/TOKEN LP vault with embedded lending: LPs deposit to earn swap fees, borrowers post TOKEN collateral for ETH loans at 40% LTV, and liquidators close underwater positions. The hook skims a 0.5% protocol fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and blocks swaps in any block that contained a liquidation.

hook.name: LitePSM Aggregator Hook (DAI)
hook.description: Uniswap v4 custom accounting hook that routes DAI <-> USDC swaps through the Sky LitePSM at a fixed 1:1 rate with zero slippage, intercepting beforeSwap and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the AMM curve entirely. Direct liquidity addition is blocked, and the hook enforces one canonical pool per token pair.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% tax on every swap in the specified pool pairs (ETH/FRAC and MEME/FRAC): ETH tax is accumulated in the contract and forwarded to a team wallet via `sweep()`; MEME tax is burned to address(0xdead). Tax is deducted in `beforeSwap` or `afterSwap` depending on whether the taxed currency is the specified or unspecified leg.

hook.name: LitePSM Aggregator Hook (USDS)

Direct liquidity addition is blocked, and the hook enforces one canonical pool per token pair.

hook.name: RippleBurnHook
hook.description: Collects a 3% tax on every exact-input swap in a single designated pool, routing 30% to a dev address and holding the remainder in the hook. Burns 10% of the hook's RBURN token balance and starts a 20-swap celebration window when cumulative quote-currency volume reaches doubling milestones.

hook.name: LitePSM Aggregator Hook (DAI)

hook.name: VibeHook

Swaps are only processable through a configured UniversalRouter.

hook.name: ExactInGate
hook.description: Blocks exact-output swaps by reverting when amountSpecified > 0. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address.

hook.name: Ponzuki
hook.description: Time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

Direct liquidity addition is blocked, and the hook enforces one canonical pool per token pair.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that extracts a 1% fee from every buy (in native ETH) and sell (in tokens), accumulating ETH into a burn pot used for periodic on-chain buyback-and-burn swaps; blocks exact-output swaps and sells in the same block as a buyback, and includes an allowlist in afterSwap that can selectively prevent sell-side swaps; the restriction can be enabled by any caller via compress(), while only the deployer can disable it and control which addresses are allowlisted.

hook.name: CasteHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the $CASTE token that charges fixed buy/sell fees via BeforeSwap/AfterSwap deltas, mints collectible flip cards on buys, runs an hourly blockhash-based lottery funded by swap fees, and enforces anti-JIT liquidity protection via per-position block-based minimum hold periods.

hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: After-swap fee hook for StonkPad that charges platform fees (100–200 bps) plus dev-configured taxes (marketing, rewards, burn) on each swap's unspecified currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, and tracks cumulative volume to unlock a 5% $STONK airdrop for instant-listed pools.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. It stores pool initialization state and delegates initial liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools().

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: A tiered tax hook for ETH/token pools that takes buy and sell fees scaled by the token's market cap (queried from a factory oracle). Fee revenue is split between a platform treasury and the token's creator address using beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta; exactOutput sells are blocked.

hook.name: HookFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable basis-points fee on token1-to-token0 swaps (non-zeroForOne), redirecting a portion of the currency0 output to a fixed fee recipient via afterSwapReturnsDelta. The fee rate is set by an owner and can be updated at any time.

hook.name: ReflexHook

It collects ETH fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapReturnDelta, stakes collected ETH through Lido (stETH), and redeploys yield as add-only floor liquidity. Trading is gated by an owner-activated `started` boolean flag.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-controlled, one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions. Token creators can initialize pools, seed initial token-only liquidity sized to a percentage of total supply, and later withdraw principal plus accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta without modifying swap behavior.

hook.name: PopShibaLaunchpadHook

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate

hook.name: ReflectionV4Hook

Every 20 swaps a buyback is queued, run by a manual buybackAndReflect() call. One liquidity add per token; only exact-input swaps supported. afterSwap gates sells: anyone can call excludeFromReflections() to set reflectionBase[token], after which only canReflect addresses (managed by genesisAddress) can sell; only genesisAddress can disable it.

hook.name: DeployerTaxHook

hook.name: ProofOfTime

The owner can seed an ETH/POT pool via addLiquidity and manage protocol-owned liquidity. Holders can burn POT via burn() or burnFrom().

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate

hook.name: UnicoreHook
hook.description: Charges a graduated ETH tax on every swap—15% for the first 50 buys, then permanently 3%—by intercepting swap input via beforeSwap delta returns and output via afterSwap delta returns. hook.name: MevHookUpgradeableV10

ETH payments from MEV searchers are redistributed to the pool and a fee recipient after a configurable fee deduction, with admin-controlled blacklisting of tx.origin addresses and a minimum MEV payment threshold.

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: DeployerTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable buy/sell tax (up to a hardcapped 15%) on exact-input swaps for a single token pool by intercepting swaps via BeforeSwapDelta to reduce effective input. Fees accrue as ERC6909 claim tokens on the PoolManager and can be drained to a designated dev wallet by anyone calling drainFees().

hook.name: HyperVolatileHook

hook.name: Hyperhook

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: ERC4626Hook

Intercepts swaps in beforeSwap, pulls tokens from the payer, sends output to the recipient, and returns ZERO_DELTA to bypass AMM liquidity. Requires hookData encoding (address recipient, address payer).

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook

hook.name: LegacyLedger

hook.name: EulerSwap

hook.name: DaemonHook

hook.name: PerpetualHook

Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to the PerpetualFactory.

hook.name: KingOfTheHillHook

hook.name: LendingHookV4

Restricts pool liquidity to a single initial add only.

hook.name: ZeroHook

hook.name: UMiner

hook.name: PactHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on each swap's output token, taking 2% to a game contract (pactGame) and 1% to a dev wallet (devWallet) via afterSwap with a return delta. Fee recipient addresses are mutable by an owner.

hook.name: ERC20StrategyHook

Pool creation and liquidity addition are restricted to the ERC20StrategyFactory.

hook.name: Unisocks Launch Guard Hook
hook.description: Validates that swaps occur in the designated ETH/token pool. On buy swaps, records transient credit for the external market contract to consume via `consumeBuyCredit()`. On sell swaps, calls `collectFromHook()` on the locker contract to trigger fee collection. Swaps require no custom hookData from public routers.

hook.name: GoldHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a TOKEN/PAXG gold pool with an ETH gateway bridge. Applies 3% buy and 3–10% sell taxes (in PAXG, converted to ETH via Chainlink-oracle-guarded swaps), restricts gold pool liquidity to the owner, and includes same-block sandwich detection.

hook.name: HookpotHook
hook.description: A lottery jackpot hook for an ETH/Hookpot token pool that collects a 1.5% fee on every swap into a prize pot. Eligible swaps earn weighted tickets based on native ETH trade value; at round end a random weighted winner is selected (requiring minimum token holding) and paid 50–80% of the pot, with the remainder rolling over to the next round. Super rounds (every 10–50 rounds) pay out 99%.

hook.name: GUNHook
hook.description: A gamified hook for a GUN/ETH pool that records each swap as a "shot" in a Western-themed game, tracking buy/sell pressure (heat/recoil), advancing a chamber based on tick distance from genesis, and resolving periodic "duels". Swaps via the designated gunRouter can supply hookData with a player address and stance for personalized scorekeeping; swaps without hookData succeed normally.

hook.name: ATOHook
hook.description: Bonding curve hook that acts as sole counterparty for an ATO ERC-20 token. Buys mint ATO along a forward curve funded by ETH; sells redeem from an ETH reserve. External liquidity is blocked. Trading fees are streamed to stakers via a Synthetix-style 7-day reward window.

hook.name: Dot
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that fully handles ETH/token swaps via put (ETH→token, 30% vault fee stays in vault raising the floor price) and clear (token→ETH, 25% vault fee + 5% team fee) operations. Normal AMM liquidity is disabled. Requires 32 bytes of hookData encoding the swapper address. Auto-migrates all reserves to a full-range Uniswap V3 position when ETH reserves reach 100 ETH.

hook.name: PlumbHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that intercepts all swaps to execute buy/sell operations on its own ERC-20 token (PlumbToken) via a custom price curve with a ratcheting ETH floor price backstop. External liquidity additions are disabled. Includes a team-controlled graduation mechanism that migrates accumulated ETH liquidity to a full-range Uniswap v3 position.
