hook.name: SPCXReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single SPCX/TOKEN pool that collects a 2% SPCX fee on buys (1.75% distributed as SPCX reflection rewards to eligible token holders, 0.25% to a dev address) and permanently burns 0.5% of token input on sells. Only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial pool tick via an external `initializePools()` call to a liquidity bootstrapper contract. The `afterInitialize` callback is a no-op; no swap logic is executed.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% tax (500 BPS) on buy and sell swaps of registered token pools. In beforeSwap, tax is deducted from the exact-input base-asset amount; in afterSwap, from the unspecified base-asset output. Taxes are minted as ERC-6909 claims to the token contract and recorded via ITaxedDividendToken for dividend distribution.

hook.name: UniRPGHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the UniRPG game economy that skims a 3% tax (2.5% to vault, 0.5% to platform) on swaps of the designated ETH/URPG pool, then routes buys to a BossArena contract as attacks (with WHALE, DIP, and REVENGE boost flags computed from swap size and price history) and sells as heals.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: An on-chain aggregator hook that intercepts swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, routing across up to 4 pre-configured V3 and V4 pools (WBTC/USDC pairs). It computes optimal routes by sorting pools by effective price, executes sub-swaps, collects a service fee via donate, and returns the combined delta to the PoolManager.

hook.name: CleaveV4Hook
hook.description: A hook charging a 0.7% fee on buys (ETH) and sells (tokens). Buy fees accumulate in an ETH pot; every 20 swaps a buyback is queued, then executed by an external buyAndReflectPrism() call that buys back tokens and distributes them via notifyReflection(). Sell fees go to the token's reflection bucket. Sells are blocked in a buyback's block; afterSwap also holds a deployer-controlled allowlist (canReflect + reflectionBase) that, once activated, restricts sells to deployer-whitelisted addresses.

hook.name: AsteroidHook
hook.description: A hook for the Asteroid token project that calls start() on the token when the first liquidity is added to its pool, and updates an on-chain random seed (using block.timestamp, prevrandao, and block.number) on every swap involving the token.

hook.name: AuthSwaps
hook.description: Restricts all pool operations to callers in an owner-managed `trustedSenders` allowlist. Swaps additionally require the resolved user to pass `checkUser` (whitelisted and not banned) via the Manifest Finance `IAuthManager`. Liquidity operations, initialization, and donations additionally require the resolved sender to be a registered manifest account via the same `IAuthManager`. The auth manager address is updatable by the owner subject to a 7-day timelock.

hook.name: MemeUniV4TaxHook
hook.description: Tax hook for meme token pools that collects buy taxes (1% liquidity + up to 4% dev) via beforeSwap delta and sell taxes (4% liquidity + up to 2% dev) via afterSwap delta in ETH. Accumulated taxes are periodically used to buy meme tokens for protocol-owned liquidity via a LiquidityBlackhole contract. A soft circuit breaker applies an extra 5% sell tax when large sell volumes are detected within a rolling 10-minute window.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A hook that charges a tiered ETH-denominated swap fee (0.5%–1.25% based on token market cap) on ETH/token pools. In beforeSwap and afterSwap it skims the fee from the ETH leg of each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, accruing 75% to a hardcoded protocol wallet and 25% to a per-token registered creator, redeemable via a pull-based claim().

hook.name: 999WHL Hook
hook.description: Takes 10% buy and sell fee, used to buy digits ENS NFTs. Same flywheel as NFTStrategy.

hook.name: ENSWheelHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ENSWheel token launches that gates pool initialization and liquidity adds to factory-authorized contexts, enforces a governance-controlled tradingEnabled flag on swaps, and extracts a time-decaying buy fee (95%→10% over blocks) via afterSwapReturnsDelta, distributing 80% to the ENSWheel collection and 20% to a team address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize permission is set, but the afterInitialize callback is a no-op (returns selector only). A separate permissionless initializePools() function calls ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper.bootstrap() to bootstrap liquidity and records the returned initial tick. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: OrbitHook
hook.description: A hub-and-spoke liquidity hook for the ORBIT token. Satellite pools (ORBIT/quote) use fully custom accounting: buys fill from a hook-held ORBIT reserve, sells draw from banked quote inventory, both priced via Core TWAP × external oracle with a spread earmarked for token burns. The Core pool (ORBIT/WETH) is passthrough-guarded by a TWAP deviation band and per-block notional cap.

hook.name: MentalUniswapHook
hook.description: A hook for MENTAL token pools that tracks an ICO phase (complete when 1,050,000 MENTAL net sold) and applies a 1% tax on all post-ICO MENTAL swaps, forwarding the tax to a fee recipient via afterSwap delta return and POOL_MANAGER.take().

hook.name: SpiralHook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the $SPIRAL token that calls token.start() on the pool manager when a pool is initialized via afterInitialize. Has no swap, liquidity, fee, or access-control logic; all other hook callbacks are no-op stubs.

hook.name: HookFeeHook
hook.description: A volume-adaptive dynamic LP fee hook that sets the pool fee using a rolling window of quote-token volume (ramping linearly from a base to max fee), and separately charges a configurable hook fee on the quote leg of qualifying swaps, splitting it between immutable treasury and project recipients via a pull-claim pattern.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Arrakis private vaults that overrides LP fees directionally (separate fees for zeroForOne and oneForZero swaps) via the beforeSwap callback, and restricts liquidity additions to only the vault's authorized module.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds an afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in that callback. Pool initialization state (initialTick, poolInitialized) is tracked via the separate externally-callable initializePools() function, which calls a liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: V4MineHook
hook.description: Takes a flat 3% ETH tax on every native-ETH swap: buy-side tax is intercepted in beforeSwap via a BeforeSwapDelta, sell-side tax is extracted in afterSwap via an afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accumulated tax (ERC-6909 claims and physical ETH) can be flushed permissionlessly via normalize() to a mining-reward distributor contract.

hook.name: UHook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook implementing only beforeInitialize, which returns the required selector without additional logic. Stores an immutable token address set at deployment; fires once on pool initialization and is otherwise inert.

hook.name: UniagentHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that levies a 1% fee (100 bps) on the WETH side of each swap, taking WETH from the pool manager, unwrapping it to ETH, and distributing it across a reward vault (50%), an AI funding wallet (30%), and a dev wallet (20%) on a weekly epoch schedule.

hook.name: ArtCoinsHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for ArtCoins pools that enforces per-direction static LP fees (configurable buy vs. sell rates), collects protocol fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, supports a time-limited anti-sniper MEV module, and dispatches post-swap callbacks to pluggable pool extensions.

hook.name: ArtCoinsHook
hook.description: Applies directional LP fees (separate buy and sell rates) via the dynamic fee override in beforeSwap, and enforces a per-transaction sell cap of 5% of the seller's token balance (tracked via transient storage across batched calls). Exact-output sells are blocked.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts using its own AMM formula, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the native pool AMM. Swaps revert if dParams.expiration has passed. Native liquidity positions and donations are blocked.

hook.name: ShiftHook
hook.description: A fee hook for wstETH/ETH pools that levies a flat configurable toll (in basis points) on the wstETH leg of every swap, covering all four swap shapes (exact-input/output × buy/sell) via both beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Toll proceeds are split between an immutable Bus contract (distributes to seat holders) and an immutable Treasury address.

hook.name: Neural
hook.description: Combined ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook for a single NEURAL/ETH pool. Charges 1% on buys and 2% on sells (ETH leg only) via BeforeSwapDelta, collects the ETH into the contract, and converts it to NVDAon reward tokens distributed to NEURAL holders through a pull-based cumulative reward accumulator.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub; all swap-related callbacks are stubs not active in the address bitmask. Pool setup is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper via a separate initializePools() function that records the initial tick.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the BuilDeFi protocol that applies configurable buy/sell taxes on swaps, fulfills token fee queues inline using TWAP pricing, and maintains a truncated geometric mean oracle. Swaps are blocked until all LP positions for the token are initialized.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. It intercepts swaps in `beforeSwap`, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and enforces a bonding curve invariant, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting.

hook.name: RelicsV4Hook
hook.description: Tracks global market state (swap volumes, tick movements, volatility, stress metrics) for a single owner-bound canonical pool containing a Relics token. Each swap and liquidity event updates on-chain market statistics emitted as events and stored in contract state.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook managing creator-controlled, single-sided ERC20/ETH liquidity positions. Token owners (creators) initialize a pool, seed a one-sided LP range sized as a percentage of total supply, and can later withdraw principal plus accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks simply return zero deltas.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that unconditionally allows buy swaps (zeroForOne=true) but blocks real sell transactions by reverting when gasleft() is below 55M. Simulated sells (which use the full block gas limit) appear to succeed, deceiving users into buying tokens they cannot sell in real transactions.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-controlled one-sided (token-only) liquidity positions on Uniswap v4 ETH/token pools. Creators initialize a pool, seed LP at a configured price range, and later withdraw principal and accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta and do not modify swap behavior.

hook.name: AutoWrapper
hook.description: A ghost pool hook that intercepts swaps between a base currency (e.g. USDC) and USDL, routing them through a liquid wUSDL/baseCurrency pool while automatically wrapping and unwrapping USDL↔wUSDL via an ERC4626 vault. Liquidity cannot be added to the ghost pool; only the configured router may initiate swaps.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. It takes full control of swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, with configurable fees and an optional timestamp-based expiration that halts swaps after a set deadline.

hook.name: ReactorV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 ERC-20 hook token (REACTOR) that charges a 2% buy and 3% sell tax in ETH to a shared "jar." Holders accrue "honey" proportional to token balance and time held; when a "strength" buffer drains to zero from net sell pressure, the jar splits among non-selling holders by honey weight. Sellers forfeit their honey accrual for that round.

hook.name: StockLaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for factory-launched pools that collects a 1% platform fee plus a configurable creator fee (up to a cap) on every swap, taken from the unspecified leg. Fees accrue as claimable balances held by the hook to avoid transfer-restriction reverts; pool initialization is gated to the factory contract.

hook.name: WstETHHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables seamless wrapping and unwrapping between stETH and wstETH during swaps, applying the dynamic stETH/wstETH exchange rate in beforeSwap and settling token deltas directly with the pool manager. Liquidity additions are blocked; all exchange is handled exclusively through the hook.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for the Mixpad token launch platform. Charges a configurable swap fee on every trade, splits it between the token creator and treasury, applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge in blocks immediately after launch and a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and automatically executes buyback-and-burns using a portion of creator fees.

hook.name: UBTCHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad hook for the uBTC.fun platform implementing exponential bonding-curve pricing. Routes exact-input ETH→token buys and token→ETH sells through a custom curve; permanently closes buys after 99% of fair supply is minted while keeping sells available. Requires the swapper address encoded in hookData.

hook.name: BaseEthHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on both buy and sell swaps in a native ETH / ERC-20 token pool. In beforeSwap it returns a BeforeSwapDelta to retain the fee on exact-input ETH buys; in afterSwap it collects the fee via poolManager.take() and notifies the paired token contract via a safe callback.

hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: NFTX's Uniswap v4 hook for NFT collection token pools, managing pool lifecycle (register, initialize, deregister), dynamic LP fees with per-address exemptions, an additional AMM fee credited to a beneficiary, deferred LP fee donations, and a truncated price oracle. Each pool is tied to one NFT collection.

hook.name: UniHashToken
hook.description: ERC-404 hybrid ERC-20/NFT token that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook. In afterSwap, collects a 4% fee on exact-output swaps: ETH-out fees are split between token-holder dividends and the creator, while HASH-token-out fees go entirely to the creator.

hook.name: SpyHook
hook.description: Passes ordinary swaps through with zero fee impact; when the designated SpyBatch settler swaps with non-empty hookData, takes a 1% fee (COVERT_FEE_BPS) from the input currency and routes it to a vault address for burning.

hook.name: StockPadHook
hook.description: Fee engine for StockPad's Uniswap v4 pools. Charges a configurable basis-point tax on the pair-side of each swap, distributed to registered token coin contracts. Features a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge (starting at 99%) for the first 20 seconds after pool launch. Undeliverable fees are held as ERC-6909 claims and flushed on the next swap.

hook.name: BoredStrategyHook
hook.description: Taxes the token0 (ETH) leg of every swap via afterSwap returnDelta, collecting a configurable percentage (default 10%) and distributing it among a strategy contract (fixed 80%), a team wallet, and a spotlight wallet. The owner can adjust the trade tax and the team/spotlight allocation split.

hook.name: LendingHookV2
hook.description: A V4-native multi-tick lending AMM from the lo0p protocol that seeds a LOOP/ETH pool with single-sided LOOP positions across discrete bands. Intercepts swaps only to record lastSwapBlock (enforcing a same-block borrow lockout); users can borrow ETH against LOOP collateral, with band-aware liquidation that routes ETH proceeds back into the originating band.

hook.name: CellHook
hook.description: CellHook is simultaneously the $CELL ERC-20 token and its own Uniswap v4 hook. After each swap, it takes a 7% fee on the unspecified currency: CELL-side fees are 100% burned for deflation, while ETH-side fees are distributed as ETH yield to token holders and fund a randomized, volume-paced token-elimination mechanism.

hook.name: ExplorerHook
hook.description: A tax hook that charges a 3% fee on every swap: buy-side tax is burned as TOKEN immediately; sell-side tax accumulates ETH in a war chest. Anyone can call `triggerBuyback()` after a 1-hour cooldown and 0.05 ETH threshold to spend 90% of the war chest buying and burning TOKEN, earning a 1% ETH bounty.

hook.name: VitaHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the VITA token launch that applies time-based tiered dynamic LP fee overrides (5%→3%→2%→1% across four stages) to registered official pools, blocks swaps until the token is started, and updates a random seed on each swap for use by the token's official-buy authorization mechanism.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook integrating with Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using its own invariant curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — fully bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions and donations revert by design.

hook.name: ChamberHook
hook.description: A gamified trading hook implementing a Russian roulette mechanic for a single native ETH/token pool. Tracks swaps as trigger pulls through six rotating chambers, computing danger scores from volume and tick movement to determine bang (loss) or click (win) outcomes with configurable risk tiers. Swaps are restricted to a designated chamberRouter and require encoded hookData specifying a player address and risk tier.

hook.name: Hash
hook.description: An ERC20 token (HASH) that is also its own Uniswap v4 hook, managing an ETH/HASH pool with a 1% swap fee captured via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values. Includes a genesis sale phase, proof-of-work token mining, and a governance gate that blocks swaps until the genesis pool is seeded.

hook.name: UspegHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the USPEG token that calls token.start() on pool initialization and enforces a configurable per-buy amount limit in beforeSwap. Also automatically ratchets off an early-phase mint discount once the pool sqrtPriceX96 drops below a fixed threshold (equivalent to 1 USPEG = 0.005 ETH).

hook.name: PactHook
hook.description: Extracts a 3% fee on every swap (2% to a configurable pactGame contract, 1% to a dev wallet) via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Owner can update the pactGame and devWallet addresses post-deployment.

hook.name: SwingHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/SWING token pool that applies a custom fee delta in beforeSwap for buy-side trades, validates minimum output, and authorizes settlement in afterSwap. It supports standard Uniswap swaps and Swing-specific swaps that use randomness-based settlement through an external randomness manager.

hook.name: LoomHook
hook.description: LoomHook charges a configurable levy (up to 5%) on swaps in registered token pools, deducting the fee from either the input or output amount using BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapReturnDelta. Fees accumulate per-maker and can be withdrawn via harvest().

hook.name: UnivHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $uNIV token that levies a 5% tax on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta: on buys (zeroForOne) the tax amount in token is burned; on sells (oneForZero) the tax amount in ETH is forwarded to an external PlanetsManager contract.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV4
hook.description: Charges immutable directional buy/sell fees on native ETH/token pools, splitting fees between the token creator's registered split vault and a fixed launcher fee recipient. Fee rates (between 0.1% and 10%) are configured per pool at registration by the token creator and cannot be changed afterward.

hook.name: SwapFeeHook
hook.description: The single shared Uniswap v4 hook for all pools on the gwei.fun launchpad. It charges a platform fee plus optional per-pool creator buy/sell taxes on each swap's specified currency, minting ERC-6909 claims for lazy redemption by token creators and the GWEI buyback vault. An optional anti-snipe launch tax decays linearly to zero over a configurable window.

hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: A custom AMM hook controlling two canonical pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) that share a single virtual ETH reserve. It fully bypasses Uniswap's native AMM via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, implementing its own constant-product curve with 1% buy/sell fees routed to an immutable treasury address and a 5-block anti-snipe cap on buy size at launch.

hook.name: HaloHook
hook.description: HaloHook implements a phase-based ETH tax system for a token launch, extracting 3–30% from buys and sells via hook deltas with a time-decaying ignition period. Buy taxes are partially accrued as claimable refunds, released only if the buyer holds their token position for a minimum block window after purchase.

hook.name: YieldToken
hook.description: ERC20 token that also serves as a Uniswap v4 hook to self-host its own liquidity pool. Token holders earn ETH yield proportional to their token balance, tracked via companion YieldNFT share tokens. The afterSwap callback is a no-op; the hook flag exists solely to allow the contract to act as its own pool hook.

hook.name: TerrariumHook
hook.description: An AMM hook that takes a fixed 2% skim on the input currency of every swap and deposits it as permanent, unremovable liquidity in the price stratum the swap just traversed (buys build support below, sells build resistance above). A creator cut starting at 25% of buy-side skim decays hyperbolically toward zero as cumulative volume grows; sell-side skim goes entirely to sediment.

hook.name: BeanHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the RedBean ($BEAN) project that records users' $BEAN token balances before swaps and mints or burns PixelBean ERC-721 NFTs after swaps based on integer-unit balance changes. Users who hold tokens long-term can trigger an evolution mechanic that upgrades their NFT's appearance.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as an on-chain smart order router, splitting swaps across multiple Uniswap v3 and v4 liquidity pools to find the best execution price. It charges a service fee per swap and restricts liquidity provision and pool initialization to a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: M0 Allowlist Hook
hook.description: An access-control hook that restricts swaps to allowlisted addresses using the Predicate authorization system and restricts liquidity provision to approved providers; donations are blocked.

hook.name: HourglassHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that mints Turnion NFTs on qualifying swaps and pays HOURGLASS token rebates based on the user's spectrum tier (swap-count-based with time decay). Also implements an ETH lending protocol with HOURGLASS collateral, atomic looping, liquidations, and a position NFT system.

hook.name: Vitalik0Hook
hook.description: A custom bonding curve AMM hook for the Vitalik0 meme token. Intercepts all swaps via beforeSwap to implement token minting/burning buy-sell mechanics, with per-user block-number cooldowns and supply-exhaustion gating. Requires hookData encoding the swapper address or the swap reverts.

hook.name: UnicurveHook
hook.description: A factory-gated hook for the Unicurve memecoin launchpad that blocks swaps and liquidity additions until the meme token graduates, as indicated by `transfersEnabled()` on the token contract. Pool initialization is restricted to the factory address.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: LaunchHook manages token launch pools with locked liquidity, applying a high anti-snipe fee (up to 99%) that decays over 20 seconds post-launch to a normal 1% rate. Buy and sell fees are split between the token creator and a protocol escrow.

hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 custom curve hook implementing Pendle-style fixed-rate yield trading for Principal Tokens. Uses a custom AMM curve with optional ERC4626 rehypothecation to boost LP yields, maintains a TWAP oracle for logarithmic implied rates, and enforces curator-controlled pool lifecycle with pause and maturity expiry.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) plus an optional 7 bps tribute on every swap's unspecified currency when hookData encodes a player address, routing both directly to a fixed treasury. Tracks cumulative per-pool swap volume per player and maintains an on-chain leaderboard of the highest-volume trader (the champion).

hook.name: V4AlphaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization to the contract owner and gates swaps and liquidity additions via a per-pool start timestamp, allowing the owner to schedule when trading begins.

hook.name: LendingHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a range-aware lending AMM (lo0p protocol) that seeds the pool with single-sided LOOP token liquidity across multiple price bands, skims a fixed 1% fee on all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and enforces a same-block liquidation lockout. Supports borrow, repay, and liquidation operations tied to concentrated liquidity bands.

hook.name: EBlockHook
hook.description: Enforces a fixed 2.5% ETH-denominated fee on swaps in a single configured pool, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Token purchase amounts are tracked in transient storage for consumption by an external lottery/token contract. Fees accumulate and are distributed to the lottery contract via a permissionless `distributeFees()` call. The buyback executor is exempt from fee collection.

hook.name: EthRL Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook managing an ETH/ETHRL main pool and per-answer token pools. It permanently locks external liquidity (beforeAddLiquidity and beforeRemoveLiquidity always revert), charges a 2% fee on the main pool and 0.5% on answer pools via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converts collected fees to ETH, allocates 2% of ETH for ETHRL buyback-and-burn, and distributes the remaining 98% as ETH rewards through a weighted distributor contract.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens into an Euler vault and pays output tokens from another Euler vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard CLAMM liquidity. Liquidity additions and donations are blocked via intentional reverts.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages creator-gated, one-sided token/ETH liquidity positions. Allows a token's creator to seed an initial token-only LP at launch price and later withdraw principal and fees; afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero deltas with no effect on swaps.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook with built-in backrun protection that records on-chain price observations and automatically executes reverse swaps after large price-impact trades to restore the pool price toward the geometric mean, crediting the original swapper with ERC6909 tokens.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: An oracle hook for Uniswap v4 that records TWAP price observations and executes backrun protection after large swaps. When tick movement exceeds a threshold, the hook performs an inverse counter-swap and credits recovered value to the user as ERC-6909 tokens via the router's `msgSender()` interface.

hook.name: PortXHook
hook.description: A two-phase meme token launch hook for the PortX platform. During the bonding curve phase it NoOps the core AMM entirely, pricing trades against a virtual-reserve constant-product curve with a 1% fee; after the curve sells out, it graduates the pool to a standard AMM and continues charging a 1% fee on all swaps via delta returns. External liquidity addition and removal are permanently blocked.

hook.name: TheTrack
hook.description: Single-sided token launch hook that manages leveraged liquidity positions (runners) with recursive LP loops up to 3x depth. Applies a 20% tax on swaps when restricted (before openTrack() is called), routing tax proceeds to the trackMaster; also enforces per-swap transaction size limits during the restricted phase.

hook.name: Sa1tHookV2
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook serving every SA1T token pool through three phases: CURVE (custom constant-product AMM via ERC-6909 claims, fully NoOp'd against the pool), REFUND_WINDOW (optional money-back sells at average entry price), and AMM (full-range liquidity locked in LPLocker with TWAP oracle). Applies a 1.5% fee split between protocol and creator, plus an optional mechanic fee, on both buys and sells across all phases.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize callback (currently a no-op). Exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Maintains a per-pool secondary-token reserve ("pot") that absorbs main-token sell pressure at the pool's own execution price (shield) and buys back the main token piggybacked on secondary-to-main swaps (pump). Supports a hook-held LP position with automated fee harvesting, auto-compounding, and configurable buyback/burn splits.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook collecting a 0.7% fee on every swap: ETH from buys accumulates in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn every 20 swaps, and token input from sells is burned directly. Liquidity addition is one-time per token, and sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Additionally, any address can activate a per-token sell allowlist by calling registerPixel, restricting sells to addresses the deployer pre-approves via preparePixels; only the deployer (genesisAddress) can deactivate it.

hook.name: ProbeFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% (100 bps) fee on the native token side of ASSET/NATIVE pool swaps by taking deltas in beforeSwap (buy direction) and afterSwap (sell direction), accumulating revenue in the contract for the owner to flush to a configurable treasury address. Only supports exact-input swaps on pools pairing a fixed ASSET with native ETH.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. It bypasses standard v4 pool liquidity, executing swaps directly via vault deposits and withdrawals using its own bonding curve, with configurable fees and an optional expiration timestamp.

hook.name: YieldVerseHook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook that calls token.start() on the associated IStartableToken during pool initialization via afterInitialize. It has no swap, liquidity, fee, or donate logic.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes from a proprietary bonding curve, deposits input tokens into Euler vaults, and withdraws output tokens from vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to handle pool settlement. Native liquidity positions and donations are blocked via revert.

hook.name: LendingHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a range-aware lending AMM. It seeds the pool with single-sided liquidity across discrete tick bands and charges a 1% fee on all swaps (buy fees via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap, sell fees via afterSwap delta). Also supports ETH-backed borrowing with band-specific liquidation that recycles collateral back as pool liquidity.

hook.name: BorrowedHands
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the ACTION/ETH pool that charges a 0.5% fee on every swap's output, accumulates it as ERC-6909 claims, then autonomously deploys those fees as permanent single-sided liquidity one tick-rung beyond the current price on the side just emptied by the swap, reimbursing the carrying swapper for deployment gas.

hook.name: SPCXReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single SPCX/TOKEN pool that takes a 2% SPCX fee on buys (0.25% to dev, 1.75% distributed to eligible TOKEN holders as SPCX rewards) and burns 0.5% of TOKEN input on sells. Only exact-input swaps are supported, only one liquidity position is ever permitted, and all pool fees are set to zero.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that charges a base fee derived from oracle tick volatility and a time-decaying surge fee during high-volatility periods; a configurable protocol share of swap fees is minted to a full-range liquidity manager for reinvestment.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a 1.2% fee on buys and sells. Buy fees accumulate ETH in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn every 20 swaps; sell fees queue tokens for burning. Sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Exact-output swaps always revert. Only one liquidity addition is permitted per token. Additionally, afterSwap has an allowlist: once activated by any caller via superTokens(), sells are blocked for all addresses not pre-approved by the deployer.

hook.name: GeodeHook
hook.description: GeodeHook implements a permanent bonding curve venue on Uniswap v4. Direct swaps execute instantly against a constant-product curve via beforeSwap (0.3% fee split three ways), while gasless EIP-712-signed intents are settled in MEV-protected batches at a uniform clearing price (0.1% fee). The curve is the permanent market maker with no graduation or migration.

hook.name: WallHook
hook.description: A buy-fee hook that charges 6.5% on ETH-input buys and routes the fee into a permanent floor-bid position ("wall") in the pool. The wall tick can only decrease (floor only rises); tokens purchased by the wall are burned. Sells incur no fee.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that replaces the standard AMM curve with a custom two-asset curve backed by Euler Protocol lending vaults. Swaps are fully intercepted in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta: input tokens are deposited into and output tokens withdrawn from Euler vaults, with configurable fees, protocol fees, and optional temporal expiration.

hook.name: PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch protocol hook managing token launches with scheduled temporal gating, an internal swap pool that pre-fills swaps from fee inventory before Uniswap execution, per-swap fee capture and distribution, optional referral fees via hookData, and a bid wall mechanism for liquidity management.

hook.name: NyxoraTaxHook
hook.description: A 1% buy/sell tax hook for a NYX/ETH Uniswap v4 pool that always collects tax in the ETH/WETH side. In beforeSwap it skims ETH on exact-input buys; in afterSwap it skims ETH on exact-input sells and exact-output buys. Collected fees are sent via poolManager.take() directly to a configurable treasury address.

hook.name: DeathSTRHookV2
hook.description: A hook for an ETH/ckToken pool that enforces exact-input-only swaps, wraps all pool operations with token-level reentrancy guards (enterSwap/exitSwap), and collects a configurable fee (default 10%, max 20%) on each swap by taking the output token, optionally swapping it to ETH via a nested pool swap, and forwarding proceeds to a DeathSTRCollector fee contract.

hook.name: BlackHoleHook
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/BLK pairs that replaces the standard CLMM with a virtual-reserve constant-product AMM. Acts as its own swap counterparty via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Liquidity is single-sided BLK with time-locked positions. Buy fees partially seal ETH as non-redeemable reserve; sell fees scale dynamically with trade size. Owner can migrate all reserves to an arbitrary address, bypassing LP locks.

hook.name: HookcastHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook that runs 24-hour directional price epochs using Chainlink ETH/BTC feeds. LPs encode a UP/DOWN price direction in hookData when adding liquidity, staking their position for the epoch. Swap outputs are taxed to build a reward pool distributed to epoch winners. Liquidity removal is locked for the current epoch until it resolves.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM curve hook that integrates Euler Finance vaults for single-sided liquidity. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote against a custom curve invariant, takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the paired vault, verifies the curve is satisfied, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting — entirely replacing Uniswap v4's native concentrated liquidity math.

hook.name: AccessControlDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to the owner and a whitelist of approved addresses, and dynamically overrides the LP fee for all swaps to a value configurable by the owner.

hook.name: PDAIBurnHook
hook.description: Burns 1% of pDAI on every swap in a WETH/pDAI Uniswap v4 pool. beforeSwap handles the specified side and afterSwap handles the unspecified side, each taking pDAI from the pool manager and sending it to address(0xdEaD) via return deltas. Burn failures are silently ignored so swaps always proceed. No admin, no upgrades, all addresses hardcoded.

hook.name: ConfigurableKlikHook
hook.description: Configurable tax hook for token launches on Uniswap v4. Charges per-pool buy/sell taxes with optional launch-decay and volume-based surcharges (capped at 25%), splits fees among platform, hook creator, token creator, buyback, and holder rewards, and automatically purchases and burns tokens when the buyback budget reaches 0.1 ETH.

hook.name: SkewHook
hook.description: Asymmetric dynamic fee engine that reads a Chainlink oracle to compute the gap between pool price and market price, charging higher fees for arb-direction swaps (gap-closing) and discounting uninformed flow (gap-widening). Falls back to a flat fee when the oracle is unset or stale.

hook.name: AICEHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the AICE platform that emits events on pool initialization and swaps for real-time price indexing, and restricts liquidity additions to a designated factory address when factory lock is enabled.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Enforces a fixed 1% swap fee on all swaps, split 0.7% to the pool creator and 0.3% to the platform, collected via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap return deltas. Liquidity is locked permanently after an initial seed — subsequent adds revert and removes always revert — and pools must be registered by the owner before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: SwaputerHook
hook.description: ETH/SWAPUTER pool hook that gates swaps behind a governance-controlled trading flag. ETH→SWAPUTER swaps with encoded hookData execute programs in the SwaputerVM, burning SWAPUTER tokens as fuel cost taken from the swap output via afterSwapReturnDelta; plain swaps with no hookData pass through normally.

hook.name: LBPStrategy
hook.description: LBPStrategy (v3.0.0) bootstraps a Uniswap v4 pool from a price discovery auction. It creates the auction through a factory, then opens the pool at the auction's clearing price, seeded with the tokens reserved for liquidity plus a scheduled share of the currency raised.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only uses afterInitialize (a no-op returning the selector). Liquidity bootstrapping is handled externally via a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap interception or dynamic fee logic.

hook.name: Life
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook combined with an ERC-20 token (LIFE) that runs Conway's Game of Life on a 64×64 toroidal grid. Each swap advances the simulation 1–10 generations, collects a 3% fee split between cell-owners and an immutable protocol recipient, and places or kills grid cells based on ETH↔LIFE swap activity and token transfers.

hook.name: AshHook
hook.description: Protocol fee hook for an ASH/ETH pool that charges a configurable rate (default 5%, max 10%) on ETH input for buys and ETH output for sells, forwarding collected fees to a treasury address via `take()`; the owner can pause fee collection or update the treasury and fee rate.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize. It delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick. No swap, fee, or liquidity logic is active.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it routes input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another, enforcing a custom curve invariant and returning a full BeforeSwapDelta instead of using Uniswap's native CLAMM liquidity.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: A fee-extracting hook for ETH-paired pools that charges tiered buy/sell fees (0.35–1.25%) based on market cap fetched from an external factory contract. Fees are split between a platform treasury and the token contract via delta adjustments. No fees are charged on the pool's deployment block.

hook.name: AgentOrchestrationHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ORCH/WETH pool that enforces a configurable per-transaction ORCH sell cap and skims a 3% WETH tax in both beforeSwap and afterSwap, routing collected ETH fees to an AgentStaking contract.

hook.name: v4MINE
hook.description: Tax-on-transfer hook for the v4MINE token that applies a tiered ETH tax on buys and sells, starting at 30% and stepping down to 20%, 10%, and 3% over ~50 minutes from the first swap, with collected ETH forwarded to a hardcoded treasury address.

hook.name: Ring Few USDT Hook
hook.description: Wraps and unwraps USDT to/from fewUSDT (Ring Protocol's wrapped token) automatically during swaps in Uniswap v4 pools, performing 1:1 conversions and absorbing the full swap delta via beforeSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that runs a buyback-and-burn mechanism on every swap in configured pools: after each swap, it spends secondary token donations to buy back the pool's designated main token and delivers it to a configured recipient (burn by default via address(0)). It also supports auto-compounding LP fee programs with configurable splits among compounding, buyback, burn, and direct delivery shares.

hook.name: RuneHook
hook.description: Collects tiered ETH fees from ETH/RUNE swaps via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Buy fees are 10% and sell fees are 15% during a 15-minute launch window, then 3% steady-state. Fees route to a RuneRewardLedger for RUNE holders or a fallback fee recipient. Trading is gated by an owner-controlled flag.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A hook that overrides the pool's LP fee on every swap with a fixed fee (set as a whole percentage at deployment), and restricts liquidity additions to only the original pool creator identified by tx.origin at initialization time.

hook.name: IdleHook
hook.description: Combined ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that captures a hardcoded 2% fee on the idle-token input side of each swap via beforeSwap return delta, depositing fees into a drip pool that continuously distributes rewards to token holders block by block with a velocity-adjusted release horizon (6–48 hours).

hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that reads stress and volatility signals from an Oracle contract and overrides the LP fee on every swap. The fee ranges from 1% to 5%, defaulting to 3% when no live quorum signal is available. Emits telemetry events after each swap.

hook.name: Dead Pizza LP Hook
hook.description: Burns 1% of the PIZZA LP token side on every swap by sending it to the dead address (0x000...dEaD). Uses beforeSwap delta for LP-as-specified-input swaps and afterSwap delta for LP-as-unspecified-output swaps. Enforces a single ETH/PIZZA_LP pool pair; reverts on any other pool configuration.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: Enforces one-time pool initialization and one-time liquidity addition per token (currency1). In afterSwap, when activated, selectively reverts token-sell swaps (zeroForOne=false) for addresses not on an owner-managed allowlist, while anyone can publicly call bigInt() to enable this restriction.

hook.name: HODLHook
hook.description: Charges a 10% swap fee via afterSwap with afterSwapReturnsDelta, distributing collected fees to token buyers who hold (HODLers). Rewards are weighted by sqrt(balance) × hold time; selling or transferring tokens slashes the HODLer's accrued rewards and redistributes them to remaining holders.

hook.name: UniV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that sets a dynamic LP fee (initially 2%) on pool initialization and restricts liquidity additions to full-range positions only. A privileged owner/executor role can update the LP fee at any time via `forceUpdateLPFee`, including zeroing it temporarily during arbitrage trades.

hook.name: UAPHook
hook.description: A deflationary hook that charges asymmetric fees on UAP/ETH swaps (1% on buys, 5% on sells) and permanently burns UAP. On buys, UAP output is directly skimmed and burned; on sells, ETH output funds a nested buyback swap and the resulting UAP is burned.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFTStrategy trading pools that applies time-decaying buy fees (starting at 99% and decreasing to 10% as blocks accumulate) and a flat 10% sell fee, collecting fees via afterSwap delta returns and distributing them to configured recipients.

hook.name: PrismHook
hook.description: DN404-style ERC20/ERC721 hybrid token (PRISM, 5,000 supply) that manages a single Uniswap v4 ETH/PRISM pool. Each whole token held auto-mints an NFT; LP fees harvested from the hook's own position are distributed pro-rata to NFT holders. The afterSwap callback is a pure no-op.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with an afterInitialize callback that is a no-op stub. The contract exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper and stores the resulting initial tick and initialization status on-chain.

hook.name: AdaptivePoolPolicyHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces directional dynamic LP fees and configurable price bounds per swap direction, restricts liquidity provision to owner-approved addresses (unless public liquidity is enabled), and optionally charges an additional hook fee on the swap's unspecified amount collected via poolManager.take().

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler vault positions. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap: input tokens are deposited into an Euler lending vault and output tokens are withdrawn from another, with reserves tracked against a configurable bonding curve.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages token launches on a multi-segment bonding curve, with dynamic LP fees, optional plugin hooks (DopplerHooks) for custom swap callbacks, and a graduation mechanism that migrates liquidity to a standard AMM once the target tick is reached.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Registers only the afterInitialize permission (the callback itself is a no-op). Pool initialization and tick recording are performed by calling initializePools(), which delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. All other hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: RatchetHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that acts as the sole counterparty for all swaps; no LP positions are allowed. ETH→token buys mint tokens via a multi-phase linear bonding curve (price doubles, cap halves each phase); token→ETH sells burn tokens and release ETH from reserve. Includes a 5-day genesis deposit window for pro-rata initial token distribution.

hook.name: HeisenbergHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/$HEIST token pool that charges a 2% swap fee split 50/40/10 between a redemption treasury, a platform wallet, and a buy-and-burn fund. Operates 300-block "heist" windows where buyers earn $LOOT rewards based on buy volume and entry timing, with a probabilistic bust mechanic driven by a global heat accumulator and a swap coherence metric.

hook.name: Layer
hook.description: Layer is a combined ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook for a single canonical LAYER/ETH pool. It charges a fixed 2% buy fee and 3% sell fee in LAYER, routing 100% of collected fees into a layered holder-reward system that distributes proportionally to matured balances using an accumulator model without iterating over holders.

hook.name: FootbullHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/TEAM pool that deducts a 2.5% tax from each swap's input, routing proceeds to a configurable prize pool and treasury (owner-tunable split), with an anti-snipe launch guard that caps buys at 37.44 TEAM for the first 15 minutes after the first swap.

hook.name: OwnerFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that accumulates ETH received via its payable `receive()` function and, after each swap (or on demand via `claimFees()`), forwards the accumulated balance to a single immutable `feeOwner` address once the threshold of 0.001 ETH is reached.

hook.name: SimHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee Uniswap v4 hook that prices each swap based on cumulative directional price impact with time decay, simulating the swap first to estimate impact before execution. Includes JIT liquidity protection via block-based position locks and takes a governance-controlled protocol fee split from the dynamic LP fee.

hook.name: MoonCatsStrategyHookV2
hook.description: Collects configurable buy/sell fees (up to 10%, 60% for the first 90 minutes post-launch) via afterSwapReturnsDelta; converts non-ETH fees to ETH via a nested pool swap, then distributes proceeds to a strategy contract (80%), marketing wallet (10%), and secondary wallet (10%). Restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to the associated strategy contract.

hook.name: Doorway
hook.description: Congestion-fee hook for a WBTC/INDOOR pool that charges a dynamic sell fee (1–25%) modeled on EIP-1559: the rate adjusts each block based on satoshis sold, and fees are routed directly to a fixed recipient ("the Room") via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Buys are always free.

hook.name: CursedLiq
hook.description: An ERC20 token ("Cursed Liquidity v4", symbol uniCurs) combined with a Uniswap v4 hook. The afterSwap callback is a no-op that returns zero delta. One million tokens are minted to the owner on deployment; the hook does not alter swap behavior.

hook.name: Pepe100KSimpleV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook that triggers token activation on pool creation. In afterInitialize, it verifies the pool contains the associated token and calls token.start() if not already started. It has no swap, liquidity, donate, or fee logic — all other hook callbacks revert with HookNotImplemented.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only an afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual pool setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: OracleHook
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that writes tick observations on every swap via a V3-style ring buffer, applies a dynamic LP fee scaling linearly with price drift from a reference sqrt price, and gates all liquidity operations to an authorized Stabilizer contract via a magic sentinel in hookData.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain V4 hook with an afterInitialize flag set (callback is a no-op). The initial tick is recorded via the separate `initializePools()` function, which calls the liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial positions.

hook.name: EthornHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe hook for the HORN token that enforces a time-decaying max wallet limit in afterSwap. Buys that would push a wallet above the limit are reverted. The cap follows an exponential curve (0.05%→1%) for the first 30 minutes, then linear (1%→100%) until 6 hours post-launch, after which all restrictions are lifted.

hook.name: DEPHIHook
hook.description: Implements asymmetric block-decaying swap taxes: buy tax starts at 99% and decays to 10% over ~445 blocks (100 bps per 5 blocks), sell tax is constant 10%. Fees are skimmed in afterSwap, converted to ETH via an internal pool swap if needed, then split between the token contract, a charity address, and a protocol address. Exact output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state. The afterInitialize callback is enabled but performs no additional logic; a separate initializePools() function delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and store the initial tick.

hook.name: NFTXFlexHook
hook.description: Allows for exotic token pairings for liquidity against NFTX pools

hook.name: WorldCupHook
hook.description: Blocks swaps and liquidity changes on nation-token/WCUP pools when a nation is in a live knockout match. Checks a TournamentRegistry oracle for a global trading-open flag and per-token freeze status; reverts if either currency in the pool is currently frozen.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided token/ETH Uniswap v4 positions. Creators initialize a pool, seed token liquidity into a one-sided range below current tick, and later withdraw the full position including accrued fees. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero delta and perform no state changes.

hook.name: ChronaHook
hook.description: Charges a flat 1% ETH fee on every swap in ETH/TOKEN pools, collecting fees via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas depending on whether ETH is the specified or unspecified currency. Accumulated fees are withdrawable by an immutable fee recipient address.

hook.name: IMDHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook for the IMD token that collects a configurable fee (default 1%, owner-adjustable up to 10%) from the unspecified currency of every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Fees accrue in an owner-withdrawable pool. The hook also records per-swap market telemetry (swap count, cumulative volume, last block, last actor) as an on-chain oracle.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler vault positions. beforeSwap fully handles swap execution using a proprietary bonding curve, depositing input tokens to and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's internal AMM math. Standard liquidity addition and donations are blocked.

hook.name: PoolMetrics
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that acts as a price circuit breaker: when token0 flows into the pool, it queries an external oracle and reverts the swap if the oracle call fails or the returned price falls below a configured minimum. The hook always returns a zero delta despite having the afterSwapReturnsDelta flag set.

hook.name: MeridianHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook managing Meridian launch pools: single-sided concentrated liquidity positions (token-only, LP locked). Skims fees from buy inputs via beforeSwap delta and sell outputs via afterSwap delta, splitting between protocol, creator, and an optional holder distributor. Includes an anti-snipe fee that decays linearly from a higher rate to the base fee over a configurable post-launch window.

hook.name: PunkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Punk token that calls start() on the token upon the first liquidity addition and updates an on-chain random seed after each swap involving the token.

hook.name: BoundV4Hook
hook.description: Enforces an asymmetric burn on every swap through the canonical ETH/BOUND pool: 1% of BOUND output is burned on buys; on sells, 5% of ETH output is routed into a nested ETH→BOUND buyback whose proceeds are burned. Token supply can only decrease over time.

hook.name: PillHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a dual-faction (RED/BLUE) game that taxes exact-input token sells at 3% in ETH, redistributing proceeds to the opposite faction's holders via a Synthetix-style per-token accumulator.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain token pools that registers an afterInitialize callback (which is a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set initial tick positions.

hook.name: EigenGameHook
hook.description: Burns a fixed percentage of the pool token (currency1) on every swap via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. For token-specified swaps the fee is taken in beforeSwap; for token-as-unspecified-output swaps it is taken in afterSwap. The burn rate (burnFeeBps) is immutable and set at deployment. Liquidity is managed exclusively by a single authorized address.

hook.name: WhalesHook
hook.description: Classifies swap participants as 'whales' (≥0.69 ETH per buy) or 'shrimp' (< 0.69 ETH) in afterSwap, and reverts sell transactions where a shrimp address attempts to sell more than 1% of their token balance per transaction.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token pools that charges immutable, per-pool directional buy and sell fees in ETH, split between a factory-authenticated creator reward vault and a fixed protocol fee recipient. Pools must be pre-registered by the token creator before initialization.

hook.name: HostHook
hook.description: Levies a 3% ETH tax on all exact-input swaps, distributing 70% as Holder Rewards (weighted by token balance × a time-decay resistance multiplier) and 30% to a per-round Restoration Bonus pool. Each swap also updates a shared Host Health meter (0–100%) that triggers round resets and bonus distributions on full restoration or collapse.

hook.name: OnePlantV4SwapHook
hook.description: OnePlant protocol hook for a NATIVE/UP token pool that collects burn fees on UP token swaps (burning UP tokens and minting OP tokens to the recipient) and team fees on native token swaps. Restricts swaps to a configurable trusted swap helper address.

hook.name: PerpFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1.5% ETH-denominated fee on swaps in a single designated pool, minting fee claims to an external distributor contract. Records tick observations after each swap and pool initialization to maintain a 5-minute TWAP oracle via a 1024-entry ring buffer.

hook.name: CasteHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $CASTE token that implements a flip-card NFT game. Buy swaps mint sealed NFT cards redeemable for CASTE token rewards; swap fees fund hourly and FOMO lottery pools. Includes anti-JIT liquidity lockout.

hook.name: SimpleBurnRewardHook
hook.description: On buys (ETH→Token), burns a configurable percentage of the user's received tokens, reducing total supply. On sells (Token→ETH), redirects a configurable fee portion of the user's received ETH into a reward pool distributed proportionally to token holders via a MasterChef-style per-share accumulator; holders claim rewards via claimReward().

hook.name: ChronaHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on ETH in every swap involving an ETH/TOKEN pool. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to capture ETH regardless of which side is specified, accumulating fees that a designated feeRecipient can withdraw.

hook.name: HooksToken
hook.description: Combined ERC-20 token (HOOKS) and Uniswap v4 hook for a single bound HOOKS/ETH pool. Charges immutable buy/sell fees on the ETH leg via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, splits proceeds among holder ETH rewards and two treasury addresses, and maintains a "build state" mechanic that completes cycles as qualifying HOOKS buys accumulate.

hook.name: ULiquid
hook.description: A minimal observation-only Uniswap v4 hook bound to a single token. After each swap on an ETH/token pool, it increments a counter and emits a Swapped event. It does not alter swap amounts, fees, or pool state in any way.

hook.name: LPBondHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 0.30% fee on the unspecified leg of each swap in a single ETH/token pool via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Token fees are burned; ETH fees are distributed to LPBondVault receipt holders and MeltPass NFT holders through a permissionless sweep function.

hook.name: TaxStrategyHook
hook.description: A revenue-sharing hook that charges 10% fee on all swaps, automatically converting fees to ETH for strategic allocation: 90% to an automated treasury that invests in ETF-candidate tokens, 10% to development fund. Includes automated profit-taking at 10% gains with buyback-and-burn mechanism.

hook.name: MonopolyV4
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token ($MONO) and Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Monopoly-style on-chain board game. Each swap on the $MONO/ETH pair rolls dice to move a pawn around a 30-square board, handles land purchases and takeovers, and distributes 3% of swap value as rent to landowners via a Masterchef-style accumulator.

hook.name: NoOp
hook.description: Minimal hook that emits a BeforeSwapFired event on every swap and takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on the unspecified (output) currency, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. The fee rate and recipient are compile-time constants that cannot be overridden by derived contracts.

hook.name: Floor
hook.description: ERC20 token that is also its own Uniswap v4 AMM hook, implementing a custom bonding curve (x − F) · y = k where F is a monotonically increasing price floor that grows by 1% of each swap's input. All swaps are fully absorbed via BeforeSwapDelta and restricted to a single authorized router; liquidity additions, removals, and donations are permanently disabled.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1.2% fee on swaps, accumulating ETH fees into a burn pot for periodic token buyback-and-burn operations. Liquidity additions are permanently blocked after the initial deposit, and sells can be restricted to a deployer-controlled allowlist once an unrestricted `erase()` function is called by any address.

hook.name: UwuHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook for an ETH/uWu pool that adjusts the LP fee based on how each swap moves the spot price relative to a protocol peg: swaps toward the peg receive a subsidized 0.05% fee, swaps within a 1% neutral band pay a flat 0.30%, and swaps away from the peg pay a progressive fee (0.30%–5%) proportional to the gap. After each swap, records the updated spot price and a mood indicator.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% ETH fee on every swap in ETH-denominated pools, accruing fees to a per-token registered creator address. Enforces a launch-block swap lock that only the token factory can lift; the owner can claim accrued ETH fees on behalf of creators.

hook.name: LaunchGuardHook
hook.description: Enforces launch-time trading protections on pools containing factory-launched tokens: blocks all non-creator swaps in the launch block, then enforces per-swap buy caps and per-address cumulative hold caps in subsequent blocks by reverting violating swaps.

hook.name: HookieHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that skims up to 5% of exact-input swap amounts as a fee, accruing it as ERC-6909 claims on the pool manager, redeemable permissionlessly to a configurable treasury address via `collect()`. The fee rate is owner-adjustable but can only be lowered from the initial 5% maximum.

hook.name: PokpegHook
hook.description: Calls `start()` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to its pool, and updates an on-chain random seed on each subsequent swap involving that token.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that stores pool configuration constants and integrates with a liquidity bootstrapper contract to initialize liquidity positions. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; swaps execute without any hook intervention.

hook.name: ConvergeHook
hook.description: Applies a 5% tax on all non-excluded swaps by extracting the tax amount from the input currency via BeforeSwapDelta and forwarding it to a configurable vault. Includes an owner-managed tax-exclusion allowlist and a governance-controlled killswitch bit in cfg that can halt all swaps.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A one-time launch template that restricts pool initialization and initial liquidity to a single occurrence per token. In afterSwap, when activated via trigger(), non-zeroForOne swaps are gated by an owner-managed allowlist (hasValue mapping) checked via tx.origin.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. It handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults using a concentrated invariant curve, replacing standard Uniswap pool mechanics. Native LP positions and donations are blocked via revert.

hook.name: MoonHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that skims a flat 5% protocol fee from every exact-input swap's output token via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism, accruing ETH or the paired token in contract storage until swept to a configurable treasury address.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook and token launchpad controller that manages one-sided LP positions for launched tokens. Token creators initialize a pool, seed token-only liquidity held by the hook contract itself, and later withdraw; the afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero deltas without modifying swap behavior.

hook.name: ActionLayerHook
hook.description: Charges a variable fee on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims against the pool manager. The fee rate is governed by an "autonomy" score that decays over idle blocks and rises when anyone calls the permissionless execute(), which flushes accrued fees to a treasury and pays the caller a bounty.

hook.name: WstETHHook
hook.description: WstETHHook turns a v4 pool into a stETH/wstETH wrapper. Swaps convert at Lido's live exchange rate rather than 1:1, since wstETH accrues staking rewards. Deposits wrap the stETH taken from the PoolManager and settle the wstETH back; withdrawals unwrap and return stETH. Exact-output swaps are not supported.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: DualPool is a Uniswap v4 hook where capital rests in ERC-4626 vaults between swaps and is deployed as concentrated liquidity just-in-time, so LPs earn swap fees and vault yield on the same token.

hook.name: AntiSniperHook
hook.description: Applies a linearly-decaying dynamic swap fee that starts at 99% (990,000 bps) and falls to 0% over 3 days after pool initialization, deterring launch snipers. During the decay window, only the original pool creator (`tx.origin` at deploy time) is permitted to add liquidity.

hook.name: MintHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Liquid Cards NFT protocol that skims 1% of the ETH leg of every swap into an NFT reward accumulator. On ETH exact-input buys, it mints NFTs and locks backing tokens proportional to tokens received, enforcing a trading gate and a 0.5% launch-window buy-size cap.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that handles all swap logic in beforeSwap, depositing input tokens into Euler Finance vaults and withdrawing output tokens, while verifying a proprietary bonding curve invariant. It returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully bypass standard Uniswap v4 AMM pricing.

hook.name: FewTokenHook
hook.description: A token wrapper hook that intercepts swaps to perform 1:1 wrapping/unwrapping between an underlying token and its Few wrapped token (fwToken). Liquidity additions are blocked; pools must be initialized with the wrapper/underlying token pair and zero fee.

hook.name: LFWAHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (in ETH) on buys and sells of the LFWA token in a single ETH/LFWA Uniswap v4 pool. On buys, the fee is deducted from the input ETH via a beforeSwap delta; on sells, the ETH output fee is taken via an afterSwap delta. Fees are sent to an immutable recipient address.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Collects a 1% swap fee on every swap (0.7% to creator, 0.3% to platform) via delta adjustments in beforeSwap/afterSwap, accumulated in a FeeVault. Liquidity is permanently locked — one-time seeding allowed, but LP removal always reverts. Pools must be registered by the owner before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: Tithe
hook.description: ERC20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that collects ETH taxes on swaps. Charges a flat 10% buy tax on ETH-in swaps and a graduated sell tax (15%/10%/5%) based on how long the seller has held the token (tracked by block number since first buy), forwarding all collected ETH to a hardcoded treasury address.

hook.name: UPetHook
hook.description: A tamagotchi-themed hook that applies a variable swap tax (1% when the pet is healthy, 5% when sick/dead) via afterSwap delta return. Buy taxes burn the paired token; sell taxes accumulate in a treasury. Permissionless skill functions (feed, play, clean) let anyone spend the treasury to restore pet vitals and burn more tokens.

hook.name: FarmHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as a yield farm and liquidity manager, enforcing full-range liquidity added only through the hook. Charges a 1% swap fee routed to a fee recipient, distributes minted reward tokens via a Synthetix-style accumulator with tiered emissions (6.6M/day bootstrap, then 660k/day), and applies a 10% claim tax redistributed to current LPs.

hook.name: OneWayBidHook
hook.description: A one-way bid hook that applies a low dynamic fee (0.3–10%) to swaps selling the accumulated token into the pool, and a high penalizing fee (20–99%) to swaps buying it out, creating a ratchet effect that accumulates the token over time. The owner can adjust fee levels for each direction within fixed bounds.

hook.name: StockLaunchHook
hook.description: A shared factory hook that charges a platform fee (0.5%) and a configurable creator fee on every swap, denominated in the paired asset (stock/ETH). Fees are taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and held as claimable balances for the treasury and pool creator; pool initialization is restricted to a factory contract.

hook.name: VolatilityGuardHookV2
hook.description: A volatility-reactive dynamic fee hook that switches LP fees between a base rate (0.05%) and a panic rate (2.00%) based on tick movement. When price moves beyond a tick threshold within an anchor window, it enters panic mode with elevated fees for 60 seconds.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults using a proprietary bonding curve. It fully manages swap accounting via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, settling tokens by depositing/withdrawing from Euler vaults, and supports configurable per-pool swap expiration timestamps.

hook.name: StockpairHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a token launchpad with permanently locked liquidity after seeding. Charges 0% on buys and a 2% sell fee on exact-input token sells, split 60% to the token creator and 40% to the platform via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: DragonXHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook combining limit orders with a tax mechanism: market sells incur a 10% tax (split between genesis wallets and a buy-and-stake contract), while limit order sells incur a 0.5% tax. Integrates a truncated geometric oracle for price observation.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% (300 bps) tax on every ETH/TOKEN pool swap by taking the tax amount from the pool manager and forwarding it to a hardcoded treasury address. Tax is applied on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta).

hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for an ETH/SATO token pair that intercepts swaps to implement custom buy (token mint) and sell (token burn) mechanics against a price curve. Requires a swapper address encoded in hookData; reverts if absent. Includes sell cooldowns and a self-deprecation mechanism when the supply cap is reached.

hook.name: PoolMetrics
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that enforces a minimum oracle price for swaps yielding token0. When a swap produces a positive token0 amount, it queries a constructor-supplied oracle; if the call fails or the returned price falls below a minimum threshold, the hook returns an invalid selector, reverting the swap. The afterSwapReturnsDelta flag is set but the returned delta is always zero.

hook.name: FewTokenHook
hook.description: Wraps and unwraps "few tokens" (a wrapped ERC20 variant) 1:1 during swaps via beforeSwap, settling deltas directly so the pool holds the wrapped token while users interact with the underlying token. Enforces zero-fee pools containing only the wrapper and underlying currency pair.

hook.name: ElasticHookFarmToken
hook.description: An ERC20 farming token that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook. Buying the token activates staking (increases active stake) and selling deactivates it; rewards denominated in the token itself are minted per-share from a decaying daily emission schedule, settled during beforeSwap and afterSwap callbacks.

hook.name: uTokenHook
hook.description: Deflationary hook for ETH/token pools that burns a configurable percentage (up to 10%) of the token on every swap. Burn is applied in beforeSwap for token-specified swaps and in afterSwap for unspecified token output. Pool initialization and liquidity management are restricted to an immutable authorized address.

hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the NFTX protocol that manages NFT-backed liquidity pools with dynamic LP fees (per-origin fee overrides via OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG), on-chain price oracle observations, and AMM fee collection credited to a configurable beneficiary address.

hook.name: HookenToken
hook.description: An ERC-404 hybrid token that is also its own Uniswap v4 hook. In afterSwap, it takes a 4% fee on exact-output swaps: on sells, 1% goes to a creator royalty and 3% is distributed as ETH dividends to token holders; on buys, the fee accrues to the creator as tokens. Each swap also feeds an on-chain evolution engine that advances NFT life stages based on cumulative volume and triggers mutation events on sharp price moves.

hook.name: DoodStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Dood strategy tokens that collects a swap fee in afterSwap as a positive delta, distributes it 80/20 between two recipients (80% to the DoodStrategy contract and 20% to the team wallet), converts token-denominated fees to ETH via a nested pool swap, and toggles an anti-MEV flag on the strategy token contract during swaps.

hook.name: UmaskHook
hook.description: Charges a 2% swap tax on all trades: buys are taxed in beforeSwap by taking input tokens before the swap executes (via BeforeSwapDelta), and sells are taxed in afterSwap on the ETH output. Collected fees are split between a team wallet and a token reward sink via the normalize() function.

hook.name: ProAdvancedTibuHooklet
hook.description: A concentrated liquidity hook for an ETH/TIBU pool that implements dynamic swap fees with surge protection and volume-based adjustments, auto-rebalancing of the liquidity position, an on-chain oracle with manipulation protection, and owner-controlled fee collection with configurable pause and emergency modes.

hook.name: WeatherHook
hook.description: Tracks a per-pool "weather" score (clamped to [-7, 7]) that increments on buys (ETH→FARMERS) and decrements on sells, then emits an event. Exposes a stageOf() view returning one of five named stages (Drought, Dry, Cloudy, Clear, Bountiful) for use by an off-chain game. Does not affect swap execution.

hook.name: HooksensorHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that reads quorum-verified Bittensor subnet stress scores and TAO price volatility from an on-chain EIP-712 bridge to set the LP fee on every swap (range: 1–5%, default 3% when no live reading). After each swap it emits telemetry events for off-chain oracle scoring.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A buy/sell hook deducting a 4% fee per swap: ETH fees from buys accumulate in a burn pot for buyback-and-burn via the pool; token fees from sells queue for burning. Pool init and liquidity addition are one-time per token; exact-output swaps always revert. Sells can be gated by an admin allowlist (timeBased/hasValue): any address can activate the restriction per token via pitchWC(), after which only deployer-allowlisted addresses can sell, and only the deployer can deactivate it.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled (as a no-op returning the selector). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick and initialized state on-chain.

hook.name: EPOWZeroFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that overrides LP fees to zero for pools containing the EPOW token. Only dynamic-fee pools with EPOW as one of the pool's currencies can be initialized; the hook enforces this on both pool creation and each swap.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Collects a 1.7% fee on buys (ETH) and sells (token), routing buy fees to a burn pot for periodic buyback-and-burn operations. Every 20 swaps with a non-empty burn pot, a buyback is flagged; sells in the same block as a buyback are blocked. Liquidity addition is permanently gated to a single provider, and sell access can be restricted to an admin-controlled allowlist via a publicly-triggerable `timeBased` flag.

hook.name: VirtualLBPStrategyBasic (Aztec)
