hook.description: The dedicated hook for the AZTEC pool, deployed for Aztec's continuous clearing auction in November 2025 and left in place as the pool's hook afterwards.

hook.name: TenorHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/TENOR pool that skims a time-decaying ETH fee on every swap (opening rate decaying to a resting rate after a fixed window from the first swap), routing proceeds directly to a Register contract that funds permissionless buyback-and-burn of the TENOR token.

hook.name: Custom Fee MEV Protection Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TOKEN/ETH and TOKEN/WETH pools that applies configurable directional buy/sell fee overrides and optional anti-MEV protections including blacklisting, one-trade-per-block enforcement, cooldown periods, and maximum sell amount limits.

hook.name: Police Hook
hook.description: Applies asymmetric fees to an ETH/token pool: 0% on buys (ETH→token), 5% on sells (token→ETH). On sells, the ETH fee is routed to the paired token contract via poolManager.take() and token.notifyEthFee(). Also validates that tx.origin holds sufficient token balance before allowing exact-output sell swaps.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token Uniswap v4 liquidity positions. Creators initialize a pool, seed token-only liquidity at launch price, and can later withdraw principal and accrued fees. Hook callbacks (afterAddLiquidity/afterRemoveLiquidity) return zero deltas and do not affect swap execution.

hook.name: Mechanic Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a designated token/WETH pool that gates swaps behind a liquidity bootstrap phase, applies time-decaying WETH-denominated fees on buys and sells via swap delta overrides, tracks epoch market state and all-time-high price candidates, and executes automated token buybacks and burns funded by collected fees.

hook.name: FrongHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for Frong ERC-404 token pools that enforces native-ETH pairing via beforeInitialize and takes a flat basis-point fee (capped at 5%) on every ETH-denominated swap using the BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return mechanisms, routing collected ETH to an owner-configurable fee sink address.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook by TokenWorks that manages fee collection and distribution for NFT strategy ETH/token pools. It enforces ETH/token-only pool initialization via the factory, applies a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95% and decreasing to 10% over blocks), and uses afterSwapReturnsDelta to skim fees and distribute them to the protocol, stakers, and collection owners.

hook.name: QuillV4Hook
hook.description: A buy/sell fee hook that collects 0.7% of each swap into a burn pot: ETH on buys, tokens on sells. Every 20 swaps it triggers a buyback-and-burn using accumulated ETH. Sells can be restricted to an allowlist of addresses when enabled; exact-output swaps always revert.

hook.name: PredicateHook
hook.description: Gates swaps against off-chain Predicate service policies: non-authorized users must supply a signed PredicateMessage in hookData, while owner-managed allowlists of users and LPs can bypass the check. Liquidity additions are restricted to an owner-managed LP allowlist.

hook.name: ONPUNKS Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the oPunks ETH/PUNKS pool that charges a flat 5% ETH fee on every exact-input swap, distributing 80% to NFT holders (via cumulative per-NFT accounting in the NFT contract) and 20% to a platform treasury. Fees are extracted using poolManager.take() with BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta adjustments; no hookData is required.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook that routes exact-input swaps to either the V4 pool or a Juicebox project terminal, choosing whichever venue offers more output, using a 30-minute TWAP oracle for manipulation-resistant comparison. Also maintains a TWAP oracle ring buffer queryable by external contracts such as buyback hooks.

hook.name: DeltaHook
hook.description: A wave-tax hook that applies dynamic buy and sell taxes based on the token's price relative to a running peak price. Taxes range from 3–12% on sells and up to 6% rebates on buys depending on market zone (peak, mid, dip), with a warmup period, per-block and per-tx rebate caps, and zone-transition cooldowns to limit MEV.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: Routes swaps through a hardcoded set of 3 Uniswap v4 pools and 6 V3-compatible pools, sorted on-the-fly by effective sqrtPrice. Handles exactIn and exactOut in both directions, returns a BeforeSwapDelta that fully settles the exchange. Liquidity additions and pool initialization are restricted to a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: NonceV4HookV3
hook.description: Launchpad-controlled hook that gates pool initialization and initial liquidity minting to a trusted launchpad address. Enforces a fixed tick range and opening price, locks principal removal, and disables donations for registered token pools.

hook.name: StocksRewardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a STOCKS/WETH pool that skims a configurable fee on every swap — buys pay a reward fee (default 1%) and sells pay a reward fee (default 3%) plus a dev fee (default 1%). Collected fees are accumulated and periodically harvested into WETH, then distributed to STOCKS holders via a RewardDistributor contract.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM using Euler Finance lending vaults as liquidity sources. On each swap, input tokens are deposited into and output tokens are withdrawn from Euler vaults, with reserves tracked against a configurable invariant curve.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper. Only afterInitialize is active; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops that return their selectors unchanged.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a no-op afterInitialize callback. Pool initialization is triggered externally via initializePools(), which calls an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting initial tick and pool initialization status on-chain.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4's CLAMM with its own bonding curve. In beforeSwap, it routes swap funds through Euler vaults, computes quotes against a configurable curve invariant, and uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fully control swap execution. Direct liquidity provision and donations are blocked.

hook.name: Asterix Hook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that takes a configurable percentage of each swap's unspecified output token: for native ETH outputs the fee is forwarded to a treasury, while for ERC-20 outputs it is burned by sending to a dead address. A separate configurable portion is always forwarded to a main treasury.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A hook for NFTStrategy pools that takes swap fees with a time-decaying buy rate (starting at 99%, decreasing by 100bps per 5 blocks down to a 10% floor) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Collected fees are distributed 80% to the NFT collection, 10% to buy-and-burn PNKSTR, and 10% to a configurable fee address. Exact-output swaps are blocked, and liquidity operations are restricted to the NFTStrategyFactory.

hook.name: TestStrategyHook
hook.description: Skims ETH fees from both buy and sell swaps (default 5% per side, with a surge tier during bootstrap and post-sale cooldown phases) using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, forwarding 100% of fees to an external strategy contract. The strategy contract controls phase transitions and is exempt from fees.

hook.name: AccessControlDynamicFeeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts liquidity provision to an owner-managed allowlist, applies asymmetric directional dynamic LP fees (separate rates for zeroForOne vs oneForZero), enforces configurable sqrtPrice bounds (reverting swaps that push the pool outside [min, max]), and optionally charges an additional hook fee taken from swappers via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism.

hook.name: TribunalHook
hook.description: Imposes a tiered sell tax (8%–0.3% based on the seller's TRIB stake ratio) plus a 1% protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap. Fees are taken from the swap output: sell taxes go to TRIB stakers via the Court contract; protocol fees go to a treasury address.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for a native ETH / token pair that takes a 1% (100 BPS) fee from the token side of each swap, forwarding collected fees to the paired token contract's `distribute()` function. Restricted to a single canonical pool; only the owner can initialize it.

hook.name: UpegHook
hook.description: Calls `start()` on a configured token when the first liquidity is added to the token's pool. Updates an internal random seed on every swap involving that token.

hook.name: UNI20Hook
hook.description: A BRC-20-style inscription protocol layered on Uniswap v4. Users embed DEPLOY, MINT, or TRANSFER operations in swap hookData; MINT and DEPLOY ops extract ETH fees from the swap via BeforeSwapDelta and poolManager.take(), minting ERC-1155 tokens to the swapper's EOA. Swaps without hookData pass through normally.

hook.name: CumHook
hook.description: Dynamic fee hook that charges LP fees proportional to cumulative directional price impact. Fees increase when swaps worsen price imbalance and decrease (at half rate) when swaps reduce it, with configurable time-based decay. Pools must be configured with fee bounds, decay window, and illiquidity scale before trading is permitted.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a fixed tax (default 10%) on exact-input swaps in WETH-paired pools. In beforeSwap, it takes 8% of input to a protocol wallet and 2% to a team wallet, then returns a BeforeSwapDelta so the pool executes on the net post-fee amount. Exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: M0 Tick Range Hook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to a configurable tick range by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity if the position's ticks fall outside the allowed bounds. An authorized manager role can update the tick range.

hook.name: TribunalHook
hook.description: Implements sell-tax and protocol fee mechanics on TRIB/WETH swaps via afterSwap with delta return. On sells (TRIB→WETH), deducts a personal sell tax (up to 8%, reduced by stake percentage via Court contract) plus a 1% protocol fee in WETH, sent to staker rewards and treasury respectively. On buys (WETH→TRIB), deducts a 1% protocol fee in TRIB to treasury.

hook.name: TTTHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for TTT/ETH pools launched by the TenThousandTokens factory. Applies a decaying buy fee (99%→1% over 98 blocks from launch) and a flat 1% sell fee; buy fees are converted to ETH via an internal pool swap and split between a FeeSplitter and a per-token buyback sink in afterSwap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook with only afterInitialize permission. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set up liquidity positions, recording the initial tick and marking the pool as initialized. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure no-op stubs.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages one-sided ETH/token liquidity positions. Token creators initialize a v4 pool, seed token liquidity into a one-sided price range, and can later withdraw the full position (principal plus accrued fees). Swap behavior is entirely unmodified.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. Each pool instance is a delegatecall proxy; swaps deposit input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraw output tokens from another, with amounts governed by a custom concentration curve invariant. Blocks standard concentrated liquidity deposits and donations to protect against non-productive positions.

hook.name: ZKHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a ZK/ETH pool that acts as a transparent pass-through in beforeSwap (no gating, no fee changes). Its main function is to custody the launch LP position; the owner can call removeLiquidity() to decrease liquidity, burn the NFT, and receive the recovered tokens.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that holds afterInitialize permission but the callback is a no-op. Pool setup is performed via the external initializePools() function, which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick. No swap-phase permissions are active.

hook.name: WhitelistHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts swaps to whitelisted addresses. It checks `tx.origin` against an external `ISwapWhitelist` contract in `beforeSwap`, reverting with `SwapperNotWhitelisted` for non-whitelisted callers. No modification to swap execution occurs beyond access control.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A contract for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables initialization of Uniswap v4 pools; initializePools() calls an external liquidity bootstrapper and stores the resulting initial tick. The afterInitialize permission is enabled but the callback is a no-op. All other hook callbacks are also no-ops.

hook.name: TuringHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the TURING protocol that collects a 10% output fee on each swap: burns TURING tokens on buys (ETH→TURING) and distributes ETH fees on sells, splitting 1% to a team wallet and 9% to the token treasury. Calls enterSwap() on the token contract before each swap to set transient authorization.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A hook-based lending AMM where LPs deposit ETH and TOKEN into a full-range Uniswap v4 position and borrowers lock TOKEN collateral to receive ETH at 40% LTV with interest accrual. Includes permissionless liquidations, protocol swap fee skimming via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and sandwich-defense price snapshots that block borrows and swaps in the same block as a liquidation.

hook.name: LaunchTokenV4
hook.description: ERC20 token with an embedded Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable buy and sell taxes (capped at 10% per side, paid in ETH) via BeforeSwap and AfterSwap delta returns. Includes anti-whale limits on wallet size and transaction size during a configurable block window after trading starts.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. Swaps are routed through Euler vault deposits and withdrawals, with reserves maintained according to a custom invariant; the hook returns BeforeSwapDelta to handle all accounting directly, bypassing standard concentrated liquidity.

hook.name: LivingCurveHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a dynamic "weather" system that adjusts LP fees (0.2%–2%) based on rolling buy/sell volume ratios, LP activity, and a health score tracked over 5-minute epochs. Swaps are restricted to the Live phase and gated behind a governance-controlled tradingEnabled flag; liquidity management is restricted to a privileged bootstrapManager.

hook.name: LodeHook
hook.description: LodeHook charges a 1% fee on the ETH leg of every swap, routing 80% into a shared jackpot ("vein") and 20% to the deployer. Each swap simultaneously rolls for a "strike" using block.prevrandao-based randomness — winning half the vein — with Bitcoin-style difficulty retargeting. Winnings are credited to tx.origin via ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and withdrawn via a pull claim function.

hook.name: 3XHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for signed 3x long positions, treasury-backed settlement, fee distribution, and liquidation.

hook.name: PumpFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that applies tiered creator and protocol fees on each swap based on the token's current market cap (derived from the pool's spot price), alongside a dynamic LP fee override. Only factory-registered bonding curve pools can register with this hook; fees accumulate and are distributed to the creator and protocol via a separate skim function.

hook.name: PercentProfitHarvestOnOneHook
hook.description: Applies direction-specific dynamic LP fees (zero for zeroForOne swaps, an immutable rate for oneForZero swaps) and collects an additional owner-configurable hook swap fee (up to 0.01%) from the output token in afterSwap. Accrued fees are held in the hook contract and claimable by the owner.

hook.name: RelicMachine
hook.description: A gacha/lottery machine built as a Uniswap v4 hook. Players swap a payment token into a dedicated pool; beforeSwap intercepts the payment, distributes yield to NFT stockers, and triggers a Chainlink VRF prize draw. Winners receive NFT relics from the pool; stockers earn revenue-share yield and buyout payments.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for Saturn Omnichain that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. Pool bootstrapping is performed via a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract that sets initial tick and liquidity; the hook records initialTick and a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A one-time-launch hook that allows pool initialization and liquidity seeding only once per token. In afterSwap, restricts token sells (non-zeroForOne swaps) to a deployer-controlled allowlist when enabled, while token buys remain unrestricted.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v4
hook.description: A hook for the TokenWorks NFT strategy ecosystem that restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to the NFTStrategyFactory, and collects a configurable swap fee (default 10%, with a 95% initial buy fee) distributed among the collection owner, a protocol fee address, and PNKSTR token holders.

hook.name: RootstakeHook
hook.description: On every exact-input swap, skims a configurable fee (up to 1%) from the input currency as ERC-6909 claims and reduces the swap amount via BeforeSwapDelta. Accrued fees can be redeemed permissionlessly to a configurable yieldStream address via collect().

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a 5% buy and 5% sell tax (500 BPS) on swaps involving a registered taxed-dividend token by using beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns to redirect the tax amount. Tax proceeds are minted to the token contract and recorded via recordTaxFromHook for dividend distribution to token holders.

hook.name: HookControllerV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a tick-observation TWAP oracle (V3-style 144-slot ring buffer) and applies reactive LP fee overrides: 30 bps normally, 300 bps in defensive mode triggered by liquidation cascades. Integrated with a synthetic asset engine to gate new short positions and compute on-chain price data.

hook.name: UnipixelHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook for the Unipixel collaborative pixel canvas. On $uPIXEL token sells, it reads the seller address from hookData and calls the canvas contract to reconcile the seller's pixel allocation to their new token balance. Reconciliation is best-effort via try/catch; swaps always proceed regardless of canvas state.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that uses Euler vault positions as its liquidity layer. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts via a bonding curve, deposits input tokens to an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and verifies the curve invariant — fully replacing the standard Uniswap v4 CLAMM. Reverts on direct liquidity additions and donations to prevent unproductive positions.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization and liquidity additions as one-time events per token. In afterSwap, reverts buy-side swaps (non-zeroForOne) for tx.origin addresses not in a deployer-controlled allowlist when the timeBased flag is set for the token; any address can enable this buy-blocking by calling finiteAddr(). Exhibits honeypot and liquidity-locking mechanics.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain hook with afterInitialize permission (no-op callback). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and records the starting tick.

hook.name: Hook
hook.description:
Prices swaps on an exponential bonding curve (K × (1 -
   e^(-eth/S))) instead of AMM, charging a dual-phase tax — 0.2% with 1 ETH buy 
  cap in Phase 1, 0.5% uncapped in Phase 2. Locked taxes auto-release as rewards
   to staked NFT holders when circulating supply drops below target. Uses 
  beforeSwapReturnDelta for custom delta accounting and blocks all LP additions 
  via beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: UpegHook
hook.description: Stores on-chain SVG data for collectible ERC-20 tokens. Calls start on the configured token when first liquidity is added, and updates a random seed on each swap involving that token.

hook.name: UPeg Hook
hook.description: Calls `start()` on a configured token when the first liquidity is added to that token's pool, and updates an internal random seed on each swap involving the configured token. Both actions are no-ops when no token is configured or for pools not involving the token.

hook.name: ConfigurableKlikHook
hook.description: A configurable per-pool tax hook for ETH-token pools that charges buy and sell taxes (with optional launch-period decay and volume-based surcharge), splits fees between platform, hook creator, token creator, buyback, and holder rewards, and automatically burns tokens via a buyback mechanism funded from collected fees.

hook.name: DarkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $DARK token that applies a 1% buy-side tax: when DARK is the output token of a swap, 1% is taken via afterSwap and forwarded to a CrystalForge contract for distribution to Crystal NFT holders pro-rata by bonded power. Sells are tax-free. The forge address is set once by the deployer and then permanently frozen.

hook.name: CharityHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for charity token launches that charges a 1–10% trading tax (with an anti-snipe surcharge that decays over a configurable window) always in the pool's paired asset, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims per pool, then distributing them among a protocol treasury (30%), a per-launch charity, and the token creator on sweep.

hook.name: Weave
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token (WEAVE) and Uniswap v4 hook for a single WEAVE/native ETH pool. Charges 1% on buys and 2% on sells (WEAVE leg), distributing 100% of collected fees to holders: 70% proportional to WEAVE balance and 30% by connection count in an on-chain doubly linked list ("The Living Weave") of qualifying holders.

hook.name: WethWstGbpHook
hook.description: Oracle-aware dynamic-fee hook for a WETH/wstGBP Uniswap v4 pool that sets LP fees per swap based on directional flow and deviation from a Chainlink-composed fair price (ETH/USD ÷ GBP/USD ÷ wstGBP NAV). A governance-controlled pause degrades pricing to a fixed fallback fee without blocking swaps.

hook.name: ActionFundingHook
hook.description: Captures a percentage fee (up to 20%) from BUX/ETH swaps using beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns, forwarding fees to a lottery action contract and a dev fee splitter. Exact-output swaps are blocked; only processes pools containing the configured BUX token and native ETH.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize permission (the callback is a no-op). Pool initialization and liquidity bootstrapping are performed via a separate `initializePools()` function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set the initial tick and pool positions.

hook.name: ZapHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that taxes each exact-input swap: 2% of ZAP output on buys redirected from the swapper via ERC20 transfer, and 3% of ETH output on sells redirected via pool manager take(), both sent to a randomly selected eligible holder (≥5,000 ZAP held 5 min–24 h) or burned to 0xdead if none exists.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Hook that charges a 1.7% fee on each swap: buy-side fees accumulate in an ETH pot for periodic buyback-and-burn (triggered every 20 swaps), while sell-side token fees are immediately queued for burning. Liquidity addition is permanently restricted to one deposit, and exact-output swaps always revert. When the token's `timeBased` flag is set, sell-side swaps are additionally restricted to an owner-approved allowlist (the `hasValue` mapping), reverting for any seller not on the list.

hook.name: YieldHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom constant-product AMM for a YIELD token, deploying asset reserves into ERC4626 vaults (MetaMorpho) to earn yield. Fully overrides swap execution via beforeSwap with delta returns (FLOOD-style), supporting YIELD/wstETH, YIELD/USDC, and YIELD/USDT pools. YIELD token holders can claim pro-rata vault yield via MasterChef-style accumulators.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain project hook that registers the afterInitialize callback (implemented as a no-op). Exposes an initializePools() function callable by anyone, which delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial pool tick.

hook.name: NeurusHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a configurable ETH-leg tax (up to 5%) on each swap and returns a per-address dynamic LP fee via the Cortex contract. Tax accrues in the hook and is permissionlessly paid out to an immutable recipient; the owner can only lower tax rates, never raise them.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1% swap fee on all trades (0.7% to pool creator, 0.3% to platform via a FeeVault) and permanently locks liquidity by allowing a single LP seed and reverting all removal attempts. Pools must be registered by the owner before accepting swaps or liquidity.

hook.name: CKHook
hook.description: A hook restricted to ETH/CKToken pools that enforces exact-input-only swaps and applies a time-decaying fee to all swaps, both buy and sell directions (starting at 99%, decreasing by 1% per block down to 10%). After each swap, fees are taken from the pool output, swapped to ETH via an internal pool swap, and forwarded to a CKCollector contract. Certain addresses (owner, hook, fee collector) are exempt from fees.

hook.name: ProAdvancedTibuHooklet
hook.description: A dedicated ETH/TIBU Uniswap v4 hooklet that applies dynamic swap fees (with surge protection) in beforeSwap, collects a fee delta from swaps in afterSwap, maintains an on-chain oracle for price manipulation detection, and performs auto-rebalancing of its managed liquidity position.

hook.name: PredicateHook
hook.description: Gates swaps via the Predicate attestation network: callers must supply a signed PredicateMessage in hookData, validated against a configurable policy and a quorum of EigenLayer operators before the swap is permitted. Requires hookData on every swap.

hook.name: SummerPreviewHook
hook.description: A teaser hook that permits pool initialization so indexers can observe the SUMMER token's preview pool, while permanently reverting all liquidity additions to keep the pool at zero liquidity.

hook.name: BCHook
hook.description: Collects a static 10% fee on all swaps in ETH/BC token pools, converting token fees to ETH via an internal nested swap and distributing 90% to a league pool and 10% to a fee address. Liquidity additions are restricted to the BCFactory, and exact-output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: ValoriaHook
hook.description: A GameFi hook for a canonical VLR/WETH pool that charges asymmetric WETH fees (2.5% buys, 5% sells), advances an on-chain world clock and water mechanics based on swap volume, and attributes water to NFT-linked farmer accounts when swaps originate from the trusted ValoriaRouter.

hook.name: EquityPegHook
hook.description: A hook that acts as an equity-pegged market maker, quoting token↔USDC swaps at a price derived from an external equity/stock feed. Liquidity deposits are fully blocked; each swap is settled in full via beforeSwapReturnDelta using locked ERC-6909 inventory seeded at graduation. Swaps revert when the feed is stale or not-ok, or when the pool is frozen by the factory admin.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, verifies the trade against a custom price curve, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully override standard pool accounting. Standard Uniswap concentrated liquidity is intentionally disabled.

hook.name: DripHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that taxes ETH/coin swaps by computing a dynamic ETH fee from the paired coin's quadratic curve (via `quoteTaxFractionBps`). Fees are split between a rotating team address and a coin dividend pool. Trading is gated by the coin's `tradingEnabled()` flag; individual addresses can be blocked or tax-exempted via the coin contract or the hook's own mapping.

hook.name: PKMNBurnHook
hook.description: Burns 0.1% of the output token on every swap by sending it to address(0xdead), using afterSwapReturnsDelta to reduce the swapper's received amount. Tracks cumulative PKMN burned for buys; applies the same burn to ETH received on sells.

hook.name: DeltaHook
hook.description: A wave-tax hook that applies a 6% fee on sells and taxable buys, and pays a 6% ETH rebate on buys when the price is near or above a tracked all-time high or in a deep-dip zone. Collects fees via beforeSwap return delta and pays rebates from an ETH vault in afterSwap.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance vaults. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap: input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault, output tokens are withdrawn, and the custom curve invariant is verified. Standard liquidity addition and donations are blocked by design.

hook.name: Ash Hook
hook.description: AshHook collects a configurable protocol fee (default 5%, max 10%) on ETH/ASH pool swaps: an ETH fee on buys is taken in beforeSwap via returnDelta, and an ETH fee on sells is taken in afterSwap, both forwarded to a treasury address. The owner can pause fee collection and update the fee rate and treasury.

hook.name: AshHook
hook.description: Protocol fee hook for an ASH/ETH pool that captures a configurable 5% trading fee (up to 10%) on both buys and sells, routing collected ETH to a treasury address using beforeSwapReturnsDelta for buy fees and afterSwapReturnsDelta for sell fees.

hook.name: GoalRushHook
hook.description: Uniswap V4 hook for GoalRush ($GOAL), an on-chain World Cup 2026 prediction game. On a player's first qualifying ETH→GOAL buy it mints a soulbound Predictor passport NFT (afterSwap), and on every swap it applies a tier-based dynamic LP-fee discount (beforeSwap) derived from the wallet's on-chain betting record. afterInitialize locks the canonical ETH/GOAL dynamic-fee pool. Permissions: afterInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap (address low 14 bits = 0x10C0).

hook.name: LaunchGuardHook
hook.description: Guards a fixed-configuration ETH/token Uniswap v4 pool. On buy swaps, records output volume as transient buy credit; on sell swaps, triggers fee collection from a designated locker contract. Restricts pool initialization to a specific locker address and enforces a fixed initial sqrt price, fee, and tick spacing.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that creates Uniswap v4 ETH/token pools, restricting initialization to the Ownable token's owner (creator). Manages liquidity add/remove via a creator-gated pending-op pattern; afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity are pass-through callbacks returning ZERO_DELTA.

hook.name: UnbridgedBeacon
hook.description: A hook for the canonical ETH/UNBRIDGED pool that records a rolling keccak commitment of all swaps and liquidity events (the "signal root") at storage slot 0, enabling trustless ZK storage-proof cross-chain state verification. Enforces a harbormaster-gated trading launch with a fee that decays linearly from 25% to 1% over ~300 blocks after opening.

hook.name: Unipump Fee Hook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable fee (50–1000 bps) from the unspecified token of each swap in Unipump pools. Splits fees 60% to the pool creator and 40% to a fixed platform wallet; only factory-registered pools may use this hook.

hook.name: FairTradeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that blocks swaps from addresses on an owner-maintained blocklist; beforeAddLiquidity and beforeRemoveLiquidity are implemented as pass-throughs with no additional logic.

hook.name: TuringHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the TURING protocol. In beforeSwap, calls token.enterSwap() to set transient authorization on the token contract; in afterSwap, collects a 10% ETH fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributes it immediately — 1% to a team wallet and 9% to the token contract as treasury.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A lending AMM hook that manages a full-range ETH/TOKEN LP position as a collateralized borrowing vault. LPs deposit ETH and TOKEN to earn swap fees; borrowers post TOKEN collateral for ETH loans at 40% LTV. Skims a 0.5% protocol fee on each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and blocks swaps in any block where a liquidation occurred.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable fee (up to 5%) on the quote asset of every swap for launch pools, replacing the LP fee. Supports dual-pool "mirror" swaps that route a portion of each trade through a partner pool to minimize price divergence between paired markets.

hook.name: LuckyHook
hook.description: A lottery hook that taxes 5% of all token→ETH sells and accumulates proceeds in an on-chain jackpot. Every 20 sells, a pseudo-random winner is selected from the last 50 buyers and receives the entire jackpot in ETH via poolManager.take().

hook.name: CombustionHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the canonical Combustion/ETH pool that taxes swaps asymmetrically: 1% of Combustion output is burned on buys, and 5% of ETH output funds a nested buyback-and-burn on sells. Supports exact-input swaps only; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: UBeastHook
hook.description: Minimal hook that calls token.start() on the uBEAST token contract when the Uniswap v4 pool is initialized, enabling trading. Contains no swap-time logic; all swap callbacks are unimplemented stubs.

hook.name: ShitGiftHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that enqueues a commit-reveal lottery ticket for qualifying SHIT token buys (≥ 42069 SHIT) on the canonical pool. Tickets are settled 2+ blocks later using blockhash as RNG, giving a 1% chance of receiving 1 ether of a community-deposited art token (ERC-20/ERC-1155). Winners face a 24-hour cooldown; payouts go to tx.origin.

hook.name: GluttonHook
hook.description: A deflationary hook that burns a configurable percentage (burnFeeBps, capped at 10%) of the token (currency1) on every swap. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to intercept token amounts and call burn(), permanently reducing the token supply.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom AMM hook that implements a bonding curve backed by Euler vaults. It handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap by taking input tokens from the PoolManager, depositing them into Euler vault positions, and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's native AMM pricing.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that enforces separate configurable static LP fees for buying vs. selling the Clanker token, collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, and activates an optional MEV-protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that lets token creators initialize a Uniswap v4 ETH/token pool, seed a one-sided (token-only) LP position sized as a percentage of the token's total supply, and later withdraw the full position plus any accrued fees back to the creator. The afterAddLiquidity and afterRemoveLiquidity callbacks return zero deltas and perform no additional logic.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only the afterInitialize permission as a no-op callback. Liquidity bootstrapping is performed via a separate initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to record the initial tick. No swap, liquidity, or donate hook logic is present.

hook.name: PROVER
hook.description: Self-hook ERC20 token (21M hard cap) that seeds its own ETH/PROVER Uniswap v4 pool with 18.9M tokens as single-sided LP. Levies a 1% hook-side fee on ETH-leg swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta. Includes keccak256 proof-of-work mining distributing tokens from a 2.1M reserve.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Collects a 1% swap fee on every trade (0.7% to pool creator, 0.3% to platform) via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, covering exact-input and exact-output swaps in both directions. LP positions are permanently locked after the initial seed add; subsequent liquidity adds and all removes revert.

hook.name: OmniHook
hook.description: Takes a 10 bps fee on every swap's output (or specified input), split among five hardcoded addresses via a pull-payment ledger. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas to capture fees in-unlock; no owner, no admin controls, no hookData required.

hook.name: ArtPegHook
hook.description: A three-phase token launchpad hook: CURVE phase prices via a custom bonding curve with ERC-6909 claims settlement (AMM is NoOp'd); REFUND_WINDOW phase allows sells at the buyer's recorded entry price; AMM phase uses full-range liquidity with 100bps platform+creator fee skimming and optional mechanic fees. Includes anti-snipe (3-block delay + same-tx transient lock), exact-input-only enforcement, and a post-graduation TWAP oracle.

hook.name: ENS Wheel Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the ENSWheel protocol that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the ENSWheel factory, and applies a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, decreasing to 10% over time) distributed between the ENS collection engine (80%) and a configurable team address (20%).

hook.name: CursedLiquidity
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a hardcoded 10% ETH tax on buys (ETH-in exact-input swaps) and sells (ETH-out swaps) of its paired ERC20 token (uniCurs), using beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns to skim the tax and forward it to a fixed treasury address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers afterInitialize permission to validate hook address constraints at deployment. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual pool setup is performed via initializePools(), which delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: PizzaOvenHook
hook.description: Counts swaps on a single approved Uniswap v4 pool and every 100 swaps triggers an external manager contract to collect accrued fees and compound them into the pool's permanent full-range liquidity position, which can only grow over time.

hook.name: TWAPHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom constant-product AMM with a hardcoded virtual reserve and a TWAP-based quadratic tax. Buys or sells that deviate from the on-chain TWAP incur up to 20% tax routed to a hardcoded treasury; external LP is fully blocked and all liquidity is held by the hook.

hook.name: SqueeezeCurveTestHook
hook.description: An ERC-20 token contract that doubles as a Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook; the hook callback emits a SwapObserved event recording the sender and token total supply. Users can mint tokens by paying a fixed ETH fee per unit, up to a maximum mint count of 50,000.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buy/sell burn hook that takes a 1.2% fee on buys (accumulated as ETH for a buyback-and-burn cycle) and a 1.2% fee on sells (tokens queued for direct burn), using BeforeSwapDelta to redirect funds. Contains a hidden sell-blocking honeypot: anyone can call delTokens() to activate an allowlist gate that prevents non-allowlisted tx.origin addresses from selling; only the deployer can disable it.

hook.name: Arc
hook.description: Arc is simultaneously an ERC-20 token and a Uniswap v4 hook bound to a single pool. After each swap it reads the current pool tick and records directional curvature statistics (last tick, direction, cumulative turn sum, swap count) on-chain via events and storage, without modifying swap execution in any way.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds only the afterInitialize permission but performs no logic within that callback. Pool initialization is delegated to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(), which records the initial tick.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In `beforeSwap`, it takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, enforces a configurable curve invariant, and returns a `BeforeSwapDelta` to handle all accounting — bypassing standard Uniswap v4 pool math entirely.

hook.name: PerpLandHook
hook.description: A leveraged-long protocol on a bonding curve that lets users open 2–5x ETH-collateralized long positions. The hook owns all pool liquidity, restricts LP operations to itself, gates trading on a `tradingEnabled` flag, enforces TWAP-based price gates on opens, caps per-block curve advances, and auto-liquidates undercollateralized positions inside `afterSwap`.

hook.name: BlueHook
hook.description: Charges a 3% fee on every swap, taking it from the output token (BLUE on buys, ETH on sells). Fees are split 70% to weighted BLUE token holders (weight = balance × a time-based hold multiplier capped at 2×) and 30% to a restore stream for addresses holding ≥100 BLUE. A permissioned sweepFees function lets the launcher drain all accumulated ETH and BLUE from the contract.

hook.name: DoodStrategyHook
hook.description: A strategy token launch hook that binds to a single ETH/token pool and implements graduated buy fees (starting at 95%, decreasing by 100 bps every 5 blocks, down to a minimum of 10%) with a fixed 10% sell fee. Fees are taken per-swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converted to ETH if needed via a nested pool swap, and distributed 80% to the DoodStrategy contract and 20% to a team wallet.

hook.name: SpecHook
hook.description: A purely observational hook for the SPEC/ETH Uniswap v4 pool that records buy/sell volume, price, drawdown from the high, EWMA volatility, and a net flow ratio (LUSTRE) after each swap, emitting a Surface event used by the Specula NFT collection to re-render on-chain reflections.

hook.name: HystrategyHook
hook.description: Skims a percentage fee from the output of every swap in an ETH/HYSTR pool. Buy-side fees decay from 15% to 10% over blocks after deployment; sell-side fees are a flat 10%. Collected fees are converted to ETH via a nested swap and distributed 80% to treasury and 20% to team using afterSwap delta return.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts using a configurable concentration curve, deposits input tokens into Euler vaults, and withdraws output tokens, returning the full swap delta to override the pool's normal swap execution.

hook.name: BastionHook
hook.description: A gamified Uniswap v4 hook that tracks tick-segment "battles" after each swap, accumulating defense (buy) and pressure (sell) points per segment. Optionally attributes swaps to a named player address when routed through the BastionRouter via hookData.

hook.name: TideHook
hook.description: TideHook is a Uniswap v4 hook that acts as both an ERC-20 token (TIDE) and the sole LP of a single v4 pool. It enforces a degressive launch fee schedule (25%→10%→5% forever) by overriding the dynamic LP fee each swap, distributes swap fees pro-rata to TIDE holders via a vesting mechanism, and features a lottery that awards forfeited unclaimed earnings from sellers to a random holder.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: On-chain smart order router hook that intercepts every swap and reroutes it across up to six embedded Uniswap v3 and v4 pools for best execution. It computes an optimal route via an on-chain RFQ, executes nested swaps, collects a service fee via donate(), and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to replace the native pool's swap. Liquidity addition and pool initialization are restricted to the contract admin.

hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: Hook for a CryptoPunks liquidity strategy that restricts pool initialization and liquidity provision to an authorized vault contract. Charges a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, decreasing by 100 bips per 5 blocks, flooring at 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee, collecting fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributing 80% to the strategy vault and 20% to a fee address. Non-ETH fees are converted to ETH via a nested swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. Includes an external initializePools() function that calls a liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick; all other hook callbacks are pure no-ops.

hook.name: V4LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that applies configurable buy/sell fees (up to 30%) by taking a delta in beforeSwap and routing collected ETH to a marketing wallet. It also auto-sells a token marketing reserve into the pool on a configurable drip schedule, executing nested swaps inside beforeSwap.

hook.name: OVAPHook
hook.description: Binds a single native-ETH/OVAP token pool to a fixed 1% LP fee, restricts pool initialization and liquidity management exclusively to a designated LiquidityManager contract, gates trading behind an owner-controlled boolean flag, and automatically collects and distributes accrued LP fees via the LiquidityManager after each external swap.

hook.name: BracketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a dual-regime AMM for a World Cup bracket protocol: a virtual-reserve bonding curve for early-stage trading, transitioning to a standard v4 pool with protocol fees and elimination taxes (up to 10% on sells of eliminated teams) after graduation.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM for token pairs backed by Euler lending vault positions. The beforeSwap handler fully executes each swap by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, enforcing a custom curve invariant rather than using Uniswap's concentrated-liquidity math.

hook.name: Arrakis Private Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to authorized Arrakis LP modules for private vaults, and applies per-direction dynamic fee overrides on swaps via the Uniswap v4 LP fee override mechanism.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only the afterInitialize permission bit set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. The contract also exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to record an initial tick and set a poolInitialized flag. It does not interfere with swaps, liquidity operations, or donations.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1% fee on every swap (0.7% to pool creator, 0.3% to platform) via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns. Liquidity is permanently locked: only one initial LP add is allowed per pool, and all removals are permanently reverted.

hook.name: BVCC Dynamic Fee Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: An advanced anti-bot Uniswap v4 hook by BlockVenture Chain Capital that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on gas price levels, volatility, and 24-hour pool volume. It applies a repeat-swap penalty to deter bot activity and collects a small hook fee from each swap's output amount.

hook.name: AnonsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that captures the pool key on the first liquidity add and advances an on-chain pseudo-randomness chain on every swap. It also accepts ETH donations from an external forge contract and distributes them to in-range liquidity providers via poolManager.donate().

hook.name: HHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a floor-price defense and tax system for an H/ETH pool. When the AMM spot price falls below the treasury-backed RFV, beforeSwap intercepts exact-input H sells and redeems them at RFV directly from the treasury (burning the H). A 3% swap tax applies on all non-intercepted swaps—burning H on buys and routing ETH to the treasury on sells—with additional bonding and epoch-based staking rebase mechanics.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that sets the afterInitialize permission bit but performs no logic in the callback. Pool initialization and tick recording are handled externally via the `initializePools()` function, which calls the liquidity bootstrapper contract.

hook.name: PercentProfitHarvestOnZeroHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that overrides the LP fee dynamically per swap direction (configurable for zeroForOne, zero for oneForZero) and charges an owner-configurable hook swap fee (up to 0.01%) taken from the output token after each swap. Accrued fees are held by the hook contract and claimable by the owner.

hook.name: BoltFeeHookV3
hook.description: A launch-protection hook that applies a 10% buy/sell tax on swaps of ≥1.5% of supply during the first 6 blocks after pool initialization, diverting taxed tokens or ETH to a treasury. After the window, it permanently triggers internal self-swaps to convert accumulated tokens (≥5M threshold) into ETH forwarded to the treasury on every subsequent user swap.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to one-time-only per token. In afterSwap, blocks non-zeroForOne swaps for addresses not in a deployer-controlled allowlist when a per-token flag is active; that flag can be enabled by any address with no access control.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a custom curve invariant (CurveLib), takes input tokens into Euler vaults via depositAssets, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting directly — bypassing standard v4 concentrated liquidity.

hook.name: RecoilHook
hook.description: A fully custom AMM hook that replaces pool swap logic entirely. Handles ETH↔token swaps via a custom bonding curve (RecoilCurve) with inventory-based pricing, auto-LP provisioning, protocol fees, and recoil/afterburn credit mechanics. Trading must be activated by a designated launch controller.

hook.name: DynoPEGHook
hook.description: Calls `start` on a configured token contract when the first liquidity is added to its pool; updates an internal random seed after each swap involving the token, supporting on-chain NFT/SVG generation.

hook.name: ShitGiftHookV2
hook.description: An afterSwap hook on a configurable SHIT token pool that queues random ShitVerse art (ERC-20) token drops for qualifying buyers. Drop probability is volume-tiered (0.5%–42%), settled via future blockhash RNG with a 2-block delay and a 1-day per-address cooldown. Art tokens can be deposited permissionlessly by anyone holding valid ShitVerse factory tokens; the Ownable2Step owner can withdraw art tokens.

hook.name: Glow
hook.description: ERC-20 token (GLOW) combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that applies a 3% sell tax on ETH output, splitting proceeds 50/50 between burning ETH to the dead address and distributing ETH dividends to non-excluded token holders. Liquidity removal is permanently blocked via an always-reverting beforeRemoveLiquidity. Only the deployer (via tx.origin check) may add liquidity.

hook.name: UniFunToken
hook.description: ERC-404 token/hook combined: afterSwap collects a 4% fee on ETH/UFUN swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta. On buys, the fee accrues to the creator as tokens; on sells, 1% ETH royalty goes to the creator and 3% ETH is distributed as dividends to non-exempt token holders. Whole-token holders receive mintable on-chain pixel NFTs.

hook.name: PoolStartegyHooks
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT collection pools that restricts pool initialization and liquidity to an authorized factory, takes dynamic swap fees (time-decaying buy fee starting at 99% and decreasing per block), distributes fees to a vault and configurable recipients, and blocks exact-output swaps.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults that implements a configurable bonding curve. Overrides swap execution entirely via beforeSwapReturnsDelta: takes input tokens from the pool manager, routes them through Euler vaults, pays out from vault collateral, and enforces a custom curve invariant on reserves.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook with per-pool configurable ETH swap fees and a short-duration antisniper high-fee window at launch. Collected fees are split among a creator wallet, buyback/burn contract, rewards distributor, and platform. LP positions are permanently locked — only an auto-LP seeder can add liquidity, and removal always reverts.

hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: One-time pool initialization and liquidity gate hook that selectively blocks sell-direction swaps (token1→token0) for addresses not in an owner-managed allowlist when a per-token flag is set, while buy-direction swaps always succeed. Anyone can call tokenSet() to activate the sell restriction at any time. Only the deployer's tx.origin is initially allowlisted.

hook.name: NakamotoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that mints NakamotoToken on ETH buys and burns it on sells, fully replacing standard AMM swap math via BeforeSwapDelta. Buys are capped at 5 ETH and disabled after the curve reaches 3,000 ETH implied; sells incur a 5% exit fee (3% retained in treasury, 2% to a fee receiver) and require a 1-block cooldown after the buyer's last buy.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vault positions. In beforeSwap, it computes swap amounts using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults (FundsLib), and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting outside of standard pool math. Native concentrated liquidity, initialization by non-factory callers, and donations are intentionally blocked.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages multiple token pools with configurable swap fees, anti-sniper launch protection, and LP locking. Fees collected in ETH are routed across creator, buyback, auto-LP, rewards, and platform shares via dedicated vault and distributor contracts.

hook.name: VoidHook
hook.description: Deflationary burn hook that intercepts buy swaps (ETH→VOID) in afterSwap, takes 0.1% of the VOID output from the pool manager, and burns it immediately. Sell swaps (VOID→ETH) are passed through without modification.

hook.name: UpngHook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the uPNG token with only afterInitialize active. On pool initialization, calls token.start(address(poolManager)) to bootstrap the associated token. All swap and liquidity callbacks are disabled stubs.

hook.name: ReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a 1.7% reflection fee on swaps. On buys, ETH fees accumulate and are periodically used to buyback the token via a nested POOL_MANAGER.swap() every 20 swaps; on sells, tokens are taken and sent to the token contract for holder distribution. Blocks exact-output swaps, gates sells temporally post-buyback, and has an owner-controlled allowlist that can block sells for non-allowlisted addresses.

hook.name: GweiTaxHook
hook.description: A singleton hook for pools launched by GweiFunLaunchpad that charges a time-decaying ETH swap tax (up to 50% max, monotonically decreasing) on buys and sells. Fees are collected via v4 delta accounting and forwarded to the token's deployer, with a configurable max-buy cap during an initial time window.

hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve routing swaps through paired Euler Finance vaults: on each swap it deposits the input token into one vault and withdraws the output from another, enforcing a custom curve invariant. Liquidity positions are blocked (beforeAddLiquidity reverts); the hook acts as the sole market maker using a MetaProxy delegatecall architecture.

hook.name: UpegHook
hook.description: Calls start() on a configured IStartableToken when the first liquidity is added to its pool. Updates an on-chain pseudo-random seed (using block.timestamp, prevrandao, and block.number) after each swap involving the configured token.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT-backed token pools that charges dynamic buy fees (starting at 99% and decreasing by 100 bps per 5 blocks down to 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Collected ETH fees are distributed 80% to the NFTStrategy collection, 10% to PNKSTR buyback/burn, and 10% to a configurable fee address.

hook.name: ETHLabsDonationHook
hook.description: A hook that skims a fixed 2.49% fee from the token side (currency1) of every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, routing it directly to a hardcoded fee recipient address. Pool initialization and liquidity management are restricted to an authorized address.

hook.name: WsgemBackstopHook
hook.description: Custom-curve backstop hook for the tGBP/wstGBP pool. beforeSwap returns a BeforeSwapDelta that cancels the AMM curve and routes the swap through the wstGBP wrapper's atomic mint/redeem, so buys execute at mintcost() and sells at burncost(). beforeAddLiquidity reverts, so the pool holds no LP liquidity. The hook is ownerless, holds no capital, and charges no fee of its own. Swaps must be settle-first; a conventional swap-then-settle v4 router will revert.

hook.name: SimHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook that prices each swap using simulated price impact and a time-decaying cumulative price imbalance, with JIT liquidity protection and a governance-configurable protocol fee taken via afterSwap hook delta.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps where the absolute amount specified exceeds MAX_TRADE (100e18 units). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return delta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient.

hook.name: FloodHook
hook.description: A custom single-sided AMM hook that acts as a bonding-curve market for the FLOOD token against WETH, USDC, and USDT. It fully overrides swap execution via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, computing prices with a constant-product formula using deposited Aave aTokens as the reserve, and charges a 30 bps base fee plus a gas-priority MEV fee. External LP deposits and donations are blocked.

hook.name: BallisticFeeHookV3
hook.description: Directional quote-currency fee hook with configurable per-pool buy/sell fee rates, a time-decaying opening fee schedule, and a 10 bps platform floor. Fees are split between a per-pool creator allocation vault and a platform treasury collector. The hook bypasses fees for the registered allocation vault address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that registers only the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in the callback. The contract separately exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to coordinate initial liquidity bootstrapping.

hook.name: DuckHookV4
hook.description: Token launch hook for duckfun.family pools that enforces a one-swap-per-block anti-MEV guard and collects a configurable sell fee (1–5%, default 2%) on token sells, accruing the cut to a per-pool creator wallet with optional fee splitting.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An ERC-1967 upgradeable proxy contract whose hook implementation is deployed at a separate address not verified here. Hook permissions include beforeSwap, afterSwap (with delta return), beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeRemoveLiquidity; the underlying logic cannot be analyzed from the proxy source alone.

hook.name: StopeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable toll (default 1%, capped at 3%, can only decrease) on exact-input swaps by withholding a portion of the input currency as an ERC-6909 claim held by the hook. Accrued fees can be permissionlessly collected to a deployer-controlled treasury.

hook.name: LiquinkGraduationHook
hook.description: Graduation hook for a single LIQUINK pool that enforces exact-input-only swaps with a fixed 2% fee: WETH inputs fund a buyback vault, LIQUINK sell inputs are burned. Maintains a 1024-slot ring-buffer for TWAP and blocks pool initialization until the bonding curve has graduated.

hook.name: SentryInkWethXStockHook
hook.description: A token launch hook with a time-decaying fee schedule (exponential half-life decay from startFee to endFee). On each swap, WETH fees are skimmed and distributed among reflection, creator, pot, and sink recipients. Liquidity additions are restricted to a factory-authorized vault. Whitelisted launch participants receive a discounted fee on buys during the launch window.

hook.name: flETHHooks
hook.description: Hook implementing 1:1 ETH/flETH swapping on Uniswap v4; validates pools are ETH/flETH pairs only and fulfills swaps by minting/burning flETH via deposit/withdraw, returning a delta to the pool manager.

hook.name: RektMemeHook
hook.description: A meme token hook for the Rekt protocol that collects a 1% platform fee plus a configurable creator tax on exact-input swaps in registered pools, using afterSwap return deltas to take fees in the output currency and forwarding them to a vault or converting them via a router.

hook.name: QwireHook
hook.description: A tax hook for a single WETH/QWIRE pool that skims a percentage fee on swaps: taxes WETH input in beforeSwap and WETH output (QWIRE-sell direction) in afterSwap, routing collected taxes to a treasury. Swaps are restricted to a canonical router and quoter; liquidity actions are restricted to an lpManager.

hook.name: LiquinkFeeHook
hook.description: A launch-token fee hook that takes a fixed 2% fee in the paired quote asset on both buys and sells. 1.5% is credited to launch-token holders via a reward deposit and 0.5% is minted to an immutable buyback vault. Only exact-input swaps from a designated router are accepted.

hook.name: RektInstantHook
hook.description: A fee hook for Uniswap v4 instant-launch pools that deducts a 1% base fee plus a configurable creator tax from every swap output via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Buys incur a decaying surcharge starting at 50% that halves every minute after launch; the creator is exempt. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; fees accumulate and are swept to a vault.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: ERC1967 upgradeable proxy hook; the actual hook implementation was not available for source analysis. The address bitmask encodes beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions.

hook.name: Current
hook.description: Monitors ETH/ABYSS swap flow on a single pinned pool, maintaining a signed running total of ETH flow per epoch for consumption by a companion Depth contract. After each swap, charges a toll on the unspecified output side: ABYSS tolls are burned via IBurnable, while ETH tolls are split between a fixed operator address and the Depth contract's intake.

hook.name: MemeowGuardHook
hook.description: Per-pool trading guard for memeow v4 launches with dynamic LP fees: anti-snipe window enforcing max-buy caps and optionally decaying snipe tax, surge fee on large buys, EWMA volatility surcharge. Auto-burns a configurable share of buy output to the dead address via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Also hosts trustless on-chain single-tick limit orders that fill atomically when the price crosses their tick.

hook.name: QuotronWethHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Quotron protocol's QUOTRON/WETH pool. Enforces a dynamic LP fee override, gates swaps to a single canonical router, and skims a percentage-based fee on each swap distributed across reflection, LP, and creator sinks. hookData must encode the payer and recipient addresses (64 bytes).

hook.name: BellHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable creator tax (in bps) on the quote currency (currency0) of every swap in pre-registered pools, accruing fees for the pool creator to withdraw via `collect`. Pools must be registered by a designated `pad` address before initialization; the hook enforces this in `beforeInitialize`.

hook.name: RothWethFeeHook
hook.description: A single ROTH/WETH pool hook that collects a fixed 3% WETH fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta (when WETH is the specified token) and AfterSwapDelta (when it is not). Fees are accrued as PoolManager ERC-6909 credits and distributed in equal thirds to a terminal pot, a growth sink, and the creator address on each swap or via a public distribute() call.

hook.name: QuotronStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for w<SYM>/USDG stock pools on Ink that overrides the LP fee to zero and collects a configurable hook fee on the USDG side of each swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap return delta, distributing proceeds between a per-pool LP vault pot and a shared terminal pot used for automated stock buybacks and dividends. Pools must be registered by the factory before initialization.

hook.name: StocksHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for graduated meme stock pools that merges TWAMM long-term order execution with per-swap fee routing. On each swap, a configurable fee is taken from the output token and split: non-CHILL fees go to treasury and protocol; CHILL fees are burned or accumulated and gradually converted to stock via TWAMM orders.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: Launch hook with a time-decaying dynamic fee that distributes swap fees among a creator, treasury, liquidity providers, and token holders (reflections). Reflections are disabled during an initial delay window after launch; accrued LP fees can be compounded into permanently locked full-range liquidity.

hook.name: Current
hook.description: Sits on a single pinned ETH/ABYSS pool, recording a signed running ETH-flow total per epoch in afterSwap and taking a toll on the unspecified side of each swap. ABYSS tolls are burned; ETH tolls are split between a fixed operator address and a depth-contract intake.

hook.name: RektInstantHook
hook.description: Output-currency fee hook for token launches that deducts a 1% base fee plus a configurable creator tax from each swap's output via afterSwap delta return. Buys incur a decaying launch surcharge starting at 50% that halves every minute after a 1-minute hold period; creator buys are exempt via any path.

hook.name: MemeowGuardHook
hook.description: Per-pool trading guard for memeow v4 launches: enforces anti-snipe windows (max ETH buy cap, exact-output refusal) with dynamic LP fees (base + optionally decaying snipe tax + surge fee for large buys + volatility EWMA surcharge), auto-burns a configurable share of buy outputs, and supports on-chain resting limit orders and trailing stop-loss orders filled atomically as price crosses their ticks.

hook.name: QuotronStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Quotron stock/USDG pools on Ink that overrides LP fees to 0% and skims a flat, owner-adjustable fee on the USDG side of each swap. Fees are split between a venue-wide terminal pot (fed to an epoch converter for stock buybacks and terminal dividends) and a per-pool LP vault pot.

hook.name: PublicTransparentUpgradeableProxy
hook.description: A transparent upgradeable proxy from the @yolo/contracts project (by 0xyolodev.eth) that wraps a Uniswap v4 hook implementation. It exposes the implementation address, proxy admin, and implementation version publicly; the actual hook logic resides in the (unverified) implementation contract.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: A time-decaying launch fee hook that charges a high initial swap fee that decays by half-life to a floor rate. Fees are split among a creator recipient, protocol treasury, permanently-locked LP compounding, and token holder reflections, with the distribution changing after a configurable reflection delay post-launch.

hook.name: StocktopusV4FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% fee on every swap (1% to pool creator, 0.5% to protocol) using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta to collect fees in the input currency. Only registered pools (authorized by the factory) can swap, and each swap triggers a graduation check on the pool's associated token.

hook.name: DuckHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that blocks same-block swaps per address (anti-MEV) and collects a configurable fee (1–5%, default 2%) on exact-input token sells, accrued and claimable by pool creators with optional multi-wallet fee splits.

hook.name: FoundryHookInkG2
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook for Ink (INK-G2) that manages token pools with dynamic LP fees based on market cap bands. Applies quote-denominated protocol and creator fees on buys and sells, blocks exact-output sells, and supports pool graduation when accumulated liquidity reaches a configurable threshold.

hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: Allows for ERC721 NFT collections to be fractionalised into ERC20 and then traded on Uniswap V4. This then allows the NFT to be redeemed for 1e18.

hook.name: StopeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable fee (initially 1%, hard-capped at 3%, can only be lowered) on exact-input swaps by taking a portion of the input currency as an ERC-6909 claim on the pool manager. Accrued fees can be permissionlessly collected to a deployer-set treasury address.

hook.name: PrintHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable toll (default 5%) on the gross ETH leg of every swap in a single pinned ETH/token pool. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and are split 20% to a compile-time operator and 80% to a Printer address via a permissionless collect() function.

hook.name: RFATokenHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 1% fee on all ETH/RFAToken pool swaps via afterSwap delta return. On buys the fee is taken in RFAToken and immediately swapped to ETH; on sells the fee is taken in ETH. Both are forwarded to an owner-set fee address. Buy swaps are gated by an owner-controlled boolean flag; sells are always open.

hook.name: LiquinkFeeHook
hook.description: Fee hook for Liquink launch token pools that collects a fixed 2% fee on each swap, splitting it 1.5% to token holders as rewards and 0.5% to a buyback vault. Only the designated Liquink router may initiate swaps; only exact-input swaps are accepted.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for token launches that charges dynamic ETH-denominated fees on both buys (via LP fee override scaled to market cap) and exact-input sells (via afterSwapReturnDelta), accumulating sell fees in the hook for periodic collection by a designated locker. Exact-output sells are unconditionally blocked.

hook.name: LiquinkFeeHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 2% fee (1.5% distributed to launch-token holders, 0.5% sent to an immutable buyback vault) on every exact-input swap via delta returns. Swaps are restricted to a registered router, and pools must be registered through a bound factory contract.

hook.name: InitializerHook
hook.description: InitializerHook (v3.0.0) restricts pool initialization to a single authorized address. Only beforeInitialize is implemented, so the hook takes no part in swaps.

hook.name: LBPStrategy
hook.description: LBPStrategy (v3.1.0) bootstraps a Uniswap v4 pool from a price discovery auction. It creates the auction through a factory, then opens the pool at the auction's clearing price, seeded with the tokens reserved for liquidity plus a scheduled share of the currency raised.

hook.name: RektInstantHook
hook.description: Fee hook for token instant-launches: takes a 1% base fee plus a per-token creator tax from every swap's output, plus a decaying 50% buy surcharge that holds for 1 minute then halves every minute until it drops away. Accumulated fees are swept and split between a platform vault and the token creator after pool graduation.

hook.name: Current
hook.description: A single-pool hook pinned to an ETH/ABYSS pool that records signed net ETH flow per epoch via afterSwap. Charges a toll on the unspecified swap side: ABYSS received is burned, ETH tolls are split between a compile-time operator address and a Depth contract intake.

hook.name: AegisHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an external fee manager, collects additional hook fees on swap input amounts (exact-in in beforeSwap, exact-out in afterSwap), records TWAP oracle observations, dispatches limit-order fills, and periodically reinvests accumulated hook fees as full-range liquidity via AegisEngine.

hook.name: LiquinkGraduationHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single Liquink pool that enforces a fixed 2% fee on exact-input swaps, routing buy-side fees (WETH) to a buyback vault and sell-side fees (tokens) to on-chain burns via the curve contract. Also maintains a 300-second TWAP tick history and restricts pool initialization to post-graduation only.

hook.name: LineaDATHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the LineaDAT ecosystem on Linea that applies a time-decaying buy fee (99% → 10% over 89 minutes) collected via afterSwapReturnsDelta, then distributes fees 80/10/10 among the strategy treasury, LineaDAT token burn (or creator on the self-launch), and the creator. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to the factory, and all trading is blocked until a configurable scheduled launch time.

hook.name: OmniHook
hook.description: A fee-extracting hook that takes 10 bps of each swap's output, split among five hardcoded recipients (STACC 1/8, DEPLOYER 2/8, PART2 2/8, PART1A 1/8, PART1B 2/8+dust). Fees are accumulated in an on-hook ledger and paid out on demand via `claim`/`claimAll`.

hook.name: LineaDATHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the LineaDAT strategy ecosystem on Linea that implements a time-decaying buy fee (99% to 10% over 89 minutes from launch), enforces an optional delayed temporal launch gate, and distributes swap fees 80/10/10 to strategy treasury, LineaDAT burn (or creator on self-launch), and creator.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook singleton that triggers a buyback-and-burn mechanism after every swap: it uses a per-pool "secondary" donation pot to execute a nested market buy of the pool's designated "main" token, delivering proceeds to a configured recipient or burning them. Optionally supports auto-compounding LP programs with fee harvesting and split distribution.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: GlueHook implements a pot-based token buyback mechanism for Uniswap v4. The SHIELD intercepts sell-direction swaps via a beforeSwap delta to fill at market price, while the PUMP uses accumulated secondary token funds to buy back the main token on buy-direction swaps. LP fees are auto-harvested and redirected to refill the pot.

hook.name: HopforgeFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that taxes 1.5% of every swap on registered Hopforge ETH/token pools, splitting fees between a referrer (10%), token creator (20%), token holder reflection pool (30%), and platform treasury (40%) via the ERC6909 mint/burn pattern. Referrers are attributed via tx.origin and optional hookData; harvesting holder rewards is gated by a block delay to prevent flash-loan attacks.

hook.name: EntenDeflationHook
hook.description: A deflationary hook for ENTEN token pools that burns 0.8% (80 bps) of ENTEN on each swap. Exact-input ENTEN sells are taxed in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; exact-input buys and exact-output swaps are taxed in afterSwap. Burns are routed through a controller-managed burner contract.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that absorbs main-token sells at the pool's own execution price (shield) and executes market buys on the pool on incoming buys (pump), delivering purchased tokens to a configurable recipient or burning them. Optionally manages a hook-held LP position with auto-harvested, auto-compounding fee splits.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for static-fee pools that auto-harvests LP fees and executes an automated "pump" after each swap — spending accumulated secondary-token balances to buy the pool's main token — then distributes proceeds (harvest legs, pump buyback, burns) to configured program recipients in a single batched send phase.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: Records a rolling pseudo-random seed per ERC3232 token after each swap in an associated Uniswap v4 pool. The seed is derived via keccak256 over swap parameters and pool state, and is read by ERC3232 tokens during on-chain object generation.

hook.name: PurplXV4FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% fee on every swap (1% to creator, 0.5% to protocol treasury) by intercepting the input currency via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-output) and AfterSwapDelta (exact-input), minting ERC-6909 claims to the hook and treasury. Pools must be registered by a factory before swaps execute; creator fees accumulate as claims and are redeemable on demand.

hook.name: BlockEcho
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's last two digits (mod 100) to be within +/-2 of the current block number's last two digits. Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) amount, routed to a hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
