hook.description: A reusable Uniswap v4 hook that records a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token by observing pool swaps in afterSwap. After each swap, it updates a keccak256 hash chain (incorporating swap params, delta, block number, and prior seed) keyed by the ERC3232 token address, which tokens read during object generation.

hook.name: FuzeV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates swaps to pools registered by the Fuze factory or owner. In beforeSwap, it checks that the pool has an enabled configuration, reverting with "FUZE_POOL_NOT_REGISTERED" if not; otherwise passes through with zero delta and no fee override.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: A hook that enforces signed exchange-rate quotes on each swap. In beforeSwap it validates a cryptographic signature from a designated quoteSigner covering the swap parameters, maximum input, rate, nonce, and expiry. In afterSwap, any output exceeding the quoted rate is absorbed as "eg" tokens minted to the hook and later claimable by authorized accounts.

hook.name: MonadLimitOrder
hook.description: A limit order hook that allows users to place out-of-range liquidity positions at specific ticks. Orders are automatically filled when the pool price crosses the order's tick during afterSwap, with proceeds minted to the hook and claimable by order placers via withdraw.

hook.name: FuzeV4Hook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that gates swaps to pools registered and enabled by the Fuze factory or owner. Each pool must be configured with a creator address, vault, and fee parameters before trading is permitted; swaps on unregistered or disabled pools revert.

hook.name: MonadLimitOrder
hook.description: A limit order hook for Uniswap v4 on Monad, wrapping OpenZeppelin's LimitOrderHook. In afterSwap, it detects crossed ticks and fills outstanding limit orders by removing liquidity and transferring tokens. Adds self-delegatecall wrappers (placeOrderNative, claimFill) to preserve msg.sender context and per-owner registration tracking.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that maintains a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token by hashing swap parameters, deltas, and block context on each swap. Token contracts read this seed via `randomSeed()` to derive pseudo-random values during object generation.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: Uniswap v4 pool initializer implementing the Doppler Multicurve bonding curve mechanism, distributing liquidity across multiple tick-range positions for token launches. Supports locked pools with fee-collecting beneficiaries, dynamic LP fee adjustment via linked Doppler hooks, and pool graduation logic triggered by reaching a target tick.

hook.name: TotalizerTrap
hook.description: Tracks a per-pool cumulative swap volume and reverts any swap whose amount would bring the running total to a multiple of 11. Inherits a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) taken on every swap's output currency via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: UniswapV4ScheduledMulticurveInitializerHook
hook.description: A token launch hook by Whetstone Research that gates pool initialization and liquidity additions exclusively to a designated Initializer contract, and blocks swaps until a per-pool configured start timestamp, enabling scheduled fair-launch token distributions.

hook.name: UniswapV4ScheduledMulticurveInitializerHook
hook.description: A Doppler protocol hook (by Whetstone Research) that gates pool initialization and liquidity additions to an authorized initializer contract, and enforces a configurable start time before which swaps are blocked.

hook.name: FuzeV4Hook
hook.description: Gates swaps by checking that the pool has been registered and enabled via an admin-controlled config. Swaps revert if the pool config is absent or disabled; no fee overrides or token deltas are applied.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swaps to only allow selling the token the pool currently holds more of, based on virtual reserves derived from slot0 price and active liquidity. Past a 10% skew cap the gate inverts so only the rebalancing direction is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return-delta, routed to a fixed recipient address.

hook.name: NoOp
hook.description: Minimal hook that emits a BeforeSwapFired event on every swap and takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on the unspecified (output) currency, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. The fee rate and recipient are compile-time constants that cannot be overridden by derived contracts.

hook.name: TailTwins
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's absolute low byte to be within 16 of the current pool's sqrtPriceX96 low byte; reverts otherwise. Also charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwap return delta, routed to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: ExactInGate
hook.description: Blocks exact-output swaps by reverting when amountSpecified > 0. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address.

hook.name: FuzeV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates swaps to pools registered by the Fuze factory or owner. Swaps revert unless the pool has been configured and enabled with a creator address, vault address, and fee parameters (fuze + creator fee, capped at 5%).

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: A reusable Uniswap v4 hook that maintains a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token by hashing swap parameters (sender, pool key, swap params, deltas, block number) after each swap. The seed is exposed via randomSeed() for token-side use during ERC20 transfers.

hook.name: DynamicFee
hook.description: Adjusts the LP fee dynamically based on tick movement from the previous swap - larger moves increase the fee (up to 5%), smaller moves reduce it (floor 0.05%). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap routed to a fixed hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees computed from a truncated geometric oracle, charges a configurable protocol fee share on each swap by minting ERC6909 claims to a full-range liquidity manager, and automatically reinvests accumulated fees back into the pool.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: A reusable Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook that maintains a rolling keccak256 seed per ERC3232 token, updated after each swap using swap parameters, balance delta, and block context. ERC3232 tokens read this seed for deterministic on-chain randomness during transfers.

hook.name: MonadLimitOrder
hook.description: Implements a limit order mechanism for Uniswap v4 pools. Users place out-of-range single-sided liquidity as limit orders at specific ticks; when a swap causes the pool price to cross those ticks, the hook automatically fills the orders by removing liquidity via afterSwap. Includes an emergency native-currency withdrawal function callable only by the deployer.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: GlueHook intercepts main-token sells by filling them from a funded 'pot' at the pool's own execution price (shield), and after each swap auto-harvests LP fees and executes a capped 'pump' buy of the main token using pot secondary-token reserves.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) plus an optional 7 bps tribute on every swap's unspecified currency when hookData encodes a player address, routing both directly to a fixed treasury. Tracks cumulative per-pool swap volume per player and maintains an on-chain leaderboard of the highest-volume trader (the champion).

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: DynamicFee Hook w/ Oracle Implementation.

hook.name: MonadLimitOrder
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 limit order hook that allows users to place limit orders at specific out-of-range ticks, which are automatically filled when the pool price crosses the target tick. Built on the OpenZeppelin LimitOrderHook base; supports order placement, cancellation, and withdrawal of filled orders.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps where the absolute amount specified exceeds MAX_TRADE (100e18 units). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return delta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient.

hook.name: FuzeV4Hook
hook.description: A swap hook for the Fuze protocol that gates swaps by requiring pools to be registered and enabled via a governance-controlled config. Reverts on unregistered or disabled pools. Pool configs define a creator address, vault address, and fee parameters (fuze + creator fees capped at 5%).

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: A reusable Uniswap v4 hook that records a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token after each swap in a pool containing that token, enabling on-chain randomness for ERC3232 token generation without minting objects itself.

hook.name: AegisHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook that charges additional hook fees on every swap (collected in the input token), auto-reinvests accumulated fees into the pool via an external AegisEngine, integrates an on-chain oracle for TWAP cardinality management, and delegates limit-order processing to a LimitOrderManager.

hook.name: Aegis DFM
hook.description: A dynamic fee market maker hook that uses a truncated geometric oracle to compute base and surge fees, collects a protocol fee share on each swap, and reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: A reusable Uniswap v4 hook that records a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token after each pool swap. In afterSwap, it updates lastSeed[token] using a keccak256 hash of the prior seed, swap parameters, and block data, enabling ERC3232 token contracts to derive randomness for object generation without the hook itself minting anything.

hook.name: FuzeV4Hook
hook.description: Gates swaps to pools that have been registered and enabled by the hook owner or factory. Swaps on unregistered or disabled pools revert; no fee override, delta manipulation, or hookData inspection is performed.

hook.name: LegacyLedger
hook.description: Charges a mandatory 0.10% protocol fee (AeonFee) on every swap's unspecified currency, routing it to a fixed immutable treasury address. Optionally charges an additional 0.05% loyalty tax when hookData encodes a player address, incrementing that player's on-chain loyalty score and tier.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: Records a rolling random seed per ERC3232/Hookd token after each swap involving that token's configured pool. The seed is a keccak256 rolling hash of swap parameters, deltas, block number, and the prior seed. ERC3232-aware tokens call randomSeed() to read entropy for object generation.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buyback-and-burn hook that executes a pump (buyback) after every swap on a configured pool: it spends a secondary-currency pot to buy the pool's designated main token, then delivers it to a recipient (address(0) = burn via Glue Protocol). Additionally supports an optional auto-compounding hook-held LP program with configurable fee-split rules.

hook.name: CoalaOptimismHook
hook.description: Collects a 1% buy and 1% sell tax on swaps in registered pools by intercepting beforeSwap and afterSwap. Tax is taken from the base-asset side of each swap and minted as ERC-6909 claims to the project token address. Pools must be registered by an owner-controlled factory before they can be initialized or traded.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that distributes SuperDCAToken rewards to liquidity providers based on staked amounts, splitting newly minted tokens between the pool and a developer address on each add/remove liquidity event. Applies dynamic LP fee overrides: 0% for allowlisted internal addresses, 1% for all others.

hook.name: PointsHook
hook.description: Awards ERC-20 POINTS tokens to tx.origin after swaps that buy a specific token using TOKEN_A, minting at a 1:10 rate relative to the TOKEN_A amount spent. Points are only awarded for qualifying TOKEN_A pairs and directions.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn Uniswap v4 hook with a singleton donation pot per pool. In beforeSwap, absorbs main→secondary sells at pool execution price from the pot (shield). In afterSwap, executes a size-capped market buy of main on secondary→main swaps (pump), delivering or burning acquired tokens. Optionally hosts an auto-compounding LP position per pool with configurable fee splits.

hook.name: PumHook
hook.description: Gates swaps on creator token / carry token pools, blocking sells of the creator token until a minimum sqrtPrice threshold is reached. The owner can toggle per-token market sellability and update the dynamic LP fee via updateDynamicLPFee.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Adjusts LP fees dynamically across up to 7 configurable tiers using a period-based EMA of stablecoin-side swap volume. After each completed period, fees step up or down based on whether volume exceeded the EMA deadband. Includes a guardian-controlled pause mechanism that forces a fixed fee tier.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Dynamically adjusts LP fees based on swap volume using an exponential moving average, cycling between floor, cash, and extreme fee tiers. Also charges a configurable hook fee collected as an afterSwap delta.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables staking SuperDCA tokens to earn minted rewards distributed to liquidity providers and a developer address on each liquidity add/remove. Applies dynamic swap fees that differ based on whether the swapper is an allowlisted internal address.

hook.name: WETHHook
hook.description: WETHHook turns a v4 pool into an ETH / WETH wrapper. Swaps mint or burn WETH 1:1 against native ETH via the WETH9 contract. Deposits take ETH from the PoolManager and settle the minted WETH back; withdrawals unwrap and return native ETH. Direct liquidity provision is disabled.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements staking and reward distribution for SuperDCA token pools. Users stake SuperDCATokens to direct emissions to specific pools; accrued rewards are minted and split 50/50 between a developer address and the pool (via donation). The hook also applies dynamic LP fees, giving allowlisted "internal" addresses a 0% fee and all others a 1% fee.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for DCA pools that enforces dynamic fees based on user type (internal 0%, keeper 0.10%, external 0.50%), restricts swaps to admin-approved routers via an allowlist, and distributes SuperDCA token rewards 50/50 between LPs (via pool donations) and a developer address during liquidity operations and external swaps.

hook.name: IndexHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for index token pools that enforces an owner-controlled pool allowlist, applies dynamic LP fees with optional custom hook fees, grants zero-fee swaps to index tokens swapping on their own native pools, and tracks index token balances across pools for burn coefficient accounting.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A gauge hook for SuperDCA token pools that enforces pools include the SuperDCA token, applies dynamic LP fees with lower rates for allowlisted internal addresses vs external swappers, and distributes minted SuperDCA token rewards to liquidity providers proportional to staked amounts on each liquidity add/remove event.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A single-pool Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees across three regimes (floor, cash, extreme) based on EMA-smoothed per-period volume analysis. After each swap, it accrues a configurable percentage of LP fees to the hook owner and may update the pool's dynamic fee tier via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a staking and reward distribution system for SuperDCA token pools. Users stake SuperDCATokens to direct rewards to specific pools; on each liquidity event, accrued rewards are minted and split equally between the pool and developer. Applies dynamic fees (0% for allowlisted internal addresses, 1% for all others) on each swap.

hook.name: PointsHook
hook.description: Awards ERC20 points tokens to a user address (encoded in hookData) after swaps that buy a specific token using TOKEN_A (0x7C81Bf9fF2080033286071996bEe7D2E54a54D7C), at a rate of 1 point per 10 TOKEN_A spent. Points are minted by a companion PointsToken ERC20 contract deployed by the hook.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for SuperDCA token pools implementing a three-tier dynamic fee structure (0% internal, 0.10% keeper, 0.50% external), a king-of-the-hill keeper deposit mechanism, and SuperDCA token reward distribution via minting and pool donations triggered on liquidity operations. Only verified router addresses are permitted to execute swaps.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: Oracle hook for zero-fee, full-range Uniswap v4 pools that records TWAP observations and performs automatic backrun swaps to partially reverse large price impacts, returning value to swappers via ERC6909 tokens. Only exactIn swaps are supported; routers must implement IMsgSender or backrun transactions will revert.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that automatically executes backrun swaps to restore price toward its geometric mean after significant price moves, crediting backrun proceeds to the original swapper via ERC6909 tokens. Only supports exactIn swaps on zero-fee, full-range oracle pools.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing staking and reward distribution for pools containing SuperDCA token. Applies dynamic LP fees in beforeSwap — 0% for whitelisted internal addresses and 1% for others — and mints SuperDCA rewards to liquidity providers and a developer address on each liquidity add/remove.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A staking and reward-distribution hook for SuperDCA token pools. Dynamically overrides LP fees (0% for internal addresses, 1% for external) and mints SuperDCA token rewards on add/remove liquidity, split between liquidity providers (via pool donation) and a developer address.

hook.name: GridHook
hook.description: A grid trading hook for Uniswap v4 that manages per-user sets of ranged liquidity positions distributed around the current price. Users or authorized keepers can deploy, rebalance, and close grid order sets. The afterSwap callback records the current tick and swap count and emits a swap observation event, without affecting swap execution.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A hook for Arrakis private vaults that overrides LP fees per swap direction (zeroForOne and oneForZero) based on configuration set by authorized vault executors. Restricts liquidity additions to the Arrakis module registered for each pool.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Juicebox v4 smart-router hook that compares expected output from the Uniswap v4 pool against Juicebox buy/sell paths, routing each swap to whichever delivers more tokens. Also maintains a TWAP/geomean oracle and optionally enforces slippage protection via tagged hookData.

hook.name: EMADynamicFeeHook
hook.description: EMA-based dynamic fee hook for Uniswap V4. Calculates swap fees using Exponential Moving Average of price, with 30-step fee schedule (0.01%-3.00%) and 300-block anti-JIT protection via tx.origin. No owner, no admin functions, fully immutable

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a shield mechanism (absorbs main-to-secondary sells from a funded pot at the pool's own price, returning a BeforeSwapDelta) and a pump mechanism (uses pot funds to buy back the main token on incoming buy swaps via a nested self-call), with optional auto-harvesting and auto-compounding of a hook-held LP position.

hook.name: Findex Hook (Optimism)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Findex protocol that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to whitelisted pools and authorized providers, while managing dynamic LP fees and granting transfer exceptions to limited-account holders after swaps and liquidity events.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements dynamic fee management backed by a truncated geometric oracle, charging protocol fees on swaps (exactIn and exactOut) and auto-reinvesting them as full-range liquidity.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on EWMA-estimated price volatility, scaling fees between a configurable base and max fee. An owner-configurable protocol fee share is recorded from the spread above the base fee and withdrawn to a treasury address.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Adjusts the pool's dynamic LP fee across up to 7 tiers based on an EMA of stablecoin-denominated swap volume, raising fees during high-volume periods and lowering them during lulls. A guardian address can pause the hook, which locks the fee at a configured pause tier until unpaused.

hook.name: StrategicHook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook for Strategic Reserve ETH/token pools that collects swap fees (buy fees decay over time from a starting rate to a floor; sell fees are constant) and distributes them across the reserve contract, a reserve vault, the V1 reserve, V1 vault, and an optional community address. Exact-output swaps are disallowed; buy-direction fees are converted to ETH via a nested pool swap before distribution.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that runs a buyback ("pump") mechanism after every swap: it uses secondary tokens held in a per-pool pot to buy back the pool's main token in the same transaction. It also auto-harvests and optionally auto-compounds LP fees from a hook-held liquidity position.

hook.name: XecoinSwapLimitHook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that enforces emergency pause and per-user daily input limits for exact-input swaps. Requires a trusted router and 32-byte hookData encoding the user address; reverts on exact-output swaps, unrecognized routers, or daily limit exhaustion.

hook.name: Counter
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that increments a per-pool counter on each beforeAddLiquidity call. Swap and remove-liquidity callbacks are present in the source but commented out and inactive.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages SuperDCAToken staking and reward distribution. Rewards are minted proportional to staked amounts and time elapsed, then distributed on liquidity events (50% to pool, 50% to developer). Before swaps, applies a dynamic LP fee override—0% for internal addresses, 1% for external addresses.

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for SuperDCA token pools that enforces a three-tier dynamic fee structure (0% internal, 0.10% keeper, 0.50% external), restricts swaps to an allowlist of verified routers, and distributes SuperDCA token rewards (50% pool donation, 50% developer) before liquidity add/remove operations.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Routes swaps to whichever venue (Uniswap V4 pool or Juicebox project terminal) gives the user more output, using a 30-minute TWAP oracle to compare quotes on-chain. Also maintains an on-chain price oracle compatible with the IGeomeanOracle interface for external TWAP queries.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHookSimple
hook.description: Adjusts LP fees dynamically based on price volatility using an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA). Fee scales between a configurable base (default 0.30%) and max (default 1.00%) based on observed price changes. Tracks cumulative swap volume in afterSwap. Owner can update volatility parameters and per-pool fee bounds.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A permissionless Uniswap v4 hook that runs a per-pool buyback pot: after every swap on a configured pool, it uses a fee-funded balance to buy the pool's designated main asset (in either swap direction), sized by liquidity depth and fees, rate-limited by a time-based spend bucket, and gated on a time-weighted reference tick. Supports an optional auto-compounding LP program with configurable fee splits (burn, refuel, recipient).

hook.name: ATXMV4GlobalHook
hook.description: A liquidity management hook that restricts add/remove liquidity to owner-whitelisted pools and enforces full-range positions. Emits PositionLiquidityChanged events with LP attribution resolved via optional 20-byte hookData or Polygon PositionManager NFT ownership.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Routes exact-input swaps between hardcoded DAI and USDT addresses on Polygon through a Curve StableSwap3 pool, taking tokens from the pool manager and settling output via BeforeSwapDelta. The setFee function has no access control, allowing anyone to modify the swap ratio. A multicall function provides a hardcoded admin address with arbitrary call execution capability.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a buyback-and-burn pot per pool: in beforeSwap, it absorbs sells of a designated 'main' token at the pool's exact execution price via a delta return (shield); in afterSwap, it triggers capped market buys of the main token after each purchase via a nested self-swap (pump). Also manages an optional auto-compounding LP fee program per pool.

hook.name: TELxIncentiveHook
hook.description: Tracks LP positions (add and remove liquidity events) by recording them in an external PositionRegistry for off-chain incentive distribution. Access to liquidity hooks is restricted to an authorized position manager; pool initialization is gated via the registry.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Applies asymmetric swap taxes (5% on buys, 20% on sells) to each swap by computing a fee from the specified amount, routing it to a fixed feeReceiver address via poolManager.take(), and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to account for the extracted amount.

hook.name: Aegis V1.1
hook.description: Dynamic fee hook designed to optimize capital efficiency, protect LP value, and automatically adapt to market volatility.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies volatility-based dynamic fee overrides on each swap, collects a configurable protocol fee share, and reinvests it into a full-range liquidity position via a connected FullRangeLiquidityManager. It also maintains a truncated geometric oracle to track per-block tick movement for automated fee tuning.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 0.2% fee (1/500) on exact-input swaps by withdrawing the fee amount from the pool via `poolManager.take()` and returning a `BeforeSwapDelta`. Exact-output swaps pass through without any fee.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle and executes automatic backrun logic to mitigate price impact — when a swap moves the price beyond a threshold, the hook performs a partial or full inverse swap in the same transaction and credits the original trader with the proceeds as ERC6909 tokens.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A hook that gates custom exact-input swap execution to a single hardcoded tx.origin address, taking a fixed 10^15 token units from the pool manager on matching swaps. A checkOrigin flag (freely settable by anyone—no access control) can block all non-allowlisted swappers from executing.

hook.name: UChildAdministrableERC20
hook.description: An ERC20 token proxy contract (bridged USDC on Polygon), not a Uniswap v4 hook. The contract implements standard ERC20 transfer/mint/burn with blacklisting, pausing, and rescue functionality. Hook permission bits in its address are coincidental — there is no hook logic in the source.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Intercepts exact-input swaps, taking half the specified input amount via ERC-6909 claim tokens, settling them against the pool manager, and transferring the underlying tokens to msg.sender. Includes a togglable tx.origin allowlist (publicly settable, no owner restriction) that restricts swaps to a single hardcoded address when active.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 0.2% (1/500) protocol fee on exact-input swaps by intercepting beforeSwap and extracting the fee from the pool via BeforeSwapDelta. Exact-output swaps pass through without a fee.

hook.name: StableSwap
hook.description: A stable-swap hook that intercepts all swaps in beforeSwap, executing 1:1 token exchanges at a 0.05% fee. Pool liquidity is deposited into Aave v3 to earn yield, with accrued interest partially distributed to swappers. Standard AMM liquidity provision is blocked; LPs must use the hook's custom deposit/withdraw functions.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that aggregates USDC.e/USDC swaps across 12 liquidity pools (11 v4 pools and 1 PancakeSwap v3 pool) by sorting routes by effective sqrtPrice and filling sequentially. It uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to return the aggregated delta, levies a fee via poolManager.donate(), and restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Routes exact-input swaps between DAI and USDT on Polygon through a hardcoded Curve StableSwap3Pool, using beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fulfill the swap output directly. Swap direction is determined by zeroForOne. A configurable fee ratio (default 99.9%) is applied to the input amount before the external swap.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description: Records the pool tick before each swap using transient storage, then invokes an external LimitOrderManager to execute limit orders that crossed the tick range after each swap. Includes role-gated dynamic LP fee management via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Intercepts exact-input swaps from a hardcoded tx.origin address, extracting 1/500 of the input amount and redirecting it to that address via BeforeSwapDelta. An unprotected setCheckOrigin flag, when enabled, blocks all swaps from origins other than the hardcoded address.

hook.name: StableSwap
hook.description: A 1:1 stable swap hook that fully replaces Uniswap's AMM via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, routing pooled liquidity into Aave V3 and executing swaps at a fixed 1:1 ratio. Native liquidity provision is blocked; LPs must use the hook's custom deposit/withdraw functions instead.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Routes exact-input DAI↔USDT swaps through a Curve StableSwap3Pool (`exchange_underlying`) on Polygon via `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`, bypassing Uniswap v4 pool liquidity entirely. Contains a privileged `multicall` allowing a hardcoded admin address to call arbitrary contracts with arbitrary calldata.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Charges a 0.2% fee on exact-input swaps by intercepting in beforeSwap, taking the fee amount from the pool via poolManager.take(), and crediting it to tx.origin before the swap executes.

hook.name: AntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Charges a punitive LP fee at pool launch that decays linearly to a floor rate over a configurable time window, making block-0 sniping unprofitable. Pool creation is restricted to a designated migration module; the hook also maintains a TWAP accumulator read by an external fee ratchet.

hook.name: IndexHook
hook.description: A hook for index token pools that tracks index token reserves across liquidity positions, applies a 0% LP fee override for the index token's own self-swaps, and optionally takes a custom hook fee from swap input. Pool operations are restricted to explicitly allowlisted pools, and liquidity additions enforce a per-pool LP allowlist for manually added pools.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A hook that short-circuits exact-input swaps by taking and settling the input currency directly (bypassing the AMM) and transferring it to the caller, returning a delta that nets the specified amount to zero. Exact-output swaps are passed through to the pool manager unchanged. Includes an ungated tx.origin allowlist toggle controlled by a public setCheckOrigin() function.

hook.name: X402Hook
hook.description: Afterswap hook that charges configurable basis-point fees on the output token, with different rates for a designated facilitator address vs. other callers; fees are transferred directly to a fee recipient via PoolManager.take().

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that conditionally gates swaps by tx.origin: when checkOrigin is set to 1, only transactions originating from a single hardcoded address (0xdA88261bfed59aB29ee3C1407cd0060411812347) are permitted. The checkOrigin flag can be set by any caller with no access control.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that intercepts exact-input swaps from a single hardcoded tx.origin address, returning a BeforeSwapDelta claiming 1/500th of the specified amount (the corresponding take() call is commented out, likely causing settlement failure). An unprotected setCheckOrigin() function can gate all swaps exclusively to that origin address.

hook.name: PoolStartegyHooks
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization and liquidity addition to calls from a PoolStrategyFactory. On each swap, applies a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, declining to 10% over time) and distributes collected fees — optionally converting them to ETH via a nested swap — to a strategy vault, collection owner, and protocol fee address.

hook.name: EMADynamicFeeHook
hook.description: EMA-based dynamic fee hook for Uniswap V4. Calculates swap fees using Exponential Moving Average of price, with 30-step fee schedule (0.01%-3.00%) and 300-block anti-JIT protection via tx.origin. No owner, no admin functions, fully immutable.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Takes a 0.2% fee (1/500) from exact-input swaps by calling poolManager.take() and returning a BeforeSwapDelta; exact-output swaps pass through without fee extraction.

hook.name: FrdmV4LiquidityHook
hook.description: An oracle-based, LP-backed liquidity hook that bypasses the Uniswap v4 AMM curve entirely, executing swaps at FrdmOracle FX rates via BeforeSwapDelta. It manages pool reserves directly using V2-style share accounting, charges a configurable base fee plus per-currency inflation fee, and is UUPS upgradeable behind an ERC1967 proxy.

hook.name: CoalaPolygonHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the COALA token launch platform that collects a 1% buy and sell tax (100 BPS each) on registered pools. Taxes are taken from the base asset side of each swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values, with collected amounts minted to the project token address.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Routes exact-input DAI↔USDT swaps through a hardcoded Curve StableSwap3Pool on Polygon, applying a configurable fee ratio via BeforeSwapDelta. Owner can pause swaps via an `enabled` flag. Contains an owner-only `multicall` that can make arbitrary external calls from the hook contract.

hook.name: X402Hook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that differentiates between facilitator (payment flow) and standard router (trader flow) callers, applying different fee rates and emitting events per swap type. In the current implementation, the returned hook delta is always zero, so no fees are actually deducted from swappers via the delta mechanism.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that extracts a 0.2% fee to itself via BeforeSwapDelta when tx.origin matches a hardcoded address (0xdA88261b...); a publicly-callable setCheckOrigin toggle can enable an allowlist mode that reverts all swaps from non-matching origins.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook singleton implementing a per-pool buyback-and-burn mechanism: a "shield" absorbs sells from a funded donation pot at the pool's own execution price (via beforeSwapReturnsDelta), and a "pump" spends pot secondary tokens to buy back the main token on incoming buys (via a nested self-call swap in afterSwap). Supports optional auto-compounding LP programs with configurable fee splitting.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Intercepts exact-input swaps for a hardcoded privileged origin (0xdA88261bfed59aB29ee3C1407cd0060411812347): takes the full input token from the pool manager and returns a BeforeSwapDelta absorbing the specified amount, bypassing normal pool execution. An optional checkOrigin flag (publicly togglable by any caller) can restrict all swaps exclusively to that privileged address.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements dynamic LP fee management using a base+surge model from a DynamicFeeManager, records price observations via a truncated geometric oracle, and collects a protocol fee share on both exact-in and exact-out swaps, reinvesting proceeds via a FullRangeLiquidityManager.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Routes exact-input swaps between DAI and USDT on Polygon through Curve's StableSwap3Pool (exchange_underlying), returning a BeforeSwapDelta to fulfill the swap outside the v4 pool. Includes an unrestricted setFee/setEnabled (callable by anyone) and a privileged multicall restricted to a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that, after every swap on a configured pool, executes a buyback of the pool's designated "main" token using accumulated secondary tokens (the pump), then delivers or burns the purchased tokens. Also supports auto-compounding LP fee programs that harvest trading fees and re-mint liquidity into hook-held positions.

hook.name: StableSwap
hook.description: A custom stable swap hook implementing a 1:1 AMM with a 0.05% fee, depositing pool liquidity into Aave V3 and distributing accrued interest to swappers as a bonus. Standard liquidity addition is blocked; LPs must use the hook's custom deposit/withdraw functions. Contains privileged emergencyWithdraw and unconstrained multicall backdoors controlled by a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Charges a 0.2% fee (1/500) on exact-input swaps by minting ERC-6909 claim tokens to itself using BeforeSwapDelta; exact-output swaps pass through unchanged with no fee.

hook.name: Counter
hook.description: Applies a 5% buy tax and 20% sell tax on every swap by calling poolManager.take() to extract fees in the input currency and forwarding them directly to an immutable fee receiver address. Uses BeforeSwapDelta to reduce the effective swap amount processed by the pool.

hook.name: TELxIncentiveHook
hook.description: Tracks LP positions and swap events for off-chain reward logic. Requires add/remove liquidity to be sent through a registered position manager; emits swap events with the current tick so off-chain scripts can determine whether LPs were in-range.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description: Executes limit orders by tracking tick movement across swaps: beforeSwap stores the current tick in transient storage, and afterSwap calls an external LimitOrderManager to fill any orders whose tick range was crossed. Includes a role-gated function for updating the pool's dynamic LP fee via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Intercepts exact-input swaps from a specific hardcoded tx.origin address, taking 1% of the specified input amount via BeforeSwapDelta (routing that portion through the hook's own ERC-20 reserves rather than pool liquidity). Includes an origin-based allowlist gate toggled by an unprotected setCheckOrigin function.

hook.name: OmniHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 10 bps fee on every swap output, directing it to a pull-based internal ledger split across five hardcoded recipients (STACC 1/8, DEPLOYER 2/8, PART2 2/8, PART1A 1/8, PART1B 2/8+dust). Recipients call claim() or claimAll() to withdraw their share. No owner, no fee configuration, no access control on swaps.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A hook that intercepts exact-input swaps from a hardcoded tx.origin address, taking half the specified input amount via ERC-6909 claims and transferring the tokens directly to msg.sender rather than routing through pool liquidity. A permissionless `checkOrigin` flag can restrict all other swap origins.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that extracts a 0.2% fee (1/500) via BeforeSwapDelta for swaps from a hardcoded privileged tx.origin address, while allowing all other origins to swap fee-free. A public setCheckOrigin flag can block all non-privileged tx.origin addresses from swapping entirely.

hook.name: TELxIncentiveHook
hook.description: Tracks LP positions in an external PositionRegistry to support off-chain incentive reward calculation; gates pool initialization and liquidity operations to an authorized position manager.

hook.name: BSTDirectionalWhitelistHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a BST/USDT pool that enforces directional access control: buying (USDT→BST) is unrestricted for all users, while selling (BST→USDT) is gated to an owner-managed allowlist of authorized sellers. Liquidity additions and removals are also restricted to addresses with the LIQUIDITY_MANAGER role.

hook.name: StableSwap
hook.description: Stablecoin swap hook that routes pool liquidity through Aave V3 to earn yield, executing 1:1 swaps with a 0.05% fee. Accrued Aave interest is partially distributed to swappers. Native Uniswap LP is disabled in favor of custom deposit/withdraw functions managed by the hook.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as an on-chain DEX aggregator for a USDC.e/USDC pair on Polygon. On beforeSwap, it queries prices across up to 11 v4 pools and 1 v3 pool, routes the swap through the optimal path, charges a protocol fee via donate, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully override the standard pool fill. Liquidity addition and pool initialization are restricted to an admin address.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: On exact-input swaps where tx.origin matches a hardcoded address, takes 1/500th (0.2%) of the input amount from the pool via BeforeSwapDelta without settling. Includes a publicly-toggleable checkOrigin flag that, when set to 1, reverts swaps from any other origin.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that functions as an on-chain DEX aggregator, routing swaps across up to 12 hardcoded V3/V4 pools embedded in its bytecode using a price-sorted RFQ mechanism, and collecting a service fee on each swap via donate. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to a single admin address checked via tx.origin.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook by Uniswap Labs that deploys multi-range concentrated LP positions before each swap and removes them after, using ERC4626 vaults to rehypothecate idle capital between swaps. Pool fees are static (set at creation via PoolKey.fee). Owner can configure bucket weights per pool and pause swaps via a liveness flag.

hook.name: PolHook
hook.description: Charges a 0.2% fee on each swap by calling poolManager.take() to collect the fee amount from the pool into the hook contract, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to offset the swap amount. No access control and no hookData usage.

hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A DEX aggregator hook that intercepts swaps and re-routes them through the optimal combination of Uniswap V4 and V3 pools by sorting available liquidity sources by effective price. It uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to capture the full swap delta, charges a service fee via poolManager.donate(), and restricts liquidity addition and pool initialization to a single hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that charges a fixed per-pool ETH-side fee on every swap and distributes proceeds instantly across configurable modes: direct recipient payouts, buyback-and-burn, staking rewards (robin mode), lottery draws, or liquidity provisioning. Exact-output sells are unsupported.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that intercepts swaps to collect ETH-denominated fees, instantly distributing them to configurable recipients, a platform wallet, and a buyback reserve. Supports multiple distribution modes: direct recipient payouts, token buyback-and-burn, staking rewards (robin mode), lottery draws, and protocol-owned liquidity minting.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects fees on every ETH/token swap, splits them between the token creator and platform treasury, distributes referral cuts from the platform share through a tiered referral chain, and records ETH volume per token for graduation tracking.

hook.name: VolatileFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects dynamic fees (1–6.6% BPS, scaling with recent tick-move volatility) directly to a per-pool fee recipient via poolManager.take() on all ETH swap legs, bypassing LP fee distribution entirely. Only native ETH pools are supported.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A launch-platform hook for tokenized stocks that charges a fixed per-pool swap fee (0–5%, set at launch), splits it 80/5/15 between creator, bid-wall, and platform, and automatically places a single-sided quote-token liquidity range one tick spacing below spot using the wall share. Liquidity additions are restricted to the factory and the hook itself until the pool graduates past a configurable price threshold.

hook.name: CreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges fixed directional buy and sell fees in beforeSwap or afterSwap depending on trade shape, collecting a protocol fee, and paying the remainder to up to five creator-nominated recipients.

hook.name: CashCatQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all CashCat launchpad pools that charges a configurable swap fee (up to 10%) always in the pool's quote currency via v4 return-delta accounting. Fees are taken in beforeSwap for specified-quote swaps and afterSwap for unspecified-quote swaps, minted as ERC-6909 claims to a locker. Pool creation is gated to the CashCat launchpad; afterSwap also records a cosmetic graduation milestone based on post-swap price.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. It has no swap-time logic; all hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain project hook that registers `afterInitialize` as a no-op callback. Initial liquidity setup is performed via a separate `initializePools()` function that invokes an `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract and records the initial tick. Has no swap-time logic — swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A 1% fee hook for token launches that intercepts ETH→token buys (in beforeSwap) and token→ETH sells (in afterSwap) to collect fees from the ETH side via return deltas, forwarding proceeds to a factory contract that splits revenue between the token creator and platform.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook with anti-snipe fee protection: charges very high fees (~99%) at pool open that decay to a configured rate (1–3%) over 20 seconds, applied on buy and sell swaps. Fees are split among a fee recipient, platform, and optional token holder distributor. Liquidity addition is locked to the hook itself.

hook.name: VampHook
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered tax hook for Vamp Pad ETH/token pools. On each swap it collects a fee (up to 1.25%) scaled by the token's current market cap, then distributes platform and creator shares to configurable treasury addresses.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Shared multi-pool hook for Robinhood Chain Launchboy pools that implements a per-pool linearly decaying LP fee (up to 30%) to deter snipers at launch. The fee decays from a configured start rate to an end rate over a set duration. Pool initialization is restricted to the contract owner (server) to prevent front-running.

hook.name: VladBrianV1127CouplingHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that implements a coupling mechanism between two meme tokens (VLAD and BRIAN): when a user buys one token in an entry pool (against SPY), the hook automatically executes a nested swap in a VLAD/BRIAN duel pool, selling the opponent token proportional to the amount purchased.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A single shared launchpad hook that gates pool creation and liquidity management to the factory, permanently locks single-sided token liquidity, and charges time-decaying anti-snipe fees on swaps distributed across creator, platform, and referrer fee components via ERC-6909 claims.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH-only fee on every swap through registered pools using return-delta accounting (beforeSwapReturnsDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta). Accrued WETH fees are split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury at configurable proportions, claimable permissionlessly.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable fee (up to 5%, set at deployment) on the ETH side of swaps in native-ETH launchpad pools. Fees are collected in beforeSwap (ETH-specified trades) and afterSwap (token-specified trades) via delta returns, then forwarded to a LaunchFeeSplitter contract that attributes them to each token's creator.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable creator tax (up to 2% in basis points) on swap quote-token amounts for factory-registered token launches, crediting accumulated taxes to the creator's claimable balance. Also prevents liquidity removal on registered pools until officially unlocked.

hook.name: PrismHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Prism token launchpad that applies buy and sell fees on registered launch tokens. Fees are deducted via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-input) or AfterSwapDelta (exact-output) and accumulated as claimable balances for token creators.

hook.name: FlowstateC1Hook
hook.description: A buy-only custom-curve hook that fully overrides Uniswap V4 AMM pricing by routing swaps to an external Flowstate C1 market via BeforeSwapReturnsDelta. Sell-direction swaps always revert; spread margin accrues on the hook for owner sweep. Pairs must be registered by the owner before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: WarzyHook
hook.description: Singleton launchpad hook for the Warzy platform on Robinhood Chain. Takes a 1% ETH fee on every swap (80% to the token's dev, 20% to treasury or parent-token holders via FeeDistributor). Enforces an anti-snipe warmup window after launch, locks liquidity so only the factory can add and nobody can remove, and automatically graduates tokens when their ETH FDV crosses a configurable threshold (USD-pegged via an on-chain oracle pool).

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that runs an automated buyback-and-burn ("pump") after every swap on pools that opt in by funding a secondary-token pot. It also supports a single auto-compounding LP fee program per pool, with configurable compound, buyback, and burn splits harvested inside every swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; liquidity is bootstrapped separately via initializePools(), which delegates to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: PrismStocksHook
hook.description: A DN404-style ERC20/NFT hybrid token acting as a Uniswap v4 hook. Swap fees are collected from the hook's own liquidity position and forwarded to PrismStockVault, where a keeper converts them into SPY stock token dividends distributed to NFT holders proportional to their token balance.

hook.name: BurnOnSwapHook
hook.description: Burns a configurable percentage (up to 3%) of specified swap token amounts per pool by taking tokens from the pool manager and calling burn() on them. The burn token and fee rate are configured per pool by the owner.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops; the only active permission is afterInitialize.

hook.name: GreenlineBuybackHook
hook.description: After each swap, skims a configurable buyback share from the unspecified currency: token-side skims are burned immediately, quote-side skims accrue for a permissionless executeBuyback() that swaps quote back into the token and burns the proceeds. Pool initialization is gated to factory-registered pools only via beforeInitialize.

hook.name: ViraltokHook
hook.description: Bonding-curve fair-launch hook (pump.fun-style x·y=k) that serves buys and sells via BeforeSwapDelta during the launch phase, auto-graduates to a standard AMM by seeding single-sided liquidity at the final curve price, and applies a constant 1% LP fee override post-graduation with 50/50 creator/protocol fee splitting.

hook.name: ShiftyFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-adjusted fee hook for ETH/token pools that charges 1–7% ETH fees on buys (beforeSwap) and sells (afterSwap), scaling with the previous swap's tick movement; fees are pushed directly to a per-pool fee recipient with no claim step. Only exact-input swaps are supported; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: WickHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the WICK token that captures a fee on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, splitting proceeds between a prize pot, team wallet, and staking distributor. A configurable launch guard in beforeSwap restricts WICK purchases to an allowlist until deactivated by the owner.

hook.name: MemeStonkCanonicalPoolHook
hook.description: Enforces exact-price pool initialization and temporary add-liquidity exclusivity for canonical meme-stonk pools. Only the immutable factory can initialize pools at pre-registered prices; liquidity additions are restricted to a designated controller address until a block-based exclusivity period expires.

hook.name: LifecycleHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces a factory-gated pool lifecycle with a trading cutoff. Pools must be pre-registered by a designated factory with a cutoff timestamp in the same transaction as initialization; beforeSwap reverts once block.timestamp reaches the cutoff, effectively closing trading at a predetermined time.

hook.name: LBPStrategy
hook.description: LBPStrategy (v3.1.1) bootstraps a Uniswap v4 pool from a price discovery auction. It creates the auction through a factory, then opens the pool at the auction's clearing price, seeded with the tokens reserved for liquidity plus a scheduled share of the currency raised.

hook.name: HookenAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe hook for Hooken launch pools that applies a 50% tax on non-whitelisted buys within a 4-second launch window (routed to protocol treasury), and a cyclic dynamic tax on all other buys and sells (routed to the token creator), always collected in native ETH via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta returns.

hook.name: FactionGameHook
hook.description: A game-specific Uniswap v4 hook for faction pools that enforces vault-only pool initialization and liquidity management, a nighttime trading curfew, and a decaying anti-snipe WETH tax (up to 99%) on public swaps during the post-night window, with an optional tick-move price-impact circuit breaker.

hook.name: SharedStockFeeHook
hook.description: A shared registry hook for stock-paired pools that collects swap fees denominated in a "reward stock" token, minting ERC-6909 claims to each pool's designated distributor. Fee rates and distributor address are set once at pool registration and are permanently immutable thereafter.

hook.name: IronHook2
hook.description: Takes a tiered ETH tithe (60–100 bps, graduated by cumulative ETH banked) from every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, accumulating proceeds per-pool. Once the pot exceeds 0.02 ETH, anyone can call bank() to distribute it 60/15/15/10 across a floor vault, launch creator, FolioBurner, and protocol treasury, with a 1% bounty to the caller.

hook.name: FablesRampETH
hook.description: Singleton dynamic-fee hook for native ETH pools on Robinhood Chain. Charges a per-pool flat fee with a TTL-bounded admin override (poke) clamped between a configured floor and cap. Sweeps native ETH fee revenue to an ERC20-only epoch distributor by wrapping into WETH; ERC20 pools also supported.

hook.name: HoodsHook
hook.description: Singleton ETH-fee hook for hoods.meme token pools. Takes a market-cap-tiered ETH fee on each swap (max 1% of ETH moved), accruing fees separately for a treasury and a per-token creator splitter; fees are pulled later so no external call occurs in the swap path. Sell-exactOut swaps are rejected. Fee schedule is factory-snapshotted at pool launch and immutable thereafter.

hook.name: SoloHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for SoloFactory-launched token pools that collects ETH-denominated swap fees via delta returns (base fee plus per-token creator buy/sell tax), with time-decaying anti-snipe surcharges in early blocks and deployer-dump surcharges during a configurable window. All fees accrue 100% to the token creator and are claimable as ETH.

hook.name: BangFeeHook
hook.description: A tax hook for an ETH/index-token pool that charges a fixed fee (up to 4%) on every swap by diverting ETH to a treasury address. ETH-specified swaps are taxed in beforeSwap via a BeforeSwapDelta; index-token-specified swaps are taxed in afterSwap via an AfterSwapDelta.

hook.name: PonzuHook
hook.description: Applies a time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

hook.name: MemestonkFeeHook
hook.description: ETH-side swap fee hook for memestonk/ETH pools that charges a time-decaying launch fee (10% at open, decaying linearly to 3% over 10 minutes), gates trading via a factory/LPSeeder-controlled openTrading call, and maintains a TWAP-lite on-chain oracle updated on every swap.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a token launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade, routing them between the token creator and a treasury (with configurable buyback-and-burn). Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in early blocks post-launch and a time-limited surcharge on sells from the original deployer address.

hook.name: VaultGate
hook.description: A trading gate hook that blocks swaps until the designated engine contract enables trading. Only the immutable engine address may swap while trading is closed; once open, swaps proceed normally. The hook has no state or owner and cannot re-close trading.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch's full-lifecycle memecoin hook that manages token creation, fair launch periods, and ongoing trading. Implements an internal swap pool to fill orders from accumulated fees before hitting the Uniswap pool, fee distribution with optional referrer support, a bid wall mechanism, and temporal access control that gates swaps until a scheduled launch timestamp.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for a TIPOFF/ETH pool that charges a flat 5% fee on both buys and sells, always collected in ETH (currency0), using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to skim the fee and forward it to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: Upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta enabled. The implementation contract (0x05e2C457bf002652998231706D6719310FdFc4cA) is not source-verified, so full behavioral analysis was not possible.

hook.name: Lev7FeeHookV3
hook.description: Charges a 3% fee on buy-side swaps (one-for-zero) in pools where currency1 matches feeToken, routing fees to a configurable treasury. Also maintains an on-chain tick oracle and accrues per-epoch buy credits.

hook.name: TelpadHook
hook.description: Takes a 1% fee on the unspecified side of every swap, split 50/50 between the pool creator and a platform wallet. Pool creators are registered at initialization via a factory contract, and accrued fees can be claimed by anyone to the designated recipients.

hook.name: PonsD09EHook
hook.description: A fee-and-burn hook for PONS token/ETH pools. Takes a configurable ETH fee (default 2%) on both buy and sell swaps, splitting proceeds between the token creator (90%) and a vault for $D09E buybacks (10%). On sells, also burns a configurable portion of the sold token from a hook-maintained burn reserve funded separately from swap flow.

hook.name: HookuidityHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for creator token launches that charges a 2% fee on ETH buys (injected as pool liquidity via poolManager.donate()) and a 2% fee on ETH sells (directed to a per-pool creator reward vault), with a 0.10% launcher platform share deducted from each. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swaps can execute.

hook.name: FablesRamp
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that charges a configurable flat fee per pool with an optional directional premium and a TTL-bounded keeper override. Requires dynamic-fee pool initialization; pools must be pre-configured with floor, flat, and cap fee bounds before creation.

hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: Bonding curve hook for an ETH/SATO pool that replaces AMM liquidity entirely using BeforeSwapDelta. Buys mint SATO via a forward curve; sells burn SATO via an inverse curve paid from ETH reserves held by the hook. A 0.3% fee is skimmed on all trades. Requires hookData encoding the swapper address; a per-user block-number cooldown applies between buys and sells.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A managed token launch platform hook that collects configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode) via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Pool initialization is gated to a designated launch manager, only one liquidity position is permitted per pool, and liquidity removal is permanently disabled.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $REEFGUARD token that charges a 5% fee on both buys and sells, always collected in ETH (currency0), and forwarded to an immutable fee recipient address using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns.

hook.name: LBPStrategy
hook.description: LBPStrategy (v3.0.0) bootstraps a Uniswap v4 pool from a price discovery auction. It creates the auction through a factory, then opens the pool at the auction's clearing price, seeded with the tokens reserved for liquidity plus a scheduled share of the currency raised.

hook.name: QuiverHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Quiver protocol that sets asymmetric LP fees (quiverFee vs pairedFee) based on swap direction via updateDynamicLPFee, and collects protocol fees on the non-Quiver token side of each swap using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Includes optional MEV protection via an external module active for 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks (swap, liquidity, donate) are no-op stubs that simply return their selectors.

hook.name: RaffleTaxHookEth
hook.description: Collects a fixed ETH tax (feeBps, capped at 5%) on every swap in native-ETH pools, redirecting the fee into the contract as a raffle prize pot. Taxes are taken via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta across all four swap shapes; the fee rate is immutable after deployment, and the operator can withdraw accrued ETH via collect().

hook.name: SessionHook
hook.description: Restricts swaps to the regular US stock market session (9:30–16:00 New York time, Monday through Friday, with DST support), reverting with MarketClosed outside those hours. Pool initialization is gated to an authorized markets address and requires zero LP fee.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that captures the initial tick after pool initialization. Only the afterInitialize flag is active; the callback itself is a no-op returning only the selector. Pool seeding is handled externally via a LiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: MikoFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 400 bps protocol fee on the native ETH side of all native/ERC-20 pool swaps, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas and sent to an immutable fee treasury. During a configurable launch window (default 720 seconds), an exponentially-decaying anti-sniping surcharge (default starting at 6000 bps, tau=158s) and per-swap/per-wallet token amount caps are enforced.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for native ETH/token pools launched via V4FunLaunch. Charges 1–7% ETH fees on buys (in beforeSwap) and sells (in afterSwap), with the fee scaling linearly based on tick movement from the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; only the bound factory may register pools.

hook.name: FarmIndexFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for FarmIndex pools that charges ETH fees on every swap. Buy fees are deducted from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees are deducted from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee rate scales between a pool-configured base and max (both within 1–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, and is forwarded directly to a per-pool fee recipient.

hook.name: ZnsHookStaticFee
hook.description: A token-launch hook for the ZNS Launchpad (forked from Clanker v4) that sets directional static LP fees per pool at initialization, dynamically updates the LP fee on each swap based on swap direction (clanker vs. paired token), routes fee collection to a factory address, and optionally activates an anti-MEV module for up to 2 minutes post-launch.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy contract that delegates all calls to an implementation address. The hook implements beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeInitialize, with both beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta enabled, indicating it modifies swap deltas. The actual hook logic resides in the unresolved implementation contract.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A fixed-rate fee hook for a $TIPOFF/ETH pool that collects a 5% fee on both buys and sells, always denominated in ETH (currency0). Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address via return deltas split between beforeSwap (when ETH is the specified currency) and afterSwap (when ETH is the unspecified currency).

hook.name: HelixHook
hook.description: Collects fees from swaps on factory-registered tokens, applying a combined hook fee and buy tax on purchases. Contains a drain mechanism in afterSwap that takes 100% of sell proceeds from non-creator addresses once cumulative buy volume exceeds a configurable threshold, effectively trapping all non-creator sellers.

hook.name: CBLaunchV4Hook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to a single immutable launcher address, ensuring a launch pool remains closed to outside liquidity providers. Swap behavior is completely unaffected — only `beforeAddLiquidity` is active, reverting any deposit from an address other than the launcher.

hook.name: RhmiFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/RHMI pools that charges a fixed ETH trade tax (immutable, capped at 4%) on every swap, routing fees directly to a treasury address. Fee collection is split across beforeSwap (ETH-specified swaps) and afterSwap (ETH-unspecified swaps) using return deltas; no owner or admin controls exist.

hook.name: OpenCatUsdgFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-aware fee hook for USDG-quoted Uniswap v4 pools that charges a dynamic fee (1–5%) on exact-input swaps only. Buy fees are taken from USDG input in beforeSwap; sell fees from USDG output in afterSwap. The fee ramps between a configurable base and maximum based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool recipient address.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for ETH/token pools on the v4.fun launcher. Charges fees in native ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling between configurable base and max rates (1%–7%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Exact-output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: Graduation gate hook that restricts pool initialization to a designated migrator and blocks all swaps on a per-pool basis until the pool is explicitly opened via openPool() after graduation liquidity has been locked.

hook.name: SnowLaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated token pools in Snow Protocol. Collects buy and sell taxes (1% protocol fee plus a configurable per-token rate) by taking Q-token amounts via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, routing proceeds to creator fees, SNOW buyback-burn, dividends, and auto-added tax liquidity. Only factory-registered curves may initialize pools; liquidity is permanently locked.

hook.name: GoPumpMeFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for goPumpMe campaign pools that charges a flat WETH-denominated app fee on every swap, split between the campaign's cause recipient and the goPumpMe treasury, while overriding LP fees to zero to ensure fees are always taken in WETH only.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared multi-pool hook that applies a linearly decaying dynamic LP fee (from a configurable high start rate to a lower end rate over a set time window) to deter sniping at token launch. Each pool gets its own fee schedule keyed by pool ID, seeded at initialization and updated per-swap by the owner-configured schedule.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% swap tax on launchpad pools, always denominated in the pool's quote token, split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and the pool token creator. Only the registered strategy contract can initialize pools with this hook; the tax is taken via BeforeSwapDelta or AfterSwapDelta depending on which swap leg is the quote currency.

hook.name: FlashhoodFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for FlashhoodLaunch pools that charges ETH fees on buys (input) in beforeSwap and sells (output) in afterSwap, with fees scaling between 1–5% based on the previous swap's tick movement.

hook.name: DegenHoodV4HookV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the DegenHood platform that collects WETH fees on token swaps, splitting proceeds between a per-pool beneficiary and a protocol treasury, while managing a dynamic LP fee set at initialization and refreshed on every swap.

hook.name: MarketHoursFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized equity pools that charges a dynamic LP fee: a configurable base fee plus a time-varying surcharge computed from US market hours (regular session Mon–Fri 09:30–16:00 ET, extended hours, or closed). The surcharge widens when the reference market is shut, compensating LPs for stale-price risk. Implemented via LP fee override in beforeSwap; the contract holds no funds and has no owner or governance.

hook.name: AuraHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for factory-launched tokens that charges buyers a configurable fee plus buy tax, and can drain 100% of the sell-side quote amount from non-creator sellers once a buy-volume threshold is reached, directing collected fees to the token creator.

hook.name: SockLaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that prices swaps on a shared virtual constant-product curve denominated in basket units (a weighted index of stock assets). Pools hold no native liquidity; all swaps are fully consumed and settled via ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager. Trading is gated by a market clock and Chainlink price freshness checks.

hook.name: QuiverV4Hook
hook.description: Shared policy hook for Quiver V4 pools that gates token purchases via EIP-712 signed vouchers with per-buyer cumulative allocation limits. Restricts liquidity addition to the designated launcher during the bootstrap phase, and blocks all buys via access-controlled pools unless the buyer holds a valid signed voucher.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized-stock token launches. Each pool's flat swap fee (0–5%) is set at launch and split among the creator, a bid-wall budget, and a platform treasury. The bid wall is a quote-token single-sided liquidity range placed one tick spacing below spot; it automatically rebuilds after each swap when the budget crosses a threshold, permanently sequestering any tokens it buys.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK pools that charges a fixed WETH fee on every swap via return-delta accounting, splitting accrued fees between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury. Each pool's fee rate and recipients are registered once by a permissioned launcher and cannot be modified afterward.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that computes base + surge LP fees via a DynamicFeeManager and charges a configurable protocol fee on each swap (exactIn in beforeSwap, exactOut in afterSwap), minting the fee share to a full-range liquidity manager for reinvestment. Uses a truncated geometric oracle to record price observations and auto-tune fee parameters.

hook.name: RobinhoodRWIV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Factory and hook for launching fixed-supply TOKEN/RWI pools on Robinhood Chain. Restricts pool initialization to the hook itself via beforeInitialize, and uses beforeSwap with a return delta to internally match accumulated token-fee inventory against organic RWI buys at the current pool price, routing that portion directly without going through the AMM curve.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools (native ETH / TOKEN) with LP fee set to 0. The hook intercepts swaps to collect an ETH-denominated fee (set at pool registration, up to 5%), then instantly distributes it to a platform wallet and per-pool recipients, with the remainder routed to one of several reserve modes: buyback-and-burn, stock rewards, robin staking, lottery, or liquidity provision.

hook.name: HoodpadV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all Hoodpad v2 graduated meme pools. Charges a protocol fee and per-pool creator tax on every swap via afterSwap return delta, accumulates them as pending balances, and allows a trusted sweep operator to convert memecoin-denominated fees to the quote currency via internal swaps and distribute proceeds to the protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback-and-lock vault.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable WETH-denominated fee (in pips) on every swap in both directions using the return-delta mechanism. Accrued fees are split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury and can be claimed permissionlessly.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding-curve launch hook for pmav.fun's ERC-20 quoted lane. Runs a constant-product curve with a 1% base fee (70/30 creator/platform), block+1 anti-snipe, decaying early-buy premium, permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund waterfall, and in-place graduation that reshapes to a full-range Uniswap v4 pool and sets a dynamic LP fee.

hook.name: HimsTreasuryFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 0.5% treasury fee and 0.3% development fee on every swap's executed amount using afterSwapReturnsDelta. Maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle and gates all swaps behind a treasury-controlled swapsEnabled flag.

hook.name: MarketHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook that gates all pool operations through a designated router contract. Swaps and liquidity additions require trading to be open (via IMarketHookRouter.isTradingOpen()), fees must remain at zero, and donations are permanently disabled.

hook.name: PackedTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a creator tax (up to 5% of each swap's unspecified side) in afterSwap via a delta return, redirecting the cut to the creator address fixed at pool initialization. Only curves registered with the factory can open pools; the tax rate is immutable after pool creation and collected into per-creator balances claimable by anyone.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated Pons v2 meme pools that collects protocol and creator fees on every swap via afterSwap using a return delta, batches memecoin-denominated fees and converts them to the quote currency via internal swaps, then distributes proceeds among the protocol, creator, and an optional buyback-and-lock vault.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% tax on every swap in launchpad pools, always denominated in the pool's quote token, split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and each pool's token creator. Pools must be initialized via a one-shot-bound strategy contract and carry a zero LP fee; the tax is the only charge on trades.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with dynamic fees driven by a truncated geometric mean oracle and surge-based fee adjustment. Charges a configured protocol fee plus an undisclosed 0.10% "hidden" fee (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) on every swap, minting proceeds as ERC6909 claims to a full-range liquidity manager for optional reinvestment.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (returning the selector as a no-op). All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure stubs. Pool initialization is managed externally via a LiquidityBootstrapper contract called through initializePools().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Exposes an `initializePools()` function that calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting tick in `initialTick`. All hook callbacks, including `afterInitialize`, are no-ops; the hook does not modify pool initialization or swap execution in any way.

hook.name: InstantHook
hook.description: A fixed-fee hook for ether-quoted "Instant" launch markets that charges 1.50% on every swap's ether leg (1.00% to the market creator, 0.50% to the platform), using BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to collect fees across all swap directions, while setting the pool LP fee to zero.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
