hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches managed by a launchManager, enforcing configurable buy/sell fees distributed to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas. Liquidity removal is permanently locked, donations are disabled, and pool initialization is restricted to the launchManager.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to seed initial liquidity and record the starting tick.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic swap fees with surge pricing, a truncated geometric oracle, and full-range liquidity reinvestment of collected fees. On every swap, the hook charges a protocol fee plus a hardcoded 0.10% hidden surcharge (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) that is silently minted to the liquidity manager, with an always-true condition ensuring the surcharge is applied on exactOut swaps regardless of configured protocol fee settings.

hook.name: HoodersLaunchHook
hook.description: Launch hook for Hooders tokens on Robinhood Chain managing the full token lifecycle: seeds a concentrated liquidity bonding curve, applies a decaying sniper tax and per-wallet anti-snipe buy cap, routes fees across platform/creator/liquidity/RWA buckets, atomically collapses the curve into a full-range AMM position upon graduation, and runs a jackpot buyer-reward system.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable swap fee (30–500 bps) on ETH-input swaps, rising to 30% during a 60-second antisniper launch window. Collected fees are routed to creator, buyback/burn, rewards, and platform. LP additions are restricted to a designated autoLpSeeder after the initial seed, and LP removal is permanently blocked.

hook.name: KingOfTheHillHook
hook.description: A competitive "King of the Hill" hook where the largest single ETH buyer becomes king and earns 2% fees from all buys. Kings are dethroned when a new buyer exceeds a decaying threshold (×1.03); dethroned kings receive NFT commemorations (ChronicleSoul/ChronicleScroll) and have 12 hours to claim earnings before a keeper can forfeit and buyback-burn the remaining KOTH.

hook.name: YinYangHook
hook.description: A hook for ETH/token pools that collects a 5% fee on the ETH leg of each swap and routes proceeds to a flywheel contract that splits them among a team wallet, token burns, and liquidity providers.

hook.name: SparkHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for Spark token launches that charges protocol and creator fees on swaps using quote-token amounts, with a block-number-based anti-snipe mechanism that applies elevated fees to early buyers within a configurable window after launch.

hook.name: DirectionalFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable, per-pool, per-direction fee from the unspecified side of each swap and forwards it to a designated vault. Fees are capped at 5% (500 bps) and rate changes are subject to a 5-minute timelock delay.

hook.name: RiversLaunchHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for the Rivers protocol that manages phased token launches. Restricts swaps to the controller before fee activation, dynamically overrides LP fees based on pool phase (pre/post-graduation), and collects protocol trade fees from public swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook that deploys concentrated LP positions across configurable tick ranges before each swap and removes them after, with idle assets rehypothecated into ERC-4626 vaults between swaps. Fee is static (set at pool creation via PoolKey.fee); hookData is ignored on swaps.

hook.name: UnipadHookV4
hook.description: Shared, ownerless anti-snipe hook that applies a decaying dynamic LP fee per pool: 50% for the first 2 blocks after initialization, 20% for blocks 2–4, and 1% thereafter. Each pool's fee schedule is independent, starting from its own initialization block.

hook.name: DirectV4StakingFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed WETH fee on every token/WETH pool swap, distributing 30% to the pool creator, 15% to platform token stakers via a staking vault, and 55% to the treasury. Fees are extracted via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas using poolManager.take().

hook.name: NulifyFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a volatility-based fee in native ETH on every swap: buys are charged on the ETH input in beforeSwap, sells on the ETH output in afterSwap (exact-input only). The fee rate floats between a configurable base and maximum (both within 1–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, scaling up during volatile conditions to protect LPs.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the TIPOFF/ETH pool that collects a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always denominated in ETH, and forwards fees to an immutable feeRecipient address via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad hook (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) that runs a constant-product curve phase with block+1 anti-snipe protection, decaying anti-snipe fee premium, per-wallet 2% buy cap with automatic refund waterfall, and 1% quote-denominated fee (70/30 creator/platform split). Automatically graduates to a standard full-range Uniswap V4 pool with dynamic LP fee when the curve raise target is reached.

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: Gates liquidity operations on a Uniswap v4 pool: only a designated locker address may add liquidity, and any real liquidity removal (liquidityDelta < 0) is permanently prohibited for all parties. Zero-delta decreases (fee collection) are still permitted.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects ETH fees on every ETH/token swap, splitting proceeds between the token creator and a treasury address, with optional referral cuts distributed from the platform share. Tracks net ETH volume via a factory contract to support token graduation logic.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook serving as the complete fee engine for token launch pools. It gates swaps until a scheduled activation time, then computes a time-decaying anti-snipe or market-cap-decaying fee taken exclusively in WETH via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap hook delta. Fees are split among protocol, creator, and partner; the creator's slice can optionally fund a flywheel routing WETH to buyback-and-burn, auto-LP, reflections, or WETH dividends to holders.

hook.name: EquifoldEvolutionHook
hook.description: Cosmetic accounting hook for Equifold launch pools that observes post-swap quote flow to update a tamagotchi-style creature's condition (fed/hungry/starving/ghost) and prophecy ladder (volume and price-hold milestones), emitting events without gating or modifying swaps.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Forge platform hook that enforces configurable buy/sell fees (split among platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients) taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas. Pools must be registered by a launchManager before trading, liquidity removal is permanently locked, and donations are disabled.

hook.name: MarketSessionFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees based on NYSE market session schedules (2026–2050), ranging from 4.5 bps during regular hours to 74.5 bps when markets are closed. It also charges an additional 0.5 bp hook fee on each swap's unspecified amount, which is taken via PoolManager and sent to a configured fee recipient.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Collects swap fees on Mixpad-launched tokens, splitting revenue between creator and treasury with configurable shares. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in early blocks post-launch, a time-limited deployer dump penalty on early sells, and supports optional buyback-and-burn and dividend routing to a yield vault.

hook.name: PumpV4Hook
hook.description: A factory-gated launch-pool hook that charges a fixed 2% WETH-side fee on every swap, routing fees to a per-pool CreatorFeeShare contract. Only factory-registered pools may initialize or swap; initial liquidity is permanently locked via beforeRemoveLiquidity revert; exact-output swaps are disabled.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies buy/sell taxes on swaps and fulfills pending fee obligations using TWAP-based pricing, routing collected fees to registered receivers (LP managers, leaderboard, genesis). Also maintains a truncated geometric oracle for pool observations.

hook.name: QuoteFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap, always denominated in the ETH side of the pool (currency0), by splitting the charge between beforeSwap and afterSwap callbacks depending on which side is specified. Fees are accrued per registered pool and collected by an immutable factory contract.

hook.name: JadeHook
hook.description: A swap fee hook for a token launchpad that charges a configurable base fee on swaps for registered tokens, with an elevated rush fee during an initial block window after token registration. Fees are accrued to token maker addresses and can be claimed via the hook contract.

hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: Fee-taking hook that skims 1.5% of every swap in ETH. On buys (ETH→token), fees are claimed as ERC-6909 ETH credits in beforeSwap and redeemed in afterSwap or via a permissionless collect(); on sells (token→ETH), fees are taken from the ETH output in afterSwap. Fees are split among token holders (via DividendToken.fundPot), creator, platform, and ops.

hook.name: HoodseaFeeHook
hook.description: Shared hook for native-ETH/token pools that charges a 1.5%–3.5% fee on every swap, with optional anti-sniper linear decay from 80% at launch. Fees are taken from ETH input on buys (beforeSwap delta) and from ETH output on sells (afterSwap delta), then routed to a per-pool recipient address registered by a factory.

hook.name: StarHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for bonding-curve token launches registered via a factory contract. On each swap, it deducts a configurable fee (default 1%, max 3%) from the quote-token leg and credits it to the token's creator. Buys within a configurable block window after launch incur a higher anti-snipe tax (default 12%). Fees accumulate in the hook and are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: HookuidityHookV1
hook.description: A v4 hook for ETH/token pools that charges a 2% buy fee and 2% sell fee on native ETH. Buy fees are donated directly to current in-range LPs via poolManager.donate(); sell fees accrue to a per-pool creator reward vault. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: ModularLaunchpadHook
hook.description: Modular Uniswap v4 launchpad hook with optional anti-snipe (time-based per-buy WETH cap curve), buy throttle (pool-wide rate limit during launch window), and JIT liquidity defense. Supports two fee models: standard (per-swap afterSwap take with optional creator-burn and liquidity-deepening redirects) or universal (hook-held seed LP with permissionless harvest() into a 70/30 creator/protocol split). This instance uses universal economics with anti-snipe enabled.

hook.name: PairV4Hook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization so only a trusted launchpad contract can initialize pre-authorized pools with a fixed fee (10,000) and tick spacing (200). Implements only beforeInitialize; swap behavior is entirely unmodified.

hook.name: NoSellHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that permanently blocks sell swaps (HODL → ETH direction) for all senders except a single protocol address set once by the deployer via setProtocol(). Buy swaps (ETH → HODL) are always permitted without restriction.

hook.name: GoldFunHook
hook.description: Memecoin launchpad hook implementing a constant-product bonding curve for token launches. During the curve phase, swap math is fully overridden and fees (protocol + referral + creator) are skimmed from the ETH side. At graduation, raised ETH and unsold tokens are seeded as locked full-range liquidity in the same pool. Post-graduation, the hook collects the same fee split from normal AMM swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas.

hook.name: RobinHoodHook
hook.description: Volume-based dynamic fee hook (0.2%–5%) using a quadratic curve over 5-minute epochs. Takes 10% of each swap's fee as a creator commission via afterSwap return delta, withdrawable by the deployer.

hook.name: StockPoolHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed fee on the stock leg of coin/stock pool swaps, minting ERC-6909 claims to a per-stock dividend vault. Pool creation is gated to a registrar; the fee rate (capped at 10%) is frozen per pool at initialization. Exact-stock-amount swaps revert on partial fill to prevent overcharging.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for v4.fun pools. Charges ETH fees between 1–7% on buys (via beforeSwap BeforeSwapDelta on input) and sells (via afterSwap delta on output), with the fee scaling linearly based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool feeRecipient; only exact-input swaps are allowed.

hook.name: LeshyClassicQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Leshy classic token pools that collects a controller-governed treasury fee on swaps, denominated in the quote asset. Fees are accrued as ERC-6909 claims via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas and redeemable to the current treasury address. Pool initialization is gated to the registered factory adapter.

hook.name: FriarV2
hook.description: Volatility-responsive dynamic LP fee hook porting the Liquidity Book (LFJ joe-v2, MIT) volatility-accumulator mechanism to Uniswap v4. Fee rises with recent price movement and decays back to a per-pool base rate, hard-capped at 10%. Config is per-pool, frozen at initialization; no owner or admin functions.

hook.name: EquifoldRaidHook
hook.description: A cosmetic observation hook for Equifold v4 launch pools that gamifies swap activity as a cooperative boss raid. Buys damage the boss and sells heal it based on quote volume; raid state resets every 10 minutes. No swap gating, no hookData required, and no effect on trade execution.

hook.name: ZayyanXPADHook
hook.description: Volatility-scaled fee hook for Zayyan XPAD pools that charges a bps fee on the quote side (currency0) of every swap; the rate scales linearly between baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims inside the pool manager and can be permissionlessly swept to the pad's fee wallet.

hook.name: SazareFairLaunchHook
hook.description: A fair-launch hook for new token markets that enforces a price floor backed by settlement-asset reserves, collects creator and protocol trading fees on each swap, and routes swap input through a configurable risk controller with warehouse, volatility, and profit-burn sub-modules. Swaps are blocked until the canonical factory activates the market via a governance call.

hook.name: CobaltHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that deducts percentage fees from swap quote amounts via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-input) and afterSwapReturnsDelta (exact-output). Applies an elevated anti-snipe tax rate during the first configurable number of blocks after token registration; accumulated fees are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: HoodBookHookV1
hook.description: Permanently locks liquidity in Uniswap v4 pools by reverting all beforeRemoveLiquidity calls where liquidityDelta is negative, preventing LP withdrawals. Allows delta == 0 calls (fee collection) to proceed normally.

hook.name: SomprazHook
hook.description: A Sompraz launchpad hook that collects fees on swaps of registered tokens. On buys, charges a combined platform fee and per-token buy tax from the quote amount. On sells, non-creator sellers are charged 100% of the swap output as a fee, effectively blocking sells for anyone except the token creator.

hook.name: StandardV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/token pool that charges a volatility-scaled fee (1–7%, based on previous-swap tick movement) on every exact-input buy and sell. Fees are routed to a CentralBankController, and net ETH flow per epoch is tracked to drive expansion or contraction of a reserve-backed token system. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound controller.

hook.name: FriarTier
hook.description: A dynamic LP fee hook using a Liquidity Book volatility accumulator to compute a spacing-invariant surge fee on top of an immutable base fee set at deployment. Each deployment is a distinct fee tier with no owner, admin, or upgradeability.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-adjusted fee hook that charges between baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps on each swap based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims and swept to an immutable feeWallet; all parameters (fee bounds, fee destination) are fixed at deployment. Exact-output swaps are refused.

hook.name: MidasAntiSnipeSuperhook
hook.description: ETH/token hook that charges configurable fees on both sides of each swap — ETH-side fees are split between a royalty recipient and the pool's adopter, token-side swaps burn a configurable amount to a dead address. Buys within a configurable post-launch window pay a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge. Includes an on-chain TWAP oracle and rejects fee-on-transfer tokens and exact-output swaps.

hook.name: LaunchHookV3
hook.description: Fee hook for ETH/token launches that withholds tiered ETH fees on buys and sells via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Applies an anti-sniper window (28% fee), a secondary window (15% fee), and a normal period (2% fee) after LP is seeded, distributing fees to a treasury and a rewards distributor.

hook.name: StonkVenue LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that gates swaps behind an owner-controlled `tradingEnabled` flag, supports only exact-input swaps, and collects configurable buy/sell fees in ETH by redirecting amounts via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to a designated fee wallet.

hook.name: BuybuttonFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based ETH fee hook for Uniswap v4. Charges a dynamic fee (1%–7%) on buys via beforeSwap delta and on sells via afterSwap delta, scaling the rate with the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool feeRecipient.

hook.name: LoopBuybackHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Loop Trade launch pools that skims a configurable buyback portion (up to 90%) of a fixed 1% swap fee, burning tokens directly when the token side is received or accumulating quote currency for permissionless buyback-and-burn via executeBuyback.

hook.name: QuantisFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-adaptive ETH fee (1–5%) on every swap in ETH/token pools. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales between a configurable base and max based on tick movement from the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are allowed; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: FlowstateC1Hook
hook.description: Custom-curve Uniswap V4 hook that routes buy-only swaps (quote-in, inventory-out) through the Flowstate C1 market, fully overriding the AMM curve via BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA. Sell direction reverts. Charges a configurable spread plus a TokenJar protocol fee on each fill.

hook.name: CircusFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on the quote asset for every swap in graduated Circus launchpad pools. Distributes fees between the token creator and protocol, with a configurable portion compounded back into the pool's permanently locked full-range liquidity position.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a WETH-only fee on every swap through registered pools, taking a configurable percentage of the WETH leg (specified or unspecified) and distributing accrued fees to immutable per-pool project and protocol treasury addresses.

hook.name: RobinhoodRWIV4LaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 token launch factory for fixed-supply TOKEN/RWI pairs on Robinhood Chain. Uses beforeInitialize to gate pool creation exclusively to internally launched tokens, pricing them via TWAP oracles to target a $10,000 USD market cap with permanently locked liquidity.

hook.name: StonkBirdsFeeHook
hook.description: 2% ETH fee on swaps. 175 bps to NestBoosterPot, 25 bps to polVault. Taken in beforeSwap when ETH is specified, afterSwap otherwise. Only native ETH / STONKBIRDS pools. Owner can mark addresses fee-exempt.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH-native pools, charging 1–7% fees in ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient. Only exact-input swaps are allowed; pool initialization is restricted to a single registered factory address.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4
hook.description: Shared fee hook for all Foundry launchpad pools on Robinhood Chain. Takes ETH-denominated fees (1.00–1.25% scaled by pre-trade market cap), splits them between creator and protocol with configurable payout wallets, enforces anti-snipe restrictions during the launch window, blocks outside liquidity additions pre-graduation, and supports a graduation mechanism after which the hook fee drops to zero.

hook.name: RimeHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for the Rime protocol that taxes every swap in quote-asset terms, applies anti-snipe mechanics (Sniper Shield and launch-decay) during curve and post-graduation phases, enforces a minimum price floor while a pool is on its curve, and detects graduation events.

hook.name: RimeHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for RIME coin pools that taxes every swap in the quote asset via a configurable bps rate, applies a decaying Sniper Shield surcharge at launch, an anti-snipe surcharge after graduation, enforces a price floor preventing sales below the opening edge, and detects graduation when the price crosses a configured threshold.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: A graduation gate hook for GreenTown token launchpad pools. Restricts pool initialization to a single migrator address and blocks all swaps until that migrator explicitly opens the pool after locking graduation liquidity.

hook.name: EvpEquityRewardTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a 0.7% tax on the equity quote token for swaps in six EVP/equity pools (EVP paired with MSFT, SPCX, SPY, TTWO, HIMS, or MU). Only exact-input swaps are allowed; buy-side fees are taken upfront in beforeSwap, sell-side fees in afterSwap. Accrued fees can be permissionlessly swept to an immutable vault.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 1% swap fee on all swaps, split 70% to the pool creator and 30% to the platform. Liquidity is locked permanently after a single seed add. Only pools registered by the owner can be used.

hook.name: CreatorFirstHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects swap fees and routes them to the token creator (100% creator share by default, 0% treasury). Supports per-token fee parameters, optional anti-snipe and deployer-dump taxes, and automatically executes buyback-and-burn of accumulated fees using the pool.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A minimal test hook that implements stub liquidity callbacks (beforeAddLiquidity, afterAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity) that return the correct selectors without performing any logic. Has no swap hooks and no state mutations.

hook.name: SteakHouseV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that enforces per-band or time-based configurable LP fees across 8 MCAP bands, with per-band maxWallet and maxTx limits. Features an optional sniper tax (40–80%) for the first 12 seconds post-launch, a 24-second dev-buy window capped at 15% of supply, and an owner-managed volume-bot exemption whitelist that trades with 0% LP fee.

hook.name: TotalizerTrap
hook.description: Tracks a cumulative total of swap sizes per pool and reverts any swap that would make the running total a multiple of 11. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee from the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: QuiverV4Hook
hook.description: Shared policy hook for Quiver v4 token launch pools. Enforces permissioned pool initialization via a launcher, optional liquidity exclusivity during the bootstrap phase, and optional buy-side gating that requires buyers to be pre-authorized by an on-chain gate authorization contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization. An external `initializePools()` function calls a `LiquidityBootstrapper` contract to bootstrap liquidity and store the initial tick. All swap-path hook callbacks are no-ops; the hook has no swap flags.

hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: A fee-skimming hook for the Quiver launchpad that collects a configurable per-token tax (0–10%) on every swap via afterSwap, accruing fees in WETH or the launched token. Fees are distributed 50/25/25 to token holders (as stock rewards), the creator, and the protocol treasury.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal omnichain hook for the Saturn protocol with only an afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op (pure, returns selector); actual pool initialization is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools().

hook.name: UretimHookNFT
hook.description: Launchpad hook that permanently locks pool liquidity (no removals allowed), charges configurable swap fees split among creator, protocol, referral, and token holders, and applies a time-decaying anti-snipe fee surcharge during the launch window. Optionally maintains a per-pool TWAP oracle. Only the factory can initialize pools or add liquidity.

hook.name: ResearchHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 1% fee on every swap in the quote currency, split between beforeSwap (for quote-specified swaps) and afterSwap (for quote-unspecified swaps) via return deltas. Fees accumulate in the contract and can be withdrawn to a configurable treasury address. Only applies to tokens registered by the factory at launch time.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for bonding-curve token launch pools. Buy-side fees are set as dynamic LP fee overrides; sell-side ETH fees are taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta and held in the hook for off-path locker collection. Pools can graduate to a higher market-cap fee tier once accumulated ETH reaches a threshold.

hook.name: BagsV4Hook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Bags platform pools that enforces full-range, permanently locked liquidity, overrides LP fees to 0, and charges a 2% fee on the WETH leg of every swap, split 50/50 between the Bags vault and a per-pool creator fee share recipient.

hook.name: RhythmHook
hook.description: A single-market hook for native ETH/token pools that enforces sell-side swap restrictions via configurable modes: cyclic time windows or price-oracle-triggered lockouts measured by a 5-bucket TWAP ring-buffer oracle. Liquidity is permanently locked after market launch; only the canonical market contract may initiate swaps.

hook.name: AnteaterhoodFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a volatility-based ETH fee (1–7%) on ETH/token pool swaps. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees are taken from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee rate scales with the previous swap's tick movement, resting at a configurable base fee in calm markets and ramping to a configurable max fee during volatile periods. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Forge launch platform that enforces pool registration by a launchManager, restricts liquidity to a single authorized launch position, and collects configurable buy/sell fees in beforeSwap and afterSwap, distributing them to platform, creator, rewards, and utility buckets via a claim vault.

hook.name: BlendHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that settles every basket token swap at exact NAV by minting or redeeming through registered BasketVault contracts, routing constituent trades through configured liquidity pools. Liquidity provision to the basket pool is refused; the underlying CLAMM curve never executes.

hook.name: FuseHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Fuse token launchpad that collects configurable hook fees, creator buy/sell taxes, and time-decaying anti-snipe fees on registered tokens. Fees are taken as BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta adjustments and routed to a claimable balance for the token creator.

hook.name: BlendHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that intercepts all swaps on basket/quote pools, settling them at exact NAV by minting or redeeming through BasketVault contracts rather than executing the AMM curve. Liquidity additions are refused; each constituent is acquired or liquidated via registered external route pools.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Fee engine for a token launchpad that charges a configurable protocol + creator fee (in the pool's quote token) on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Pools are registered by a factory, liquidity is seeded exactly once and permanently locked, and an optional linearly-decaying anti-snipe fee surge applies in the blocks after launch.

hook.name: HoodseaFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for native-ETH/TOKEN pools. Charges ETH fees on buys in beforeSwap and sells in afterSwap, with fees scaling between a configurable base and max (1%–5%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Exact-output swaps are blocked and will revert.

hook.name: PadFeeHook
hook.description: Singleton hook shared by all graduated pons v2 memecoin pools. Collects protocol, launchpad, creator, and charity fees from the quote leg, and optional burn fees from the memecoin leg, on every swap. Applies a time-decaying snipe tax on early buys. On buys, optionally stakes half of post-burn memecoin in a CoinFlip game. Supports per-pool rich/poor wallet balance gates and FOMO-only relayer allowlists.

hook.name: BEEF
hook.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20 token that also serves as its own Uniswap v4 hook, applying configurable buy/sell taxes on the native ETH side of swaps in a single bound pool. Tax is captured via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta and forwarded to a controller address for processing.

hook.name: LittleJohnHook
hook.description: A factory-deployed Uniswap v4 launch-pool hook that takes an ETH-leg fee on all four swap shapes via beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta. The fee optionally decays over time from a launch-time rate to a settled base rate. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 ETH claims to a per-pool locker. A configurable time-bounded sell-lock can restrict the creator from selling during the launch window. Pool config is write-once via factory; no owner or upgrade path exists.

hook.name: BagsV4Hook
hook.description: Shared hook for all Bags pools enforcing full-range-only, permanently-locked liquidity, zero LP fee, and a 2% hook fee on the WETH leg of every swap. Fees accrue per-pool and are swept to a platform vault (50%) and a creator fee share contract (50%), with an optional partner cut carved from the protocol half.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHookV4
hook.description: Sets a creator-specified LP fee for migrated pools at initialization via updateDynamicLPFee; fees must be pre-registered by a bound launchpad address before pool initialization.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records an initial tick on pool initialization. Exposes an `initializePools()` function that delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and store the starting tick.

hook.name: EndgameHook
hook.description: A game-theory hook that seeds a single coin-only pool with the full token supply. Qualifying buys (≥ a geometrically rising floor) reset a countdown clock and update the leader; when the clock expires with an identified leader, that address wins the accumulated LP fee pot split between winner and a dev fee recipient.

hook.name: IpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Ipad token launch platform that collects quote-token swap fees (with an elevated anti-snipe tax during the first N blocks after launch) and accumulates them for token creators to claim.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook that deducts a configurable fee (up to 2% per side) from swap input amounts using v4's custom accounting (poolManager.take() + BeforeSwapDelta). Tax rates are fixed immutably at deploy time; proceeds are withdrawable only to the owner address set at construction.

hook.name: EquityLaunchHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve launch hook for stock-token-quoted pools on Robinhood Chain. Implements guard-phase fee decay (90%→3% over ~50 blocks), a flat 1% curve phase, and 1% post-graduation fee, with per-wallet and per-block buy caps during the launch window. Fees are captured via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta returns and routed to a FeeRouter contract.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: A graduation gate hook for GreenTown launchpad tokens that blocks all pool initialization and swaps until a designated migrator has locked graduation liquidity and called openPool(). Once a pool is opened it remains open permanently; the check is per-pool keyed by PoolId.

hook.name: MarketMakerHookZeroSeed
hook.description: Protocol-owned market maker hook for a single token/USDC pair that maintains a fixed ask ladder above spot and trailing bid structures below. Charges a flat fee (split between deployer and protocol) on all swaps plus a piecewise-linear zone tax on sells (burned), with LP fees permanently overridden to 0 via beforeSwap delta. No admin keys, no upgrade path.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding-curve token launch hook (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) that implements a Uniswap v4-native constant-product curve with an ERC20 quote token. Features include block+1 anti-snipe, 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, 1% dynamic LP fee split 70/30 creator/platform, and in-place graduation to a full-range standard Uniswap v4 pool upon reaching the raise target.

hook.name: PriceDecayFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a sliding swap fee based on how far the pool's current price is from its launch price. The fee starts at a configurable maximum at launch and decays linearly to a base fee as the price moves away, with fees collected as ERC-6909 claims in the quote currency and swept to a configurable recipient via a permissionless `sweep()` call. Fee parameters and recipient are owner-controlled.

hook.name: PensionTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 4% tax (400 bips) on ETH involved in swaps: deducted from ETH-input swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and from ETH-output swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, forwarding the collected ETH directly to an immutable pension fund vault address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external LIQUIDITY_BOOTSTRAPPER contract to bootstrap initial liquidity positions and record the initial tick.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Factory-gated singleton hook for pools launched by LaunchFactory, taking trading fees on the stock side (currency0) and splitting them between a platform treasury (30%), a creator recipient, and token holders via a FeeDistributor. Exact-output sells are not supported.

hook.name: YardFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for YardLaunch pools that charges ETH fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta). The fee rate scales dynamically between a configurable base and max rate (1%–5.12%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, with only exact-input swaps permitted.

hook.name: SharesHook
hook.description: Collects protocol fees (2.5% each) on buy and sell swaps for a designated native/token pool, updates an on-chain random seed on each swap, and notifies an external launch controller of swap activity. Triggers a token start on first liquidity addition once config is finalized.

hook.name: ActionLayerHook
hook.description: Implements a linearly-decaying dynamic LP fee (from a fixed startFee to endFee over decayBlocks, immutable schedule) applied per-swap via beforeSwap. Also supports single-tick resting limit orders that fill automatically in afterSwap when price crosses them; proceeds are held as ERC-6909 claims until withdrawn.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: Fee hook for coin/pair-token pools that intercepts the pair-token leg of every swap to collect a configurable fee via BeforeSwapDelta and ERC-6909 accrual (zero net v4 delta per swap). Accumulated fees are split between a project treasury (paid in the pair token) and a protocol treasury (converted to WETH via a frozen DIRECT or VIA_USDG V3 route, with graceful in-kind pair-token degradation if conversion fails).

hook.name: BullionTaxHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable buy/sell taxes (default 6% each) on GOLD/WETH swaps, collecting the tax amounts to a treasury address. The owner can adjust tax rates up to 20%, update the treasury, or pause the hook.

hook.name: QuantisFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools in the Quantis protocol. Charges buy fees (ETH input) in beforeSwap and sell fees (ETH output) in afterSwap, with the fee rate scaling between configurable base and max (1%–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool recipient.

hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: Immutable hook for the official ETH/STONK pool that permanently forbids liquidity removal, gates swap direction and liquidity additions via a transfersLocked flag on the token contract, and tracks STONK inbound/outbound quotas per swap in afterSwap.

hook.name: NakamotoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that mints NAKAMOTO tokens on ETH buys (curve-priced with a pool-value floor) and burns them on sells (priced by treasury/supply ratio with a 5% exit fee). Liquidity additions are disabled; the hook features a whitelist-gated launch window, a per-buyer sell cooldown, and self-deprecates permanently after 3,000 ETH in cumulative curve purchases.

hook.name: YoinkFeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad fee hook that charges a market-cap-tiered swap fee (0.80%–1.00%) on every trade in registered pools via afterSwap, splitting proceeds between the platform and the pool creator. Includes a configurable launch-window buy cap (anti-snipe guard) enforced via tx.origin.

hook.name: LooprDualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT-quoter hook that deploys multi-range concentrated liquidity just-in-time for each swap and removes it in afterSwap, with ERC4626 vault rehypothecation of idle assets between swaps. Uses a static LP fee fixed at pool creation; owner configures tick-range bucket weights and can pause swaps via a liveness flag.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook that lets anyone deploy memecoins trading on a concentrated liquidity curve denominated in an issuer-controlled quote token (e.g., USDG). Enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap, a 1% base fee plus optional decaying anti-snipe premium, and graduates pools to standard Uniswap v4 with a 1% LP fee once the raise target is reached.

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: Restricts liquidity operations so only an immutable locker address can add liquidity to the pool, and permanently prevents any real liquidity removal (liquidityDelta < 0) by any position owner, locking principal forever while still allowing fee collection via zero-delta calls.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to the factory address, preventing front-running by requiring `sender == factory` in `beforeInitialize`. Has no swap-time flags, so swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool with no hook.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces factory-only pool initialization and applies a parabolic MEV-decay fee, starting at 80% and decaying to a 1.5% base over 30 seconds after pool creation. The factory's own launch buy is exempt from the MEV fee.

hook.name: SentryWethFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launch hook that forces the pool's LP fee to zero and instead skims fees in WETH on every swap, splitting proceeds between a creator fee recipient and treasury. Uses a time-decaying fee schedule (flat start rate, then exponential half-life decay to a floor) with a launch whitelist for discounted buys.

hook.name: BuffetAMM
hook.description: hook that gets prices from price engine to give swaps using liquidity stored in the pool manager

hook.name: PairPadMemeHook
hook.description: Singleton hook shared by all graduated PairPad meme token pools. Charges a configurable fee on every swap via afterSwap (Internal Swap Pool pattern), optionally converts memecoin-denominated fees back to the quote currency via internal pool swaps, and distributes proceeds across protocol, creator, and buyback-and-lock buckets.

hook.name: PotatoV4Hook
hook.description: A token launch platform hook that manages bonding curve-style launches. Takes a 1% fee on buy swaps via BeforeSwapDelta (burns fee tokens on sells), enforces a 4-second anti-snipe window at launch, caps per-wallet token holdings, and tracks graduation when a quote-token liquidity threshold is reached. Fees are split among creator, protocol, and referrer.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: Collects configurable buy/sell fees on each swap (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode), distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients tracked as on-chain liabilities. Liquidity additions are gated by a single-use launch authorization from a designated launch manager; liquidity removal is permanently locked.

hook.name: VoltHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via delta adjustments in beforeSwap and afterSwap. It applies a block-weighted anti-snipe surcharge on early buys after launch, routes fees to token creators via a claimable balance, and integrates with an external factory (IVoltFactory) for token registration and swap recording.

hook.name: NoxaHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for meme coin fair-launches that charges a fixed 1% tax on the base asset (WETH) side of every buy and sell, minting the collected tax as ERC-6909 claims to the launched token contract. Pool creation is restricted to factory-registered pools only.

hook.name: ReflectionFeeHook
hook.description: A 2% swap tax hook for graduated reflection-token pools. On ETH-specified swaps it takes a fixed 200 bps fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta callbacks and forwards it to a per-token fee bucket in the factory contract. Pool initialization is gated to a designated graduator address to prevent front-running.

hook.name: UhoodnamesFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-adjusted fee hook for Uhoodnames launchpad pools that charges 1–5% ETH fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta). Fees scale with the previous swap's tick movement and are forwarded directly to a per-pool fee recipient. Exact-output swaps are rejected; only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: MemeFolioTaxHook
hook.description: Immutable 3% native-ETH swap tax hook for a single ETH/token pool. Tax is taken in beforeSwap (on buys) and afterSwap (on sells) via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, stored as PoolManager claims, and permissionlessly distributed 2:1 to immutable buyback and treasury wallets.

hook.name: PrismaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a token launchpad that takes a quote-token fee on swaps for registered tokens, applying an elevated snipe tax during the first N blocks after token launch. Fees are accumulated on-chain and claimable by token creators.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-adjusted swap fee denominated in the pool's quote currency, scaling linearly between a base and max rate based on how far the previous swap moved the price (tick delta). Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and are forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via the permissionless `sweep()` function.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad tokens that skims a creator-set reflection fee plus a platform fee in ETH on every swap — in beforeSwap for exact-in buys and exact-out sells, in afterSwap for exact-in sells and exact-out buys — accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims sweepable by a designated distributor.

hook.name: HoardFeeHook
hook.description: Fee engine for the canonical HOARD/USDG Uniswap v4 pool, charging a 3% gross fee on all swaps collected in USDG and split equally between a Stock Vault and a USDG Wall manager. Records post-swap prices to an oracle after every swap; a LiquidationRouter address can be set as fee-exempt by the owner.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. The contract exposes an `initializePools()` function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick. No swap logic is present.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: Token launch hook that collects configurable buy/sell fees (via swap deltas) on launchManager-registered pools, distributing proceeds among platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Enforces a single liquidity position per pool and permanently disables liquidity removal.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad token pools that gates swaps until a scheduled activation time, takes configurable WETH trading fees (time-decaying anti-snipe for Standard launches or market-cap-decaying for Meme launches), and routes creator fees through a flywheel to buyback-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, or WETH dividends.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock pools on Robinhood Chain that charges a time-decaying fee on the stock leg of every swap, splitting proceeds among holder reflections, creator, terminal pot, and growth sink. The pool LP fee is zeroed out; fees are taken entirely via hook deltas. Only the factory's LP vault may add liquidity.

hook.name: VladBrianV1127CouplingHook
hook.description: After a swap in a configured VLAD/SPY or BRIAN/SPY entry pool, the hook automatically executes a coupled sidecar swap in a VLAD/BRIAN duel pool, selling the opponent token proportional to the entry-pool buy amount. Coupling is capped by the hook's own token inventory and skipped gracefully on failure.

hook.name: SurgeHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that applies configurable hook fees, creator buy/sell taxes, and time-decaying anti-snipe fees to registered tokens, extracting fees from swap amounts via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and routing them to token creators.

hook.name: LaunchHookV3
hook.description: A token-launch hook that imposes a native-ETH creator tax on swaps across temporal phases: a factory-only launch phase, an early 35% tax window, a whitelist-exempt early period, then dynamic buy/sell tax cycles with configurable base rates. Operates only on factory-registered ETH/token pools.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook managing bonding-curve memecoin pools with three fee phases: launch guard (90%–3% decaying anti-sniper fee over ~5s), curve (1% flat until graduation threshold), and graduated (1% flat, pool opens to public LPs). Fees are captured via before/after swap deltas on the quote token and routed to a FeeRouter with an optional referrer extracted from hookData.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK pools that charges a configurable fee always denominated in WETH on every swap in both directions. Uses beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas to take the fee from the WETH leg, accruing it to per-pool balances that are split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: ExactInGate
hook.description: Blocks exact-output swaps by reverting if amountSpecified > 0, allowing only exact-input swaps. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization. Delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools().

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook for token launch pools that gates public trading to a configured block number, then collects a fixed 1% base fee plus configurable creator and decaying opening taxes from the unspecified swap currency, distributing proceeds to protocol and creator fee recipients.

hook.name: IndexFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on all swaps in native ETH/token pools, taken in ETH and sent to an immutable treasury address. Uses return deltas split across beforeSwap (when ETH is the specified currency) and afterSwap (when ETH is the unspecified currency); pools where currency0 is not native ETH pass through untaxed.

hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: A meme coin launchpad hook (pmav.fun v2.2) that implements a bonding curve via a concentrated Uniswap v4 position, enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap semantics, charges a 1% fee split 70/30 between creator and platform, and graduates coins to a permanently locked full-range pool when the curve is exhausted.

hook.name: BeaconProxy Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy. The implementation contract (0xca3EB46Cc39c7426307c36BAFC97F585c6244884) is not verified; only the proxy source is available. The hook holds beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, and afterSwap permissions per its address bitmask.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects buy and sell fees (denominated in WETH) via swap delta overrides, with an optional elevated anti-sniper fee (85%) during the first 30 seconds post-launch. Fees accumulate per pool and are claimable by the factory.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: A shared launchpad hook that skims ETH fees on every swap using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Fees are split into a per-pool creator reflection fee and a platform fee, accrued as ERC-6909 ETH claims, and swept by a distributor to buy back the token for holders and route platform revenue.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op selector return) and tracks pool initialization state; actual liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: RUSH
hook.description: A fixed-supply ERC-20 token that doubles as its own Uniswap v4 hook, collecting configurable buy/sell taxes on the native ETH side of swaps and forwarding them to a controller for distribution via delta adjustments.

hook.name: MarblePoolHook
hook.description: Protocol fee hook for the canonical native ETH/MRBL pool on marble.fun. Burns a configurable portion of MRBL received in swaps, distributes native ETH to a fee splitter, and applies an additional launch-only snipe fee until disabled by the owner. The LP fee is dynamically adjustable by the owner via updateDynamicLPFee.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that holds the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in that callback. Liquidity bootstrapping is handled externally via initializePools(), which records the initial tick and delegates to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: WavesCurveHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook that runs a presale phase where buys and sells are priced against a virtual-reserve curve; once the curve fills, anyone can call graduate() to deploy permanently locked wide-range liquidity and the pool trades as a standard Uniswap v4 AMM.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: Charges configurable fees on WETH-paired pool swaps, overriding LP fees to zero and taking WETH directly via swap deltas. Applies an elevated 85% sniper fee during the first 30 seconds after pool launch, then reverts to a registered per-pool fee tier. Factory-initiated swaps are fee-exempt; accumulated WETH fees are claimable by the factory.

hook.name: BastionHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable swap fee ("tribute") on pools involving factory-registered tokens, routing the fee to guardian addresses tracked by a factory contract. Fee rates are set at token registration time and capped at 5%.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state via an external liquidity bootstrapper. Only afterInitialize is active, which is a no-op returning the selector with no additional logic.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% fee on both buys and sells in an ETH/$TIPOFF pool, always denominated in ETH (currency0). Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to skim the ETH fee from each swap, routing it to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: BoltHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for factory-launched tokens that collects protocol and creator fees (plus a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge) via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns on the quote token, routing collected fees to token creators for on-demand claiming.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that collects buy/sell fees on registered tokens, enforces an anti-snipe window and fair-launch max-buy cap via block.timestamp, and automatically routes collected fees to creator buybacks and dividend distributions.

hook.name: SessionHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts swaps to regular US stock market hours (9:30–16:00 New York time, Monday–Friday), computing DST transitions on-chain without an oracle. Pool initialization is restricted to an authorized `markets` address and must pair a specific token at zero LP fee.

hook.name: onuNativeTaxHook
hook.description: Charges an immutable native ETH tax on every swap in a single designated Uniswap v4 pool, deducting the tax from the native-token side via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas. Accumulated tax is held as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to a fixed recipient once a fixed threshold is reached.

hook.name: RobinhoodScannerSafeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1.5% swap fee from the output currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, sending proceeds to an immutable fee recipient. Pool registration and initialization are restricted to a factory address set once by an immutable initializer; swaps revert for unregistered pools.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker-issued tokens that enforces per-pool static LP fees with separate buy and sell rates, collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap via delta manipulation, and includes an optional MEV-protection module that can temporarily raise fees within two minutes of pool creation.

hook.name: ZayyanXPADHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-scaled quote-side fee on every swap in Uniswap v4 pools opened with zero LP fee, collecting fees as ERC-6909 claims and forwarding them to a designated fee wallet. The fee rate adjusts between a configurable base and maximum BPS (capped at 5.3%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap.

hook.name: RobinhoodV4SelectableFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1.5% base fee plus a launch-time configurable creator fee (0–10%) on swaps. Fees are collected in the non-launch-token currency and minted as ERC6909 claims to the creator's designated recipient; pool creation and liquidity are restricted to the factory and position manager.

hook.name: RehearsalHook
hook.description: Mainnet dry-run variant of SpcxStrategyHook that restricts swaps to owner-allowlisted tx.origin addresses. The base hook charges a decaying buy tax (95%→10%) and flat 10% sell tax on an ETH/SPCXSTR pool, takes fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta, and distributes them 80/10/10 to controller/dev/rewards with token-to-ETH conversion via a nested afterSwap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Only afterInitialize is enabled (as a no-op selector return). Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: LunchTaxHookImmutable
hook.description: A non-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired token launches that collects configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 20% per side) via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, with optional launch guards including timestamp-based trading delays, decaying opening taxes, and per-transaction buy caps. Collected ETH is distributed to token creators and a platform address.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated Pons v2 memecoin pools. Takes a hook fee plus an optional creator tax on every swap via afterSwap return delta, accumulating fees in pending balances. A trusted sweep operator periodically converts memecoin-denominated fees to the pool's quote currency via internal swaps, then distributes proceeds among the protocol, a buyback-and-lock vault (five-year vest), and the pool creator.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only uses afterInitialize. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops. On pool initialization, it delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: StonkWorkersFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for ETH/token launch pools (PackLaunch). Charges ETH fees on buys in beforeSwap and sells in afterSwap, with the rate floating between 1% and 6.6% based on recent tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are supported; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual initialization is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract to record an initial tick.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for Vladdy v4 ETH/TOKEN pools that takes all swap fees in native ETH and distributes them instantly per-trade to a platform wallet, buyback reserve, and configurable recipients. Supports a stock-rewards mode where fees accrue to purchase a configured stock token for distribution. Exact-output sells are unsupported.

hook.name: ResearchHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 1% fee on every swap in the quote currency (both buys and sells), accumulating fees in a claimable balance for treasury withdrawal. Only applies to pools containing tokens registered by the ResearchFactory.

hook.name: V2Hook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that charges a fee on the numeraire leg via hook deltas (bypassing LP fee, which is overridden to zero). The fee decays linearly from a configurable start (up to 80%) to a steady-state end (default 1%) over a configurable window (default 10 s) to deter opening-block snipers; exactOut swaps revert during this window. Liquidity additions are vault-only; principal removals are permanently locked. Optionally gates buys to NFT holders and locks sells for a presale period.

hook.name: EveriseHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable sell fee (in ETH) on token-to-ETH swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulates the ETH in a fee pool, then executes a nested buyback swap to purchase the project token and burn it via ITokenBurn.burn(). Burns are triggered automatically when feePool reaches a minimum threshold, with deferred retry on failure.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies fixed-rate buy (3%) and sell (6%) taxes on every swap. Fees are deducted from the unspecified currency in afterSwap via ERC-6909 claims and swept to a timelocked treasury address controlled by an owner multisig.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. Has no swap-time logic; afterInitialize is the only active permission.

hook.name: FriarTier
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook using a Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator mechanism. Applies an immutable base fee (fixed at deployment per tier) plus a variable surge component based on price displacement across tick buckets. No owner, no admin, no upgradeability; all parameters are frozen at construction.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: Launch hook with a time-decaying dynamic fee (high start → floor) that skims fees from swaps and splits them among creator, treasury, holder reflections (via dividend token notifyReward), and auto-compounding locked full-range LP. A pre-reflection delay window redirects the reflection share to creator/treasury; whitelisted launch wallets pay the floor fee rate.

hook.name: SnipeGuardHook
hook.description: Applies a punitive dynamic swap fee at pool launch that decays linearly from 50% to 1% over 180 seconds, discouraging sniper bots from buying in the first blocks after a pool is created.

hook.name: BobHook
hook.description: BobHook collects swap fees for factory-registered token stations, applying a higher snap fee during a configurable early block window after listing and a flat fee thereafter. Accumulated fees are attributed to designated patrons and redeemable via redeem/redeemAll.

hook.name: HunnidV4FeeHook
hook.description: Fixed 1% ETH fee hook for HUNNID pools that collects fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and routes them to a fee router. Only allows swaps in token/ETH pools that have been registered through the authorized adapter.

hook.name: Zhao8HookV3
hook.description: A generation-3 fee hook that charges a creator fee (up to 10%, set at deploy) plus a flat 0.2% protocol fee on every swap shape (exact-in and exact-out, buy and sell) by minting ERC-6909 claims to a fee locker vault. An optional anti-sniper premium from a creator registry is added on top, with the total capped at 50%.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-adjusted fee on every swap, scaling linearly from a base rate to a maximum based on how far the previous swap moved the price (tick delta). Fees are collected in the pool's quote currency via delta returns, accrued as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager, and redeemable permissionlessly via `sweep()` to a fixed, immutable fee wallet.

hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A tax-on-swap hook for Peeps V4 token launches that skims configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, then distributes collected amounts across funds, burn, dividend, and liquidity sinks in afterSwap. Enforces an optional anti-farmer window blocking third-party LP additions, and gates all swaps via a registry-controlled clearing window.

hook.name: RallyHookU4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 token launch hook implementing a bonding-curve phase (CURVE) that transitions to a free-market phase (BREAKOUT) upon reaching a target price. It acts as the sole liquidity provider, applies dynamic LP fees per swap direction, collects protocol fees with optional referral attribution, and uses delegatecall to a fixed fee-facet for fee distribution.

hook.name: ToyhoodFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools. Charges fees (1%–6.2%) on buys via beforeSwap delta (ETH input) and on sells via afterSwap delta (ETH output), with the fee scaling between a base and max rate based on tick movement from the previous swap. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient; only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that blocks real sell transactions by checking gasleft(): buys always succeed, sells are allowed only when gas remaining exceeds 30M (typical of simulations/eth_call), and revert on real user transactions with normal gas. Users who buy tokens cannot sell them.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Applies a per-pool creator tax (up to 2% in basis points) on swaps involving a registered launch token, taking the tax from the quote-token side of each swap and crediting it to the token creator for later claiming. Also locks registered pools against liquidity removal until unlocked.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired pools that collects configurable swap fees via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, permanently locks LP positions (beforeRemoveLiquidity always reverts), applies a 60-second elevated antisniper fee window at launch, and routes collected fees to creator, auto-LP, buyback/burn, and rewards vaults.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to the factory address, preventing front-running of Uniswap v4's permissionless initialize call. No swap-time callbacks are active; all swap flags are false.

hook.name: DTFFeeHook
hook.description: Swap-tax hook that skims a configurable buy/sell fee (always denominated in a fixed fee token) off every swap and forwards it directly to a treasury. Features a time-decaying launch tax (starting up to 90%, decaying linearly to the baseline fee over an immutable window) as an anti-sniper measure, with permanent exemptions for the protocol router and launcher. Fee rate and treasury are admin-adjustable via OpenZeppelin AccessManager.

hook.name: RallyHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve token launch hook that runs a virtual constant-product curve during the CURVE phase, serving all swaps from hook inventory against virtual reserves. On graduation it atomically seeds a permanent full-range CLMM position and switches to collecting a post-graduation protocol fee split across configurable recipients, with optional referral tracking via hookData.

hook.name: GateFeeGraduateHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that gates LP access to a single launcher-controlled position, charges a static 1% fee always collected in ETH via return deltas (beforeSwap for buy-exactInput, afterSwap for other cases), and auto-graduates a pool on-chain once cumulative net ETH bought in crosses a 4 ETH threshold.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A hook that gates oneForZero swaps on gasleft(), reverting if remaining gas is at or below 30,000,000; zeroForOne swaps are always permitted unconditionally.

hook.name: RobinhoodArenaFeeHook
hook.description: A post-swap hook for Robinhood Arena launch pools that collects a configurable fee from the output token of each swap and distributes it to multiple recipients via an external ArenaFeeHelper contract. Pool initialization is restricted to owner-authorized deployer addresses.

hook.name: Zhao8Hook
hook.description: Takes a configurable creator fee (up to 10% at deploy time, plus an optional sniper premium from a registry) from the output currency of every swap using the afterSwap-returns-delta pattern, routing 80% to the token creator and 20% to the protocol owner via a fee locker contract.

hook.name: ApeLaunchHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that gates pool initialization to pre-registered pools and restricts liquidity additions via transient-storage authorization. Only the launchpad or locker contract can authorize liquidity adds; all swaps execute as standard Uniswap v4 with no hook intervention.

hook.name: MomoHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Momo token launch platform that collects protocol fees on swaps in registered token pools. It applies a configurable base fee (default 1%) and a higher anti-snipe tax (default 7%) on buys within the first 30 blocks after a token's launch, with collected fees claimable by the token creator.

hook.name: CreatorFeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad fee hook that takes a fixed percentage of each swap's output (TOTAL_FEE_BPS), splitting it 70/30 between the token creator and the protocol treasury via a shared fee engine. Pools must be WETH pairs and can only be created by the authorized factory. Also supports multi-token LP rewards via a juice mechanism using V4-style fee-growth accounting.

hook.name: StockFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: Fee hook for stock-paired (TOKEN/<stock>) Uniswap v4 launch pools. Charges a fixed fee on the stock/quote leg across all four swap directions, accumulating as ERC-6909 claims. A permissionless claimFees() converts accrued stock fees to WETH via Uniswap V3 (TWAP-guarded slippage floor) and distributes as native ETH across a fixed 4-way split: dev, treasury, buyback, and token mechanism.

hook.name: ManagedTickerHook
hook.description: A shared hook for all "invented ticker" dollar pools that delegates per-pool callbacks to a ManagedTickerToken wrapper, enforcing capacity limits and optional liquidity maintenance before swaps, and validating price/backing invariants after swaps. Restricts liquidity additions and removals to the wrapper contract during maintenance windows.

hook.name: BoobHook
hook.description: A launch-pad fee hook that collects a configurable basis-point fee on quote-token amounts for registered token swaps. Applies a higher anti-snipe tax on buys within the first configurable number of blocks after token launch. Collected fees accrue to the token creator and are claimable via `claimFees`.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable tax (in the quote token) on each swap, splitting proceeds among token holders via a dividend sink, a creator address, and the platform. Fees are extracted using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values, with no hookData required.

hook.name: PairV5LaunchV2Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 70 bps fee on quote-token swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta, routing collected fees to a per-pool vault. Maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle using a circular observation buffer (up to 32 entries) to support buyback price quoting.

hook.name: DynamicRWAHook
hook.description: Fee hook for ETH/token launch pools that withholds fees from both buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), with time-based anti-sniper fee tiers stepping down from 28% to 15% to 2% over the first 200 seconds after LP seeding. Liquidity additions are locked once seeded, and removals are permanently blocked.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that redirects a configurable share of swap output to platform and creator fee recipients, optionally burns a per-pool buyback slice of token output on exact-input buys, and enforces a temporal anti-sniper gate that blocks all swaps until a configured number of blocks after pool initialization.

hook.name: RookHook
hook.description: Charges configurable swap tolls on enlisted token pairs, applying an elevated sniper levy for early buys within a configured block window after listing. Collected fees accrue to each token's founder address and can be withdrawn on demand.

hook.name: WickHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook with a 0% LP fee that captures a 4% hook fee on each swap (2.25% pot, 0.75% team, 1% staking distributor). Includes a launch guard that restricts buy-side swaps to allowlisted senders until disabled by the owner.

hook.name: QuoteAssetCreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token/quote-asset pools that charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap, denominated in the quote asset. Fees are split 0.9% to the token creator's reward vault and 0.1% to a launcher fee recipient, implemented via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: DegenV1Hook
hook.description: A fee hook for token/WETH pools that collects WETH-denominated hook fees on swaps, splitting proceeds between an operating treasury, a buyback vault, and a per-pool beneficiary. LP fees are enforced via updateDynamicLPFee on each swap, and pool creation is restricted to a privileged module address.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Fee hook for token launches that takes a configurable tax (up to 10%) on swaps denominated in the quote token, splitting proceeds among a dividend sink (token holders), a creator address, and a platform recipient.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 fee hook that charges a configurable per-pool fee always in WETH on both swap directions using return-delta accounting; accrued fees are split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury and can be permissionlessly claimed.

hook.name: PNGStrategy Hook
hook.description: Applies configurable buy and sell fees on ETH↔strategy-token swaps by intercepting them via BeforeSwapDelta (buy) and AfterSwapDelta (sell), taking fees in ETH via poolManager.take(). Collected fees are split among a strategy contract, an owner recipient, and a holder rewards recipient according to configurable BPS ratios; pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the strategy contract.

hook.name: BeaconProxy Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy, delegating all calls to an upgradeable implementation at 0xca3EB46Cc39c7426307c36BAFC97F585c6244884. The implementation source is not included in the verified source set, so the exact hook behavior (fee logic, swap access control, custom data requirements) cannot be determined from source alone.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker protocol hook that sets separate static LP fees for buying vs. selling the clanker token, applying them dynamically via updateDynamicLPFee on each swap. Collects protocol fees via delta manipulation in both beforeSwap and afterSwap, supports optional MEV protection modules (active for up to 2 minutes post-launch), and triggers LP locker fee claims on every swap.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a configurable fixed LP fee override (default 8%) on every swap via the dynamic fee override mechanism, and optionally collects a protocol fee share from swaps by minting ERC6909 balance claims to a liquidity manager for reinvestment.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(). Implements no swap-related logic.

hook.name: RuneMarketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization to authorized addresses, enforces per-pool pause controls settable by an OPERATOR_ROLE admin, collects a configurable percentage fee on swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, and notifies an IOrderManager of tick movements after each swap to settle limit orders.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via a liquidity bootstrapper. All swap and liquidity callbacks are pure no-ops; the hook's only active logic is the afterInitialize flag and a separate initializePools() entry point.

hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Stonk protocol pools that gates swaps to NYSE trading hours, permanently locks protocol liquidity, enforces a per-swap size cap, and withholds a flat fee from the asset leg via delta returns instead of the native LP fee.

hook.name: DeadBuybackHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 5% WETH fee on all swap directions and types (exact-input and exact-output) in a WETH/DEAD token pool, splitting fees 50/50 between a team wallet and a permissionless buyback-and-burn mechanism that executes every 10 taxed swaps.

hook.name: PackedHook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to addresses registered as curves in a factory registry via the `beforeInitialize` callback. Has no swap callbacks; once a pool is initialized, it behaves as a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1% base fee plus an optional creator tax (up to 10%) denominated in the payment token side of each swap. Fee proceeds are split between an immutable protocol recipient and a per-pool creator fee recipient via PoolManager token credits. Pool registration is gated to a factory address and liquidity additions are restricted to a position manager.

hook.name: EthicsV4HookProxy
hook.description: A minimal ERC-1967 proxy whose address is CREATE2-mined to encode Uniswap v4 hook permission bits. All calls are delegated to a separate implementation contract stored at the ERC-1967 slot. The implementation source is not verified or available for inspection.

hook.name: CrossDexHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that holds no liquidity and fulfills every swap by routing through registered external venues. Supports exact-input only, blocks liquidity provision, and charges a configurable owner-controlled markup on each fill.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad pools that restricts pool initialization to a designated launchpad address (via afterInitialize) and emits a PoolSwap event on every swap for off-chain indexing. No hook deltas are taken and swap execution is otherwise unmodified.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a WETH-denominated trade fee on every swap through registered pools, splitting accrued fees between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury per pool config.

hook.name: CASHCATSTR
hook.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20 token that acts as a native-tax Uniswap v4 hook for its bound ETH/token pool, collecting configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 10%) on the ETH side of each swap. Collected tax is routed to a controller contract for processing and distribution to token holders.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: A launch hook for WETH/token pairs that applies configurable protocol fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), denominated in WETH.
