An elevated 85% sniper fee is enforced during the first 30 seconds after pool registration. Pools must be registered by a designated factory contract; swaps on unregistered pools revert.

hook.name: HookedHook
hook.description: A shared fee-collection hook for MainToken/USDG and MainToken/ETH listings that charges configurable buy/sell fees (in basis points) in afterSwap via delta returns, distributing proceeds between a fee collector and an ops wallet. Supports multiple listings, fee-exempt addresses, and rejects exact-output swaps.

hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for klik.finance that charges market-cap-tiered fees (0.10%–1.00%) on token swaps, split between a platform treasury and the token creator. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims to support single-sided launch pools and flushed on subsequent swaps. Includes launch-block locking and per-origin anti-snipe buy caps in USD for the first few blocks after pool deployment.

hook.name: AgenEngineHook
hook.description: A shared programmable-fee Uniswap v4 hook that reads per-market rules on every swap, applies a configurable fee (optionally tiered by trade size and direction, in either token), overrides the pool LP fee to zero, and routes collected fees to market-specific vaults via ERC-6909 claims.

hook.name: VectisHook
hook.description: A shared hook for all Vectis pools that restricts pool initialization to the LaunchFactory address and liquidity additions to the Locker address. Swaps are fully unrestricted; the hook has no swap flags, no dynamic fee, and no delta modifications.

hook.name: Lev7FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% buy fee in feeToken, sent to a treasury. Exact-in buys are charged in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; exact-out buys are charged in afterSwap via AfterSwapDelta. Also maintains an on-chain tick oracle for fee pools with a configurable observation interval.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization to a single designated launchpad address, preventing front-running of pool creation for token launches. It is not in the swap path and runs only once per pool, at initialization.

hook.name: DoorsHook
hook.description: Locks the pool to a designated claim router until the owner opens trading or a scheduled timestamp passes; then takes a flat 1% ETH fee on all swaps, accumulating fees as ERC-6909 claims on the hook and flushing them to a dev wallet on each subsequent trade.

hook.name: RobinhoodEthUsdgV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Immutable token launch hook for Robinhood Chain that creates TOKEN/ETH or TOKEN/USDG pools with permanently locked liquidity priced via a WETH/USDG TWAP oracle. In beforeSwap, it matches stored token LP fees against incoming buy orders at the current pool tick before they reach the AMM.

hook.name: VoltHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Volt launchpad that collects a flat 1% swap fee on registered tokens and routes it entirely to the token's founder via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta adjustments. Founders accumulate earnings on-chain and withdraw via claimEarnings().

hook.name: PairV5LaunchV2NativeFeeHook
hook.description: Observation-only hook that records tick observations and swap counts on each swap to maintain a 30-minute TWAP oracle for launchpad-registered V4 pools. Exposes price quote functions from the TWAP; pools must be registered by a trusted registrar before swaps are accepted.

hook.name: GemHook
hook.description: A launch-platform hook for the Gem Factory that collects configurable protocol fees and per-token creator taxes on swaps through registered token/quote pairs. Fees are taken from the quote-token amount in beforeSwap or afterSwap and distributed to token creators as claimable balances.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that gates pool creation to a factory, blocks all third-party liquidity adds/removes, and charges configurable fees on the quote currency with a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge split among creator, platform, and optional referrer.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: Quote-gated Uniswap v4 hook that requires a cryptographic signature from a designated quote signer for each exact-input swap. Validates exchange rate bounds and nonce in beforeSwap; in afterSwap, captures any output exceeding the signed maximum exchange rate by minting ERC6909 tokens to itself, claimable by authorized accounts.

hook.name: OrbitHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Orbit token launch platform that collects protocol fees on swaps of registered launched tokens, redirecting fee amounts from pool output via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Applies a higher snipe tax during the first N blocks after launch; fees accrue to token creators and are claimable via the hook contract.

hook.name: v4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Shared swap-fee hook for the v4.fun launchpad. Charges ETH fees on buys (deducted from input in beforeSwap) and sells (deducted from output in afterSwap) using a volatility-adjusted rate that scales linearly between a pool's registered baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A single-pool launch hook with permanently locked liquidity that charges a time-decaying opening fee on swap inputs in both directions, crediting fees as ERC-6909 claims redeemable to a FeeVault. Also tracks a 24-hour time-weighted average high-price reference for use by external components such as a Dip Defender.

hook.name: KnoxHook
hook.description: Gates swaps on a `launched` boolean set by a designated launchpad contract, blocking trading until initial liquidity is seeded. The afterSwap callback records on-chain swap statistics (volume in each direction, trade count, last block) for use as an external index.

hook.name: AMT-1 Canonical Market Hook
hook.description:
Immutable custom-accounting Uniswap v4 hook for AMT-1 markets.
Routes exact-input swaps through deterministic mint and burn pricing
without LP liquidity or a secondary pool price.
Github: https://github.com/Amt-Protocol/amt-1/

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap and afterSwap callbacks that return deltas. The implementation contract source was not available for analysis; classification of fee, access control, and custom swap data requirements is based on address flags only.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $REEFGUARD token that applies a fixed 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells), always collected in native ETH (currency0) and forwarded to an immutable fee recipient address via return deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap.

hook.name: ArcanaHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the ARCANA token launch that enforces temporal buy/sell locks (7-day buy lock, 1-day sell lock) via beforeSwap, with an owner-managed exempt allowlist for bypassing restrictions. Also maintains a Uniswap v3-style TWAP oracle by recording pool tick observations in afterSwap.

hook.name: DropFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a DROP/ETH pool that charges a flat 1% ETH fee on every swap. On buys (ETH→DROP), the fee is deducted from ETH input via a beforeSwap delta; on sells (DROP→ETH), it is deducted from ETH output via an afterSwap delta. Exact-output swaps are disabled.

hook.name: HookedV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for MainToken/USDG trading pairs that collects fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta: 10% on buys (6.5% to a rewards collector, 2% to a jackpot, 1.5% to an ops wallet) and 3.5% on sells (2% to jackpot, 1.5% to ops). Liquidity provision is restricted to the owner and a configurable position manager.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Levies a flat 1% protocol fee in native ETH on every swap of a native-ETH/token pool, split 70% to a treasury and 30% to a per-pool creator address registered by a launch factory. Fees are accrued in-contract using PoolManager custom accounting deltas (beforeSwap and afterSwap) and withdrawn separately.

hook.name: MinimalDiamondCallBackProxy
hook.description: An ERC-2535 Diamond proxy hook built on the Crane framework that delegates calls to registered facets by function selector. The hook has beforeSwap with delta return capability, plus beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, and beforeDonate flags; actual swap logic resides in unverified implementation facets.

hook.name: ZeroHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that charges a configurable BPS fee on the ETH side of every swap in factory-registered token-ETH pools. Fees are taken from the pool manager and routed to a factory contract for distribution to token creators.

hook.name: StonkBrokerHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token pools that charges a configurable flat fee (up to 5%) in ETH on every swap. On buys (ETH in), the fee is deducted from the input via beforeSwap delta; on sells (ETH out), from the output via afterSwap delta. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool recipient address during the swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: DegenV3Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for DEGEN token launches on Robinhood chain that applies a time-decaying swap fee (up to 79% in the first 30 seconds post-launch, settling to a permanent 1%), split among an operating treasury, a DEGEN buyback vault, and a per-pool creator beneficiary. Fees are accumulated as ERC-6909 claims and can be flushed permissionlessly.

hook.name: MonkeyFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-sensitive fee hook for native ETH/token pools that collects ETH fees (1%–7.3%) directly via BeforeSwapDelta on buys and AfterSwapDelta on sells. The fee scales between a configurable base and maximum based on the previous swap's tick movement. Exact-output swaps are blocked; only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag active (implemented as a no-op). Includes a separate initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial tick. Swap behavior is entirely vanilla.

hook.name: GeysirHook
hook.description: Initializer hook for the GEYSIR token that calls token.start() once when the pool is initialized via afterInitialize. Has no swap, liquidity, or fee logic — all other callbacks are inert stubs with their flag bits unset.

hook.name: ZentralOfficialFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a flat per-pool fee (0.25%–5%, fixed forever at registration) on exact-input swaps by taking fees from input and/or output currencies via poolManager.take(), forwarding them directly to a per-pool fee recipient wallet on every swap with no accrual or claim step.

hook.name: Clanker Static Fee Hook (V2)
hook.description: A Clanker v4 hook that applies directional static LP fees: different fee rates for clanker-token vs paired-token swap directions. On each swap, it calls updateDynamicLPFee to enforce the configured static rate for that direction.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a configurable block-number-based anti-sniper gate that blocks swaps until a set number of blocks after pool launch. In afterSwap, it redirects a configurable fee (platform + creator basis points) from the unspecified swap output into per-currency balances, with an optional buyback-burn that sends an additional token slice to a burn address on buy swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Implements IHooks with only afterInitialize enabled; the afterInitialize callback is a pure no-op. Provides a separate external initializePools() function that records the initial tick by calling an external liquidity bootstrapper contract (ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper). All other hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: SkhoodHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to callers recognized as valid curves by the Factory contract. Swaps are unrestricted and behave identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a per-pool configurable fee on every swap, always denominated in WETH, using beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta mechanics. Fees accrue to immutable per-pool project and protocol treasury addresses and are distributed via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled (no-op). Provides a permissionless initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the pool's initial tick.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Collects a platform swap fee on every trade and splits it between the token creator and treasury, with the creator's share further split into a claimable payout and an automatic buyback-and-burn. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the first N blocks after launch and a time-limited extra fee on sells from the deployer address.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered fee hook for launched tokens where buy fees are charged as a dynamic LP fee override and exact-input sell fees are taken by the hook via afterSwapReturnsDelta and accumulated for later release to a locker. Exact-output sells are rejected. Pools must be registered by a factory before fee logic activates.

hook.name: JoltHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Jolt token launchpad that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Includes an anti-snipe mechanism that charges elevated fees for early buys within a configurable number of blocks after token launch, with fees routed to token creators and claimable on-demand.

hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: A multi-strategy hook for USDG/token pools that enforces owner-gated pool initialization and liquidity management, applies a time-decaying fee curve on swaps (starting high at launch and decaying to a resting rate), and splits collected fees between an ops wallet and a protocol fee collector contract via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: StonkbrokerFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that extracts a fixed 40% fee on all swaps in $STONKBROKER-paired pools: 40% of the input on buys (via BeforeSwapDelta) and 40% of the output on sells (via AfterSwapDelta). Only exactInput swaps are supported; fees accrue as ERC-6909 claim tokens redeemable by the owner.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH fee on every swap in both directions using return-delta accounting. Each pool has an immutable per-pool fee config (feePips, projectTreasury, protocolTreasury) registered once by a permissioned launcher; accrued WETH is distributed via a permissionless claim() function.

hook.name: CoilHook
hook.description: An ERC-20 launchpad token whose beforeSwap hook skims a fixed percentage fee (configurable up to 5%) from every swap using the beforeSwapReturnsDelta pattern, then distributes it among a protocol wallet, token holders via a MasterChef-style dividend accumulator, and a platform buy-and-burn treasury. Ownership is renounced after pool seeding, making the fee split immutable.

hook.name: OurHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook (3% buy, 6% sell) that deducts fees from the unspecified currency on every swap and transfers them directly to a timelocked treasury address via afterSwapReturnsDelta. The treasury address is owner-controlled with a 3-day timelock.

hook.name: JetstreamHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable fee (up to 3%) on the ETH leg of every swap, splitting proceeds among a pool creator, a buyback wallet, and a platform wallet. It gates liquidity additions until a pool is registered by the factory, preventing griefing attacks during pool initialization.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Levies a flat 1% protocol fee in native ETH on every swap of a native-ETH/token pool, using BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to take the fee via PoolManager custom accounting. Fees are split between a treasury (10% default, up to 40% max) and a per-pool creator address (minimum 60%), accrued in-contract and withdrawn on demand.

hook.name: BellV4Factory
hook.description: A permissionless factory that launches fixed-supply ERC20 tokens into native-ETH Uniswap v4 pools with permanently locked one-sided liquidity. Uses the beforeInitialize hook solely to reject unauthorized pool initialization by third parties; swaps and liquidity operations have no hook callbacks.

hook.name: UnifiedFeeHook
hook.description: Manages platform and creator fees for curated token launches (exact-input only). On buys (native → token), deducts platform and creator fees from input pre-swap; on sells (token → native), burns a portion of tokens pre-swap and extracts a platform fee from native output post-swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with an afterInitialize permission (callback is a no-op). Pool initialization and initial tick recording are performed by a separate `initializePools()` function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: WildV4InitGateHook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization by requiring a designated registrar (set once by owner) to pre-authorize each PoolId; authorization is consumed on use. Swaps and liquidity operations are unaffected by this hook.

hook.name: PhantomHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps of registered tokens, distributing fees to token creators. Includes block-number-based anti-snipe protection that charges elevated fees during the initial blocks after a token's launch.

hook.name: Doppler
hook.description: Uniswap v4 pool initializer that distributes liquidity across multiple positions using a bonding curve (Multicurve). Supports dynamic LP fees, optional Doppler Hook callbacks on initialization and swaps, and fee collection via afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: TwinHook
hook.description: Singleton hook shared by Twin launch pools. Restricts pool initialization to a registered launcher; charges configurable buy/sell taxes on swaps via afterSwapReturnDelta, sending proceeds to a vault. Maintains per-pool TWAP and block-start tick snapshots for manipulation resistance.

hook.name: CoalaHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for COALA token launches that charges a fixed 1% tax on the WETH (base asset) side of all swaps, minting the tax as ERC-6909 WETH claims to the launched token contract. Only factory-registered pools may be initialized or swapped through this hook.

hook.name: SniperAuction
hook.description: Anti-snipe fee hook that charges a linearly decaying buy-side fee (configurable up to 99%) during a short launch window (5–30s), then zero fee afterwards. Fee proceeds are taken directly from WETH input via BeforeSwapDelta and distributed 70% to the token creator / 30% to the platform once a 0.01 WETH threshold accumulates.

hook.name: LunchTaxHookPair
hook.description: ERC1967 proxy wrapping a Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 5% per side) via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, accruing fees per pool in the quote token and distributing them to recipients through a pull-based ledger with optional holder-rewards routing.

hook.name: EcoTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable per-pool creator tax on every swap in registered taxed markets. Exact-output swaps are taxed upfront in beforeSwap (grossed up to match the effective rate), while exact-input swaps are taxed in afterSwap on actual output produced. Tax proceeds are sent to the registered market address via IEcoTaxSink.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook for Uniswap v4 that manages token launches with a custom AMM curve. Enforces a 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, applies a decaying anti-snipe fee on buys, collects quote-denominated fees, and automatically graduates to a standard full-range pool (setting a fixed LP fee via updateDynamicLPFee) when the curve is completed.

hook.name: FlowPadCurveHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve hook for FlowPad token launches that places the entire curve supply as a one-sided concentrated liquidity position. Charges ETH fees with anti-sniper decay via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, blocks early buys during a configurable snipe-guard window, and graduates the pool (lifts max-wallet cap, starts creator vest) when the curve fully sells out.

hook.name: SignitoHook
hook.description: A per-token launch hook that collects a 2% protocol fee on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, routing fees to a fee vault recorder. Liquidity is locked after initial seeder funding — only the designated seeder address may add liquidity thereafter.

hook.name: CardwallFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Cardwall token launches that charges ETH fees on swaps using a volatility-based dynamic rate (1%–7%). Buy fees are deducted from ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales linearly with the previous swap's tick movement and is sent immediately to the pool's configured fee recipient.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always collected in ETH (currency0). In beforeSwap, the fee is skimmed from the specified ETH amount for buys (ETH→token); in afterSwap, it is skimmed from ETH proceeds for sells (token→ETH). Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always collected in ETH (currency0). In beforeSwap, skims the ETH fee when ETH is the specified currency; in afterSwap, skims it when ETH is the unspecified leg. Fees are sent to an immutable feeRecipient address via poolManager.take().

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that collects a configurable fee (up to 1%) on every swap in registered token pools, splitting proceeds between the token creator, the platform treasury, and up to three referral tiers. Tracks cumulative quote volume per token to signal graduation milestones.

hook.name: VenomHook
hook.description: Collects layered swap fees (protocol fee + creator buy/sell tax + time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge) on tokens registered via a companion Venom factory. Fees are denominated in the quote currency and routed to token creators for on-demand claiming.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap (returning a delta), beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeRemoveLiquidity permissions. The implementation contract was not resolved, so full logic cannot be verified.

hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for meme token launches that skims configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, overrides LP fee to 1%, and distributes collected taxes to funds, burn, dividend, and liquidity sinks. Enforces exact-input-only swaps, blocks swaps during a clearing window, and restricts third-party liquidity additions via a time-based anti-farmer lock.

hook.name: NexsetsHook
hook.description: ETH fee hook for a token launch that cycles buy and sell taxes through a 1–5% repeating schedule. Applies a 60% anti-snipe tax during a 4-second post-launch window for non-whitelisted addresses, with an admin-controlled sell-only override (up to 60%). LP is permanently locked after the one-time seed. All fees route 100% to the protocol treasury.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% tax on every swap in launchpad pools, always denominated in the pool's quote token, split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and the pool's token creator. Only pools initialized by the authorized strategy contract are taxed; swaps on unregistered pools pass through without fees.

hook.name: StrategyFeeHook
hook.description: Charges fixed 5% (500 bps) buy and sell fees on ETH-paired pools via swap delta manipulation. Fees are accumulated per pool and swept to a registered vault address by calling sweep(). Pools must be registered by a factory address before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: FriarTier
hook.description: A dynamic LP fee hook using Liquidity Book's volatility-accumulator (surge) mechanism on top of an immutable base fee tier set at deployment. Each deployment represents a single fixed base fee, making the fee tier part of the pool's on-chain identity; all fee parameters are frozen at construction with no admin controls.

hook.name: DexTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native-ETH pool pairs that charges a configurable ETH tax (capped at 5%) on every swap, forwarding the fee directly to a recipient address in the same transaction. The tax is always taken in currency0 (native ETH), applied in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency and in afterSwap otherwise.

hook.name: RobinoHook
hook.description: Observation hook for Robino graduated pools that emits events on pool initialization, liquidity changes, and swaps. Pool initialization is gated to tokens registered in the Robino factory; afterSwap only records swap data via events without modifying execution.

hook.name: HoodsHook
hook.description: Singleton ETH-fee hook for hoods.meme pools. Takes a tiered ETH fee (0.25%–1%) on every swap, scaled by fully-diluted market cap, and distributes it between a platform treasury and a per-token creator splitter. Sell exactOut swaps are rejected. Pool LP fee is 0.

hook.name: RobinhoodEthUsdgV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Immutable Uniswap v4 launch factory for TOKEN/ETH and TOKEN/USDG markets on Robinhood Chain. Deploys token-only liquidity into permanently locked positions, then intercepts swaps via beforeSwap to internally match accumulated LP fee token inventory against organic buys at the current pool tick before those buys reach the AMM.

hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that runs each coin on a concentrated bonding curve (800M tokens, ETH-paired). Enforces block+1 trading start, first-hour 2% per-wallet cap with auto-refund, decaying anti-snipe fee premium, and 70/30 creator/platform fee split. Graduates to a permanently locked full-range LP in the same pool when the curve sells out.

hook.name: FeeVaultHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools that skims a configurable share (10–50%) of each swap fee into a per-pool quote vault. Accumulated fees are distributed to token holders via Merkle-based drops, triggered either when the vault reaches a configured threshold or on a 7-day epoch cadence.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a realized-volatility fee on every swap, ranging from a base rate to a ceiling proportional to how far the previous swap moved the tick price. Fees are taken in the pool's quote currency as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep() function. Exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook that deploys concentrated LP positions across multiple configurable tick ranges (buckets) before each swap and removes them after, using ERC-4626 vault rehypothecation to earn yield on idle capital between swaps. Pool fee is static (set at deploy time); swaps can be paused per-pool by the owner.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: PmavHookQuoted (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) is a bonding curve hook for token launches on Robinhood Chain quoted in an ERC20 (USDG/stock tokens). It enforces block+1 anti-snipe, a permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund waterfall, a decaying anti-snipe fee premium, and auto-graduates pools to a locked full-range LP position once the raise target is met.

hook.name: LoopBuybackHook
hook.description: A shared hook for all Loop Trade launch pools that gates initialization to factory-registered pools, then skims a configurable buyback share of swap fees from the unspecified currency — burning tokens directly if the skim lands on the token side, or accruing quote currency for permissionless buyback-and-burn execution via executeBuyback().

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock pools that charges a configurable swap fee (0–5%, fixed at launch), split among creator, platform treasury, and a bid-wall bucket. The hook manages a single-sided liquidity "bid wall" below spot price and locks liquidity additions to the factory and itself until the pool graduates (price reaches a configured graduation tick).

hook.name: PadFeeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated pons v2 memecoin pools. Collects and distributes protocol, creator, launchpad, and charity fees from the quote leg and optional burn from the memecoin leg in each swap. Supports a decaying snipe tax on buys, optional coin-flip game integration on buys, and conditional swap access controls (relayer allowlist, wallet balance gates, fixed-digit amount enforcement).

hook.name: WolfHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that runs a 24-hour WOLF/SPY AMM sale with dynamic fees (1% on buys, 0% on sells), then post-launch opens a floor redemption pool where WOLF holders can burn tokens for SPY at a fixed price backed by sale proceeds.

hook.name: LootHookV4
hook.description: Meme token launchpad hook that records oracle price observations, enforces per-origin cumulative buy caps during the first hour after launch, writes transient attestation data for on-chain game credit, dispatches token graduation, and executes an in-swap crank for fee collection and protocol maintenance.

hook.name: TaxGuard
hook.description: A tax-collecting hook that skims a configurable buy/sell tax from exact-input swaps and routes proceeds to a designated tax receiver, while applying a dynamic LP fee override via the 0x400000 bit. Tax rates are owner-adjustable downward only.

hook.name: SVMHook
hook.description: A gamified trading hook that charges a percentage fee on every ETH swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, assigns buyers to competing teams (STOCKS vs MEMES), and distributes the collected pot to the winning team at the end of each round.

hook.name: AgiV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated AGI v2 launchpad pools that collects a fee cut (hookFeeBps + creatorTaxBps) on every swap via afterSwap, deducting the fee from the pool manager's flash-accounting ledger and accruing it to per-pool pending balances, which can later be swept and split between protocol, buyback-and-lock vault, and creator.

hook.name: PaperHandsHook
hook.description: Taxes PAPER token sells during "panic mode" — when the pool price is ≥15% below the tracked sqrtPrice peak — by burning 20% of the sold PAPER to 0xdEaD. Buys are never taxed; sells are always permitted but subjected to the burn tax in panic mode.

hook.name: EdgeHook
hook.description: Fee hook for token launches on the Edge protocol. Charges a decaying anti-dump sell tax (linear decay over a configurable block window) plus configurable hook and creator buy/sell taxes on registered token swaps. All collected fees are routed to token creators via a claimable balance mapping.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools that collects a hook fee and creator tax on every swap via afterSwap return delta, then batches pending fees for distribution to protocol, creator, and a buyback-and-lock vault through internal pool swaps (ISP style).

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that captures swap fees (1–5%) entirely in ETH and distributes them instantly per-trade. Supports five fee-distribution modes: direct recipient payouts with optional buyback-and-burn, stock rewards (buys a configured stock token for holders), ETH staking payouts (robin mode), weighted lottery draws, or auto-liquidity provisioning around the current price.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook for meme coins that enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap, and a quote-denominated protocol fee, then automatically graduates the pool to a standard 1% Uniswap v4 LP pool when the curve fills. Supports an optional hookData refund beneficiary that is safely ignored when absent.

hook.name: UsaginoFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for ETH/token Uniswap v4 pools that charges ETH fees on buys (taken from input in beforeSwap) and sells (taken from output in afterSwap), with the rate scaling from a configurable base to a maximum (both within 0.3%–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient; the owner can retune base/max fee per pool within the hard band.

hook.name: RetardV1227PoolHook
hook.description: Hook for a creator token launchpad protocol that manages Uniswap v4 liquidity positions for creator token markets, restricts pool initialization and liquidity modifications to the protocol, and reports the current sqrtPrice to the protocol after each public swap via onPublicSwap.

hook.name: MidasGoldHook
hook.description: ERC-20/ERC-20 pool hook that collects a fixed fee always denominated in currency0. For zeroForOne swaps the fee is deducted from the input in beforeSwap; for oneForZero swaps it is deducted from the currency0 output in afterSwap. Only exact-input swaps are supported. The fee rate and recipient are immutable at deployment, and the hook only permits the fixed token pair set at construction.

hook.name: PumpFeeHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve graduation hook that selects an LP fee tier dynamically based on the token's current market cap (derived from the pool's spot price and total supply), and deducts additional creator and protocol fees from the trader's input currency on every swap.

hook.name: FewHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook for few.fun that charges a fixed fee (≤2%) on the quote asset for every swap, split between a pool creator and an immutable protocol treasury. All economic parameters are set at construction and cannot be changed; includes an optional temporal guard that caps single-buy quote size for a configurable window after pool launch.

hook.name: IMX5V4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for IMX5 token pools that charges a 2.5% trade tax on the IMX5 leg of exact-input swaps (intercepted via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas) plus a proportional LP fee share, accumulating ERC-6909 claims redeemable by an authorized bridge. Only owner-approved pools containing the IMX5 token are permitted to swap.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Taxes every swap on a single fixed pool in the quote currency, splitting proceeds between LP dividend holders (via a vault sink), the launch creator, and the platform. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims and are settled and distributed to holders at the start of the next swap.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch protocol's core hook for memecoin pool launches on Uniswap v4. Implements an Internal Swap Pool that fills swaps from accumulated fee inventory before hitting the AMM, captures and distributes fees to creators, protocol, and a bid wall, records TWAP oracle observations per swap, and optionally routes referrer fees when an address is encoded in hookData.

hook.name: V4rcadeFeeHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook with dynamic LP fees and an owner-adjustable base fee. Restricts liquidity to allowlisted providers in full-range positions only. Optionally applies fee discounts via EIP-712-signed vouchers passed in hookData. Collects a fee from token-to-ETH exact-input swaps by donating back to the pool in afterSwap.

hook.name: LustHook
hook.description: Collects swap fees for enrolled tokens, applying a configurable flat rate and an elevated peak rate during an early launch window. Fees are taken directly from swap amounts via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and accumulated for distribution to registered token devotees.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; pool liquidity setup is triggered externally via initializePools(), which calls a configurable ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap positions and record the initial tick.

hook.name: FablesRampETH
hook.description: A dynamic-fee Uniswap v4 hook that applies a per-pool configurable flat fee override in beforeSwap, with optional directional premiums and TTL-bounded admin fee pokes. This ETH variant additionally supports native ETH as currency0.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the BuilDeFi protocol that applies configurable buy/sell taxes on swaps, manages a fee fulfillment queue to convert collected protocol fees into ETH for distribution, and maintains a truncated geometric oracle for TWAP-based pricing. Trading is gated on per-token full initialization status.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook with oracle-based dynamic fee adjustment, full-range liquidity management, and fee reinvestment. Uses a truncated geometric oracle to track tick movement and adjusts surge fees accordingly. Charges both a declared protocol fee and an undisclosed additional 0.10% surcharge on every swap.

hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook (pmav.fun V2) that creates coins with 1B fixed supply trading on a concentrated bonding curve. Enforces block+1 anti-snipe, first-hour per-wallet 2% cap with auto-refund, and 2% flat fees split among platform (0.25%), creator (0.25–0.75%), and a dividend treasury. Graduation converts the curve position to a permanently locked full-range LP in the same pool.

hook.name: Rivers LaunchHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Rivers launch pools that manages a phased token launch lifecycle (seeding, bootstrapping, graduation, settlement). Applies dynamic LP fees, collects protocol and creator fees on trades, and restricts swaps and liquidity based on pool phase and controller authorization.

hook.name: HookrModularHookV6
hook.description: A modular Uniswap v4 hook that dispatches beforeSwap/afterSwap to an immutable accounting kernel via delegatecall, applying LP fee overrides and quote-take fees from pluggable frozen modules, with optional per-swap arbitrage correction payloads for authorized routers.

hook.name: HoodlumPadHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for HoodlumPad V2 memecoin launches. Skims a fixed 1% fee from memecoin swaps (split 50/50 between creator and protocol treasury) as ERC-6909 claim tokens, maintains a self-hosted 200-slot TWAP oracle, and provides a batched fee-conversion mechanism to swap accrued memecoin fees into the quote asset.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable percentage fee on every swap for registered launchpad token pools, splitting proceeds between the token creator and platform treasury, with optional referral rewards distributed via an external registry.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses afterInitialize to support pool setup via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. It has no active swap, liquidity modification, or donation hooks.

hook.name: QuotronFloorHook
hook.description: Fee engine for QUOTRON floor pools that overrides LP fees to zero and charges a tiered fee on the stock side via return deltas. During a 6-hour launch window, whitelisted swappers pay 3%; holders of the 100 FCFS reduced-fee spots pay 10%; all others pay 40%. After the window, everyone pays 3%. Each fee is split four ways: ~2/3 to a reflections engine, ~1/6 to a STONKBROKER buy-and-burn pot, ~1/6 to an LP-reinvest pot, and ~5% to a creator address paid directly per swap.

hook.name: PumpV4StockHook
hook.description: A fee-and-liquidity hook for token launches quoted in an arbitrary ERC-20. Charges a 2% fee on both buy (via beforeSwap delta) and sell (via afterSwap delta) swap directions, restricts liquidity additions to a single factory-authorized initial seed, and permanently locks liquidity removal by reverting in beforeRemoveLiquidity.

hook.name: Ctrl Immutable Launch Hook
hook.description: Immutable, non-proxy launchpad hook for Ctrl tokens paired with native ETH. Collects a fixed 1% ETH fee using swap return deltas for creator rewards, referrals, treasury and a graduation bounty. Empty swap hookData is accepted; attribution data is optional. Core LP fee is zero. Only the initial factory seed liquidity can be added, and its position is permanently locked. Graduation at 4.2 ETH net principal releases the bounty without migrating liquidity.

hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: A fee hook that takes 1.5% of every swap in ETH, routing proceeds to token holders (via a dividend token's fundPot), the pool creator, a platform address, and an ops address. Buy-side fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims in beforeSwap and redeemed on the next sell or via a permissionless collect() call.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. All hook callbacks are no-ops that return their selectors. The contract also exposes an `initializePools()` function that calls a liquidity bootstrapper to record an initial tick, but this is not part of the hook callback logic.

hook.name: LockitcoinRobinhoodFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools charging 1–5% fees on every swap in native ETH. Buy fees are deducted from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees are taken from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales between a per-pool base and max based on the previous swap's tick movement, and is sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient.

hook.name: LeftoverSupplyHook
hook.description: Manages a fixed 300M token reserve per pool, held as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager. Pool initialization is gated to a factory address; a designated receiver can claim any portion of the remaining reserve at any time.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to the factory address, preventing front-running attacks that would cause the factory's launch transaction to revert. Has no swap-time flags, so the PoolManager never invokes it during trades; swap behavior is identical to a vanilla Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages memecoin launches on the Flaunch platform, featuring an internal swap pool for pre-swap fee conversion, temporal gating for scheduled token launches, a BidWall for buy-side liquidity support, and fee distribution to protocol, creators, and optional referrers.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (up to 1%) on every swap for registered launchpad tokens, splitting proceeds between token creators and a platform treasury with optional multi-tier referral payouts. Uses BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta to route fees from the pool, and records quote volume to a factory contract for token graduation tracking.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Taxes every swap on a single fixed pool, collecting fees always in the designated quote currency regardless of swap direction. Fees are split between dividend holders (distributed via a sink contract), the token creator, and the platform; claims are accrued as ERC-6909 tokens and settled into real tokens on the next swap or via an external sweep call.

hook.name: PulseHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a token launchpad that charges a 1% flat protocol fee on swaps involving factory-whitelisted tokens. Fees are extracted via the beforeSwap/afterSwap delta return mechanism and forwarded to a configurable revenue wallet.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to a designated factory address to prevent front-running of the initialize call. Has no swap-time hooks; swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: A launch hook for tokenized stock or WETH pairs that applies a time-decaying dynamic fee, starting at a high launch rate and settling at a 1.7% floor. Fees are split among creator, treasury, holder reflections, and permanently-locked LP compounding; pool initialization is restricted to the factory.

hook.name: Friar
hook.description: A volatility-responsive dynamic LP fee hook that adjusts swap fees using the Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator mechanism, surging fees with recent price movement and decaying back after configured windows. All parameters are immutable with no owner or upgrade mechanism.

hook.name: Friar
hook.description: Volatility-responsive dynamic LP fee hook using the Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator model. Sets per-swap LP fees based on recent price movement — low base fee in calm markets that surges with volatility and decays over configurable windows. No owner, no upgradeability; all parameters are immutable.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the pool's initial tick after initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. The hook has no swap, liquidity, or donate callbacks active; it only holds the afterInitialize flag.

hook.name: OreHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Bitcoin-inspired proof-of-work mining protocol over an ETH/HBTC pool. Buy-side swaps pay an ETH toll (1–10%) that credits hashpower toward HBTC block rewards; tolls flow into a Burn Net that places maker limit orders and burns HBTC. Trading is open from deployment with no temporal lock.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized real-world asset (equity) pools. Adjusts LP fees based on market session (open, overnight, closed) using block.timestamp and a configurable market calendar, with per-pool fee caps and operator-poke overrides for transient corrections.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only the afterInitialize permission bit set; the afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub. The contract also exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting tick. The hook does not affect swap or liquidity-modification execution in any way.

hook.name: FlareHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for the Flare token launchpad. Collects protocol fees and creator buy/sell taxes on swaps for registered launched tokens, with a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys during the first N blocks after launch. Fees are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: NockV6PoolInitializationHook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization and pre-graduation liquidity additions to an authorized sale contract; enforces price-floor constraints in afterSwap (reverts if price falls below start FDV or if a target-price crossing is reversed); maintains a 64-slot TWAP oracle with a 30-minute window updated on each swap.

hook.name: RobFeeHook
hook.description: Fixed 2% swap fee on the native-ETH side of the pool, both directions, distributed instantly to four fixed recipients. Fee rate is a constant; only the distribution split is owner-adjustable. Non-upgradeable, no pool-creation or liquidity restrictions

hook.name: TollHookV1
hook.description: Anti-sniper fee hook charging a flat buy fee and tiered sell fees based on hold duration (sniper, warm, holder, diamond tiers). Fees are configured at pool registration and are immutable; holder entry times are tracked via weighted average and updated on buys. Fees are split between a per-pool creator reward vault and a protocol fee recipient.

hook.name: OsbournHook
hook.description: A swap fee hook for the Osbourn token launchpad that charges configurable fees on enrolled token pools, with an elevated anti-snipe fee applied to early buys within a configurable post-launch block window. Collected fees accrue to token creators and can be claimed in the quote currency.

hook.name: ModularLaunchpadHook
hook.description: A configurable Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that gates pool initialization to a factory and routes launch token swap fees into a 70/30 creator/protocol split. Deployed in "universal" economics mode: the hook holds the seed LP position and fees are collected via a permissionless harvest() call rather than afterSwap. Optional modules (anti-snipe buy caps, JIT defense, buy throttle, creator-fee burn, liquidity deepening) are baked in at deploy time as immutable config.

hook.name: StockFeeHook
hook.description: A swap fee hook for TOKEN/REWARD_STOCK pools that charges a configurable buy and sell fee always in REWARD_STOCK, minting collected fees as ERC-6909 claims to a distributor contract. Pools not containing REWARD_STOCK pass through untaxed. All fee parameters (buyFeeBps, sellFeeBps) are immutable after deployment.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: An immutable launchpad hook that collects fees exclusively in the pool's configured payment token, applying a fixed 1% base fee plus an optional creator tax (0–10%). Fee proceeds are split between a protocol recipient and a per-pool creator recipient via dynamic LP fee override and BeforeSwap/AfterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: TweetPadV11UniversalHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a creator fee (1%) and protocol fee (0.5%) from the unspecified side of each swap via afterSwap return delta, with a 10% buy surcharge applied during the first 60 seconds after pool initialization. Accrued fees are held by the hook and claimable by the registered pool creator and a protocol recipient.

hook.name: RobinhoodEthUsdgV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Immutable Uniswap v4 launch hook on Robinhood Chain that creates TOKEN/ETH and TOKEN/USDG pools with permanently locked token-only liquidity. Intercepts buy-side swaps to fill orders from accumulated LP fee token inventory at the current pool tick price before routing the remainder through the AMM.

hook.name: YardkeepersFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a volatility-based ETH fee on every swap for ETH/token pools. Buy fees are taken from ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from ETH output in afterSwap. The fee rate scales dynamically between a configured base and max (1%–7%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap, with fees sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient.

hook.name: TheMint
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing ERC-402 coin minting with tiered seigniorage fees (25% buy / 99% sell at launch, decaying to 5% / 25% over 15 minutes) collected in the quote currency via return-delta. A moneyer-controlled boolean gate blocks all swaps until `openTheMint()` is called; each buy updates the coin's strike price to the all-in execution price paid.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that extracts configurable ETH swap fees and routes them to creator, buyback/burn, rewards, and platform wallets. Features a time-limited antisniper window with elevated fees during the launch window and permanently locks LP removal (beforeRemoveLiquidity always reverts).

hook.name: DegenHoodV4HookV2
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for WETH-paired token launch pools that deducts time-varying hook fees on WETH-denominated swaps, splitting proceeds between a per-pool beneficiary (deposited into a FeeLocker) and a protocol operating treasury. Pool initialization and registration are gated to a factory.

hook.name: MintFastHook
hook.description: A launchpad protocol fee hook that charges a fixed 2% fee on the ETH side of every swap using Uniswap v4 return deltas. Fees are banked as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and harvested by the launchpad contract. Pool initialization is restricted to the launchpad address.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: LaunchpadHook charges a configurable ETH fee (0.3%–1.5%) on every swap across all four exact-in/exact-out quadrants, taking fees via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns. Sells during an optional launch window pay a higher linearly-decaying fee; fees are distributed among the token creator, a land fund, and a treasury.

hook.name: VelvetHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Velvet token launchpad that collects fees on swaps using return deltas. Buy swaps are charged a configurable hook fee plus a per-token buy tax; sell swaps by non-creator addresses have their entire quote output taken as fee, effectively restricting selling to the token creator only.

hook.name: ERC8404FeeHook (Hoodroids)
hook.description:
A Uniswap v4 custom-accounting hook for the Hoodroids/ETH pool.
It collects a quote-currency-only swap fee through beforeSwap/afterSwap
deltas and sends it to an immutable fee collector. The owner may only
reduce the fee; it can never be increased.

hook.name: DirectionalFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable per-direction fee (in basis points, up to 5%) on each swap's unspecified currency via afterSwap, forwarding proceeds to a per-pool vault. Rates are separately configurable for zeroForOne and oneForZero, take effect after a 5-minute delay, and can be suspended globally by the owner via a pause flag without blocking swaps.

hook.name: RallyHookU4
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a bonding curve token launch platform. Acts as the sole liquidity provider, enforces a dynamic anti-snipe fee that decays over time, and charges quote-denominated fees on sells via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Transitions pools from CURVE to BREAKOUT phase when the price target is reached.

hook.name: DescendingFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a descending anti-snipe fee: starting at a high rate (up to 99%) held briefly after launch, then parabolically decaying to a configured steady-state rate. The fee is taken in the input currency via hook deltas and accrued as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager, collectible by the launcher. LP fee is always zero; donations are disabled.

hook.name: BobiFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based fee hook for BobiLaunch token launch pools. Charges ETH fees (1–7%) on buys via beforeSwap and on sells via afterSwap, scaling the fee with the tick movement of the previous swap. Only the bound factory can initialize pools; exact-output swaps are blocked; the owner can retune fees within the hard band.

hook.name: CoinbarrelAdvancedHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing custom fee accounting for Coinbarrel Advanced V3 pools. It intercepts swaps to collect configurable buy/sell fees via BeforeSwapDelta (input-side) and afterSwapReturnDelta (output-side), minting fee tokens to itself rather than transferring during swaps, while recording per-pool TWAP and organic volume observations.

hook.name: SlvrHook
hook.description: A hook for the SLVR/ETH pool that taxes exact-input swaps up to 2%: buys pay an ETH fee into a lottery jackpot pot and receive weighted tickets; sells pay a SLVR fee to in-range LP stakers. Optional hookData (address buyer, uint8 boost) enables ticket attribution and boost multipliers. Exact-output and partial fills revert.

hook.name: ZiaFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces keeper-configurable dynamic LP fees (up to 1%) and collects a bounded hook fee (up to 0.25%) in the swap's specified currency, accruing ERC-6909 claims redeemable only to an immutable treasury address.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad-style tax hook that collects a configurable fee (up to 10%) on swaps in the quote token via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapReturnDelta, then distributes the proceeds among token holders (via a dividend sink), a creator address, and a platform address.

hook.name: GoofyhoodFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based ETH fee hook for the GoofyhoodLaunch platform that charges ETH fees on buys in beforeSwap and on sells in afterSwap, scaling the fee between configurable base and max rates (1%–6.6%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: MineableToken
hook.description: A proof-of-work mineable ERC20 token implementing Uniswap v4 hooks. It charges variable swap fees (declining with mining eras via halvings) collected directly from the pool via delta returns in beforeSwap and afterSwap, and periodically auto-seeds protocol-owned liquidity into the canonical ETH/token pool as mining proceeds.

hook.name: DeadBuybackHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a WETH/DEAD token pool that charges a 5% WETH fee on buys and sells, splits fees 50/50 between a team wallet reserve and a buyback reserve, and automatically buys and burns DEAD tokens to address 0xdEaD every 15 taxed swaps.

hook.name: RawbinHookRWA
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for RWA token launches on Rawbin/Robinhood Chain. Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the factory. Applies a linearly decaying anti-snipe fee (up to 90%) during the first 30 blocks after launch via afterSwapReturnsDelta, donating collected fees back to the pool rather than to the platform.

hook.name: MINTLYNativeTaxHook
hook.description: Charges an immutable native ETH tax on swaps in a single Uniswap v4 pool via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Collected ETH is accumulated as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to a fixed recipient once a configurable threshold is reached.

hook.name: HookrModularHookV4
hook.description: A modular Uniswap v4 hook that delegates swap accounting to a pinned immutable kernel via delegatecall, supporting per-pool module stacks, dynamic LP fees, and an optional arbitrage correction mechanism that triggers nested swaps during beforeSwap/afterSwap for trusted routers.

hook.name: TweetPadV1Hook
hook.description: A token launchpad swap fee hook that charges creator (1%) and protocol (0.5%) fees on each swap, with an additional 10% early-buy creator fee during the first 60 seconds of pool initialization. Fees are taken from the pool manager via afterSwapReturnsDelta and accrued to per-address claimable balances.

hook.name: Clanker Dynamic Fee Hook (V2)
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook for Clanker pools that adjusts LP fees based on realized volatility. It simulates each swap to estimate the post-swap tick, computes a volatility accumulator from tick displacement relative to a reference tick, and calls updateDynamicLPFee with a fee that scales quadratically with volatility, bounded by configurable base and max fee parameters.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the $TIPOFF token that applies a fixed 5% fee on all swaps (both buys and sells), always collected in ETH (currency0) regardless of swap direction, and forwarded to an immutable fee recipient address via poolManager.take().

hook.name: FluxHook
hook.description: FluxHook collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, routing them to claimable balances. It applies a configurable anti-snipe fee multiplier during the initial blocks after token launch.

hook.name: InfectHook
hook.description: A minimal hook that implements afterSwap but performs no action, returning the selector with zero delta. Also exposes several pure/view utility functions that compute epidemiology-themed metrics (e.g. outbreak pulse, pathogen tier, transmission index) from address and bytes32 inputs via modular arithmetic, though these are unused in swap logic.

hook.name: AproFunLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-sensitive fee hook for AproFun Launchpad pools that charges 1–7% ETH fees on every swap, scaled dynamically by the tick movement of the previous swap. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from the ETH output in afterSwap. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound factory contract only.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to the factory address, preventing front-running of pool creation. Has no swap-time flags and performs no actions during swaps — the pool fee serves as the creator's tax mechanism.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock launches that charges a fixed per-pool swap fee (0–5%, set at launch and immutable) split 80% creator / 5% bid wall / 15% platform. It maintains a single-sided "bid wall" liquidity range just below spot price using accumulated wall fees, and locks out external liquidity providers until pool graduation.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic swap fees via a truncated geometric oracle and a DynamicFeeManager, with collected fees reinvested into a full-range liquidity position. The hook charges both an official protocol fee and an undisclosed additional 0.10% fee (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) on every swap.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook for the pmav.fun V2 platform (Robinhood Chain) using a quote ERC20 (USDG). Manages a constant-product AMM curve from token launch to graduation: enforces block+1 trading delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap refund waterfall, decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, 1% quote-denominated fees, and in-place graduation to a full-range V4 pool with dynamic LP fee.

hook.name: BlazeHook
hook.description: BlazeHook charges configurable buy and sell fees (in basis points) on swaps for tokens registered by the factory. It takes fees as BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta from the quote token, routes them to the token creator, and applies a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge during the first N blocks after launch.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% tax on every swap in strategy-created launchpad pools, denominated in the pool's quote token and split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and the pool's token creator. Tax is applied via BeforeSwap and AfterSwap return deltas depending on whether the quote is the specified or unspecified currency.

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization to a launchpad address, limits liquidity additions to an authorized locker, and permanently prevents liquidity removal by reverting any decrease in liquidity delta.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial pool tick via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only the afterInitialize flag is active; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: LootPadFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% fee on the unspecified leg of every swap in LootPad ETH-paired pools via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing ETH fees 50% to the coin creator, 37.5% to LOOT stakers, and 12.5% to a house address; coin-side fees accrue for the creator to claim separately.

hook.name: ScratchHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that takes a hardcoded 2.5% fee on the unspecified side of every swap (output for exact-input, input for exact-output) and forwards it to a configurable treasury address. The fee percentage is a constant; only the treasury recipient is owner-controlled.

hook.name: FoxyFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-adaptive ETH fee hook for FoxyLaunch pools that charges fees in native ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling between configurable base and max fee rates (1%–7%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Only the bound factory may open pools on this hook; only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: BallHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that collects a configurable fee on swaps of registered tokens, routing proceeds to token creators. Applies an elevated snipe tax (default 9%) on buys within the first 28 blocks after token launch, and a standard hook fee (default 1%) otherwise.

hook.name: VicksHook
hook.description: A launch-platform hook that charges a configurable base fee (default 1%) on swaps and an elevated anti-snipe tax (default 12%) on buys within the first 28 blocks after token creation. Taxes are taken from the pool manager and credited to token creators via a factory registry, withdrawable by creators.

hook.name: BluechipHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for BLUECHIP-category pools that implements directional swap fees (quoteToBase vs baseToQuote) with an admin-configurable platform fee split. Platform fees are extracted from exact-input and exact-output swaps and transferred to a treasury contract, with an LP fee override returned on every swap.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for launchpad-deployed tokens that extracts a configurable percentage from each swap in the quote currency and distributes it among token holders via a dividend sink, a creator address, and the launchpad platform.

hook.name: SolGodsFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a $SOLGODS/ETH pool that applies a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always collected in ETH (currency0). Fees are taken via beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency, and via afterSwap when ETH is unspecified, then forwarded to an immutable fee recipient address.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: Applies a time-based anti-snipe fee to pools: 50% flat fee for the first 4 minutes after initialization, then a permanent 3.5% LP fee floor. Fees are immutable — no admin controls or setters exist.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects swap fees split between token creators and a platform treasury, with referral fee distribution, snipe-window protection blocking early buys, and per-transaction buy caps during a configurable fair launch window.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps exceeding a fixed 100-token size cap (MAX_TRADE = 100e18). After each swap, takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee from the output currency and routes it to a hardcoded recipient address via poolManager.take().

hook.name: Flash
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing OTC buy routing (full-fill-or-skip), realized sell taxes with dynamic BPS based on price impact and low-volume signals, and multi-venue sell remainder routing for WETH-rooted token pools. Tax revenue is distributed among stakers, pool creators, and the protocol treasury.

hook.name: Rob0Hook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for Robinhood Chain that handles all swap accounting in beforeSwap, minting and burning Rob0Token against an ETH price curve. The pool holds no liquidity; the hook acts as the sole counterparty. Swaps are restricted to trusted routers and require an ABI-encoded swapper address in hookData.

hook.name: FlowHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for USDG-paired pools that taxes buy and sell swaps, routing fees to holder, LP, treasury, buyback/burn, and referral buckets via delta interception. An anti-snipe decay fee is applied to buys shortly after pool launch.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that records the initial tick after pool initialization, delegating liquidity setup to an external bootstrapper contract. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: HavenHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that intercepts swaps on registered ("moored") token pools, deducting a configurable fee (default 1%, capped at 5%) from each swap in the quote currency, and crediting accumulated fees to designated pool managers ("skippers") who can claim them via reap/reapAll.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1% tax on the WETH (base asset) side of buys and sells, minting the collected tax as a PoolManager ERC-6909 claim to the token contract. Pool initialization is gated to factory-registered pools to prevent launch DoS attacks.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the REEFGUARD token that applies a fixed 5% fee on both buys and sells, always collected in ETH (currency0), and forwarded to an immutable fee recipient address via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas.

hook.name: RandomDonationHook
hook.description: On each swap, selects a pseudo-random tiered fee from three configurable probability tiers and applies it on top of a base fee. The fee is split between LPs (via pool donation) and a fixed treasury address. Only owner-registered pools may be initialized or traded.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad fee hook that charges a configurable swap fee (in basis points) on the quote token of a dedicated pool, splitting proceeds among the creator, the launchpad platform, and liquidity holders via a dividend sink using ERC-6909 claims minted in beforeSwap and afterSwap.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that gates swaps until a scheduled activation time and collects trading fees in WETH via swap deltas. Fees follow a time-decaying anti-snipe schedule or a market-cap-decaying curve, split between protocol, creator, and partner, with the creator's share routed into buyback-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, and WETH dividends.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a flat 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells), always collected in ETH (currency0). Uses beforeSwap return delta for ETH-specified swaps and afterSwap return delta for ETH-unspecified swaps, forwarding all fees to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A managed token-launch hook that enforces a strict single-position launch flow authorized by a launch manager, collects configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5% basic, 15% utility) split among platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapDelta, and permanently disables remove-liquidity and donations.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% swap tax in the pool's quote token on every launchpad pool trade, split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and the pool's token creator, using beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas. Only pools initialized by the authorized strategy contract are taxed.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees computed from oracle-measured tick volatility and surge conditions, collects a protocol fee share from each swap input, and reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position via an integrated liquidity manager.

hook.name: RobinhoodFlashHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Robinhood's Flash ecosystem that routes swaps through OTC buy and sell paths, applies realized sell taxes, and supports perpetuals pools via delegatecall to a route module. Trading requires governance to configure protocol fees and unpause trading before any swaps can execute.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swap direction by virtual reserves: within a 10% skew band, swaps must sell the pool's heavier currency; beyond the cap, the gate inverts and only the rebalancing leg (selling the lighter side) is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps Aeon protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: StockFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable buy/sell swap tax in a designated reward stock token, minted as ERC-6909 claims to a distributor contract rather than transferred. Uses both beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to capture the fee regardless of which side is the specified currency.

hook.name: CubeHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (in basis points, 1%–10%) on swaps for factory-registered tokens in Cube Family launchpad pools. Fees are taken via BeforeSwapDelta or AfterSwapDelta and forwarded to a factory contract; when the pool manager lacks sufficient balance, fees are parked as ERC-6909 claims and flushed on the next eligible swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only an afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. The contract also exposes an initializePools() function (not a hook callback) that calls a liquidity bootstrapper to record an initial tick in the hook's storage.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade and splits them between the token creator and treasury. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and routes a configurable share of creator fees into automatic buyback-and-burn of the launched token.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Mixpad token launches that collects a platform swap fee on every trade, splitting it between the token creator and treasury. Includes a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the blocks immediately after launch, a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and auto-executes a buyback-and-burn of the launched token using a configurable portion of the creator's fee share.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools. In afterSwap, it takes a hook fee and per-pool creator tax from the unspecified swap output, accumulating them as pending balances. A trusted operator can later sweep these fees, optionally converting memecoin-denominated balances to the quote currency via internal pool swaps, then distributing proceeds to protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback vault.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH fee on every swap through registered pools, splitting proceeds between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury. Fee configuration (feePips, protocolBps, recipients) is set once per pool at launch by a pinned launcher and cannot be changed.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: A session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pairs. Adjusts LP fees based on US equity market sessions (open/overnight/closed) using a baked NYSE calendar, with linear opening descent spikes and optional closing ramp to price information asymmetry around market open and close events. Operator pokes can temporarily override the autonomous fee within bounded limits.

hook.name: LatchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Latch token launches that intercepts swaps on registered tokens to collect configurable protocol fees and creator-defined buy/sell taxes (paid in the quote token). Fees are claimable by token creators, and swap volume is reported to the factory for graduation threshold tracking.

hook.name: LegacyLedger
hook.description: On every swap, takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (via AeonFee base) plus an optional 0.05% loyalty tax on the unspecified currency, routing both directly to a fixed treasury address. Swaps that include a 32-byte player address in hookData earn loyalty marks accumulating into a capped tier score.

hook.name: BEANSTALK
hook.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20 token that doubles as its own Uniswap v4 hook, collecting a configurable buy and sell tax (in basis points) on the native ETH side of swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, and forwarding the collected tax to a designated controller address.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4Variable
hook.description: Shared fee hook for all Foundry launchpad pools on Robinhood Chain. Applies a market-cap-scaled dynamic LP fee (0.5%–1.5%) split between creator and protocol, with configurable creator payout wallets and a graduation mechanism transitioning pools from bonding curve to post-graduation LP fee mode.

hook.name: GammaHook
hook.description: Implements a dynamic launch-decay anti-snipe fee for Uniswap v4 pools. At pool launch, a high peak fee is charged that decays linearly over a configurable shield window down to a steady-state base fee, with fee overrides applied via beforeSwap.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4
hook.description: Shared fee hook for all Foundry launchpad pools on Robinhood Chain. Applies a market-cap-scaled dynamic LP fee (1.25% below $25k FDV, 1.00% above) pre-graduation, switching to a 0.30% LP fee post-graduation. Fees are split between the pool creator and the protocol treasury via a pull-pattern claim.

hook.name: AnyQuoteEthSharedHookV1
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for host-registered token launch pools that intercepts swap fees, converts them to native ETH via an on-chain route, and distributes ETH rewards to platform and creator wallets atomically during each swap. Any router may swap on registered pools; pool registration is restricted to the immutable host address.

hook.name: ProgrammableLaunchFeeHook
hook.description: Governs a single canonical native-ETH pool on the Robinhood chain, restricting pool initialization to an authorized address and gating the first swap to that same address. Applies a 30% LP fee for 30 seconds after the first swap, then permanently drops to 1%.

hook.name: TwoRewardHook
hook.description: Singleton v4 hook for a reflection token launchpad managing two phases: a bonding curve phase (CURVE) pricing tokens against a virtual 75/25 constant-product curve with exact-input-only swaps, and a graduated AMM phase charging layered ETH fees (rake + LP-deepening + dividend) on every swap. Hook-owned liquidity is seeded at graduation and permanently locked; the fee structure, graduation logic, and liquidity deepening are all permissionless post-launch.

hook.name: RobinShareHook
hook.description: A shared hook for RobinShare native ETH/TOKEN pools that takes an immutable ETH-denominated fee (1–5%) on every swap and distributes it instantly per-swap to a platform wallet, a buyback reserve, and configurable recipients. Supports agent-triggered buyback-and-burn via internal fee-exempt swaps.

hook.name: RallyHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that runs a virtual constant-product bonding curve. During the curve phase, the hook serves swaps from its own inventory against virtual reserves; upon reaching the graduation threshold, it atomically seeds a permanent full-range CLMM position and thereafter collects protocol fees on all swaps.

hook.name: ModuleNativeHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token pools that restricts swaps to a pre-registered, per-pool router and charges platform and creator fees on the native currency leg. Supports a module-based programmability system that receives trade callbacks for composable post-swap logic.

hook.name: WethFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: An immutable Uniswap v4 hook that charges a WETH-denominated fee on every swap using per-token tiers (3%, 5%, or 10%) from a launchpad registry, or a global fallback rate. Accrued fees are held as ERC-6909 claims and distributed via a permissionless distribute() call that splits proceeds between the token creator, treasury, a flagship buyback vault, and the token's on-chain mechanism.

hook.name: SockLaunchHook
hook.description: A launch hook for tokenized real-world assets that creates single-sided liquidity pools pairing a launch token against multiple stock assets. Applies dynamic fees with an anti-snipe decay on early buys, gates trading on a market clock (weekly hours plus holiday overrides), and routes position fees between creators and the protocol treasury.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches with a time-decaying dynamic fee curve. The hook overrides pool LP fees to zero and skims fees via return deltas, distributing them between a creator recipient, treasury, permanently-locked LP compounding, and holder reflections (via IDividendToken.notifyReward).
