Whitelisted launch wallets pay the floor fee during the opening window.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad token pools that skims a per-pool ETH reflection fee plus a platform fee on every swap. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 ETH claims in beforeSwap (exact-in buys, exact-out sells) and afterSwap (exact-in sells, exact-out buys), then swept by a distributor.

hook.name: BeaconProxy Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy (ERC-1967 beacon pattern), delegating all calls to an upgradeable implementation at 0xca3EB46Cc39c7426307c36BAFC97F585c6244884. Hook logic could not be analyzed as only the proxy source was available.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A launch-manager-controlled hook that collects configurable buy/sell fees on swaps and distributes them across platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. It enforces a strict pool launch authorization workflow, prevents liquidity removal, and disables donations.

hook.name: BallastHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable percentage fee on the WETH leg of every swap, splitting proceeds among the project token creator, a platform vault, and an optional allowlisted referrer via an accrue-and-claim model. Sell-exact-out swaps are rejected; hookData optionally encodes a referrer address.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: A swap fee hook for ETH/token pools that collects a tiered ETH fee (0.10%–1.00% based on token market cap) on each swap, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token's creator address. Fees are waived on the pool's launch block.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Applies fixed buy (3%) and sell (6%) taxes on every swap via afterSwap, deducting fees from the unspecified output currency and accumulating them as ERC-6909 claims. Tax rates are compile-time constants; fees are forwarded to a treasury address controlled by an owner with a 3-day timelock.

hook.name: DynamicFee
hook.description: Adjusts LP swap fees based on tick movement from the prior swap: larger price moves raise the fee and smaller moves lower it, bounded between 0.05% and 5%. All swaps also pay a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee taken from the output currency and routed to a fixed recipient via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable buy/sell tax (up to 2% each) on swaps using v4 custom accounting via BeforeSwapDelta. Tax proceeds are held in the hook contract and withdrawable only by the immutable owner address set at deployment.

hook.name: CashCatHookV2
hook.description: Fee engine for CashCat pools that takes a fixed-rate fee from the quote (ETH) side of every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns, splitting proceeds between a creator and a platform treasury. Liquidity is permanently locked after a single factory-controlled seed; only the factory may create or seed pools.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees (base + surge) computed by a DynamicFeeManager, takes a configurable protocol fee share on swaps and reinvests it via a FullRangeLiquidityManager, and records truncated geometric TWAP observations via TruncGeoOracleMulti.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain with only the afterInitialize flag enabled, but the callback is a no-op. Liquidity bootstrapping is performed by a separate `initializePools()` function that calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract. All other hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: LpGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a single allowlisted launcher address while leaving swaps fully permissionless. Ensures the protocol is the sole LP by construction via `beforeInitialize` and `beforeAddLiquidity` guards; the launcher is bound once post-deploy via a one-shot `setLauncher` call gated to an immutable binder address.

hook.name: HeksV6Hook
hook.description: Memecoin launchpad hook (heks.fun) that enforces a dynamic anti-snipe fee schedule (up to 90% at launch, decaying to 1% over a configurable window), restricts liquidity additions to a designated vault, permanently locks principal removal, and reverts swaps that push price outside a canonical tick range.

hook.name: CacheTollHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook that charges a time-decaying LP fee (90% at open, falling linearly to 3% over 3 hours). Restricts liquidity additions to a single designated desk, and after each swap calls an external token contract to open a per-trade settlement window for exactly the swap's amounts.

hook.name: FewHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for few.fun launchpad pools that takes a fixed percentage of each swap in the quote asset, split between the pool creator and a protocol treasury. Includes a temporal guard that caps individual buy sizes during a configurable opening window after pool launch.

hook.name: GDPFeeHook
hook.description: Collects trade taxes on registered memecoin pools by intercepting exact-input swaps and distributing fees between a platform recipient and the token creator or holder pool, independent of LP fees. Pool initialization is restricted to the launch factory, and swaps can be paused by the owner.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Shared launchpad hook for B20 token launches. Gates pool creation to a factory, permanently locks single-sided liquidity, and charges a swap fee on the quote currency split among creator, platform, and an optional referrer. Includes a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge that blocks exact-output swaps during a configurable launch window after pool creation.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that imposes a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always collected in ETH (currency0), and forwarded to an immutable fee recipient address. Fees are skimmed in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency, or in afterSwap when ETH is the unspecified currency.

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_RH
hook.description: A per-pool dynamic LP fee hook for Uniswap v4 that sets configurable fee tiers at pool initialization via updateDynamicLPFee and applies a time-decaying anti-snipe fee surcharge on buys during an optional launch window.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-scaled fee on every swap in the pool's quote currency, with a rate that scales linearly between a base and maximum bps based on how far the previous swap moved the tick. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and are forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep. Only exact-input swaps are supported; exact-output swaps always revert.

hook.name: LendsProtocolHook
hook.description: Charges an owner-configurable fee (up to 5%) on swaps in explicitly enabled pools, collecting it in the quote currency and distributing it proportionally to up to 10 weighted fee recipients via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta adjustments.

hook.name: JetstreamHook
hook.description: Singleton hook that charges a configurable fee (up to 3%) on the ETH leg of every swap, distributing proceeds between the pool creator, a buyback wallet, and a platform wallet. Liquidity additions are gated until the pool is registered by the factory.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized RWA equity pairs that adjusts LP fees based on US market calendar sessions (open, overnight, closed) using block.timestamp, with an opening descent ramp, a closing ramp, and a time-bounded operator fee poke override.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1% swap fee on all swaps (split 70% to pool creator, 30% to platform) via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Permanently locks liquidity after the initial seed by reverting subsequent LP additions and all removals.

hook.name: Bonker Dynamic Fee Hook (Robinhood Chain)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that sets dynamic LP fees based on a volatility accumulator (measured by tick movement across swaps) and collects a protocol fee (20% of LP fee) on all swaps. During pool launch, a MEV module can temporarily raise fees for up to 2 minutes. Supports optional pool extensions that execute post-swap logic.

hook.name: CrestHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that collects protocol fees and creator buy/sell taxes on swaps for registered tokens, with a time-decaying anti-snipe fee that charges elevated rates during early blocks after token launch.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK pools that charges a configurable per-pool fee on every swap, always taken in WETH, using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to extract the fee from the WETH leg of each trade and accrue it to per-pool project and protocol treasuries.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization. It delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and has no swap-time logic.

hook.name: Rivers Shared LaunchHook V4
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Rivers launch pools implementing a phased launchpad lifecycle with band-based bonding curve mechanics. Takes protocol and creator fees on swaps via delta manipulation, dynamically overrides LP fees based on pool phase, and restricts swaps and liquidity to a controller during pre-graduation phases.

hook.name: BuybackBurnHookV1
hook.description: Charges fixed directional buy and sell fees in beforeSwap or afterSwap depending on trade shape, collecting a protocol fee, and spends the remainder buying the pool's own token back on sells and burning it.

hook.name: RobinHook
hook.description: Detects and surcharges sandwich back-runs and JIT liquidity strategies, routing captured MEV to pool liquidity providers via a per-pool MEV-sharing ledger. Implements dynamic LP fee overrides with a drawbridge surcharge mechanism, a base holder fee on every swap, a per-block price-band circuit breaker, and optional swap-triggered Robin NFT minting for ROBIN token buyers.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-scaled swap fee (between immutable baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps, enforced at 1%–5.3%) on every swap, computed from the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are taken in the pool's quote currency as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep() function.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad tokens that skims a configurable ETH fee (creator reflection fee up to 12% plus a platform fee) on every swap. Fees are accrued per-pool as ERC-6909 ETH claims and swept by a distributor for redistribution to token holders and a platform fee router.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain hook that enables only afterInitialize (which is a pure no-op). Pool setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a bootstrapper contract to record the initial tick. No logic executes at swap or liquidity time.

hook.name: FlareHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Flare launchpad that charges a flat 1% fee on every swap in pools containing factory-listed tokens. Fees are accumulated in the hook contract and withdrawn to a configurable vault address.

hook.name: AirlockGate
hook.description: Launch-window gate that records whether each swap originates from a whitelisted router (via transient storage, read by AirlockToken) and collects a capped platform fee (≤1%) on exactInput swaps during a configurable time window set by an authorized launchpad.

hook.name: NiceHoodV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the NiceHood launchpad that gates pool initialization to an authorized graduation adapter and opportunistically claims LP fees from a position vault after each swap, throttled by a configurable time interval.

hook.name: SharesHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 2.5% fee on buys and sells in a specific native/token pool, redirecting fees to a configurable recipient. On each swap, updates an on-chain random seed and records volume with a launch controller; triggers token start on first liquidity addition.

hook.name: AstroNodeFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools that charges ETH fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling fees between a per-pool configurable base and max (1%–6.6%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient; exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools with 0 LP fee. Takes fees entirely in ETH on every swap and instantly distributes them to a platform wallet, configured recipients, and a buyback reserve. Supports an optional stock-rewards mode that accumulates fees and periodically buys a stock token for pro-rata distribution to holders.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: Collects per-swap fees on ETH-in (zeroForOne) and ETH-out (oneForZero) legs using a configurable fee tier (100–500 bps). Applies an 85% anti-sniper fee during the first 30 seconds after pool launch. Accumulated WETH fees are claimable by a registered factory address; the factory itself is exempt from all fees.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1% swap fee (split 70% to creator, 30% to platform) on all swaps in owner-registered pools. Liquidity is permanently locked: only a single initial seed add is permitted, and all removals revert forever.

hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: Takes a 1.5% ETH fee on all swaps in registered pools and distributes it to token holders (via DividendToken.fundPot), the pool creator, a platform address, and an ops address. Buy-side fees are minted as ERC-6909 ETH claims in beforeSwap and redeemed during the next sell or via a permissionless collect() call.

hook.name: HEIMNativeTaxHook
hook.description: A single-pool Uniswap v4 hook that charges an immutable native ETH tax on every swap. It uses BeforeSwapDelta for native-specified swaps and AfterSwapDelta for fund-token-specified swaps. Accrued ETH tax is forwarded to an immutable recipient address via a permissionless keeper function.

hook.name: GladeHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that charges a configurable basis-point fee (capped at 5%) on swaps involving registered tokens, takes the fee directly from the PoolManager, and distributes it to token wardens (owners) via a per-token harvest balance that wardens can withdraw.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% fee on every ETH/TIPOFF swap, always denominating the fee in native ETH (currency0). Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to skim ETH from the specified or unspecified leg respectively, forwarding all fees to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A permissionless launchpad game hook that seeds ETH-paired token pools and tracks swaps in afterSwap to run a timed competition: sufficiently large buys defend an escalating floor price, update the leader, and accrue LP fees to a pot awarded to the last qualifying buyer when the idle timer expires.

hook.name: OilHook
hook.description: Charges a trade tax on ETH/$OIL swaps in Uniswap v4: buy fees (ETH) go to a treasury, sell fees ($OIL) go to a holder reserve distributor. Includes a launch anti-snipe mechanism with an initially high fee (up to 95%) that decays linearly over time to the 3% normal ceiling; exact-output swaps are blocked during the launch window.

hook.name: UniswapStockLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: A shared fee-collection hook for the Long venue's stock launchpad that charges a flat creator fee (0–7%) on every swap by taking the fee from the unspecified currency side in afterSwap, accumulating it per pool for the coin creator to claim. Unregistered pools or pools with 0% fee pass through with no charge.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with a beforeSwap permission. Only the proxy contract source is verified; the implementation contract is not available, so actual hook behavior cannot be analyzed.

hook.name: HOODDOGFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for HOODDOG launchpad pools on Uniswap v4. Charges ETH fees (1%–5%) on buy swaps via beforeSwap return delta and on sell swaps via afterSwap return delta, with the rate scaling based on the previous swap's tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK token pools that charges all swap fees exclusively in WETH on every swap in both directions. Accrued WETH is split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury per pool, with fee configuration set once at pool launch by an authorized launcher contract.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Shared hook for all Tripools launch factory pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window with a 50% tax on non-whitelisted buys, and applies a dynamic tiered fee schedule on buys and sells, splitting revenue between the protocol treasury and the token creator.

hook.name: STONKBANK
hook.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20 token that also serves as a Uniswap v4 hook for a single immutably bound pool. Collects a configurable tax (in basis points) on the native ETH side of swaps for both buys and sells, routing collected taxes to a designated controller address via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values.

hook.name: FewHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for few.fun token launches that charges a fixed percentage fee in the quote asset on every swap, then splits it between a creator and protocol treasury. Supports three fee modes: Creator (direct payout), Cashback (buyback-and-burn), and Holder Rewards. Enforces a configurable time-based maximum buy size during a pool's opening guard window.

hook.name: RobinhoodMultiPairV4LaunchHook
hook.description: A multi-pair Uniswap v4 launch hook for the Robinhood Chain that atomically initializes and permanently funds up to four trading pairs (RWI, ETH, USDG, PONS) in a single transaction. Uses beforeSwap to match accumulated token-fee inventory against organic buys at the live pool price via a return delta, without moving the pool.

hook.name: LpGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a single designated launcher address, ensuring the protocol is the sole LP by construction. Swaps are fully permissionless with no hook intervention.

hook.name: BluechipHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable directional swap fees (quote-to-base and base-to-quote) with a platform fee split routed to a PlatformFeeTreasury. Pools must be registered in a PoolRegistry, initial liquidity must be full-range, and fees are administered by protocol roles.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize permission is set; the callback is a no-op returning the selector. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable WETH fee on every swap in both directions using return-delta accounting. Fees accrue per-pool and are split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: K401MarketHook
hook.description: Initialization gate for protocol-owned 401K/Stock pools. Restricts pool creation to a single authorized MarketReserve contract, enforcing fixed 0.30% fee, tick spacing of 60, and requiring the paired stock token to be actively approved in the StockPriceGuard oracle registry.

hook.name: BullionTaxHook
hook.description: Levies a fixed 4% ETH trade tax on buys (ETH→GLD, taken in beforeSwap) and sells (GLD→ETH, taken in afterSwap) via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta returns. Accumulated ETH is held in the contract until flushed to a staking sink. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output reverts. Certain addresses (e.g. a buyback contract) can be exempted from the tax by the owner.

hook.name: OmniHook
hook.description: Takes a 10 bps fee on every swap output, splitting it among five hardcoded recipients via an on-chain owed-balance ledger that anyone can claim permissionlessly. Fees are captured via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: RobinArrow
hook.description: ERC-20 token (ARROW, 100,000 fixed supply) that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook for the official ARROW/WETH pool. Collects swap fees in ARROW (1% on buys, 2% on sells), distributing 80% pro-rata to all eligible holders and 20% to the current "Robin Arrow" holder — a gamified title earned by qualifying buys (≥100 ARROW net) and immediately lost on any sell.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that activates only on pool initialization (afterInitialize). It delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick. No swap or liquidity modification logic is active.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that enables only the afterInitialize callback (a no-op returning only the selector) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate contract and records the initial tick. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook with dynamic LP fees (base + surge) computed via a truncated geometric oracle; captures a configurable protocol fee share (POL) from each swap and reinvests it into full-range liquidity through a FullRangeLiquidityManager.

hook.name: PackFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for PackLaunch pools. Charges a dynamic ETH fee (1%–6.6%) on exact-input swaps: buys are charged on input via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, sells are charged on output via afterSwapReturnsDelta. The fee rate floats with recent tick movement and is sent directly to a per-pool recipient address registered by the factory.

hook.name: ProtectedCurveHookV2
hook.description: A bonding curve AMM hook that fully intercepts swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, implementing an exponential curve (configurable beta) for token launches. Fees are split between platform payees and a buy-and-burn mechanism for a designated network token; external liquidity additions are disabled.

hook.name: PrinterHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 5% ETH fee on every swap in native-ETH/token pools, routing accrued fees automatically to a token buyback-and-burn leg, a compounding single-sided liquidity band, and a treasury. Supports a one-time decaying anti-snipe buy surcharge in the early launch window.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission (as a no-op selector return) to satisfy hook address validation. Stores pool configuration constants and an initial tick, delegating liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: A launchpad hook that redirects a configurable platform and creator fee slice from every swap's unspecified-side output, with optional per-pool anti-sniper temporal gating (blocks swaps before a launch block threshold) and optional buyback-burn (sends a portion of buy-side output tokens to the dead address).

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to the launchpad address and restricts liquidity additions to a designated locker contract. Permanently prevents all liquidity removal by reverting any attempt, locking deposited liquidity forever.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A token launch hook that gates pool creation to a designated launch manager, enforces configurable buy/sell fees on swaps (up to 5% basic or 15% utility mode), and distributes proceeds across platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via ERC-6909 claim tokens minted to a claim vault. Liquidity removal is permanently locked and donations are disabled.

hook.name: CrestHook
hook.description: A fee hook for Crest factory-launched tokens. On buys, applies a combined protocol fee, per-token buy tax, and a time-decaying anti-snipe fee. On sells, non-creator sellers are charged 100% of quote proceeds as a fee routed to the token creator's claimable balance; the token creator may sell without fee.

hook.name: GraduationGateHook
hook.description: Gates Uniswap v4 pool initialization to require one token be a designated payment token and the other to be marked as "graduated" by an on-chain GraduationRegistry. Pools that don't meet these criteria are blocked from being created.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A token launch platform hook denominated in a tokenized ERC-20 stock. Charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, configured per pool at launch) split between creator, bid wall, and platform. Automatically manages a single-sided quote-token bid wall just below spot price. Liquidity additions are locked to the factory until the pool reaches a configured graduation tick, after which the pool opens to all liquidity providers.

hook.name: MintFastHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 2% ETH-side protocol fee on all swaps in launchpad pools (ETH is always currency0). Fees are accrued as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and redeemed for real ETH via a launchpad-only collect() function.

hook.name: CashCatGraduationHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for the CashCat launchpad that restricts pool initialization to the launchpad (beforeInitialize) and monitors post-swap prices to set a one-way graduation latch when a launch token's paired-currency principal reaches a configured threshold (afterSwap).

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A fixed 5% ETH fee hook for a $TIPOFF/ETH pool that always collects fees in ETH. Fees are skimmed from the ETH leg via beforeSwap (when ETH is the specified currency) or afterSwap (when ETH is unspecified), and forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that delegates initial liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(). Only the afterInitialize flag is set; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: FoolHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% output fee on exact-input swaps, converting token fees back to ETH via a nested pool swap and minting ERC-6909 claims for a configurable fee recipient. Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the token's Launching stage.

hook.name: CreatorFeeAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that enforces a time-based per-buy WETH cap during a 3-phase launch window (flat cap → linear ramp → uncapped) to deter sniping, and takes a standardized creator/protocol fee split from swap outputs via afterSwap with afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic fee overrides via beforeSwap lpFeeOverride, records tick observations via TruncGeoOracleMulti, and reinvests collected fees via a FullRangeLiquidityManager. On every swap, an additional undisclosed 0.10% fee (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) is unconditionally extracted from the input amount on top of any disclosed hook fee.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $REEFGUARD token that applies a fixed 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells), always collecting the fee in ETH (currency0) and forwarding it to an immutable feeRecipient address. Fees are skimmed via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency, and via afterSwap return delta otherwise.

hook.name: RunnerCurveHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for token launches that prices swaps against a virtual-reserve constant-product curve, intercepts the full swap via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, blocks external liquidity additions during the curve phase, and automatically mints full-range Uniswap v4 liquidity once a configurable ETH graduation threshold is reached.

hook.name: NoMistakesHookV1
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for the Pons token-launch protocol that applies variable sell fees based on market-cap tiers. Supports both the protocol's own router (with hookData-encoded TradeContext) and third-party routers permissionlessly via pool-delta accounting. Manages per-pool graduation state and an on-chain price oracle.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A fee engine for token launch pools that takes fees in the quote asset on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, with configurable creator and protocol fee rates plus an optional anti-snipe surge fee that decays linearly over a configurable window. Liquidity can only be seeded once by the factory and is permanently locked against removal.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad pools that restricts pool initialization to a designated Launchpad address and emits a PoolSwap event on every swap for off-chain indexing. No hook deltas are applied.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain's token pool that enables the afterInitialize permission (as a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates pool setup and tick recording to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: TurboLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-sensitive fee hook for TurboLaunchpad pools that charges dynamic ETH fees (1–5%) on buys in beforeSwap and sells in afterSwap, scaling the fee with the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are taken directly from the pool manager and forwarded to a per-pool recipient on every swap.

hook.name: MrSuccHook
hook.description: Collects a 2.5% protocol fee on buys and sells in a designated native/token pool, routes fees to a configurable recipient via poolManager.take(), updates an on-chain random seed on each swap, and triggers token launch on first liquidity add.

hook.name: UruLaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launch hook for the URU token that applies a time-decaying sniper tax (up to 99% at launch, decaying to 0%) on swaps during a configurable window, routing proceeds to a vault. It also tracks URU trading volume per epoch to compute a bounded emission-rate signal.

hook.name: MemeHookV4
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for RobinSeed graduated meme token pools that collects a configurable swap fee after each swap and routes creator proceeds either to a fee escrow (Mode 0: creator fees) or to a buyback-and-lock vault (Mode 1: buyback), while a protocol share is always sent to a designated recipient via FeeEscrow.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects a platform swap fee on registered tokens and splits it between token creators and treasury, with creators optionally directing part of their share into an automatic buyback-and-burn. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the first N blocks after launch and a time-limited sell surcharge on the original deployer address.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for Vladdy native-ETH/TOKEN pools. Takes all swap fees in ETH (configured 1–5% rate, immutable per pool) and distributes them per-swap to a platform wallet, configured recipients, and/or a buyback-and-burn reserve. Supports an optional stock-rewards mode where the non-platform fee share accrues to a reserve spent buying a stock token deposited into a distributor contract.

hook.name: Ponzuki
hook.description: Time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects a platform fee on each swap in a registered token's pool, splitting it between the token creator and treasury with optional buyback-and-burn. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge during early blocks after launch and a time-limited deployer dump surcharge on creator sells. Optionally routes an additional dividend tax to a YieldVault for proportional holder distribution.

hook.name: ToyhoodFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools launched by ToyhoodLauncher. Charges ETH fees on buys (taken from input in beforeSwap) and sells (taken from output in afterSwap), with the fee rate scaling between configurable base and max bands (1%–6.2%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap.

hook.name: FriarTier
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook implementing a Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator surge mechanism on top of an immutable base fee set at deployment. Each deployment represents a distinct, non-configurable fee tier shared by all pools on that hook, with no admin controls, no upgradeability, and no protocol fee.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that allows buys unconditionally but blocks sell transactions in real on-chain execution by checking gasleft() against a 30M gas threshold. Simulations (eth_call, fork sims) have high gasleft() and pass; real user transactions have lower gasleft() and revert, trapping sellers.

hook.name: BicoLaunchpadV3
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook that deposits a token's sellable supply as a concentrated liquidity position. When the price walks to the lower bound (curve sold out), afterSwap removes the curve position, deducts graduation fees, and re-deposits locked full-range liquidity in the same Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy-based Uniswap v4 hook. The hook logic is implemented at a separate implementation address (0x28bAdEA68300D39008d01C78F774F8Bd9b4bd8Ac); only the proxy contract is verified on-chain, so implementation behavior cannot be assessed from the available source files.

hook.name: ChartGuardHook
hook.description: A price-peg enforcement hook that locks a Uniswap v4 pool to a 1:1 (one dollar) price. Pool initialization is restricted to a designated executor at exactly the $1 sqrtPrice; liquidity additions are confined to ±10 ticks of parity; and any swap that moves the tick beyond ±2 ticks from parity is reverted in afterSwap.

hook.name: HalloMarketsFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for HalloMarkets launchpad pools. Charges ETH fees between 1–5% on buys (via beforeSwap delta on input) and sells (via afterSwap delta on output), scaling the fee based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient on every swap.

hook.name: BaldPadFunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based ETH fee hook for BaldPadFun launch pools. Charges 1–5% fees in native ETH on exact-input buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), with the fee scaling linearly based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient on each swap. Exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: RootedHook
hook.description: A UUPS-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that deducts a configurable contribution fee (1–5%) from each swap and routes it to a capital vault. Enforces a timestamp-based launch gate (anti-snipe), per-transaction buy limits during a restriction window, and restricts all liquidity modifications to a designated vault address.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch's central Uniswap v4 hook that manages meme token launches (flaunches), runs an internal swap pool that fills orders from fee inventory before routing to Uniswap, distributes swap fees to creators, referrers, and protocol, records price observations for a TWAP oracle, and manages a BidWall for liquidity buybacks. New pools are gated by a configurable launch timestamp until trading is enabled.

hook.name: DoubleBackedMultiTokenFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on swaps in pools containing the BACKEDD token, taking the fee in the non-BACKEDD token and sending it to a immutable vault address. The fee is split between beforeSwap and afterSwap depending on whether the non-BACKEDD token is the specified or unspecified swap amount.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Dynamic fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools that integrates a truncated geometric oracle, adaptive surge-based fee management, and full-range liquidity reinvestment. Critically, the contract charges an undisclosed additional 0.10% fee ("hidden commission") on every swap on top of the declared dynamic fee, silently minting those tokens to the liquidity manager.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1% swap fee on all swaps (split 70% to the pool creator and 30% to a platform vault) and permanently locks liquidity after the initial seed deposit by reverting all subsequent add/remove liquidity calls.

hook.name: SettlePermissionHook
hook.description: Gates Uniswap v4 pool initialization so only an authorized settle adapter can create pools. The adapter must call `authorize(poolId)` before `PoolManager.initialize`; unregistered init calls revert. Liquidity and swaps after initialization are unrestricted.

hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Stonkdrops memecoin launchpad that charges a 1% base tax plus an optional creator fee on every swap's quote leg, routing 70% to a StonkFund raindrop pool and 30% to the treasury. Applies an anti-snipe tax in the first seconds after launch and reports USD volume back to the launchpad for vesting and stats.

hook.name: GataraEthHook
hook.description: Launch hook for ETH-quoted Uniswap v4 pools that charges configurable directional buy/sell fees denominated in native ETH, split among a pool creator, a protocol treasury, and a decaying launch-period cocoon surcharge. Blocks third-party buys in the same block-second as pool initialization to prevent atomic snipe attacks.

hook.name: DamperHook
hook.description: A sell-protection hook for newly launched token pools that applies dynamic surge fees and burns a portion of coins sold during a 3-hour post-launch damper window, scaling fees based on recent sell pressure and cumulative price impact. Liquidity mutations and pool initialization are restricted to the authorized launcher.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only the afterInitialize flag set; the afterInitialize callback performs no action. A separate initializePools() function delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: HoodXLaunchHook
hook.description: An identity hook that gates pool initialization to a single bound factory address; pools created outside the HoodX factory are rejected. Swap and liquidity behavior are unmodified standard Uniswap v4.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton post-graduation hook for Pons V2 meme pools that charges a configurable fee on each swap via afterSwap (using the delta return mechanism), converts any memecoin-denominated fees back to the pool's quote currency through internal swaps, then splits the proceeds among protocol, creator, and buyback-and-lock buckets.

hook.name: OneSidedWethLaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that deploys new ERC-20 tokens with one-sided WETH-paired Uniswap v4 pools using token-only liquidity positions locked in a locker contract. Direct liquidity additions outside of the managed launch flow are blocked via beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: NoOp
hook.description: A minimal hook that emits a swap event in beforeSwap and collects a fixed 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency in afterSwap via a return delta, routing fees to a hardcoded recipient address (AEON_FEE_RECIPIENT).

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Applies a time-decaying buy/sell tax on the ETH leg of swaps in a native ETH/token pool, forwarding collected ETH to an immutable dev wallet. The tax rate steps down by 100 bps per configurable interval from the pool's launch timestamp until it reaches 0%.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnsDelta, afterSwapReturnsDelta, beforeInitialize, and beforeAddLiquidity flags enabled. The implementation contract source is not available for analysis; swap logic and access control could not be verified.

hook.name: HoodsHook
hook.description: Singleton fee hook for hoods.meme pools that charges market-cap-tiered ETH fees (up to 1%) on every swap, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and a creator via HoodsSplitter. Pools must be registered by the associated factory; sell exactOut swaps are rejected.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools. Takes a configurable fee on every swap via afterSwap, converts memecoin-denominated fees to quote currency via internal swaps against the pool's own liquidity, then distributes proceeds among protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback-and-lock vault according to per-pool fee splits frozen at launch.

hook.name: CoalaRobinhoodHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launch hook that collects a 1% buy/sell tax on swaps involving a designated base asset, minting the tax amount as ERC-6909 claims. Pools must be pre-registered via a factory before initialization; donations are blocked.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies fixed buy (3%) and sell (6%) taxes on swaps, deducted from the unspecified currency in afterSwap. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims to the contract and can be forwarded to a treasury address, which is configurable by the owner subject to a 3-day timelock.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only the afterInitialize permission set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. Liquidity bootstrapping and initial tick recording are performed by a separate initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure no-ops.

hook.name: IndexFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all index pools that intercepts the full LP fee and splits it inline — a protocol base fee plus a volatility-scaled index fee — routing shares to a protocol treasury, index reserve, and basket stock buybacks, with a launch snipe guard on early blocks.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A tokenized-stock-denominated meme coin launch hook with per-pool fixed swap fees (0–5%), split 80% creator / 5% bid wall / 15% platform. Collects fees in the quote token on each swap, maintains a single-sided bid wall below spot price from accrued wall fees, locks external liquidity pre-graduation, and detects graduation when the pool tick crosses a configured threshold.

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_RH
hook.description: A shared fee hook for Moonsend token pools that sets immutable per-pool dynamic LP fees (1.25%–10.25%) via updateDynamicLPFee on afterInitialize, and applies an optional anti-sniper buy-side fee (~99%) for a creator-chosen 5–10 second window post-launch. Only factory-registered pools are served; sells are never taxed during the window.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that collects fees denominated in the payment token (fixed 1% base fee plus up to 10% creator tax) via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Tracks pool graduation when price crosses a configured tick and restricts liquidity additions to a designated position manager.

hook.name: IncentifiV4LegibleHook
hook.description: A token launch bonding curve hook that represents the curve as a single Uniswap v4 range position. Applies a dynamic 2% LP fee split between the token creator and a loss reward pool, gates liquidity additions to the hook only, and automatically graduates the pool to a full-range position when the bonding curve is exhausted.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables only the afterInitialize callback, which returns the selector without performing any state changes. A separate initializePools() function delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick in contract storage.

hook.name: sixNativeTaxHook
hook.description: Charges an immutable native ETH tax on swaps in a single Uniswap v4 ETH/token pool. Tax is minted as ERC-6909 claims during swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and forwarded to an immutable recipient via a permissionless keeper once an outstanding threshold is reached.

hook.name: MoonFlameBurnTaxHook
hook.description: Burns 5% of FLAME on buys and 10% on sells by intercepting swap deltas: sells are taxed in beforeSwap (reducing input) and buys in afterSwap (reducing output). Burned tokens are taken from the pool manager and destroyed via FLAME.burn(). Only supports exact-input swaps on a single configured FLAME/quote pool.

hook.name: StonkHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates swaps on a pluggable market-hours oracle (NYSE schedule), withholds an asset-leg fee on every swap split between permanent pool liquidity and project beneficiaries, and applies an exponentially decaying anti-snipe surcharge. Liquidity can only increase: `beforeRemoveLiquidity` unconditionally reverts any negative delta from any caller.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a realized-volatility fee on every exact-input swap, scaling linearly between a base rate and a max rate (both immutable) based on how far the previous swap moved the tick price. Fees are collected in the pool's designated quote currency as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep() call.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook with lifecycle-gated pool access and afterSwap fee collection. Applies a 20% anti-snipe fee for 3 seconds post-launch and 1% thereafter; fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and routed to per-pool FeeVaults. Only factory-registered pools using this hook can be initialized or swapped against.

hook.name: LpGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to a single pre-approved launcher address, ensuring the protocol is the exclusive LP by construction. Swaps are fully permissionless with no hook involvement.

hook.name: DreddHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for factory-registered token pools that deducts configurable swap fees via return deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap, applies an elevated sniper tax to early buyers within a configurable block window after launch, and accumulates fee earnings for token creators to withdraw.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools launch pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window (50% tax routed entirely to treasury for non-whitelisted buys) and a dynamic tiered tax schedule for buys and sells, splitting fees between the pool creator and protocol treasury, always settled in ETH.

hook.name: OrynthEthFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 2% fee exclusively in native ETH on every swap, splitting the fee 50/50 between a registered pool creator and a platform address. Pools must be pre-registered by a designated launcher before initialization; swaps on unregistered pools revert.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable swap fees (with an elevated antisniper fee during a post-launch window) by taking ETH from swap deltas and routing it to a fee vault, buyback burner, rewards distributor, and platform address. LP additions are restricted to a factory-designated seeder, and LP removals are permanently locked.

hook.name: BagrHookV4E
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook that deploys tokens as single-sided concentrated Uniswap v4 positions. Restricts liquidity from overlapping the curve range. After each swap, observes whether the pool price has crossed the graduation tick and emits a Graduated event. Uses a flat static LP fee with no dynamic fee ramp or anti-sniper window.

hook.name: AMT-1 Canonical Market Hook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that routes all swaps through the AMT-1 token's own mint/burn mechanism, bypassing standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. Blocks all LP liquidity provision; only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: FUNDFeeHook
hook.description: Takes an immutable 5% fee on the WETH leg of a FUND/WETH pool via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Collected WETH is split 25% to a configurable marketing receiver and 75% to an immutable stock rewards controller, redeemable as ERC-20 WETH.

hook.name: ScaleProxy
hook.description: ERC1967 upgradeable proxy for a Scale protocol hook component. The implementation contract (containing actual hook logic) is not available in the verified source, so dynamic fee behavior, swap access control, and custom data requirements cannot be determined from this source alone.

hook.name: LpGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to a single designated launcher address via beforeInitialize and beforeAddLiquidity, preventing any third-party LP from adding positions. Swaps are completely unrestricted with no hook involvement.

hook.name: PpandLaunchHook
hook.description: A launch hook for the $PPAND/ETH pool that charges a time-decaying ETH fee (starting up to 25% and reaching 0% after 30 minutes) on all swaps, enforces a 1% max-buy limit during that window, and gates trading behind a one-time openTrading() call. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and swept to an immutable beneficiary address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers afterInitialize but performs no action in that callback. Provides an external initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper and records the returned initial tick. Has no swap, liquidity, or donate logic.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: Charges a per-pool creator reflection fee plus a fixed platform fee, both in native ETH, on native-ETH/token pools. Fees are collected via delta returns in beforeSwap (exact-in buys, exact-out sells) and afterSwap (exact-in sells, exact-out buys), covering all four swap directions without double-charging.

hook.name: FeraHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing regime-specific dynamic LP fees — MEME pools use an EWMA volatility/flow estimator, RWA pools use a Chainlink oracle price-deviation overlay — plus a cumulative-tick TWAP oracle and an economic anti-JIT guard that withholds and linearly decays accrued fees on fast liquidity removal.

hook.name: FlintHook
hook.description: A token launch hook for the Flint platform that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps in quote-token terms, applying an anti-snipe surcharge during the initial blocks after token launch. Fees are routed to claimable balances for token creators and can be claimed via `claimFees`/`claimAllFees`.

hook.name: TailTwins
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the low byte of the swap size to be within 16 units (circular distance) of the low byte of the pool's current sqrtPriceX96. Takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on every swap's unspecified currency, sent to a hardcoded Aeon recipient via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a flat 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells), always denominated in ETH (currency0), forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to handle both exact-input and exact-output swap cases across both directions.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized-stock launch pools. Charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, set per pool at launch) split between the creator, a protocol bid wall, and a platform treasury. Maintains a single-sided liquidity "bid wall" one tick-spacing below spot that captures sold tokens permanently, and gates liquidity additions to the factory until the pool graduates.

hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook-based token launchpad (pmav.fun V2) that deploys ERC-20 coins with a concentrated bonding curve position, enforces fair-launch rules including a block+1 trading delay, a 2% first-hour buy cap with auto-refund, and a decaying anti-snipe premium. Charges a 1% fee split 70/30 creator/platform. Graduates coins by replacing the curve with a permanently locked full-range position in the same pool.

hook.name: ApeLaunchHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that applies a 2% fee on every swap (1.5% to the pool creator, 0.5% to a protocol treasury), splitting fees between exact-input swaps (taxed in beforeSwap) and exact-output swaps (taxed in afterSwap). Liquidity addition is gated via transient-storage authorization, allowing only the launchpad and a designated locker to add liquidity.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpads that collects a percentage fee on every swap (via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas), splits fees between the token creator and platform treasury, distributes referral cuts, and tracks quote volume for token graduation logic.

hook.name: VortexHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for factory-launched tokens that collects configurable swap fees (with anti-snipe and deployer-dump surcharges), splits proceeds between the token creator and protocol treasury, and automatically executes buyback-and-burn of the launch token using accumulated quote fees.

hook.name: FlutchV4Hook
hook.description: Manages token paired launches on Uniswap v4, charging a 1% fee on every swap taken in afterSwap via the fee-taking delta pattern. Fees in the paired asset are split among the protocol (30%), creator, and a buyback bucket; fees in the launch token are held and converted separately by a keeper. All liquidity is owned by the hook and locked permanently.

hook.name: RobinShareHook
hook.description: Hook for ETH/token pools that takes swap fees entirely in ETH (1–5%, immutable after launch), distributing them instantly per-swap to a platform wallet, a buyback reserve, and configured recipient addresses. Supports factory-initiated dev buys and agent-triggered buyback-and-burn of the paired token using accumulated reserves.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A meme coin launch platform that creates bonding curve pools on Uniswap V4 paired with a quote token. Features a concentrated liquidity curve with dynamic fees post-graduation, a permanent 2% wallet cap per tx.origin, optional anti-snipe decaying premium, creator/platform fee distribution, and pool graduation once a fundraising target is reached.

hook.name: LumosHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook for the Lumos protocol that collects a configurable swap fee on registered tokens, applying a higher anti-snipe tax for buys within a configurable block window after launch, and distributes collected fees to token creators via a rewards mapping.

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to the launchpad address and restricts liquidity additions to the locker or locker-initiated transactions via IMsgSender. Permanently locks all liquidity by reverting any removal attempts with LiquidityLockedForever.

hook.name: RobinhoodArenaFeeHook
hook.description: Fee hook that collects and distributes swap fees via afterSwap delta return, with fee amounts calculated by an external fee helper contract per pool. Restricts pool initialization to an owner-controlled allowlist of approved deployers.

hook.name: Ponzuki
hook.description: Time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

hook.name: UStock
hook.description: An ERC-20 token (uSTOCK) that is also its own Uniswap v4 hook for its uSTOCK/ETH pool. Charges a fixed 3% fee on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager. Anyone may call convert() once per 5 minutes to redeem those fees, swap them into a pseudo-randomly chosen tokenized stock from a fixed basket, and distribute the proceeds pro-rata to holders with ≥10,000 uSTOCK.

hook.name: StewHook
hook.description: A fee-skimming hook that takes a configurable cut (default 1%, max 3%) from swaps on registered token pools via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, with an elevated "rush rate" (default 8%, max 20%) for early buys within a configurable block window after launch. Accrued fees are tracked per "chef" address and claimable via scoop().

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Mixpad token launches that collects platform swap fees on every trade, splits them between the token creator and treasury, optionally executes automatic buyback-and-burns from the creator's share, and applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge in the blocks after launch plus a time-limited sell surcharge for the original deployer address.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: Applies a fixed 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells) in a $REEFGUARD/ETH pool, always collecting the fee in ETH (currency0) via return deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap, and forwarding it to an immutable fee recipient address.

hook.name: PotatoV4Hook
hook.description: A token launch hook for the Potato protocol that takes a 1% swap fee via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, enforces anti-sniping protection during the first 4 seconds after launch, applies a per-wallet token balance cap on buys, and permanently locks liquidity positions within the hook contract.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed WETH fee on every swap through registered WETH/memecoin pools, using return-delta accounting to take fees on both exact-input and exact-output directions, then distributes accrued WETH between a project treasury and a protocol treasury via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: BallastHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable basis-point fee on the WETH leg of every swap (before or after, depending on whether WETH is the specified or unspecified currency) and distributes it among the token creator, platform vault, and an optional referrer decoded from hookData. Fees accrue on-chain and are claimed via a pull-payment mechanism.

hook.name: LaunchHookV3
hook.description: A time-tiered fee hook for new ETH/token launches that withholds ETH fees from buy and sell swaps via return deltas. Applies anti-sniper (28%), second-window (15%), and normal (2%) fee tiers based on time elapsed since LP sealing, splitting fees between a treasury and rewards distributor.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for ETH-paired pools that charges fees on buys and sells, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token creator address. Fees range from 1% (low market cap) to 0.1% (high market cap), applied via BeforeSwapDelta on exact-input buys and AfterSwapDelta on exact-output buys and exact-input sells. Exact-output sells are blocked.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements the afterInitialize permission bit. All hook callbacks, including afterInitialize, are pure no-ops that return their respective selectors. Initial tick recording is handled by a separate initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract.

hook.name: PairV4Hook
hook.description: A gating hook that restricts pool initialization to a designated launchpad address. Pools must be pre-authorized by the launchpad with specific project/quote token pairs, fee (1%), and tick spacing before they can be initialized.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock pools that charges a per-pool fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at launch) split among the creator, a bid wall, and a platform treasury. It automatically manages a single-sided liquidity range (bid wall) below current price using accumulated fee revenue, and restricts liquidity additions to the factory until the pool graduates.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook that manages token launches through a curve phase with a block+1 trading delay, per-wallet 2% caps, and decaying anti-snipe fees; graduates to a standard 1% LP fee pool when the raise target is met.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: Upgradeable ERC1967 proxy pointing to a Uniswap v4 hook implementation. The implementation source is not available; the hook uses beforeSwap/afterSwap with delta returns, suggesting custom swap routing logic.

hook.name: StonkHookV4
hook.description: A token launchpad hook for Robinhood Chain that gates swaps to an ERC-20-enforced trading window (NYSE hours), applies dynamic fees with an anti-snipe surcharge that decays over three seconds post-launch, and withholds asset-leg fees as ERC-6909 claims split among liquidity, creator, protocol, and treasury. Liquidity removals are permanently blocked; the liquidity fee share is placed as one-sided resting bids below spot, funding a perpetual price floor.

hook.name: DeadBuybackHook
hook.description: Charges a 5% WETH-denominated fee on all buys and sells (exact-input and exact-output) against a configured WETH/DEAD token pool. Fees are split 50/50 between a team reserve and a buyback reserve; every 15 taxed swaps, the buyback reserve is used to purchase and send DEAD tokens to the burn address.

hook.name: GammaHook
hook.description: Implements a dynamic launch-decay fee for Uniswap v4 pools. Applies a linearly decaying anti-snipe fee that starts at a configurable peak and decays to a base fee over a shield window after launch, returned as an LP fee override in beforeSwap.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook for token launches that gates public trading until a configured block number, then charges a fixed 1% base fee plus a configurable creator tax and a time-decaying opening tax, all taken in the unspecified currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Optionally distributes a holder fee share and triggers a graduation check after each swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that only activates on afterInitialize. It coordinates with an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to initialize pools and records the initial tick and pool initialization status on-chain.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable buy/sell tax (up to 10%) on every swap via afterSwap, deducting a basis-point fee from the unspecified currency and forwarding it to a treasury address via poolManager.take(). Tax rates are set by the owner in basis points and can be frozen permanently by renouncing ownership.

hook.name: RallypadFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-adjusted fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools launched via RallypadLaunch. Charges ETH fees on buys in beforeSwap and sells in afterSwap, with fees ranging from 1%–7% based on the previous swap's tick movement, sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: XhoodHook
hook.description: Manages a base ETH/XHOOD pool and multiple child token/XHOOD pools, charging 200 bps fees on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Child pool fees are converted to XHOOD then to ETH; 20% is used to buy back and burn XHOOD, while the remainder is queued for distribution to stakers via an external reward distributor.

hook.name: EthicsV4FeeModeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1% fee on swaps in the pool's quote currency, distributing it based on a configured mode: Creator mode splits between creator (70%) and an Ethics address (30%), Rewards mode splits between a rewards vault (90%) and Ethics (10%), and Burn mode burns the base token instead.

hook.name: GoldStandardHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that adds a configurable fee to pools paired with a fixed ERC-20 reserve asset. Fees are denominated in the reserve and split between a fixed royalty recipient and the pool adopter recorded at initialization. An optional time-decaying launch surcharge applies to buys only. Exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity pairs. Computes LP fees from a configurable US market calendar (open, overnight, and closed session tiers with an opening descent ramp and closing ramp around the bell), with TTL-bounded operator poke overrides, all resolved at swap time via the beforeSwap fee-override return.

hook.name: HookrHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for the Hookr launchpad implementing per-pool anti-snipe guards with temporal cumulative buy caps, surge-based dynamic LP fees, auto-burn of token output in afterSwap, in-swap LP reward donations, and a deterministic jackpot for qualifying buys.

hook.name: SlowmoFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-sensitive ETH fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools opened by SlowmoLaunch. Charges a dynamic fee (1%–7%) on buys via beforeSwap delta and on sells via afterSwap delta, scaling the fee based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are pushed immediately to a per-pool feeRecipient; pool creation is gated to a bound factory contract.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that selectively blocks sell swaps in real transactions while allowing them in simulations. Buy swaps (zeroForOne) always pass. Sell swaps check gasleft(): if above 30M (simulation), the sell is allowed; if below (real user transaction), the hook reverts — permanently trapping buyers.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only activates on pool initialization. It stores a reference to a liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick after pool setup; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: StockPegHook
hook.description: A launch hook for a StockPeg (sPEG) / ETH pool that charges a 3% (300 bps) fee on the ETH side of every swap, routing fees to a treasury address. Restricts pool initialization to a designated bootstrapper and tracks when initial liquidity is added to gate token launch.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that charges fees in the payment token on each swap: a fixed 1% base fee plus a creator-configured tax up to 10%, split between a protocol recipient and a creator recipient via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapReturnDelta. Liquidity additions are restricted to an approved position manager. Pool graduation is tracked by checking whether the current tick has crossed a configured graduation tick after each swap.

hook.name: GammaHook
hook.description: Implements a time-decaying dynamic LP fee for pool launches: charges a high anti-snipe fee (peakFee) at launch that decays linearly to a steady-state base fee over a configurable shield window, then holds at baseFee. Fee configuration per pool is registered by a factory contract.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to the factory address to prevent front-running of pool launch. All swap-time flags are disabled, so the hook is never invoked during trades; the pool fee serves as the creator tax.

hook.name: WallStreetTradersFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for native ETH/token pools, charging 1–7% fees in ETH on each swap. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee rate scales with the previous swap's tick movement (realized volatility). Pool initialization is restricted to a whitelisted factory address; only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1% base fee plus a per-pool creator tax (up to 10%) on swaps denominated in a configured payment token. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and redeemable to immutable protocol and creator recipients; pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated to a designated factory and position manager.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize permission (the callback is a no-op stub). Exposes an external initializePools() function that bootstraps liquidity via an external contract and records the initial tick and pool initialization state.

hook.name: BoobpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Boobpad token launchpad that collects swap fees on registered tokens, applying an elevated anti-snipe tax during the first N blocks after launch, and accrues fees to token creators for claiming.

hook.name: PoolGuard
hook.description: A per-pool afterSwap hook that enforces sell limits during a time-boxed launch window. During the window, swaps that sell the designated token above a threshold (measured in paired-currency units) are reverted, unless the sender is on the owner-managed exempt list. After the window expires, no enforcement occurs.

hook.name: SudoCatHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook for a native ETH / SudoCat token pair. Applies a 2% LP fee via dynamic fee override and takes a 3% routing fee per swap: ETH buy-side fees fund holder rewards claimable from the hook; token sell-side fees are permanently burned. Six immutable fee-exempt addresses can bypass all fees by providing EIP-712 signed hookData.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: A fee hook that takes a fixed percentage of the pair-token leg on every swap, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager. At claim time, fees are split between a project treasury (paid in pair tokens) and a protocol treasury (converted to WETH via a frozen direct or two-hop V3 route with TWAP-floor slippage protection).

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that manages a Registered → Launching → Live lifecycle, restricting swaps to the factory during launch and applying a time-based anti-snipe fee (higher fee for SNIPE_DURATION seconds post-launch). Fees are extracted via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas in native ETH and routed to a per-pool FeeVault for the creator. Maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle updated on every swap.

hook.name: InstantHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1.50% fee on the ether leg of every swap in ether-quoted Uniswap v4 pools, routing proceeds to a per-market fee vault via ERC-6909 claims. The pool's LP fee is overridden to zero, making the hook fee the sole cost of a trade.

hook.name: MarketHoursFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a dynamic LP fee based on US equity market session hours. It overrides the LP fee in beforeSwap with a base fee plus a time-varying surcharge (regular, extended, or closed session), routing all fees to LPs via the pool's native tick-crossing accounting. No owner, no admin, no settable state after deployment.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a volatility-adjusted fee on every swap, with the rate scaling linearly from a base fee to a maximum based on how far the previous swap moved the tick price. Fees are taken in the pool's quote currency as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep().

hook.name: UniswapStockLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: A flat-fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools on the Long launchpad. In afterSwap, it deducts a configurable fee (0–7% in basis points) from the unspecified currency and accumulates it for the registered fee recipient (the coin's creator), who can claim accrued fees at any time via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: HomepadHybridHook
hook.description: On every swap, takes a configurable fee from the output amount via afterSwapReturnsDelta and routes it proportionally to the pool's creator, a HOME treasury, and a platform wallet. Designed for HOMEPAD hybrid launch pools that seed liquidity with a single-sided concentrated position.

hook.name: RobinhoodMixedFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Robinhood Launchpad V2. Collects dividend fees in the configured base token while collecting creator, protocol, and referral fees in the swap's unspecified currency. Enforces a maximum total fee of 9.9%.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pools. Adjusts LP fees based on a market calendar (open/overnight/closed sessions) driven by block.timestamp, with optional operator fee overrides ("pokes") bounded by TTL, configurable floor, and per-pool fee cap.

hook.name: PairPadMemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated PairPad meme pools. On every swap, afterSwap extracts a protocol fee plus a creator tax from the unspecified output currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accumulated memecoin-denominated fees are later batch-converted back to the quote currency via an internal swap, then split among protocol, creator, and a buyback-and-lock vault.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that adjusts LP fees via an oracle-based surge mechanism and reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position. Additionally charges an undisclosed 0.10% fee on every swap (labeled "hidden commission" in source) on top of the declared dynamic fee.

hook.name: GataraEthHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches with native ETH as the quote currency. Charges directional fees (buy/sell) split between the pool creator, protocol treasury, and a time-decaying cocoon surcharge, using beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Blocks buys in the exact launch-second as an anti-snipe guard.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/$TIPOFF pool that skims a fixed 5% fee in ETH on every swap (both buys and sells) by intercepting the swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, routing collected ETH to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: Arrakis private vault hook that enforces per-direction dynamic LP fee overrides in beforeSwap and restricts liquidity additions to the vault's registered module only.

hook.name: PlebIndexFeeHook
hook.description: Charges an immutable ETH trade tax (up to 4%) on PLEB/ETH pool swaps, diverting the fee directly to a fixed treasury address via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Restricts pool initialization to native-ETH/PLEB pairs; has no owner or upgrade mechanism.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain hook that registers the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in that callback. Separately exposes an `initializePools()` function (callable by anyone) that invokes a LiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized. Swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: CreatorFeeAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that charges a creator fee on every swap output (split 70/30 between creator and protocol) and caps exact-in WETH buy amounts during a configurable time-based launch window using a 3-phase curve (flat cap → linear ramp → uncapped) to reduce sniping at launch. Also supports multi-token LP reward distribution ("juice rail") using a fee-growth accumulator pattern.

hook.name: LiqHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that combines an AMM pool with an integrated lending protocol. LPs deposit ETH and tokens to earn swap fees; borrowers lock tokens as collateral to borrow ETH at a fixed LTV. The hook manages pool liquidity directly and collects a configurable protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas.

hook.name: LiquidityGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to a single authorized hub address by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity if the sender is not the hub. All other hook callbacks revert unconditionally. Swaps are unrestricted and behave identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: ValleyPulse
hook.description: An afterSwap hook for Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain that emits a ValleyPulseSwap event on every swap, recording the pool ID, sender, swap direction, and token deltas. It performs no fee changes, storage writes, or external calls.

hook.name: AgenEngineHookV2
hook.description: Programmable market engine hook that charges dynamic fees on the quote leg of every swap. Fee rates are tiered by trade size and can evolve over time or cumulative volume via configurable stages. Enforces min/max trade size bounds per market and routes fees to market-defined recipients via a separate vault.

hook.name: VeyraHook
hook.description: An ERC-20/NFT hybrid token backed by a single Uniswap v4 pool. Each whole token held automatically mints a corresponding NFT; LP fees are periodically harvested from the pool and distributed pro-rata to NFT holders. The afterSwap hook callback performs no logic and does not alter swap behavior.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: Manages bonding-curve-style launches of tokenized stock pools where currency0 is always a quote ERC-20 asset. Charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, chosen at launch) split among creator, a "bid wall" (single-sided quote liquidity maintained just below spot price), and a platform treasury. Liquidity addition is gated to the factory until graduation (price crosses a configurable tick threshold), after which the pool opens to external LPs.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Levies a flat 1% protocol fee in native ETH on every swap of a native-ETH/token pool, split 40% to a treasury and 60% to the pool's registered creator. Fees are accrued via PoolManager custom-accounting deltas (beforeSwap for ETH-specified swaps, afterSwap otherwise) and pulled by separate withdrawal calls.

hook.name: HookenAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe hook for Hooken token launches: applies a flat 50% tax on non-whitelisted buys within 4 seconds of launch (routed to the protocol treasury), then applies dynamic tiered ETH-denominated taxes cycling across per-pool buy/sell counters, routing proceeds to the token creator via HookenFeeLocker.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds the `afterInitialize` permission but performs no action in that callback. Pool initialization and tick recording are managed externally via `initializePools()`, which delegates to an `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract. No swap or liquidity modification logic is present.

hook.name: DelistGameHook
