hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the IndexPVP game that collects protocol fees (flat 1% + volatility-based dynamic component) on all swaps, overriding LP fees to 0. Includes per-pool circuit-breaker sell surcharges (up to 90%) and a global halt-window sell fee (20%), with liquidity and trading access restricted to a game contract.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An ERC1967 upgradeable proxy whose implementation contract is not resolved. The hook has beforeSwap, afterSwap, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions, indicating it modifies swap outputs. The underlying implementation logic cannot be inspected from the verified proxy source alone.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable swap tax (in the pool's quote currency) on token launches, splitting fees between a platform tax collector and the token creator. Trading is gated by a per-token start timestamp set by the launch factory.

hook.name: DoubleBackedFeeHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 3% swap fee always in native ETH (currency0), splitting fee collection between beforeSwap (ETH-specified trades) and afterSwap (ETH-unspecified trades). All fees are forwarded to a vault address. Pools without native ETH as currency0 pass through without a fee.

hook.name: NovaHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for factory-launched tokens that charges configurable protocol and creator swap fees on token/quote pairs, routing proceeds to token creators. Includes a time-decaying anti-snipe fee applied to buy-side swaps during the first N blocks after token launch, claimable on-chain by creators.

hook.name: LemonV4TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable trading tax (3–10% total) on every swap in the pool's paired asset, splitting it between a per-pool creator recipient and a fixed protocol recipient. Tax rates and recipients are set once by a designated launcher before pool initialization and are permanently immutable thereafter.

hook.name: ModularLaunchpadHook
hook.description: A configurable launchpad hook using universal LP-fee economics: the hook holds the seed LP position and anyone may call harvest() to collect its accrued fees, split 70/30 between creator and protocol. Supports optional anti-snipe buy caps, JIT sandwich defense, creator fee burn, and liquidity-deepening modules; this deployment has no swap-permission flags active.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for the NASDANK memecoin launchpad that charges a configurable WETH-denominated fee on every swap through registered pools. Fees are collected via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values and split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury, claimable permissionlessly by anyone.

hook.name: LittleJohnBondingHook
hook.description: A bonding-launch Uniswap v4 hook extending LittleJohnHook with a graduation milestone: once ETH absorbed (derived from post-swap sqrt price and fixed launch liquidity) reaches a threshold, emits BondingGraduated. Only the factory's initial liquidity add is permitted per pool; all subsequent adds revert. Fees are taken via return-deltas and minted as ERC-6909 native-ETH claims to LpLockerV4.

hook.name: TransparentUpgradeableProxy Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an ERC-1967 TransparentUpgradeableProxy, allowing the owner to upgrade the hook implementation. The underlying implementation contract (0xCEE1e713Ae68Bf4d1baf4E182b592A92EA444fFC) was not available for source analysis; behavioral properties could not be verified.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: Upgradeable hook deployed as an ERC1967 proxy; the implementation contract source is unresolved. Based on address flags, it intercepts swaps and liquidity additions, returning swap deltas from both beforeSwap and afterSwap.

hook.name: NexusHook
hook.description: A token-launch platform hook that charges configurable buy/sell fees and a block-based anti-snipe tax on registered tokens, taking fees directly from swap amounts via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and routing them to token creators as claimable balances.

hook.name: PumpFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that charges tiered creator and protocol fees on swaps based on the token's market cap, and overrides LP fees dynamically per tier. Fees are taken from the input currency in beforeSwap (exactInput) or afterSwap (exactOutput) and held for distribution via skim().

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for controlled token launches that enforces a structured initialization and single-position liquidity process through a designated launch manager. Applies configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5–15% depending on mode) on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Liquidity removal and donations are permanently disabled.

hook.name: NoxaHook
hook.description: A shared token-launch hook that charges a fixed 1% tax on the WETH (base asset) side of every buy and sell, minting the collected tax as a PoolManager ERC-6909 claim credited to the token contract. Pool initialization is gated to factory-registered pools only, preventing griefing via pre-initialization.

hook.name: RichFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-based ETH fee on buys (beforeSwap delta) and sells (afterSwap delta), scaling the rate between a configurable base and max (both in the 1–5% range) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent immediately to a per-pool recipient address set at registration.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token pools that replaces LP fees with an instant ETH fee distribution mechanism. On every swap it takes a configured fee in ETH and splits it per-trade among a platform wallet, configured recipients, and a reserve used for buyback-and-burn, stock rewards, or staking distributions (robin mode).

hook.name: LaunchBeforeInitializeHookV1
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to a single authorized factory address, enforcing fixed launch economics: LP fee of 12,500, tick spacing of 200, ETH (address(0)) as currency0, and a fixed opening sqrt price derived from tick 191,200. Pool creation reverts unless the sender is the bound factory and all parameters match exactly.

hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for NFTX collection pools, pairing NFT collection tokens against a native token. Implements dynamic LP fees with per-address flat-fee exemptions, an optional AMM fee taken from the unspecified swap leg, pending-donation queuing for LP fee distribution, and a truncated-tick oracle; pool creation and lifecycle are restricted to the NFTX Locker contract.

hook.name: CoinbarrelAdvancedHookV3
hook.description: A custom accounting hook that implements configurable split fee policies (input-side and output-side pips), mints fee claims during swaps without transferring assets, accumulates liabilities across revenue, reinvestment, and rewards buckets, and maintains on-chain TWAP-style observations with tick and volume tracking.

hook.name: MSFT
hook.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20 token that doubles as a Uniswap v4 hook, applying a configurable buy/sell tax on the native ETH side of swaps. Tax is extracted via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanisms and sent to a controller address for downstream reward distribution.

hook.name: QuotronStrategyHook
hook.description: Single-pool Uniswap v4 hook that levies a fixed 5% output tax on every exact-input swap (exact-output swaps are blocked). Fees are split 20/80 between an immutable treasury and a Quotron strategy acquisition reserve; buy-side token fees are accumulated and converted to native currency via a separate permissionless unlock.

hook.name: NoCurveHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the NoCurve launchpad that takes a fixed 1% input-side fee on exact-input swaps in WETH-paired pools and escrows it for creator distribution. Includes a time-limited anti-snipe window that caps single-buy WETH amounts during token launch.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that collects dynamic buy/sell fees on registered tokens, with anti-snipe block-based surcharges, linearly-decaying deployer dump surcharges, and automated buyback-and-burn of tokens using accumulated creator fees. Fee proceeds are split between the token creator and a treasury.

hook.name: GraduationGateHook
hook.description: Gate hook that restricts Uniswap v4 pool initialization to tokens that have graduated from a bonding curve. The beforeInitialize callback verifies that one pool currency is a designated payment token and the other has been approved by a graduation registry, reverting otherwise.

hook.name: FactoryHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for graduated BCToken pools that computes a volatility-adjusted dynamic fee split between LP positions (via LP-fee override) and a protocol waterfall (via hook deltas). Blocks swaps until the coin graduates and supports an owner-controlled halt flag.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook for meme token pools on Robinhood Chain. Captures all trading fees in WETH via swap deltas with a three-phase fee model: exponentially decaying 90%→3% during the guard phase (~5s), then flat 1% through curve and post-graduation. Enforces per-wallet and per-block buy caps during the first ~10s. Graduates the pool automatically when cumulative WETH raised crosses a configured threshold.

hook.name: PadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects a platform fee on every swap, splitting it between the token creator and treasury; a configurable portion is auto-routed to a buyback-and-burn. Applies a block-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-decaying surcharge on sells by the original token deployer.

hook.name: VladsHook
hook.description:
Uniswap v4 hook on Robinhood Chain (4663). Flags 0x4cc
(afterAddLiquidity, beforeSwap/afterSwap + return deltas). Collects
protocol fees 2% buy / 2% sell in native ETH to feeRecipient. Exact-output
unsupported on tracked pool. Bound to native ETH + Vlads ERC-20 pool
(fee 10000, tickSpacing 60) after finalize.

hook.name: BonkHook
hook.description: A fee-extracting hook that collects swap tolls in the base currency from registered token pools, distributing proceeds to designated "tappers". Applies elevated anti-sniper fees during the first configurable number of blocks after a token launch.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook (PMAV v2.2 Quoted) that manages meme-coin pools through a curve phase with quote-denominated fees, a decaying anti-snipe premium, and a permanent 2% wallet cap, then graduates to a standard Uniswap v4 pool (1% dynamic LP fee) once all curve tokens are sold.

hook.name: NopadHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for Nopad launchpad tokens. Applies a configurable fee (default 1%) on quote token amounts in beforeSwap/afterSwap using return deltas, with an elevated anti-snipe tax (default 9%) for the first ~22 blocks after token launch. Fees accrue to token creators and are claimable via the hook.

hook.name: TweetPadV11UniversalHook
hook.description: A fee-custody hook that deducts a 1% creator fee, 0.5% protocol fee, and an optional 10% buy surcharge (active for 60 seconds after pool initialization) from each swap's unspecified output/input amount via afterSwap return delta, distributing accrued fees to a registered creator and a fixed protocol recipient.

hook.name: FairLaunchHook
hook.description: A swap-tax hook for fair-launch token pools that collects a configurable fee (up to 5%) on the quote-currency leg of each swap and distributes proceeds among token holders (via a reward distributor contract), the creator, and the platform. Pool initialization is gated to a trusted launchpad address.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A bonding curve token launch hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to registered launches via an authorized locker, charges a time-decaying anti-snipe opening tax plus configurable trading fees via afterSwap, and enforces a graduation threshold before transitioning the pool to a permanent full-range position.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable fee exclusively in WETH on both swap directions using return-delta accounting. Per-pool fee configurations are registered once by an authorized launcher and split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury.

hook.name: PRHook
hook.description: Captures a configurable buy/sell fee on each swap in PR-token pools and routes it to a designated buyback vault. Exact-output swaps are handled in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; exact-input swaps in afterSwap via AfterSwapDelta. Operates only on owner-allowlisted pools.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook (0.5 fee tier)
hook.description: Singleton hook charging a fixed 0.5% LP fee (split 50/50 between creator and treasury) and a time-limited sell tax on tokens launched via the Livo launchpad. Blocks all swaps before a token's graduation event.

hook.name: MonkeyFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based fee hook for Uniswap v4 that charges ETH fees on buys (in beforeSwap) and sells (in afterSwap). The fee scales between a configurable base and max rate (1%–7.3%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, and is sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient on every swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always denominated in ETH (currency0), by splitting fee collection between beforeSwap (when ETH is the specified currency) and afterSwap (when ETH is the unspecified currency), forwarding fees to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: TurboLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based swap fee hook for TurboLaunchpad pools, charging ETH fees on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta). Fees scale dynamically between a base and max rate (both in 1–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, and are sent immediately to a per-pool fee recipient.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: A fee hook that charges a configurable pip fee on the pair-token leg of every swap, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager. Fees are split between a project treasury (paid in the pair token) and a protocol treasury (converted to WETH via a frozen V3 route, with a two-hop VIA_USDG fallback on degradation).

hook.name: CoalaHook
hook.description: Shared hook for COALA token launches that charges a fixed 1% tax on the WETH (base asset) side of every buy and sell, minting the collected tax as an ERC-6909 WETH claim to the token contract. Pool initialization is restricted to factory-registered pools only, preventing griefing of deterministic pool keys.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only uses afterInitialize as a no-op. All swap and liquidity callbacks return immediately without side effects. An external initializePools() function calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that shields a designated main token from sell pressure by absorbing sells at pool price from a funded pot (beforeSwap delta), and pumps the main token by buying with pot secondary funds on buys (afterSwap nested swap). Supports hook-held LP positions with auto-harvesting and auto-compounding fee splits.

hook.name: MemeStonkCanonicalPoolHook
hook.description: Enforces exact-price initialization and temporary liquidity-addition exclusivity for canonical meme pools on Arbitrum. The beforeInitialize callback ensures only the immutable factory can initialize a pool at a pre-registered price; beforeAddLiquidity restricts deposits to a designated liquidity controller until an immutable block-height expiry.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeInitialize, afterInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions. The implementation contract source is not verified, so full behavioral analysis is not possible.

hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: A fair-launch ERC-20/ERC-721 hybrid token (QUIVER, 4663 supply) on Robinhood Chain that seeds a single Uniswap v4 ETH/QUIVER pool with its entire supply and distributes pool swap fees to NFT holders pro-rata. The afterSwap hook callback is a no-op; token/NFT synchronization runs via ERC-20 transfer hooks.

hook.name: FactoryHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for bonding-curve token factory pools that gates swaps until the token's LP stage is reached, applies a volatility-based dynamic fee split between LPs and a protocol treasury via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas, and records tick observations with a truncated oracle.

hook.name: HookrModularHookV6
hook.description: Modular Uniswap v4 hook with per-pool pluggable module stacks managed via a stack registry. Applies dynamic LP fees and before/after swap deltas for fee extraction across composable modules, with optional MEV-correction arb and a trusted-caller enrollment system for structured hookData.

hook.name: FlowPadCurveHook
hook.description: FlowPad bonding-curve launch hook. Seeds a pool with single-sided concentrated token liquidity; buyers walk the price down accumulating ETH, functioning as a real on-chain bonding curve. Enforces a configurable snipe guard (first N blocks restricted to the launcher), takes ETH-denominated trade fees split between creator and protocol via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and supports permissionless graduation once the curve sells out.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that computes a two-component dynamic fee (base + surge) via an external fee manager and redirects a configurable share of swap fees into full-range protocol-owned liquidity through an external liquidity manager.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a tokenized-stock launch mechanism where each pool has a fixed per-launch swap fee (0–5%), split among the creator, platform, and a bid-wall bucket. The bid wall periodically places single-sided quote-token liquidity one tick spacing below spot; captured tokens are permanently sequestered. A graduation threshold latches once price falls to a configured tick, after which external liquidity is unlocked.

hook.name: HolyHoodFeeHook
hook.description: Applies asymmetric LP fee overrides in beforeSwap: 5% (50,000 pips) for ETH-in (zeroForOne) swaps and 7% (70,000 pips) for token-in swaps, using LPFeeLibrary.OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG. Fee constants are hardcoded immutables; the hook has no owner or administrative controls.

hook.name: TitanHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for token launches that charges a configurable platform fee plus per-token buy/sell taxes on each swap, applies a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys made within a set number of blocks after launch, and routes all collected fees to the token creator's claimable balance.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pools that adjusts LP fees based on US market trading sessions (open, overnight, closed) using a configurable on-chain calendar with opening descent and closing ramp mechanics. Supports per-pool directional fee premiums and admin fee overrides (pokes) with TTL expiry.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A pmav.fun V2 bonding-curve fair-launch hook (quoted/RWA variant) that runs coin sales directly as a Uniswap v4 pool. Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet-cap with auto-refund waterfall, and a decaying anti-snipe buy premium; on reaching the raise target it automatically graduates the pool to a standard Uniswap v4 position with permanently locked full-range liquidity.

hook.name: RobinhoodRWIV4LaunchHook
hook.description: A factory and beforeInitialize hook on Robinhood Chain for permissionless fixed-supply TOKEN/RWI Uniswap v4 pool launches. Liquidity is permanently locked and priced via 30-minute TWAP oracles (RWI/WETH and WETH/USDG) targeting a $10,000 USD market cap. Pool creators can claim accrued swap fees automatically converted to native ETH.

hook.name: RhmiFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed ETH-side trade tax (immutable basis points, max 4%) on all swaps in native ETH/RHMI pools, sending fees directly to an immutable treasury. Uses return-delta hooks: beforeSwap handles cases where ETH is the specified amount; afterSwap handles cases where ETH is the unspecified amount.

hook.name: HoodXLaunchHook
hook.description: An identity hook that restricts pool initialization to a bound factory address, recording only pools created by the HoodX factory. Swaps and liquidity are fully standard Uniswap V4 behavior with no modifications.

hook.name: BeaconProxy
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy, delegating all logic to a beacon-controlled upgradeable implementation (0xca3EB46Cc39c7426307c36BAFC97F585c6244884). Implements beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, and afterSwap callbacks. Implementation source was not available for analysis.

hook.name: EggsFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Eggs Launchpad pools that charges a flat fee (0.1%–5.2%) on ETH-denominated swaps: taken from the input on buys (beforeSwap) and from the output on sells (afterSwap), forwarded to a per-pool fee vault. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert. Pool registration is restricted to a single authorized factory address.

hook.name: BlendHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that enables basket token trading by intercepting swaps and settling them at exact NAV through mint/redeem on registered BasketVault contracts, bypassing the AMM curve entirely. Liquidity addition is refused; every swap routes constituent purchases or redemptions through per-basket route pools.

hook.name: HookPadHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all HookPad token launch pools, enforcing a 5-second anti-snipe window with a 60% buy tax routed to the protocol treasury, followed by a dynamic tiered buy/sell tax schedule cycling per global trade count. All fees are taken from the native ETH side of every swap and forwarded to a fee locker for distribution to the token creator or treasury.

hook.name: WethFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: Charges a WETH-denominated fee (3%, 5%, or 10% based on the token's launch tier, or a global fallback rate) on every swap by intercepting the WETH leg via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Accrued fees are distributed permissionlessly among a treasury, token creator, a flagship buyback vault, and the token's on-chain reward mechanism.

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: Locks a launch pool by restricting initialization to a designated launchpad address, restricting liquidity additions to a designated locker address (or the position manager acting on the locker's behalf), and permanently reverting any liquidity removals.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an ERC1967 upgradeable proxy. The implementation contract source is not available for analysis; the hook has beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, and beforeSwapReturnsDelta flags enabled, indicating it modifies swap amounts.

hook.name: P0nziHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook paired with a deflationary ERC-20 (p0nzi) that permanently burns a percentage of each swap output: 1% on ETH→p0nzi buys via direct incineration, and 5% on p0nzi→ETH sells via a nested internal buyback swap that converts the fee ETH back to p0nzi and incinerates it.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: A graduation gate hook for GreenTown token pools that restricts pool initialization to a designated migrator and blocks all swaps until the pool is explicitly opened (after locked graduation liquidity is deposited). One hook instance serves all GreenTown tokens, with per-pool open state keyed by PoolId.

hook.name: UniswapPoolsV4FeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic-fee hook that charges ETH fees (1–5%) on buys in beforeSwap and sells in afterSwap, scaling the fee with the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool feeRecipient; only exact-input swaps are supported (exact-output swaps always revert).

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops; only afterInitialize is active.

hook.name: LiquidityGate
hook.description: Restricts liquidity operations so only an immutable designated locker address can add liquidity, and permanently prevents any real liquidity removal (liquidityDelta < 0) for all position owners, while allowing zero-delta calls for LP fee collection. Swaps are unaffected and route through standard Uniswap v4 logic.

hook.name: NoCurveHookV2
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for the NoCurve launchpad that charges a 1% input-side fee on exact-input WETH-paired swaps via BeforeSwapDelta, escrowing fees for launchpad distribution. Includes a time-limited anti-snipe mechanism that caps per-buy WETH spend during a configurable launch window, expiring at a set timestamp.

hook.name: OrielFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Oriel token launch pools that charges a volatility-based dynamic fee (between a per-pool baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps) on buys and sells in the pool's quote currency, distributing fees directly to the pool creator's wallet; only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: HOODDOGFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based fee hook that charges ETH fees (1–5%) on swaps, scaling the fee by the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are collected via delta returns in beforeSwap (buys, zeroForOne exact-input) and afterSwap (sells), then forwarded directly to a per-pool fee recipient via poolManager.take().

hook.name: WolfHook
hook.description: A token launch hook for the WOLF token that runs a 24-hour fixed-price sale against SPY via a restricted market pool, then transitions to open trading with a permanent ask position. A separate floor pool allows WOLF holders to redeem tokens at the initial sale price from a SPY reserve.

hook.name: HashPegHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the HashPeg protocol that opens a pool binding on first liquidity provision, advances an on-chain entropy chain after each swap (for the associated vessel token to consume), and exposes a donateToPool function that distributes ETH to liquidity providers.

hook.name: Bonker Static Fee Hook (Robinhood Chain)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Bonker token pools that charges fixed LP fees configured at initialization, with separate rates for bonker-side and paired-side swaps. The hook collects a 20% protocol fee of the LP fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, routing fees to the Bonker factory address.

hook.name: FairLaunchHook
hook.description: A fair-launch bonding curve hook that bypasses the Uniswap v4 CL AMM via `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`. ETH↔token swaps execute against a custom curve reserve with configurable buy/sell fees and a floor reserve. Liquidity addition is permanently forbidden. Each swap requires `SwapHookData` (trader, recipient, minOut, deadline) in `hookData`; only a designated router address may trigger swaps.

hook.name: RiseHook
hook.description: A tokenomics hook that charges an ETH fee on sells, accumulates proceeds as ERC-6909 claims, and when reserves cross a configurable threshold, atomically market-buys its own token through the same pool and queues tokens for burning. Buybacks and burns are permissionless and can also be triggered externally via `buyback()` and `flushBurn()`.

hook.name: RobinhoodV4SelectableFeeHook
hook.description: A token-launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1.5% base fee plus a configurable 0-10% creator fee on the payment-token side of each swap. Fees are collected in beforeSwap/afterSwap via delta returns and minted as ERC-6909 claims to a single claimRecipient. Pool fee configs and LP positions are immutable after factory registration.

hook.name: ZentralCoreFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for the Zentral launchpad. Fees scale between a per-pool base and max rate (0.25%–3%) based on previous-swap tick movement, collected in ETH, token, or both per pool configuration. Input-side fees are taken in beforeSwap; output-side fees in afterSwap. Exact-output swaps are rejected; only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers afterInitialize to validate permissions. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops. Pool initialization is handled externally via a liquidity bootstrapper contract that sets the initial tick.

hook.name: SniperHook
hook.description: A hook for factory-registered tokens that collects fees on buy and sell swaps using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, applies an elevated snipe tax during the first N blocks after token launch, and accumulates collected fees claimable by token creators.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements tiered fee collection: charges an 85% anti-sniper fee for the first 30 seconds after pool launch, then applies a configurable base fee (100–500 bps). Fees are taken via poolManager.take() in both beforeSwap and afterSwap, accumulated per pool, and claimable by the factory in ETH.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A minimal test hook that implements the four liquidity callbacks (beforeAddLiquidity, afterAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity) as pure no-ops, returning only the expected selectors with no additional logic or state changes.

hook.name: StockFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: A fee hook for stock-paired TOKEN/<stock> launch pools on the LaunchFair V2 platform. Charges a fixed fee on the quote (stock) leg of every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta return values, accrues fees as ERC-6909 claims, then permissionlessly converts them stock→WETH on Uniswap V3 and distributes the proceeds in native ETH across creator, treasury, mechanism, and buyback recipients. No admin surface; all parameters are constructor immutables.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad pools that restricts pool initialization to a trusted Launchpad address and emits a PoolSwap event on every swap for off-chain indexing. Takes no hook deltas and does not alter swap execution.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Full-range liquidity management hook with dynamic LP fees (base + surge) computed by an on-chain DynamicFeeManager, a truncated geometric TWAP oracle for price observation, and automatic reinvestment of protocol fees into full-range positions. Supports exactIn and exactOut fee extraction via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta.

hook.name: CreatorFeeHook
hook.description: An immutable custom-accounting hook that charges a fee on every swap in canonical WETH. Fees are split between a creator and a platform, accumulated as PoolManager ERC-6909 claims, and deposited into a fee escrow contract via `settleFees()`.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook (1 fee tier)
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1% LP fee (split 50/50 between creator and treasury) on all swaps, plus a time-limited buy/sell tax, for tokens graduated via the Livo launchpad. Swaps revert before a token's graduation event.

hook.name: LiquidityGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to a single authorized hub address by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity if the sender is not the hub. All other hook callbacks revert with HookNotImplemented, leaving swap behavior entirely unchanged.

hook.name: VanhoodFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pools on VanhoodLaunch. Charges buys on ETH input (beforeSwap) and sells on ETH output (afterSwap) using a fee ranging from 1% to 6% BPS scaled by the prior swap's tick movement, with fees forwarded directly to a per-pool fee recipient.

hook.name: RobinCoreHookV3
hook.description: Fee distribution, anti-sniper taxation, and auto-buyback-burn hook for ROBINCORE pools. After each swap in registered pools, it collects buy/sell fees and distributes them to the creator, referrer, platform, and gas recipients, with configurable sniper protection that applies a high sell tax to early buyers during the launch window.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for a token launch platform. Charges ETH-denominated fees on buys via dynamic LP fee override and on sells via afterSwap delta taking, accumulating sell fees on-hook for off-path locker withdrawal. Tracks bonding curve graduation progress.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state. Only the afterInitialize flag is active, but the callback is a pure no-op; an external initializePools() function delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. Swap behavior is entirely unmodified.

hook.name: HoodsHook  hoods.meme launchpad
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad fee hook that collects a market-cap-tiered ETH fee (max 1%) on swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token creator. Fees are waived on the pool's launch block and step down as market cap grows.

hook.name: HookPadAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe hook for HookPad token launches that applies a 50% tax (25% creator / 25% platform) to non-whitelisted ETH buys within the first 3 seconds of launch, then collects normal platform and creator fees on all subsequent swaps. Fees are always taken in ETH and forwarded to HookPadFeeLocker.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers the afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in the hook callback. A separate initializePools() function (callable by anyone) invokes an external bootstrapper contract to record the initial tick and set a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap logic is implemented; all swap-related callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools token-launch pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window (50% flat tax on non-whitelisted buys) and a dynamic tiered fee schedule on all swaps. Ordinary buy/sell taxes split 20% to a protocol treasury and 80% accrued for the token creator in ETH; snipe taxes route 100% to the treasury.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 5% fee on every swap, always collected in ETH (currency0) regardless of swap direction. Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address by skimming ETH via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad factory on Uniswap V4 that creates 1B-supply ERC20 coins paired against an immutable ERC20 quote token (USDG). Manages a concentrated curve position with a 1% fee (70% creator / 30% platform), enforces a permanent 2% per-wallet buy cap with auto-refund, and graduates the coin to a permanently locked full-range position when the raise target is met.

hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: Takes a 1.5% ETH fee on both buy (ETH→token) and sell (token→ETH) swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, distributing proceeds to token holders (via DividendToken.fundPot), the pool creator, a platform address, and an ops address. Pool creation is gated to an authorized factory via beforeInitialize.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: Launchpad hook combining an optional anti-sniper temporal gate on early swaps, platform-and-creator fee redirection from swap output, and optional per-pool buyback-burn on token purchases. Pool initialization is restricted to an authorized Graduator contract set once by the deployer.

hook.name: HedgeFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based ETH fee hook for ETH/token pools launched by a bound factory. Charges fees in native ETH on buys (from input, in beforeSwap) and sells (from output, in afterSwap), scaling the fee rate dynamically between a configurable base and maximum BPS (1%–7%) based on the previous swap's tick movement.

hook.name: TokenLaunchpad
hook.description: A permissionless token launchpad that deploys fixed-supply ERC-20 tokens and initializes native-currency Uniswap v4 pools with permanent bootstrapped liquidity. Uses beforeInitialize to revert any external pool initialization attempt, ensuring only the launchpad itself can create pools for launched tokens.

hook.name: WingsHook
hook.description: A swap fee hook for tokens enlisted by a WingsFactory. Charges a configurable fee on swaps, applying an elevated "snare" rate for early buys within a configurable block window after token listing. Accrued fees are stashed per pilot (token creator) and claimable at any time.

hook.name: PRAdaptiveHookv2
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (0-5% max) on swaps involving the PR token. Buy fees are paid in PR, sell fees in ETH. Fees are forwarded to a buyback vault address. Only operates on owner-allowlisted pools.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: Upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and afterSwap permissions. The actual hook logic resides in an unverified implementation contract; behavior cannot be fully analyzed from the proxy source alone.

hook.name: PulseV4Hook
hook.description: Adjusts LP fees dynamically using time-decayed trading volume across nearby tick buckets (half-life one hour), with an additional gas-price-proportional project fee capped at 0.30%. The owner can pause protocol fee collection and withdraw accrued ERC-6909 revenue; LP principal is never touched by the hook.

hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for the Quiver launchpad on Robinhood Chain that skims a configurable tax (0–10%) on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating fees that are harvested and split 50/25/25 among token holders (as stock rewards), the pool creator (as WETH), and the protocol treasury.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells), always denominated in ETH (currency0), by skimming the fee from the specified or unspecified ETH leg via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and forwarding it to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: OneSidedWethLaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that deploys a new ERC-20 token, initializes a WETH-paired Uniswap v4 pool, and mints a one-sided (token-only) liquidity position locked via V4PositionLocker. Direct liquidity additions are blocked except through the hook's own createLaunch flow.

hook.name: BonniHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook binding to a single native-ETH/BONNI token pool that gates trading behind an owner-controlled boolean switch and skims ETH fees from every swap (10% buy / 15% sell during an 8-minute launch window, then 2% flat), routing collected fees directly to a BonniFeeDistributor contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial pool tick after initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: DynamicFeeRebalanceHook
hook.description: Adjusts LP fees dynamically based on an EMA of tick movement (bounded by configurable min/max and max step per block), skims a configurable revenue share from each swap into ERC-6909 claims redeemable by the fee recipient, and emits non-custodial upward-rebalance suggestions when the pool price drifts above a configured tick threshold.

hook.name: DescendingFeeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe descending swap fee hook that charges a high fee (up to 99%) at pool launch, holds it briefly, then parabolically decays to a creator-set terminal rate; fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager and released to the launcher via collect(). LP fee is always static zero.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that charges ETH-denominated swap fees on every ETH/token trade, splitting revenue between the token creator, a platform treasury, and up to three referral tiers. Fees accumulate as native ETH in per-wallet claimable balances and are withdrawn via a pull-based claim function.

hook.name: GoofyhoodFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for Goofyhood-launched ETH/token pools. Charges ETH fees on buys (from input in beforeSwap) and sells (from output in afterSwap), scaling dynamically between configurable base and max fees (1%–5.9%) based on the previous swap's tick movement.

hook.name: LanternToll
hook.description: A decaying anti-snipe toll hook that charges up to 25% of the ETH leg on all four swap shapes at pool launch, declining linearly to 1% over 180 seconds from the seeder's first liquidity add. Tolls accrue as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and are permissionlessly collectable to a fixed treasury address.

hook.name: CashPerpHookV2
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that charges a configurable basis-point fee (max 20%) on registered pools, always denominated in the quote currency (the non-strategy-token side of the pool). Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims directly to a strategy vault, with per-address fee exemptions for keeper buyback routers.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The afterInitialize permission flag is set in the address but the callback is a no-op stub. Tick recording occurs via the separate initializePools() external function, which calls the liquidity bootstrapper contract. Swap behavior is identical to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: BasketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook serving as both a factory and trading engine for basket tokens (multi-asset index ERC-20s) paired with USDG. Swaps trigger atomic basket minting (buy) or redemption (sell) by routing through constituent asset markets via Uniswap v3/v4 legs, with fee accrual to a fee auction contract.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock launches that charges a per-pool fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at launch and immutable) split 80%/5%/15% among creator, bid-wall reserve, and platform. The bid wall places single-sided quote-token liquidity one tick spacing below spot; any tokens the wall acquires are permanently sequestered.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable WETH-denominated fee on every swap through registered pools, using BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta mechanics to take the fee from the WETH leg regardless of swap direction or exactness. Accrued fees are split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury and claimed permissionlessly.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: A launch tax hook that deducts a configurable fee (in basis points) from the gross input of each exact-input swap, accumulates the tax on-chain per pool and asset, and allows anyone to collect accrued fees into an immutable reward vault.

hook.name: OreToll
hook.description: OreToll charges a flat 1% fee on the ETH leg of all swaps in a single owner-pinned pool, collected via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager and can be withdrawn permissionlessly to an owner-configurable treasury address. The fee schedule has equal min and max (both 1%), making the rate constant.

hook.name: BabyAIHook
hook.description: Charges a 3.33% fee on both buys and sells of a fixed AI/BAI pair, always denominated in the AI (quote) token. Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient via poolManager.take(); after each swap, a capped-gas call to creditHolders() on the recipient distributes accumulated fees to holders, triggered at most once per minute.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $TIPOFF token that charges a fixed 5% fee on all swaps, always collected in ETH (currency0). Fees are taken via BeforeSwapDelta when ETH is the specified currency and via AfterSwapDelta otherwise, then routed to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: HookrModularHookV6Wth
hook.description: A modular Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee and performs on-chain arbitrage recapture (MEV correction) on every qualifying swap by dispatching a nested correction swap through a pool-configured executor. Swap accounting is delegated via delegatecall to an immutable, codehash-verified accounting kernel; trusted routers may supply signed hookData for enriched payer/recipient routing.

hook.name: CreatorDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically adjusts the LP fee (0.05%–5%) based on tick movement between swaps to reflect current volatility, and accrues 1% of each swap's output volume as creator commissions withdrawable by a designated pool creator address.

hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: A multi-strategy hook that collects a time-decaying swap fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta, splitting proceeds between an ops wallet and fee collector. Pools are owner-initialized and mapped to configurable strategies; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: PrinterHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that extracts a 1% protocol fee and a configurable creator fee (up to 5%) in ETH on every swap, distributing proceeds to a treasury, token creator, holder reward pool, and optional swap referrer. Only the registered factory can create pools, and all liquidity is permanently locked at launch.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based swap fee hook for ETH/token pools launched via the v4.fun platform. Charges 1–7% fees in ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), with the fee rate scaling based on the previous swap's tick movement; fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient.

hook.name: ScaleProxy
hook.description: ERC1967 upgradeable proxy for the Scale protocol; all hook logic is delegated to an unverified implementation contract and cannot be analyzed from the available source.

hook.name: MidasRWAHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for tokens paired with RWA quote assets (e.g. Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens). Charges a 1% steady-state fee split four ways: 0.35% to LPs, 0.35% accrued for GOLD buy-and-burn (sent to dead address), 0.22% to the pool deployer, and 0.08% as an immutable template royalty. An 8% launch surcharge decays linearly over 120 seconds, with a 1.5x multiplier on sells. Burn sweeps are rate-limited to once per hour with a 10% reference-price band and 3% slippage floor.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Registers an afterInitialize callback (no-op returning the selector) and exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed liquidity and record the initial tick. No swap interception occurs.

hook.name: Scale Hook
hook.description: Upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook for the Scale protocol that acts as a virtual concentrated liquidity provider, computing and settling token amounts via beforeSwap and afterSwap balance deltas based on registered LP positions stored on-chain.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad-created token pools that gates pool initialization and liquidity to a factory, blocks third-party liquidity adds/removes, and charges a per-swap fee on the unspecified currency split among creator, platform, and referrer, with a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge over a configurable block window after launch.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Only the afterInitialize flag is set; the callback is a no-op (returns the selector immediately). Pool initialization is handled externally via a LIQUIDITY_BOOTSTRAPPER contract that seeds liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: FablesRWAETH
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pools that sets LP fees based on US market calendar sessions (open, overnight, closed) with a linear opening descent and closing ramp driven by block.timestamp. Supports operator "poke" overrides with TTL and per-pool fee caps. The ETH variant adds native ETH (currency0) settlement support via WETH wrapping.

hook.name: TripHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable WETH levy (default 1%, max 3%) on exact-input TRIP token sells in a single canonical pool, forwarding the levy directly to a SporeVault address via afterSwap delta return. Buys are exempt; the levy rate is governance-controlled within the hard cap.

hook.name: EVPLUSAI
hook.description: Immutable dynamic-fee hook where a per-pool worker posts directional LP fee budgets (0.025%–0.9%, TTL 5 min, defaulting to 0.05% on expiry). beforeSwap overrides the LP fee with 90% of the posted budget; afterSwap collects a 10% platform fee as a return delta, minted as ERC-6909 claims to the hook and sweepable to a configured treasury.

hook.name: RetardV1227PoolHook
hook.description: Manages creator token liquidity markets with restricted pool access: only the hook and an authorized inventory manager can initialize pools or modify liquidity. After each public swap, notifies a protocol contract of the updated sqrt price for price tracking.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that captures the full trading fee via before/afterSwap deltas (denominated in the quote/WETH currency) across three phases: a guard phase with exponentially decaying fees (90%→3%) and per-wallet/per-block buy caps, a bonding-curve phase (1% flat fee), and a graduated phase (1% flat fee). Fees are distributed through an attached FeeRouter with optional referrer attribution via hookData.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Inherits AeonFee (mandatory 0.10% skim on every swap's unspecified currency) and adds an opt-in 0.07% tribute via hookData, both routed directly to a fixed treasury address. When hookData encodes a player address, cumulative per-pool volume is tracked and a champion leaderboard is updated.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that collects buy/sell fees on every swap and splits them between a creator, platform treasury, optional referral tiers, and a dividend pool. Enforces anti-snipe windows and max-buy limits during a fair launch period, with optional automatic buyback-and-burn triggered by accumulated fee thresholds.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. All hook callbacks are pure no-ops that return their respective selectors. An external initializePools() function records the initial tick by delegating to a liquidity bootstrapper contract and sets a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: NexsetsHook
hook.description: Token-launch fee hook that withholds ETH fees from buys and sells via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Applies a cycling 1–5% tax schedule for both directions, a 60% anti-snipe tax during a 4-second post-launch window (with an owner-controlled whitelist), an admin-controlled special sell-tax override (up to 60%), and enforces a one-time LP seed lock. All fees route 100% to treasury.

hook.name: Rivers LaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Rivers protocol launch pools, managing a pre/post-graduation lifecycle. During pre-launch phases, liquidity and swaps are restricted to the pool controller. After graduation, public swaps are enabled with protocol and creator fees taken as BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta values and a dynamic LP fee override returned from beforeSwap.

hook.name: HoodMarketsHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: HoodMarkets protocol hook with static per-pool LP fees (capped at 10%) and a 20% protocol fee extracted on each swap via delta manipulation. Features a time-limited MEV module (active for 2 minutes post-deployment) that can temporarily raise fees, and optional pool extensions invoked in afterSwap.

hook.name: ApeLaunchHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that gates pool creation to pre-registered pools (via beforeInitialize) and restricts liquidity additions to authorized callers (launchpad or locker) using transient storage (via beforeAddLiquidity). Swaps are not intercepted; the full launch fee is embedded in the PoolKey LP fee rather than charged by this hook.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a fixed 5% fee on both buys and sells, always collected in ETH (currency0), routed to an immutable fee recipient address. When ETH is the specified currency the fee is skimmed in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; when ETH is the unspecified currency it is skimmed in afterSwap via AfterSwapDelta.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for a token launchpad platform that collects swap fees (up to 1%) on registered tokens and distributes them among token creators, platform treasury, and referral tiers. Supports optional buyback-and-burn of creator fees, dividend tax routing, and time-based anti-snipe and fair-launch windows.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad token pool hook that intercepts swaps to collect a configurable tax (up to 10%), split among creator fees, platform fees (0.5%), and token holder dividends distributed via a dividend sink on each swap.

hook.name: BeaconProxy Hook
hook.description: Upgradeable hook using the OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy pattern; all hook logic is delegated to an implementation contract controlled by the beacon owner. Hooks active: beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap — implementation source was unavailable so behavioral properties could not be verified from source.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1% swap fee (0.7% to pool creator, 0.3% to platform) on ETH/token pairs using beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns, accumulating fees in a separate vault contract. LP is permanently locked after a single seed addition; all subsequent liquidity additions and removals revert.

hook.name: BackedFeeHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook that charges a fixed 3% swap tax in native ETH (currency0) on all swaps, routing the full fee to a vault address. Fee collection is split between beforeSwap (ETH-specified swaps) and afterSwap (ETH-unspecified swaps) using return deltas; non-ETH pools pass through untaxed.

hook.name: AnyQuoteSharedHookV1
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools that intercepts swaps to collect platform and creator fees, minting them as ERC-6909 claims to a ledger contract. Pool registration is restricted to an authorized host address; once registered, any user may swap freely.

hook.name: AgenEngineHookV2
hook.description: A market engine hook that replaces the LP fee with its own tiered fee structure, collected via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapDelta returns based on trade side and size. Enforces configurable per-market trade size bounds (min/max token and quote amounts) and optionally restricts liquidity provisioning to a factory address.

hook.name: PvpV4Hook
hook.description: Launch-window hook for a single PVP/USDG 1% pool. Before market open (pvp.marketOpen()), restricts PVP buys to the designated launch router and blocks non-locker liquidity additions; the locker's LP position is permanently locked. Uses transient storage (EIP-1153) to authorize PVP token transfers during router-initiated buys. After market open, beforeSwap is a no-op for all participants.

hook.name: HookrHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for Hookr-graduated pools with configurable anti-snipe guard (block-gated buy caps and extra LP fees), dynamic surge fees scaled by trade size, auto-burn of token output to 0xdEaD, LP reward donations inside the swap, and a deterministic per-pool jackpot on qualifying buys (no randomness claimed).

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeInitialize, and beforeAddLiquidity permissions that return swap deltas. The implementation contract source is not available for further analysis.

hook.name: DriftHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects fees on swaps via swap deltas — combining a protocol fee, an optional creator buy/sell tax, and a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys. Collected fees are credited to the token creator and claimed via a pull-payment mechanism.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for all pools created by LaunchFactory. Takes trading fees on the stock side (currency0) of each pair—on input for exact-input buys, on output for all other cases—and splits each fee among a platform treasury (30%), a pool creator, and token holders via a FeeDistributor. Exact-output sells are not supported and will revert.

hook.name: CashCatMachineHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to a single designated machine address, ensuring it is the sole liquidity provider in the pool. All other hook callbacks (including swap hooks) are disabled and revert if called.

hook.name: GeysirHook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the $GEYSIR token that calls token.start() on pool initialization to activate the token. Only the afterInitialize flag is set; it has no swap or liquidity hooks and does not modify swap behavior in any way.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT hook that deploys multi-range concentrated liquidity across weighted tick buckets in beforeSwap and removes it in afterSwap, with idle assets parked in owner-configured ERC-4626 vaults between swaps. LP fee is static, fixed at pool creation. Access is gated by a per-pool liveness flag toggleable by the owner.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Three-phase token launchpad hook: a 50-block guard phase with exponentially decaying fees (90%→3%), a flat 1% curve phase until a cumulative quote graduation threshold is met, then a permanent 1% graduated phase. The hook captures 100% of trading fees via before/afterSwap deltas and routes them through a FeeRouter. Per-wallet and per-block buy caps are enforced during the first 100 L2 blocks to limit sniping.

hook.name: ChaplinFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based ETH fee hook for ChaplinLauncher pools. Charges dynamic fees (scaling between a configurable base and max bps based on the previous swap's tick movement) on ETH inputs for buys via beforeSwap delta, and on ETH outputs for sells via afterSwap delta. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve token launch hook for pmav.fun V2 (Quoted variant). Implements a virtual AMM curve with 1% fees, block+1 anti-snipe delay, decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, 2% first-hour buy cap with auto-refund, and automatic in-place graduation to a standard Uniswap V4 pool when the raise target is reached. Quote currency is an ERC20 (e.g. USDG) rather than native ETH.

hook.name: MorphogenHook
hook.description: Two-phase token launch hook implementing a bonding curve (Formation phase) with custom ERC6909 claim accounting via BeforeSwapDelta, transitioning to native Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity after 75M tokens are sold. Enforces a time-locked launch gate and maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle after the permanent phase begins.

hook.name: FarmIndexFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for ETH/token pairs launched via FarmIndexLauncher. Charges ETH fees on swap input for buys (beforeSwap) and on ETH output for sells (afterSwap), with the fee rate scaling between a configured base and max BPS based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to the pool's fee recipient on every swap.

hook.name: HypzFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for HypzLaunch ETH/token pools. Charges native ETH fees on buys (from input in beforeSwap) and sells (from ETH output in afterSwap), with the rate scaling between a configurable base and max (both in 1%–6.6%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are accepted.

hook.name: MarketHoursFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies a dynamic LP fee based on US equity market sessions (regular, extended, or closed), charging a base fee plus a time-of-day surcharge derived from block.timestamp and US Eastern time, to compensate LPs for stale-price risk outside trading hours. The hook holds no funds, has no owner, and cannot revert inside a swap.

hook.name: DegenSpyV1Hook
hook.description: Applies tiered hook fees on every SPY-token pool swap, splitting accrued SPY between an operating treasury, a buyback vault, and a pool beneficiary. Fees combine a time-decaying launch component with a permanent rate, enforced via updateDynamicLPFee on every swap.

hook.name: UnifleHook
hook.description: A pure afterSwap observer hook for Unifle-launched token pools on Robinhood chain. Emits a SwapObserved event on every swap for off-chain analytics indexing; does not modify swap deltas or collect fees (fees are handled by the ERC-20 token's _update() override).

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_RH
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to factory-registered pools and sets a dynamic LP fee once via `poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee()` in `afterInitialize`. Has no swap-time callbacks; all swap behavior is standard Uniswap v4.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad-created token pools that overrides LP fees to 0 and instead collects a tiered, market-cap-based fee directly from each swap, with an optional time-decaying anti-sniper surcharge. Liquidity additions are restricted to the initial launch position, and fees are distributed to configurable dev and partner wallets in the same transaction.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds only the afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in that callback. Includes an external initializePools() function that delegates to a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract to set up initial tick and liquidity positions.

hook.name: FamilyLaunchHook
hook.description: FamilyLaunchHook registers one token launch per pool, capturing a per-pool swap fee, optional directional buy/sell tax, and a time-limited anti-snipe tax via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Captured fees are donated back to the pool LP in afterSwap. Supports progressive liquidity tiers for relaunches; hookData is unused and no custom swap data is required.

hook.name: InitializerHook
hook.description: InitializerHook (v3.1.1) restricts pool initialization to a single authorized address. Only beforeInitialize is implemented, so the hook takes no part in swaps.

hook.name: PackedHook
