hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An OpenZeppelin ERC1967 transparent proxy pointing to an unverified implementation contract that contains the actual Uniswap v4 hook logic. The hook flags (beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnsDelta, afterSwapReturnsDelta, and liquidity hooks) are encoded in the address bitmask, but the implementation source is not available for analysis.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that defines pool configuration constants (3000 bps fee, 60 tick spacing) and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; all swap-related callbacks are absent or no-ops, so swap behavior is fully vanilla.

hook.name: MemeFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 4% fee on all swaps in ETH-paired pools (currency0 = native ETH), always denominating the fee in ETH and routing it directly to an immutable treasury address. The fee is taken in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency and in afterSwap otherwise, using return-delta hooks.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects platform swap fees on every trade and splits them between the token creator and a treasury. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the first N blocks post-launch and a time-limited deployer-dump surcharge on sells. Automatically executes buyback-and-burn of the launched token using the creator's designated share of fees.

hook.name: MemeRaceHook
hook.description: Timed meme-racing game hook on WETH/meme Uniswap v4 pools. Takes a 1.2% WETH swap fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas (anti-snipe buy fees decay from 100% over 10 blocks), tracks featured Top 3 by net WETH flow, and on round end buys back podium memes from the prize pool into treasury. Swaps require an active game window.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token pools that charges configurable directional buy/sell fees (1%–10% in 1% steps), splitting proceeds between a creator reward vault and an immutable launcher fee recipient. Fees are collected via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap delta returns; pools must be pre-registered by the token creator before they can be initialized or traded.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single ETH/FWAToken pool that charges a flat 1% fee on both buys and sells via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing fees to an owner-set address. Buys are gated by an owner-controlled boolean (externalBuysEnabled); only registered protocol modules may buy while gating is active. Exact-output swaps are always rejected.

hook.name: NullTreasuryFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 0.50% hook fee on the unspecified side of every swap in a single native ETH/NULL pool, accumulating fees as ERC-6909 claims. Anyone can call claimFees to send accrued fees to an immutable treasury address. Pool creation is gated in beforeInitialize to a single hardcoded pool key.

hook.name: ArcheryFeeHookV2
hook.description: A skill-gated launch hook for native ETH/token pools where all swaps pay a configurable default fee (up to 20%) unless the swapper presents a short-lived EIP-712 voucher earned in an off-chain archery mini-game. Fees are collected in native ETH via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta; the registrar can only lower fees (one-way ratchet), with zero acting as a permanent graduation to fee-free trading.

hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook for the Quiver platform on Robinhood Chain that skims a per-pool tax (0–10%) on every swap via afterSwap using the return-delta mechanism, accruing fees in WETH or the launched token. Harvested fees are split 50/25/25 among token holders (converted to a configured stock reward), the pool creator (claimable WETH), and a protocol treasury.

hook.name: MagiStockFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% ETH fee on every swap in the designated ETH/MSTOCK pool, minting PoolManager native-currency claims to an immutable fee distributor. Pool LP fee is 0; enforces the designated pool key and initial price on initialization.

hook.name: QuiverHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for the Quiver launchpad on Robinhood Chain. In afterSwap, skims a per-token tax (0–10%, fixed at launch) from every trade via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Accrued fees can be harvested permissionlessly and are split 50/25/25 among token holders (as purchased stock rewards), the pool creator (as claimable WETH), and the protocol treasury.

hook.name: RobinVistaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for RobinVista launch pools that charges a configurable trading fee (up to 10%) in the pool's base token regardless of swap direction or exact-in/out type. Fees are collected as PoolManager claims and distributed to five buckets (creator, holders, protocol, burn, flywheel) upon withdrawal.

hook.name: LunchTaxHookPairImmutable
hook.description: Non-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable buy/sell taxes on the quote token of each managed pool. Proceeds are distributed to the token creator, platform fee sink, and referrers, with optional launch guards (trading-open delay, max-buy cap, and a decaying launch-window tax rate).

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: Charges immutable directional buy/sell fees on native ETH/token pools, splitting fees between a token-creator vault and a fixed launcher fee recipient. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swapping is allowed.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% protocol fee on the tokenized-stock side of every buy swap in launchpad pools by adjusting hook deltas in beforeSwap (exact-input buys) and afterSwap (exact-output buys). Forwards collected fees to a FeeCollector and tracks cumulative volume, TVL, and daily metrics across all launch pools.

hook.name: BeaconProxy Hook
hook.description: Deployed as an OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy (ERC-1967 beacon pattern) pointing to implementation 0xca3EB46Cc39c7426307c36BAFC97F585c6244884. Hook logic resides in the implementation; that source was not available for analysis.

hook.name: EquityLaunchHook
hook.description: Bonding-curve launchpad hook for pools quoted in tokenized stock shares (Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens). Captures trading fees entirely on the quote side via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas, routing them through a FeeRouter (protocol/creator/referrer split). Three phases: a 50-block anti-sniper guard (90%→3% fee decay), a 1% bonding-curve phase, and a 1% graduated phase triggered by a per-pool quote raise threshold.

hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1% tax on the WETH/base-asset side of all buys and sells. The tax is minted to the launched token contract as an ERC-6909 claim in the PoolManager. Pool creation is gated to a factory, blocking third-party pool squatting; partial fills on base-asset-specified swaps are rejected to prevent tax overcharging.

hook.name: GateFeeGraduateHook
hook.description: A shared v4 hook for meme token launches that gates external liquidity (only the launcher may add LP via a one-shot per-pool gate), charges a 1% ETH fee on all swaps using the return-delta mechanism, and automatically marks a pool as graduated once net ETH inflow reaches 4 ETH.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Implements no swap, donate, or liquidity modification callbacks — swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A meme token launch hook that applies configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, distributes tax proceeds to fund, burn, dividend, and liquidity buckets in afterSwap, and blocks third-party LP additions during a configurable anti-farmer lock period.

hook.name: PairPadMemeHook
hook.description: Singleton fee-collection hook for graduated PairPad meme token pools. Takes a configurable fee (hookFeeBps + creatorTaxBps) from the unspecified currency on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating fees in pending balances. Fees are later converted memecoin-to-quote via internal pool swaps and distributed to protocol, creator, and an optional buyback-and-lock vault.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables the afterInitialize permission (as a no-op callback), with pool bootstrapping performed via a separate initializePools() function that calls a dedicated ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial pool tick.

hook.name: WraithVeil
hook.description: Intercepts swaps and fills up to 50% of each from an associated lending reserve (Crypt) at the pool's spot price plus a spread. Maintains a TWAP oracle and disables fills when spot price deviates more than 5% from the 15-minute average.

hook.name: SUSHIDOGFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for SUSHIDOG token launches on Uniswap v4. Charges ETH fees on buys in beforeSwap and sells in afterSwap, with the fee rate scaling between a configurable base and max (0.3%–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: RobHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies a fixed 3% trade tax on all swaps, collecting fees in the quote asset and minting ERC-6909 claims to an immutable fee recipient. Also checks a 6-hour interval in beforeSwap and calls an external triggerHeist() on the associated token contract when the interval has elapsed.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Only implements the afterInitialize flag (as a no-op callback). Pool initialization and initial tick recording are handled externally via `initializePools()`, which calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract.

hook.name: QuiverHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Quiver protocol token pools that sets directional LP fees (separate quiver-side and paired-side rates via updateDynamicLPFee), collects protocol fees by modifying swap deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap, triggers LP locker reward claims per swap, and runs an optional MEV protection module during a 2-minute window after pool creation.

hook.name: StonksHook
hook.description: A launchpad pool hook that restricts pool creation and liquidity additions to the launchpad contract, permanently locks LP positions, and collects time-varying swap fees on the quote currency (currency0) split between platform, creator, and holders, credited via ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook (V2)
hook.description: Singleton fee hook for Livo-graduated ETH/token pools. Collects LP fees and post-graduation taxes on the ETH leg across all four swap directions, routing them to a treasury fee router and per-token receivers via ILivoToken.accrueFees(). Blocks swaps on non-graduated tokens. Fees are withheld via BeforeSwapDelta or AfterSwapDelta depending on which leg the ETH amount is known.

hook.name: LiquidityGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions and removals to a single designated hub address, locking pool liquidity to one authorized provider. Swap behavior is unchanged.

hook.name: FeatheredHook
hook.description: Swap-royalty hook that takes 1.25% of each swap's unspecified currency after execution, splitting it between the pool creator (1%) and a protocol treasury (0.25%) via a pull-payment fee collector. Unregistered pools route the entire royalty to the protocol.

hook.name: PumpRobinHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 bonding-curve launch hook that charges a 2% WETH fee on every swap (split equally between creator and platform), escalating to 99% during a configurable anti-snipe window; the pool fee is overridden to 0% via lpFeeOverride and the hook takes fees directly via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. LP positions are permanently locked — removal always reverts.

hook.name: GlassBoxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook with authorized pool creation and a mandatory dynamic LP fee. beforeSwap enforces a per-pool trading-start timestamp and applies a linearly-decaying anti-snipe LP fee override. afterSwap collects a configurable protocol fee (in bps) from swap output, routes it to a configurable fee sink, and awards Prism points per swap.

hook.name: LaunchHoodHook
hook.description: Singleton memecoin launchpad hook that gates pool initialization, liquidity adds, and swaps until each token's graduation (transfersEnabled). Post-graduation, it skims ETH-denominated swap fees via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta, accruing them for collection by the protocol locker.

hook.name: FlockFall Dynamic Fee Hook
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook for FlockFall's ETH/SHELL pool that fetches the current fee decision from an external policy contract on each swap, overriding the LP fee. Restricts pool initialization to a designated bootstrap venue and blocks general liquidity additions until bootstrap is complete.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an ERC1967 upgradeable proxy. The implementation contract is not verified, so the full hook logic cannot be analyzed. The address bitmask indicates beforeSwap with delta return, beforeInitialize, and beforeAddLiquidity permissions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op stub returning the selector) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick. No swap, liquidity modification, or donate logic is active.

hook.name: NoCurveHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 fee hook for the NoCurve launchpad that intercepts exact-input swaps on WETH-paired pools, takes a 1% input-side fee via poolManager.take(), and escrows it per launched token. Only the designated launchpad contract can collect the escrow for 80/8/12 creator/referrer/platform distribution.

hook.name: LiquidHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A volatility-based dynamic fee hook from the Liquid Protocol that adjusts LP fees based on tick movement between swaps. It also charges a 20% protocol fee on the non-liquid token side of each swap, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas.

hook.name: RareFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based fee hook for RareLaunch pools that charges a configurable fee (0–6%) in the pool's quote currency on buys (beforeSwap) and sells (afterSwap), splitting fees 75/25 between the pool creator and platform operator. Only the bound launcher factory can initialize pools, and fees can only be lowered (never raised) by the creator after launch.

hook.name: DegenSpyV3Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for SPY/token pools that collects custom swap fees via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapReturnsDelta, splitting proceeds between an operating treasury, a buyback vault, and per-pool beneficiaries. Pool registration and initialization are restricted to a privileged module address; the dynamic LP fee is refreshed on every swap.

hook.name: LemonV4TaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook for lemon.fun token launches that charges configurable buy and sell fees (up to 10% creator + 0.5% protocol) in the paired asset using BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Per-pool tax settings are written once by the launcher before initialization and are immutable afterward.

hook.name: CFHook
hook.description: A CreatorFi fee hook that charges a 1% base swap fee plus optional creator-set buy/sell taxes (up to 5% each), with configurable anti-snipe and deployer-dump penalty features. All collected fees are credited to the token creator and claimable directly from the hook.

hook.name: SazareHookV2
hook.description: A bonding-curve AMM hook for SZR/WETH that uses custom accounting (BeforeSwapDelta) to route all swaps through an internal issuance curve with a WETH-backed floor price and protocol fees. Supports only exact-input swaps; external liquidity provision is forbidden.

hook.name: RewardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the BHE-v2 token that charges a 3% ETH-leg fee on all swaps, routing 100% of fees to a reward pot distributed to eligible token holders as native ETH via time-weighted push payouts. Features a ~13.6-hour buy-cap ramp at launch and one-shot 9-band liquidity seeding.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: PmavHookQuoted is a bonding curve launchpad and Uniswap V4 hook for pmav.fun. Coins (1B fixed supply) trade on an ERC20-quoted bonding curve with a 1% fee and a permanent 2% wallet cap; when 800M curve tokens are sold the pool graduates in-place to a permanently locked full-range LP position.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools. Takes WETH trading fees via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas using either a time-decaying anti-snipe schedule or a market-cap-based fee curve. Splits fees between protocol, creator, and partner; routes the creator share through a keeper-permissionless flywheel for buyback-and-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, or WETH dividends. Blocks trading until a configured timestamp and lifts launch-window token transfer limits once price crosses a target market cap.

hook.name: MemeFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a constant 4% swap tax in native ETH pools (currency0 = address(0)), routing the fee to a fixed treasury address via return deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap. Non-ETH pools pass through untaxed. No owner, admin keys, or adjustable parameters.

hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker v2 hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on a volatility accumulator derived from tick differences. Collects protocol fees on all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta manipulation, with an optional short-lived MEV protection module active at pool launch and support for pluggable pool extension callbacks.

hook.name: PairV5LaunchV2Hook
hook.description: A 0.7% fee-collection hook for launchpad token pools that charges fees on quote-currency swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and routes collected fees to a per-pool fee vault registered by an authorized registrar address.

hook.name: ZentralFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for the Zentral launchpad. Charges fees (between a base and max rate, scaled by the previous swap's tick movement) in ETH, the paired token, or both sides depending on a per-pool fee currency mode configured at registration.

hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the MultiPools platform that enforces a 1% swap fee split between pool creators (0.7%) and the platform (0.3%), collected via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Liquidity is permanently locked after the initial seed deposit.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: Anti-snipe launch fee hook that overrides the LP fee to 50% for the first 4 minutes after pool initialization, then permanently drops to 3.5%. The fee is applied via dynamic fee override in beforeSwap with no admin controls or setter functions.

hook.name: AegisHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic LP fees via an external fee manager, charges additional hook fees on swaps (split by exact-in/exact-out path), records price oracle observations, and periodically reinvests accumulated fees into full-range liquidity positions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. Has no swap-time logic; afterInitialize is a no-op returning only its selector.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4
hook.description: Shared fee hook for the Foundry launchpad on Robinhood Chain, enforcing a dynamic ETH-denominated trade fee (1.00–1.25%, tiered by pre-trade market cap) split between creator and protocol, with anti-snipe buy caps during the first 3 blocks and a block on outside liquidity providers pre-graduation.

hook.name: MoonHook
hook.description: A token launch platform hook that charges configurable BPS fees on swaps for registered tokens by taking from the swap delta. Applies an elevated snipe tax on buys during the first N blocks after launch; accrued fees are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: Bonding-curve hook for tokenized stock launches. Each pool has a fixed swap fee (0–5%) set at launch, split among creator, a bid wall, and a platform treasury. The bid wall accumulates its share of quote-token fees and places single-sided liquidity just below spot price; tokens acquired by the wall are permanently sequestered. External liquidity additions are blocked until the pool graduates.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic swap fees based on oracle-tracked volatility and surge pricing, full-range liquidity management with fee reinvestment, and a truncated geometric price oracle. In addition to the declared protocol fee, charges a hardcoded undisclosed 0.10% "AGGRESSIVE_SURGE" fee on every swap (labeled "Скрытая комиссия" — hidden commission — in source comments), with both fees minted to the liquidity manager.

hook.name: Watchtower
hook.description: Accumulates a TWAP price oracle for an LSD/counter-token pool (exposed via capture() for DAO use), and in afterSwap takes a basis-point fee on the unspecified side of each swap, holding collected fees until swept to the treasury or burned.

hook.name: V2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated launchpad v2 memecoin pools. Takes a percentage fee on every swap via afterSwap using the delta return mechanism, accumulates fees per pool, and on demand converts memecoin-denominated fees to the quote currency via internal swaps, distributing proceeds among the protocol, a buyback-and-lock vault, and the pool creator according to fee terms frozen at registration.

hook.name: OGHook
hook.description: Platform fee hook for OG.fun token launches. On every swap, collects a configurable hook fee plus optional creator buy/sell taxes from the quote token, distributes proceeds to token creators, affiliates (via hookData code), a buyback-and-burn pool, staking, and treasury. Includes decaying anti-snipe surcharges in early post-launch blocks and decaying deployer-dump surcharges in the first 48 hours.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Fee engine for a permissionless token launchpad. Charges a configurable fee (1% protocol + up to 9% creator add-on, up to 10% total) on every swap, always taken in the pool's quote asset, collected as ERC-6909 claims and settled separately. Includes an optional anti-snipe surge fee that decays linearly post-launch. Liquidity can only be seeded once by the factory and is permanently locked.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies fixed buy (3%) and sell (6%) taxes on swaps involving a designated token, deducted from the unspecified currency in afterSwap as ERC-6909 claims. Fees accumulate to the hook contract and are swept permissionlessly to a treasury address governed by a 3-day owner-controlled timelock.

hook.name: ModuleNativeHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token launches that restricts swaps to pool-registered routers (verified by address and codehash), collects creator and platform fees in native ETH via BeforeSwap/AfterSwap return deltas, and dispatches stateful module program callbacks on each trade.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker protocol hook for token-launch pools with directional static LP fees (separate rates for swapping toward vs away from the Clanker token), protocol fee collection via swap delta adjustments, and optional MEV protection module (active for the first 2 minutes post-launch) and pool extension support.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-scaled fee on every swap, ranging linearly between a base rate and a max rate (1%–5.3%) based on how far the previous swap moved the price in ticks. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims and swept to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep() function. Only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with a no-op afterInitialize callback. Features an external initializePools() function that calls a liquidity bootstrapper contract to set up pool liquidity and record the initial tick. All hook callbacks are pure stubs that return their respective selectors without performing any additional logic.

hook.name: HookrHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for pools launched via the Hookr launchpad. Provides a temporal anti-snipe guard (per-block ETH buy cap and exact-output buy block during launch window), surge fees scaling with trade size relative to in-range depth, auto-burn of a portion of token output to 0xdead, in-swap LP reward donations, and a deterministic jackpot pot awarded to every Nth qualifying buy recipient encoded in hookData.

hook.name: GazzFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a flat 2% ETH-side fee (plus an optional per-coin community fee up to 2%) on every swap in gazz.fun V4 pools, forwarding proceeds to a GazzFeeSplitter. Fee is always taken in native ETH regardless of swap direction. Rejects non-native-ETH pools at initialization.

hook.name: PonzuV4Hook
hook.description: PonzuV4Hook charges a dynamic fee that decays linearly from 20% at launch to 1% over the first hour, then remains at 1%. On each swap, 20% of collected fees are compounded back into the pool's liquidity position while the remainder is distributed to protocol and project fee addresses.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade and splits them between the token creator and treasury, with a configurable portion going to an automatic buyback-and-burn. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the blocks immediately after launch and a time-limited linearly-decaying surcharge on sells by the original deployer address.

hook.name: InstantLaunchHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable ETH-denominated tax (0–10%) on native ETH/token pools, split between the pool creator and a platform fee recipient. During a brief 4-second anti-snipe window after launch, non-whitelisted traders pay a flat 70% tax instead of the configured rate.

hook.name: M1AdaptiveHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable buy/sell fee from swap output on allowlisted M1 pools, forwarding proceeds to a buyback vault. Exact-output swaps pay the fee via beforeSwap delta; exact-input swaps pay via afterSwap delta. Rates are adjustable by an owner/operator within configured bounds.

hook.name: ElevatorHook
hook.description: Single-pool ELE/WETH hook that charges state-dependent monetary fees (routed to reserve vaults for buybacks, stability, and revenue) and maintains an on-chain TWAP price oracle. Also triggers automated protocol actions — compression swaps, liquidity management, and expansion tranches — clocked by each swap callback.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpads that gates pool creation and all liquidity management exclusively to the factory, permanently locks single-sided launch token liquidity, and charges a linearly-decaying anti-snipe fee plus a base fee (split among creator, platform, and referrer) taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta and credited as ERC-6909 claims to a FeeEscrow.

hook.name: EZLPFeeSplitHook
hook.description: Skims one-third of the static pool LP fee (25% of the LP's chosen total fee) from exact-input swap amounts via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, accruing fees per token in the hook's balance on Robinhood Chain until the owner withdraws them to a configurable treasury address.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad hook for memecoins with block+1 anti-snipe protection, a permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, a decaying anti-snipe fee premium, and automatic graduation to a standard 1% dynamic-fee pool once the curve fills.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: A fee hook for coin/pair-token V4 pools (LP fee 0) that takes a configurable fee in the pair token on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanics. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager, then are split at claim time: the creator leg is paid in the pair token, and the protocol leg is converted to WETH via a frozen V3 route (direct single-hop or 2-hop via USDG with TWAP floors).

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH fee (in pips) on every swap through registered pools, taking fees on both the specified and unspecified WETH leg via beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta accounting. Fees accrue per-pool and are distributed to immutable project and protocol treasuries via a permissionless claim() function.

hook.name: RdogTaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook for the rdog.fun meme-coin launchpad that deducts a configurable tax from every swap's output in afterSwap. On buys (ETH→token), it burns a percentage of the token output immediately; on sells (token→ETH), it splits the ETH output among a dividend pool, a buyback reserve, and a platform fee recipient.

hook.name: StonkBirdsFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a native ETH/STONKBIRDS pool that charges a fixed 2% ETH fee on swaps (175 bps to NestBoosterPot, 25 bps to PolVault). Uses beforeSwap return delta when ETH is the specified currency and afterSwap return delta otherwise. Only ETH/STONKBIRDS pools may attach; owner can whitelist fee-exempt addresses.

hook.name: BangHook
hook.description: Fee-taking hook for ETH-paired pools that charges a creator rate (1–5%) plus an immutable 1% platform fee on every swap. Fees are accrued as ERC-6909 claims and can be permissionlessly swept to an immutable platform wallet or per-pool dividend vaults.

hook.name: SealDaoFeeHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for a single ETH/SEAL token pool that levies a 1% DAO fee on native ETH swap amounts via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns. A treasury address can permanently disable fee collection.

hook.name: ArkHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (up to 5%) from swaps on registered tokens by taking a cut of the swap input or output via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Accumulated fees are stored as a claimable bounty for each token's designated captain and can be harvested at any time.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a flat 5% fee on all swaps, always denominated in ETH (currency0), by skimming from the specified amount in beforeSwap or the ETH leg in afterSwap and forwarding to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable fee in WETH on every swap through registered pools, using return-delta accounting to take the fee on whichever swap leg is WETH. Accrued fees are split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury and claimed via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: UnihoodHook
hook.description: A single global hook for UNIHOOD pools on Robinhood Chain that charges a time-decaying swap fee (15% → 5% → 1%) on the native-ETH side, split among creator, a self-building bid wall (single-sided ETH liquidity placed below spot), and a platform treasury. External LP is locked until pool graduation. All fee parameters are immutable at deploy.

hook.name: RobinhoodV4SelectableFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1.5% base fee plus a configurable creator fee (0–10%), collected only in the payment token (not the launch token). Pool creation and liquidity additions are restricted to a factory and position manager; fees are distributed as ERC-6909 claims to a recipient set immutably at pool registration.

hook.name: ZeroRWAHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for RWA-paired token pools that extracts a configurable basis-point fee from each swap (varying by direction and exactness) and forwards the collected fees to a factory contract for distribution to token creators.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that seeds single-sided liquidity for new token pools, applies dynamic swap fees driven by each token's on-chain tax rate, collects and converts LP fees, routing proceeds to the token's fee distribution function. Also supports token buybacks triggered by the registered launch token contract.

hook.name: TweetPadV8InitializationHook
hook.description: A beforeInitialize-only hook that gates pool creation to a trusted adapter contract verified by runtime bytecode hash and portal address. Enforces that only WETH pairs with a fixed 0.3% fee and tick spacing of 60 can be initialized through the hook.

hook.name: GazzFeeHook
hook.description: A fee hook for gazz.fun V4 pools that charges a flat 2% ETH fee on every swap, taken from the ETH side of the trade and forwarded to a GazzFeeSplitter. Only native ETH pools (currency0 = address(0)) are accepted; non-ETH pools are rejected in beforeInitialize.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that collects buy/sell fees on every swap and distributes them between the token creator, a platform treasury, and referral tiers. Enforces time-based anti-snipe and fair launch buy-size windows, with optional buyback-and-burn and dividend routing to token holders.

hook.name: IgnisHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for tokens launched via the Ignis factory that takes a percentage of swap quote amounts from the swap delta. Applies an elevated anti-snipe tax on buys during the first N blocks after token launch; accumulated fees are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: RingHook
hook.description: Applies a fixed 2% toll on a single pinned ETH/RING pool via afterSwap. On buys (ETH→RING), 2% of RING received is sent to the burn address (0xdead); on sells (RING→ETH), 2% of ETH received is forwarded to the immutable deployer address. The toll rate is a compiled constant with no admin controls or setters.

hook.name: V4rcadeFeeHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook for a single ETH/token pool that applies a configurable base fee and optionally grants discounted fees through signed EIP-712 vouchers. Liquidity is restricted to allowlisted providers with full-range-only positions and same-block-withdrawal protection.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 5% fee on all swaps (buys and sells), always collected in native ETH (currency0) and forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address. Fee is taken in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency, or in afterSwap when ETH is the unspecified (output) currency.

hook.name: FactoryHook
hook.description: A factory hook for bonding-curve token pools that gates swaps on pool graduation (`isLPd()`), computes dynamic LP fees based on volatility via a configurable fee chain, and splits fees between LPs and a protocol treasury, with optional observer notifications after each swap.

hook.name: BeaconProxy Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook deployed as an OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy, delegating all calls to an upgradeable implementation via a beacon contract. Only the proxy source is verified; the implementation at 0xca3EB46Cc39c7426307c36BAFC97F585c6244884 is unverified, so swap behavior cannot be determined from available source.

hook.name: FlowHookSS
hook.description: A launch-tax hook for single-sided ETH/token pools that extracts a configurable fee (0.5–10%) plus a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge (up to +4% for the first 60 seconds) from ETH-leg swaps as ERC-6909 claim tokens. Accrued claims are redeemed for real ETH and routed to FLOW baskets (0.25% of trade) and the pool's own token holders (remainder).

hook.name: CashCatQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by CashCat launch pools that charges a quote-leg fee (up to 10%) on every swap, minting proceeds as ERC-6909 claims to an immutable liquidity locker, and latches a graduation milestone when the locked position's paired-currency value meets a configured threshold. Pool creation is restricted to the CashCat launchpad and requires a zero LP fee.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches denominated in a tokenized stock quote currency. Charges a per-pool fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at launch, split 80/5/15 to creator/bid-wall/platform), manages a single-sided bid wall liquidity position below spot price funded by the wall fee share, and locks liquidity to only the factory and hook until the pool price reaches a graduation tick.

hook.name: NeonHook
hook.description: A fee-extraction hook for factory-deployed tokens that charges layered buy-side fees (protocol hook fee + per-token tax + anti-snipe premium scaled by blocks since launch) and drains 60% of sell proceeds from non-creator sellers. Fees are accumulated as claimable balances for the token creator and distributed via a factory registry.

hook.name: CashCatHook
hook.description: Fee engine for CashCat pools that skims a configurable ETH-side trading fee from every swap, covering both exact-input and exact-output directions. Supports an optional launch window with a higher fee that decays linearly to a base rate; fees are split between a platform treasury and the pool creator. Pool liquidity is locked at launch — LP removal always reverts.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only the afterInitialize flag set. All hook callbacks are pure no-ops. The hook exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a realized-volatility fee on every swap in the pool's quote currency. The fee rate ranges linearly from a base to a maximum (1%–5.3%) based on how far the previous swap moved the price (tick delta). Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep function. Exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: Lev7FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 3% fee on buys of a designated fee token, routing fees directly to a treasury address. Handles exact-in buys in beforeSwap and exact-out buys in afterSwap via return deltas. Includes a tick oracle that records pre-swap observations at configurable intervals.

hook.name: RookHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for tokenized US equities that sets LP fees based on the US equity market session derived from block.timestamp — 30 bps during regular hours, 60 bps pre/post-market, 100 bps when closed, with a 300 bps decaying surcharge at market open and a 2500 bps genesis decay on first liquidity add. All fees accrue to LPs.

hook.name: HoodLocksFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for ETH/token pools launched via HoodLocksLaunch. Charges 1–7% ETH fees directly from swap inputs (buys) and outputs (sells), scaling with the previous swap's tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound factory address.

hook.name: MarketMakerHook
hook.description: A protocol-owned automated market maker hook that places structured ask ladders above spot and recycles captured USDC into bid positions. Charges a flat fee on all swaps and a depth-based zone tax on sells, using beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas to skim fees in-flight. No admin, no upgrade path, and no keeper dependency.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize callback (no-op) and provides an `initializePools()` function for bootstrapping initial liquidity and recording the pool tick via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract.

hook.name: StockRipTokenHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/StockRipToken pools that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps, routing fees to an owner-set address (buys: fee taken in StockRipToken and swapped to ETH via an internal pool swap; sells: fee taken in ETH). Pool initialization and seed liquidity are gated on the token's `launching()` flag. Buy access is governance-gated via `externalBuysEnabled`; until enabled, only owner-registered protocol buyers may purchase.

hook.name: MintFastHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 2% ETH fee on every swap, collected via ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager. Fees accrue per token and can be harvested by the launchpad address via a collect() function.

hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 1.5% ETH fee on both buy (ETH→token) and sell (token→ETH) swaps. Fees are always taken in ETH to avoid token sell pressure, then distributed on-chain to token holders (via DividendToken.fundPot), the pool creator, platform, and ops addresses.

hook.name: YunaFeeHook
hook.description: Applies directional ETH fees on swaps in a native ETH pool: a buy fee (ETH-specified swaps) is routed to a holder pool via BeforeSwapDelta, and a sell fee (ETH-unspecified swaps) is split between a team treasury and holder pool via AfterSwapDelta. All fees are taken in currency0 (native ETH) using poolManager.take().

hook.name: CookHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve token launch hook for Uniswap v4 that manages a main liquidity band, charges protocol and creator swap fees via the afterSwap return delta, and atomically graduates a launch when the target price is reached — burning the main band position, re-pooling the raised base as a permanently locked buy-wall position (Position 3), and optionally initiating a TWAP buy program.

hook.name: StaticsLaunchLiquidityHook
hook.description: A launch-pool hook for the Statics protocol that charges configurable bilateral hook fees (separate input and output fee rates, up to 10% each) on swaps, routing proceeds as ERC-6909 claims to a mutable fee receiver. Pools must be registered by an authorized operator and explicitly activated before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: NoCurveHook
hook.description: Takes a 1% input-side fee on exact-input swaps in WETH-paired pools via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, escrowing fees per launched token. Only the designated launchpad address can collect escrowed WETH and token fees for creator/referrer/platform distribution.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: A fixed 5% fee hook for a native ETH / $REEFGUARD pool that always collects fees in ETH regardless of swap direction. In beforeSwap it skims the ETH fee when ETH is the specified currency; in afterSwap it skims from the ETH leg when ETH is unspecified. Fees are forwarded to an immutable feeRecipient address via poolManager.take().

hook.name: BlockEcho
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the absolute swap amount's last two decimal digits to match the current block number's last two digits within a circular tolerance of ±2; reverts otherwise. Inherits a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee taken from the unspecified currency on every swap via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to an immutable factory address, preventing front-running of pool setup by unauthorized callers. Has no swap-time flags and never intervenes in trades; the creator's fee is encoded in the static pool fee.

hook.name: PackrFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based ETH fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools, charging fees between 1% and 5.12% based on the previous swap's tick movement. Buy fees are deducted from ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from ETH output in afterSwap. Only exact-input swaps are supported — exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: LPFarmHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for stock/LP farming pools that overrides LP fees with a dynamic 85/15 split between LPs and a protocol treasury, supports a time-based anti-snipe launch curve, and auto-pauses pools when a corporate action (stock split or dividend) is detected.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A configurable fee-collecting hook that charges buy/sell fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients across three fee modes (Basic, Utility, Rewards). Pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated by a launch manager, and liquidity removal is permanently locked.

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHookV6
hook.description: Token launchpad hook (BaseStonk) that collects configurable buy/sell taxes after each swap via delta return, splitting fees between a platform treasury and creator payees. Supports optional token burn, single-sided liquidity reinvestment from fees, and a time-decaying sniper tax during the launch window.

hook.name: RewardHook
hook.description: Collects a fee (3% base, up to 20% during a 5-minute launch window) on the quote-token side of every swap via before/afterSwap return deltas, then splits the accrued fees between a holder distributor contract, a protocol fee recipient, and a buyback wallet.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: A JIT liquidity hook that deploys concentrated LP positions across multiple tick ranges before each swap and removes them after, backed by ERC-4626 vault rehypothecation for idle capital. Pool fees are static (set at creation via PoolKey.fee and explicitly rejects dynamic-fee pools); hookData is ignored on swaps.

hook.name: ScaleProxy
hook.description: ERC1967 upgradeable proxy for the Scale protocol, delegating hook logic to an upgradeable implementation. The proxy exposes beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, beforeSwap, and afterSwap permissions; the implementation source is not verified, so swap behavior could not be fully analyzed.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered dynamic fee hook for bonding-curve token launches. Charges ETH fees on buys via dynamic LP fee override and on exact-input sells by taking ETH output via afterSwap delta, accumulating sell fees in the hook for off-path collection by a privileged locker.

hook.name: Frontier FactoryHook
hook.description: Singleton hook governing graduated BCToken pools; blocks swaps until the coin is graduated (`isLPd`), then charges time-decayed volatility-based fees split between LP positions (via dynamic LP fee override) and protocol (via hook delta). The non-LP share is distributed to the protocol treasury, staking vault, and fee recipient via a two-level waterfall.

hook.name: RiftHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that collects configurable protocol and creator fees on swaps, with a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge applied during the initial blocks after each token's launch.

hook.name: TTPFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TTP/ETH pools that charges a fixed percentage fee (up to 5%) in native ETH on both buys and sells, routing the fee to a treasury address via delta-based taking in beforeSwap and afterSwap.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A tokenized-stock Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at pool launch) split between creator (80%), a bid-wall budget (5%), and a platform treasury (15%). It auto-rebuilds a single-sided quote-token liquidity position below spot price using accumulated wall fees, and restricts external liquidity additions until the pool graduates past a configured tick.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization to a designated launchpad address (via afterInitialize) and emits a PoolSwap event on every swap for off-chain indexing. No hook deltas are applied and swap execution is unmodified.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An ERC-1967 upgradeable proxy that delegates all Uniswap v4 hook calls to an unverified implementation address. The hook address encodes all 14 permission flags; actual hook behavior cannot be assessed from the proxy-only verified source.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable WETH fee on every swap in NASDANK-launched Uniswap v4 pools, using beforeSwap and afterSwap return-delta mechanics to deduct fees from the WETH leg regardless of swap direction or exactness. Accrued WETH is split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury, claimable permissionlessly via claim().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that only uses afterInitialize, which is a no-op returning the selector. An external initializePools() function calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized. No swap, liquidity, or donate logic is modified.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A tokenized-stock launch hook that charges a fixed per-pool swap fee (0–5%, set at launch and immutable) split 80/5/15 between creator, a quote-token bid wall, and the platform. The bid wall is automatically rebuilt one tick spacing below spot after each swap; liquidity additions are restricted to the factory and hook until the pool graduates.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An ERC1967 upgradeable proxy deployed as a Uniswap v4 hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnsDelta, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions. The implementation contract is not verified; swap behavior is determined by an unverified implementation behind the proxy.

hook.name: SpcxStrategyHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for a single ETH/SPCXSTR pool that charges a decaying buy tax (95%→10% at ~1%/min via block.timestamp) and a flat 10% sell tax via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Token-denominated fees are converted to ETH mid-swap via a nested pool swap; ETH shortfalls are deferred as ERC-6909 claims. Collected ETH is split 90/10 between a mutable controller address and a dev address. Exact-output swaps are unconditionally reverted.

hook.name: ApexHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable flat fee (in basis points) on every swap for factory-registered token pools, routing fees to the token creator's claimable balance. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to extract fees from both exact-input and exact-output swap directions.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: Charges configurable directional buy/sell fees on native ETH/token pools, splitting proceeds between a creator reward vault (authenticated via a fee-split vault factory) and a fixed launcher fee recipient. Fees are applied via BeforeSwapDelta for native-specified swaps and via afterSwap return delta for token-specified swaps.

hook.name: ReefGuardFeeHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 5% fee on every swap (buy and sell), always collected in ETH (currency0), and sends it to an immutable feeRecipient address. Uses beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas to skim ETH regardless of which leg is specified.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic fees via a truncated geometric oracle with surge pricing. Charges a configurable protocol fee plus a hardcoded 0.10% undisclosed additional fee on every swap (both exact-in and exact-out), and reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook (pmav.fun quoted lane) that launches fixed-supply coins paired with a quote ERC20 token via a concentrated curve position. Enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, a 1% fee split 70/30 creator/platform, block+1 anti-snipe gating, and decaying anti-snipe premium on buys. Auto-graduates to a full-range position when the curve sells out 800M tokens.

hook.name: UnifartHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for tokens launched via the Unifart factory that deducts a configurable basis-point fee from each swap's quote-token amount using the return-delta mechanism, with an elevated anti-snipe tax applied during the first N blocks after a token's launch. Fees accumulate as claimable balances for token creators.

hook.name: QuiverHookS
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for launchpad pools where launched tokens trade against tokenized stocks. Skims a configurable tax on every swap's unspecified-side output, accumulates fees, and on harvest distributes them 50% to token holders (routed through reward stocks via USDG), 25% to the pool creator, and 25% to the protocol treasury.

hook.name: PopHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated $POP meme token pools. Takes a combined hook fee and creator fee from each swap's unspecified currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Launch-token fees are batched and converted to the quote token via an internal pool swap at sweep time, then split among protocol, creator, and a cashback mode (QuoteBurn burns to dead address, HolderRewards distributes to token holders). Curve-phase pools also apply a decaying snipe tax on early buys.

hook.name: WobbHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the wobb.fun token launch platform. Intercepts swaps on registered tokens to collect platform and maker fees, apply anti-snipe and founder-sell surcharges, route dividends, and trigger auto buyback-and-burn of the launched token and/or the platform $WOBB token. Enforces a configurable staker-only early-access window and per-wallet buy cap during the guard window.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize permission enabled; the hook callback itself is a no-op, while a separate initializePools() function delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: EnvyCapital
hook.description: A combined ERC20 token and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 3% ETH fee on every swap, distributing 70% to token holders weighted by balance × hold-time multiplier (1×–2× ramping over time) and 30% to a restore stream for holders with ≥100 tokens; exact-out sells are unsupported and revert.

hook.name: VerdantHook
hook.description: Fee schedule hook for Verdant markets that overrides LP fees in beforeSwap based on a pre-configured, time-based stage schedule stored per pool. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the Verdant factory, making pools immutable after creation. No upgrade path, no delegatecall, no custody of assets.

hook.name: porkFeeHook
hook.description: Collects immutable buy and sell tax fees on the WETH leg of a single token pool, splitting proceeds between a marketing receiver and a stock rewards controller via PoolManager ERC-6909 delta credits.

hook.name: CLOCKFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-adaptive swap-fee hook for ETH/token pools launched via the CLOCK launchpad. Charges fees in native ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling between a configurable base and max rate (0.3%–5%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Only supports exact-input swaps; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: LeshyClassicQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Leshy's classic fixed-supply token pools that deducts a controller-governed treasury fee on each swap, denominated in the pool's quote asset. Fees are accumulated as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and redeemable to the treasury address defined by the fee controller.

hook.name: TollHookV1
hook.description: Anti-sniper fee hook that charges a flat buy fee and tiered sell fees based on hold duration (sniper <30min, warm 30min–4h, holder 4h–24h, diamond >24h). Uses tx.origin to track traders through routers, collects native (ETH) fees split between a creator reward vault and a protocol recipient.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade, splitting them between the token creator and treasury. A creator-configured fraction of the creator's fee share is earmarked for automatic buyback-and-burn of the launched token. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the blocks immediately after launch and a time-limited surcharge on sells from the original deployer address.

hook.name: PremiumLaunchHook
hook.description: Launch hook for meme tokens that locks initial liquidity via a dedicated locker, charges a fixed 1% fee on pair-token swaps, and splits fee proceeds 70% to the pool creator and 30% to a platform treasury via a FeeEscrow contract.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: LaunchHook charges a fixed 1% fee on ETH/token swaps: for ETH→token buys, it takes the fee from the ETH input via beforeSwap delta; for token→ETH sells, it takes the fee from the ETH output via afterSwap delta. Fees are forwarded to a factory contract (set once by a governor) via depositFees for creator/platform distribution.

hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized-stock launch pools that charges a fixed swap fee (0–5%, chosen at launch and immutable) split among the creator, a bid wall, and a platform treasury. After each swap, it automatically rebuilds a single-sided quote-token liquidity range just below spot price, with captured tokens permanently sequestered.

hook.name: RiboV4TaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook for native/token pools that applies a 1.5% buy tax (taken from native input before swap) and a 1.5% sell tax (taken from native output after swap), routing collected taxes to a configurable revenue router. Only exact-input swaps on admin-registered pools are supported; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: PulseHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook for a token launch platform (Pulse) that charges buy/sell fees and time-decaying anti-snipe fees during early blocks after launch. Fees are taken from the quote currency and routed to token creators' claimable balances. Tokens must be registered via the factory contract before fee logic activates.

hook.name: ReflectionFeeHook
hook.description: A fixed 2% swap fee hook for graduated reflection-token pools. It collects ETH fees via return-delta callbacks in beforeSwap (for ETH-specified swaps) and afterSwap (for token-specified swaps), forwarding fees to the factory's per-token creditGraduatedFee() bucket. Pool creation is restricted to the factory's graduator contract via beforeInitialize.

hook.name: RampHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for bonding curve pools that applies dynamic LP fees: an elevated anti-snipe tax during a configurable window after launch, falling back to a per-pool or global platform fee. Liquidity additions are restricted to an owner-managed allowlist of approved callers.

hook.name: CrossrateTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a per-swap tax (3–10% in BPS) on swaps involving the pool's registered quote currency, accruing fees as pool manager claim tokens split between the coin creator and a platform wallet. Anyone can call `distribute` to redeem accrued fees, optionally routing payouts through USDG into native ETH via two hookless pool swaps.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A full-range liquidity hook that applies a dynamic LP fee (base + surge) computed by an external DynamicFeeManager, charges a protocol POL share plus an undisclosed extra 0.10% fee on every swap, reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position, and records truncated geometric mean oracle observations for volatility-adaptive fee tuning.

hook.name: ChancePool
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a staker-funded betting pool where players wager USD against stakers for provably-fair outcomes (Strike/Range/Ladder modes). Gates CHANCE token purchases via owner-settable flags and charges a configurable swap fee taken from the unspecified currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: NiceHoodV4Hook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to an authorized graduation adapter address. After each swap, opportunistically calls vault.claim() to distribute LP fees for the swapped token, throttled by a configurable interval to avoid excessive calls.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Implements only `afterInitialize` (a no-op callback that returns the selector). Exposes `initializePools()` which calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` to bootstrap initial liquidity and records the resulting tick. Does not affect swaps in any way.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable fee (in pips) on both swap directions, taken in the designated pair token. Fees are accrued as ERC-6909 claims and distributed between a project treasury (pair token) and a protocol treasury (WETH via a frozen DIRECT/VIA_USDG conversion route). Pools must be registered by an admin-controlled launcher before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: CBLaunchV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for CBLaunch pools that restricts liquidity additions to the launcher address only (closedLiquidity option) and records on-chain price history (tick-cumulative observations) in afterSwap, replicating Uniswap V3-style TWAP for V4 pools that lack native price history.

hook.name: CookHook
hook.description: Graduation hook for Cook launch pools that charges protocol swap fees and creator taxes via ERC-6909 claims in afterSwap, and atomically graduates a pool once the price reaches the launch target by burning the main liquidity band and re-pooling the raise as a permanently locked buy wall (Position 3).

hook.name: Friar
hook.description: A dynamic LP fee hook that tracks per-pool swap volatility using a volatility accumulator with configurable filter and decay periods. On each swap, the accumulator updates based on tick movement and computes a fee that surges with volatility and decays afterward, hard-capped at a maximum, returned as a beforeSwap LP fee override with zero delta.

hook.name: TipOffFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $TIPOFF/ETH pool that applies a fixed 5% fee on all buys and sells, always collecting the fee in ETH (currency0) via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and forwarding it to an immutable feeRecipient address.

hook.name: SettlePermissionHook
hook.description: Gates Uniswap v4 pool initialization to a permissioned settle adapter via a one-shot authorize(poolId) allowlist; unauthorized initializations revert. Liquidity operations after initialization are unrestricted. Has no swap hooks.

hook.name: PreSaleHook
hook.description: A presale hook that gates swaps during a configurable time window to a Merkle-proof allowlist, enforces buy-only direction (zeroForOne), and tracks per-buyer token purchase caps to prevent exceeding an immutable cap.

hook.name: HypzFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-based ETH fee hook for HypzLaunch pools. Charges fees in native ETH — buys pay on input in beforeSwap, sells pay on ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales between a configurable base and max rate (both capped 1%–6.6%) based on tick movement of the prior swap. Exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: ParadygmHook
hook.description: A tax hook for the $PARADYGM token that deducts a configurable buy/sell tax (up to 25% each) from every swap via afterSwap. It returns a positive delta on the unspecified currency to reduce the swapper's output, then calls poolManager.take() to transfer the fee to a treasury address. Tax rates and treasury are settable by an owner who can optionally renounce control.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain token. Declares the afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in any hook callback — all callbacks are pure stubs. Liquidity bootstrapping and initial tick recording are handled via a separate initializePools() function that calls an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: SPRMFeeHook

hook.name: OFAHook
hook.description: An orderflow auction hook that intercepts large exact-input swaps in `beforeSwap`, minting ERC-6909 claims inside PoolManager to custody the user's input. Solvers compete off-chain to fill at a better price; if no solver wins within the auction window, the hook falls back to executing the swap through the AMM.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts liquidity additions to per-pool whitelisted modules via an onlyModule guard, and dynamically overrides LP fees in beforeSwap based on swap direction.

hook.name: OkMemeTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 tax hook for meme tokens that collects marketing, dividend, buyback, and burn fees on exact-input swaps. Fees are deducted from swap amounts via return deltas and forwarded to a settler contract for distribution, or burned by sending to address(0xdead). Exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: LaunchGuardV4Hook
hook.description: A fair-launch Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees across multiple launch phases (guarded, cooldown, graduated), enforces per-wallet and per-transaction buy limits, locks creator liquidity, and redistributes penalty fees from suspicious trades into a community rebate pool.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A pot-based buyback hook that absorbs main-token sells at the pool price via a funded shield (beforeSwap delta), executes buyback pumps on every buy of the main token, and auto-harvests LP fees for splitting and compounding back into the liquidity position.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A dynamic fee management hook that computes swap fees from a policy manager and dynamic fee manager, collects protocol fees as hook deltas on both exactIn and exactOut swaps, and optionally reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position. Uses transient storage and a truncated geometric oracle to record pre-swap ticks for fee volatility adjustments.

hook.name: VolGuardHook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on trade size and an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of recent trade volumes. Small trades pay 0.05%, with fees escalating to 0.3%, 1%, or 2% for larger or volatility-spiking trades. Optionally accepts pool TVL via hookData to use a ratio-based fee model instead of absolute thresholds.

hook.name: OkMemeTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the OkMeme launchpad that collects swap taxes (marketing, dividend, buyback, and burn fees) on both buy and sell sides via delta adjustments in beforeSwap and afterSwap. Optional hookData (a 4-byte magic value) opts into gas-bounded post-sell settlement and liquidity reflow.

hook.name: SUBAHook
hook.description: Implements a sealed-bid uniform-price batch auction over Uniswap v4 pools. Incoming exact-input swaps are buffered per epoch via ERC-6909 minting in beforeSwap (suppressing AMM execution); a permissioned keeper settles each epoch at a single uniform clearing price, matching buy and sell volume proportionally and distributing outputs to per-order user addresses.

hook.name: OkMemeTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects configurable buy/sell taxes on registered meme token pools, burning a portion of tokens to address(0xdead) and routing fees to a settler contract for dividends, marketing, and buyback distribution.

hook.name: SashaDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that adjusts the LP fee on each swap by querying an immutable oracle address. Falls back to a default fee of 0.3% (3000) if the oracle signal is stale (no update within 6 hours).

hook.name: HypersFunHook
hook.description: NAV-anchored tokenized-fund market hook on X Layer implementing a bonding curve (x*y=k) AMM for FUND/USDC swaps. The hook fully handles each swap by minting or burning FUND shares, collecting trading and exit fees, enforcing NAV-based price ceilings, and blocking external LP positions. hookData encoding the seller address and minOut slippage limit is required for sell swaps.

hook.name: OkMemeTaxHook
hook.description: Collects directional swap taxes on OK.MEME graduated Uniswap v4 pools. On each swap, burn fees are sent to address(0xdead) and marketing/dividend/buyback fees are forwarded to a settler contract, both taken via return deltas. Only exact-input swaps are supported; exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: TokiFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 0.3% fee on each swap's output token by returning a negative delta in afterSwap, accumulating fees as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager. Anyone can call handleHookFees to forward accumulated fees to an immutable treasury address.

hook.name: StrategyHookV2
hook.description: A fee-taking hook that collects dynamic fees from swaps (fixed fee on buys; variable sell fees based on NFT accumulation state and a graduated cooldown mechanism), then distributes collected ETH to a strategy contract (80%) and an optional protocol fee recipient (20%). Locks liquidity after initial provision and requires pool initialization with a specific strategy token as currency1.

hook.name: StrategyHookV2
hook.description: A hook that collects fees after each swap at dynamic rates based on buy/sell direction, NFT accumulation state, and a graduated cooldown mechanism. Fees are distributed 80% to an immutable strategy contract and 20% to an optional protocol address; liquidity is permanently locked after the initial load.

hook.name: StrategyHookV2
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that takes dynamic fees from swap outputs in afterSwap and distributes them to a strategy contract (80%) and an optional fee split address (20%). Sells are subject to escalating fees based on NFT accumulation state and a block-based cooldown mechanism. Liquidity additions are permanently locked after initial provision; currency1 must be the strategy contract address.

hook.name: StrategyHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects dynamic swap fees (graduated by sell timing and NFT accumulation state) and distributes them 80/20 between an immutable strategy contract and a configurable protocol fee recipient. Liquidity is permanently locked after the initial provision, and pool initialization is restricted to pools where currency1 is the strategy contract.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback hook that maintains a "pot" of a designated main token: in beforeSwap, it absorbs sell-side pressure by filling sells against the pot at the pool's own price via BeforeSwapDelta (shield); in afterSwap, it buys back main tokens using accumulated secondary tokens (pump). Supports a hook-managed LP position with auto-harvest, auto-compound, buyback, and burn splits.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing dynamic LP fees computed from volatility and surge conditions, a truncated geometric price oracle, and protocol fee collection with reinvestment into full-range liquidity positions. Fees are charged on both exact-input and exact-output swaps.

hook.name: StrategyHookV2
hook.description: Collects dynamic fees from swaps (with graduated cooldown sell fees and a high initial sell fee before first NFT accumulation) via afterSwap delta accounting, distributes them to a strategy contract (80%) and optional protocol fee split (20%), and permanently locks pool liquidity after the initial addition.
